title: Yu the Great founds the Xia
summary: In the traditional histories Yu tamed the great flood and passed the throne to his son Qi, starting hereditary rule.
summary_zh: 据传统史书记载，大禹治平洪水，后来把王位传给儿子启，世袭王权由此开始。

title: Yu assembles the lords at Mount Tu
summary: Tradition holds that Yu summoned the leaders of many tribes to Mount Tu, where ten thousand states brought jade and silk, confirming his supremacy.
summary_zh: 相传大禹会诸侯于涂山，“执玉帛者万国”，确立其共主地位。

title: Qi defeats the Youhu at Gan
place_zh: 甘（传统认为在今陕西西安鄠邑一带）
summary: Yu's son Qi takes the throne. The Youhu clan refuses to accept him, and Qi crushes them at Gan, securing hereditary rule.
summary_zh: 禹的儿子启继承王位。有扈氏不服，启在甘地将其击败，巩固了父死子继的王位传承。

title: Yu casts the Nine Tripod Cauldrons
summary: Yu reputedly collected bronze from the nine provinces and cast nine great cauldrons, which became the symbol of legitimate rule over All-under-Heaven.
summary_zh: 相传禹收九牧之金铸九鼎，象征九州，此后九鼎成为王权正统的象征。

title: Stone city of Shimao
summary: On the Loess Plateau in northern Shaanxi, a walled stone city of more than 400 hectares is at its height, one of the largest settlements of its time in East Asia.
summary_zh: 陕北黄土高原上，一座面积超过400万平方米的石砌城址正处于鼎盛期，是同时代东亚最大的聚落之一。

title: Qi holds the Juntai feast, hereditary rule
summary: Qi, son of Yu, feasted the lords at Juntai after succeeding his father, replacing the abdication system with hereditary dynastic succession.
summary_zh: 禹之子启继位后大享诸侯于钧台，禅让制为世袭制取代，“家天下”由此开始。

title: Disaster at Lajia
summary: An earthquake and floods bury a village on the upper Yellow River, preserving people where they fell and a bowl of the oldest known noodles.
summary_zh: 一场地震和随后的洪水掩埋了黄河上游的一座村落，遇难者的姿态和一碗已知最古老的面条都被保存了下来。

title: Taikang loses the realm to Houyi
summary: While King Taikang hunted beyond the Luo River, Houyi of the Youqiong clan seized the Xia capital; Han Zhuo later murdered Yi and usurped power.
summary_zh: 太康畋猎于洛水之外，有穷氏后羿乘机夺取夏政；后寒浞又杀羿篡位。

title: Astronomers Xi and He miss an eclipse
summary: The Book of Documents records that the astronomers Xi and He, drunk and negligent, failed to predict a solar eclipse and were punished under King Zhongkang.
summary_zh: 《尚书·胤征》载仲康时羲和沉湎于酒，未能预报日食而受征讨，为最早的日食记载之一。

title: Shao Kang restores the Xia
summary: In the traditional account, after Taikang lost power to Yi of Youqiong and Yi was killed by Han Zhuo, the young heir Shao Kang wins back the throne.
summary_zh: 据传统记载，太康失国，有穷氏后羿夺取政权，后羿又被寒浞所杀；夏的遗孤少康最终夺回王位。

title: Erlitou culture flourishes
summary: A planned site with palace foundations, roads and the earliest Chinese bronze ritual vessels. Many scholars link it to the late Xia capital.
summary_zh: 这里有经过规划的宫殿基址、道路和中国最早的青铜礼器。许多学者认为它就是夏代晚期的都城。

title: Qijia culture works copper
summary: In the upper Yellow River valley, the Qijia people make copper and bronze knives, mirrors and ornaments, part of the early spread of metalworking into China.
summary_zh: 黄河上游的齐家文化先民制作铜和青铜的刀、镜和饰品，这是冶金技术早期传入和扩散到中国境内的一个环节。

title: Jie, the last Xia king
summary: The histories describe Jie as a cruel and wasteful ruler who lost the support of his people and of the lords, opening the way for Tang of Shang.
summary_zh: 史书把桀描写成残暴奢侈的君主，他失去了民心和诸侯的拥护，为商汤取而代之铺平了道路。

title: Tang of Shang destroys Kunwu
summary: Before the final war with Jie, Tang of Shang conquered Xia's allies Wei, Gu and Kunwu, stripping the last Xia king of his supporters.
summary_zh: 商汤先后征灭韦、顾、昆吾等夏的同盟方国，剪除夏桀羽翼，为灭夏铺路。

title: Tang of Shang defeats Jie of Xia
summary: The founder of Shang overthrows the last Xia king, remembered in the histories as a tyrant.
summary_zh: 商的开国君主汤推翻了夏朝末代君主桀。史书中，桀是一个暴君的形象。

title: Tang builds the capital at Western Bo
summary: The walled Shang city at Yanshi, just east of Erlitou, is widely identified with Tang's capital Western Bo, built to watch over the conquered Xia heartland.
summary_zh: 偃师商城紧邻二里头，被认为是商汤所都西亳，用以镇抚夏人故地。

title: Tang prays for rain at Mulberry Grove
summary: During a seven-year drought, Tang offered himself as a sacrifice at the Mulberry Grove, blaming his own faults; rain reportedly fell at once.
summary_zh: 商初大旱七年，汤剪发断爪，以身为牺牲祷于桑林，自责六事，大雨随即降下。

title: Yi Yin sends King Taijia away
summary: The chief minister Yi Yin removes the misbehaving young king Taijia for three years, then hands power back once he has reformed.
summary_zh: 宰相伊尹把行为失当的年轻商王太甲放逐三年，等他改过之后再把政权交还给他。

title: The Shang walled city at Zhengzhou
summary: The early Shang build a huge rammed-earth city at Zhengzhou, with walls nearly 7 km around, palaces and bronze workshops.
summary_zh: 商代前期在郑州建起一座巨大的夯土城，城墙周长近7公里，城内有宫殿和铸铜作坊。

title: Panlongcheng, a Shang outpost on the Yangtze
place_zh: 盘龙城（今湖北武汉黄陂）
summary: A walled town with Shang-style bronzes and palaces stands near the Yangtze, far south of the Shang heartland, probably to control copper and trade routes.
summary_zh: 长江边出现一座带城墙的城邑，有商式青铜器和宫殿，远离商的腹地，很可能是为了控制铜料和交通要道。

title: Zhongding moves the capital to Ao
summary: King Zhongding moved the capital to Ao, opening a century of repeated relocations and succession struggles that the Records call the Nine Reigns of Disorder.
summary_zh: 仲丁迁都于隞，此后王位纷争、屡次迁都，史称“九世之乱”，商朝一度衰落。

title: Zu Yi relocates the capital to Xing
summary: After floods at Xiang, King Zu Yi moved the Shang court to Xing and, aided by the minister Wu Xian, briefly restored royal strength.
summary_zh: 河亶甲居相后，祖乙迁都于邢，任用巫贤，商朝复兴。

title: Huanbei Shang City
summary: Just north of the later Yin capital, a large square walled city is built and then abandoned, a missing link between early and late Shang.
summary_zh: 在后来殷都的北侧，一座方形大城建成后不久又被废弃，它填补了商代前后期之间的空白。

title: Pan Geng moves the capital to Yin
summary: The Shang settle at Yin, which stays the capital until the dynasty falls. Its ruins are the source of most Shang finds.
summary_zh: 商人定都于殷，此后直到灭亡再没有迁都。商代文物大多出自殷墟。

title: Oracle bone inscriptions
summary: Under King Wu Ding, diviners carve questions to the ancestors on turtle shells and ox bones, the earliest known Chinese writing.
summary_zh: 商王武丁时期，占卜者把向祖先提出的问题刻在龟甲和牛骨上，这是已知最早的汉字。

title: Wu Ding raises the laborer Fu Yue
summary: Wu Ding claimed to have dreamt of a sage and found him among convict wall-builders at Fuyan; as chief minister, Fu Yue helped make Wu Ding's reign the Shang zenith.
summary_zh: 武丁梦得圣人，于傅岩版筑之间得傅说，举以为相，殷道复兴，史称“武丁中兴”。

title: Wu Ding's war against the Guifang
summary: King Wu Ding fights a three-year war against the Guifang, a powerful people on the northwestern frontier.
summary_zh: 商王武丁对西北边境强大的鬼方发动战争，历时三年才将其征服。

title: Shang campaigns against the Qiang
place_zh: 商西部边地（今晋南豫西）
summary: Oracle bones record large Shang levies against the Qiang, whose captives were frequently sacrificed in royal rituals at Yin.
summary_zh: 甲骨文记载商王屡次征伐羌方，俘获的羌人常被用作祭祀人牲。

title: Sanxingdui bronze culture
summary: A separate bronze civilisation in Sichuan casts huge masks and figures unlike anything made by the Shang.
summary_zh: 四川盆地另有一支青铜文明，铸造出巨大的面具和人像，风格与商人截然不同。

title: Fu Hao leads the Shang armies
summary: Fu Hao, a wife of King Wu Ding, commands armies and leads rituals. Her untouched tomb, found in 1976, held nearly 2,000 objects.
summary_zh: 商王武丁的妻子妇好既统率军队，又主持祭祀。她的墓1976年被发现时完好无损，出土了近两千件器物。

title: Bronze culture flourishes at Xin'gan
summary: A rich tomb at Xin'gan with nearly 500 bronzes shows the Wucheng culture of the Gan River valley developed its own sophisticated bronze tradition alongside the Shang.
summary_zh: 江西新干大洋洲大墓出土青铜器近五百件，显示赣江流域吴城文化拥有与商并行的发达青铜文明。

title: Four-goat square zun cast in the south
summary: The Four-goat square zun, found at Ningxiang in Hunan, is the largest Shang square zun and a masterpiece of piece-mold casting from the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 湖南宁乡出土的四羊方尊是现存最大的商代方尊，展现了长江中游高超的分范铸造工艺。

title: Casting the Houmuwu ding
summary: Shang bronze casters make an 830-kilogram cauldron for a royal mother, the heaviest bronze vessel known from ancient China.
summary_zh: 商代工匠为一位王室之母铸造了一件重约830公斤的大鼎，这是中国古代已知最重的青铜器。

title: King Wu Yi insults Heaven
place: Between the Yellow and Wei rivers
summary: King Wu Yi made an effigy of Heaven to gamble against and shot at a leather bag of blood; Sima Qian records he was killed by lightning while hunting.
summary_zh: 武乙为偶人谓之天神而与之博，又以革囊盛血仰射之，后猎于河渭之间被雷震死。

title: Danfu leads the Zhou to Zhouyuan
summary: Pressed by raiders, the Zhou chief Danfu moves his people to the plain below Mount Qi, where the Zhou grow into a strong state.
summary_zh: 受到戎狄侵扰，周族首领古公亶父率众迁到岐山脚下的周原，周人在这里逐渐强大起来。

title: King Wen Ding kills Zhou leader Jili
summary: Alarmed by the victories of Zhou's leader Jili over the Rong tribes, the Shang king Wen Ding detained and killed him, souring Shang–Zhou relations.
summary_zh: 周首领季历屡败诸戎，势力日强，商王文丁将其拘禁杀害，商周矛盾激化。

title: Pools of wine and forests of meat
summary: Later histories portray Di Xin enlarging Zhaoge, hoarding grain at Juqiao, and feasting at pools of wine and hanging meat, while inventing the burning-pillar punishment.
summary_zh: 帝辛扩建朝歌，厚赋敛以实鹿台、钜桥，以酒为池、悬肉为林，又设炮烙之刑。

title: Di Xin's wars against the Eastern Yi
summary: The last Shang king fights long campaigns against the Yi peoples in the east, winning but draining his strength.
summary_zh: 商朝末代君主帝辛长期征讨东方的夷人，虽然取胜，却耗尽了国力。

title: Jiang Ziya joins King Wen
summary: King Wen met the aged Lü Shang fishing on the Wei River and made him his strategist; as Taigong Wang he planned the overthrow of Shang.
summary_zh: 西伯昌于渭水之滨遇垂钓的吕尚，尊为“太公望”，拜为师，谋划翦商大业。

title: King Wen imprisoned at Youli
summary: Di Xin imprisoned the Zhou leader Chang at Youli, where tradition says he elaborated the 64 hexagrams of the Yijing; Zhou ransomed him with treasures.
summary_zh: 帝辛囚西伯昌于羑里，相传其在狱中推演六十四卦；周人献美女宝马方得赎归。

title: King Wen conquers the state of Li
summary: Zhou's conquest of Li, just west of the Shang capital region, alarmed the minister Zu Yi, whose warning Di Xin dismissed, saying his mandate came from Heaven.
summary_zh: 周伐灭黎国，逼近商都，祖伊惊恐奔告纣王，纣王答曰“我生不有命在天乎”。

title: King Wen of Zhou founds Feng
summary: After conquering Chong, King Wen of Zhou moves his capital east to Feng on the Wei plain, setting up the attack on Shang.
summary_zh: 周文王灭掉崇国后，把都城东迁到渭河平原上的丰邑，为伐商做好了准备。

title: King Wu reviews his allies at Mengjin
summary: Eight hundred lords join King Wu of Zhou at the Mengjin ford, but he judges the time is not yet right and turns back.
summary_zh: 八百诸侯在孟津渡口与周武王会合，但武王认为时机尚未成熟，便率军返回。

title: Bigan is killed for his advice
summary: The king's uncle Bigan warns Di Xin to change his ways and is put to death; other nobles flee or feign madness.
summary_zh: 纣王的叔父比干劝他改过，结果被杀；其他贵族有的出走，有的装疯避祸。

title: Battle of Muye
summary: King Wu of Zhou defeats the last Shang king, who burns himself in his palace. The Zhou justify the conquest as the Mandate of Heaven.
summary_zh: 周武王打败商朝末代君主，纣王在宫中自焚而死。周人把这次征服说成是天命的转移。

title: Taigong Wang founds the state of Qi
summary: Jiang Ziya was enfeoffed in the east at Yingqiu; by simplifying rites, promoting fishing and salt, he built Qi into a prosperous coastal state.
summary_zh: 太公望封于营丘建立齐国，因俗简礼，通商工之业，便鱼盐之利，齐遂成大国。

title: Yan enfeoffed in the far north
summary: The Duke of Shao's line received Yan in the north; bronzes from the Liulihe cemetery confirm the early Zhou capital of Yan near modern Beijing.
summary_zh: 召公奭受封于燕，长子就封；北京房山琉璃河遗址的铭文铜器证实了燕国早期都城。

title: Jizi leads followers to Korea
summary: After the Shang fall, the prince Jizi expounded the Great Plan to King Wu but refused to serve Zhou and went east; tradition says he was enfeoffed in Joseon.
summary_zh: 商亡后箕子向武王陈《洪范》，不愿臣周，东走朝鲜，相传武王因而封之。

title: Boyi and Shuqi starve on Shouyang
summary: Two princes of Guzhu who opposed Zhou's conquest as disloyal refused to eat Zhou grain and starved on Mount Shouyang, becoming paragons of integrity.
summary_zh: 孤竹国伯夷、叔齐叩马谏阻武王伐纣，周灭商后义不食周粟，饿死于首阳山。

title: Zhou grants fiefs to kin and allies
summary: The Zhou kings hand out land to royal relatives and allies, founding states such as Lu, Qi, Yan, Wey and Jin to hold the conquered east.
summary_zh: 周王把土地分给王室亲属和功臣，建立了鲁、齐、燕、卫、晋等诸侯国，用来控制新征服的东方。

title: Rebellion of the Three Guards
place_zh: 商朝故地（今河南安阳一带）
summary: King Wu's brothers, set to watch over the Shang, rise with the Shang prince Wu Geng against the regent Duke of Zhou, who crushes them in a three-year campaign.
summary_zh: 受命监视商人的武王之弟们联合商王子武庚，起兵反对摄政的周公，周公经过三年东征将其平定。

title: The peace of Kings Cheng and Kang
summary: Under Kings Cheng and Kang, Zhou rule settles down. Later writers remember it as a golden age when punishments were not needed for forty years.
summary_zh: 周成王、周康王在位期间，周朝统治趋于稳定。后人把这一时期视为黄金时代，说四十多年没有动用过刑罚。

title: Duke of Zhou's eastern campaign crushes Yan
summary: After suppressing the Three Guards, the Duke of Zhou pushed east, destroying Yan and the Shang-allied Eastern Yi states; Lu was later established on Yan's land.
summary_zh: 平定三监后周公继续东征，灭奄及薄姑等东夷方国，后封伯禽于奄地建立鲁国。

title: Duke of Zhou builds the eastern capital
summary: As regent, the Duke of Zhou crushes a revolt, settles Shang nobles at a new eastern capital and is later credited with the Zhou rites.
summary_zh: 周公摄政期间平定叛乱，把商朝贵族迁到新建的东都；后世还把周代礼制的制定归功于他。

title: The He zun names 'Zhongguo'
summary: A bronze vessel records King Cheng's speech about settling in the centre of the realm; its inscription is the earliest known use of the words 'Zhongguo'.
summary_zh: 一件青铜酒器记录了周成王关于定居天下中心的讲话，铭文中的“中国”二字是这个词已知最早的用例。

title: Duke of Zhou institutes rites and music
summary: The Duke of Zhou is credited with codifying the ritual, kinship and music system of Zhou society, the order Confucius later idealized.
summary_zh: 周公制定礼乐制度，规范宗法、等级与祭祀，成为后世儒家推崇的典范。

title: Duke of Zhou returns power to King Cheng
summary: After seven years as regent, the Duke of Zhou handed full authority back to the grown King Cheng and took his place among the ministers.
summary_zh: 周公摄政七年，成王长成，周公还政于成王，北面就臣位。

title: Shu Yu enfeoffed at Tang (Jin)
summary: King Cheng jokingly gave his brother Shu Yu a paulownia leaf as a token of investiture; held to his word, he enfeoffed him at Tang, origin of Jin.
summary_zh: 成王以桐叶戏封其弟叔虞，史佚曰“天子无戏言”，遂封叔虞于唐，即晋国前身。

title: King Zhao dies on his southern campaign
summary: King Zhao leads armies south against Chu and the Jing peoples. On the last campaign he loses six armies and drowns in the Han River.
summary_zh: 周昭王率军南征楚和荆蛮。最后一次出征时，周军六师覆没，昭王本人也死在汉水中。

title: King Mu's journeys to the west
summary: King Mu campaigns against the Quanrong and, in later legend, drives his eight horses to the far west to meet the Queen Mother of the West.
summary_zh: 周穆王征讨犬戎；后世传说他驾着八匹骏马西行到极远之地，与西王母相会。

title: King Yan of Xu leads the Huai Yi
summary: While King Mu travelled west, Xu led the Huai River peoples against Zhou; tradition says Mu rushed back and, with Chu, defeated King Yan.
summary_zh: 穆王西巡期间，徐偃王率九夷侵周，穆王回师联合楚国击败之。

title: King Mu issues the Lü Xing code
summary: King Mu ordered the Marquis of Lü to draft a penal code allowing fines to redeem punishments, preserved as the 'Lü Xing' chapter of the Book of Documents.
summary_zh: 穆王命吕侯作刑书，以赎刑减轻五刑，此即《尚书·吕刑》。

title: Shi Qiang pan records Zhou history
summary: A scribe's basin with 284 characters praises the Zhou kings from Wen to Gong and the scribe's own lineage, a key primary source for Western Zhou history.
summary_zh: 史墙盘铭文284字，颂扬文王至恭王的功业及微氏家族史，是西周史重要的第一手资料。

title: Feizi is granted the land of Qin
summary: King Xiao rewards the horse breeder Feizi with a small territory called Qin, the beginning of the state that would one day unify China.
summary_zh: 周孝王把一小块名叫“秦”的土地封给善于养马的非子，这就是日后统一中国的秦国的起点。

title: Xiong Qu of Chu names sons kings
summary: Declaring 'I am a barbarian, I do not use Chinese titles', Chu's ruler Xiong Qu made his three sons kings along the Yangtze, defying Zhou.
summary_zh: 楚君熊渠称“我蛮夷也，不与中国之号谥”，立三子为王，与周分庭抗礼。

title: King Yi boils Duke Ai of Qi
summary: On slander from the Lord of Ji, King Yi of Zhou had Duke Ai of Qi boiled alive in a cauldron, a sign of turbulent royal–vassal relations.
summary_zh: 因纪侯谗言，周夷王烹杀齐哀公，周王室与诸侯关系动荡。

title: King Li silences his critics
summary: King Li uses a shaman to report people who criticise him and has them killed. People in the capital stop talking and only exchange glances in the street.
summary_zh: 周厉王派巫师监视批评他的人，发现就杀。国人不敢说话，路上相遇只能用眼神示意。

title: Gonghe Regency
summary: King Li is driven out and the realm is run by regents. 841 BCE is the first year of Chinese history with an exact date.
summary_zh: 周厉王被国人赶走，朝政由大臣共同执掌。公元前841年是中国历史上有确切纪年的开端。

title: King Xuan's restoration
summary: After the regency, King Xuan takes the throne and, with able ministers and generals, restores Zhou power against the northern and southern peoples.
summary_zh: 共和行政结束后，周宣王即位，依靠贤臣良将打退了南北各族的进犯，一度恢复了周王室的威势。

title: Campaign against the Xianyun
summary: Yin Jifu leads Zhou chariots against the Xianyun raiders who had pushed close to the capital, and drives them back north.
summary_zh: 尹吉甫率领周军战车反击逼近都城的猃狁，把他们赶回北方。

title: Qin Zhong killed fighting the Western Rong
summary: King Xuan made Qin Zhong a grandee to fight the Western Rong; he died in battle, and his son Duke Zhuang avenged him with Zhou troops.
summary_zh: 宣王命秦仲为大夫伐西戎，秦仲战死；其子庄公率周兵七千破西戎。

title: Duke Huan founds the state of Zheng
summary: King Xuan gives his younger brother Ji You the fief of Zheng. Later, foreseeing trouble, he moves his family's wealth east.
summary_zh: 周宣王把弟弟姬友封在郑地。后来姬友预见到王室将乱，便把家族财产迁往东方。

title: Mao Gong ding cast for King Xuan
summary: With 497 characters, the Mao Gong ding bears the longest known bronze inscription, recording King Xuan's charge to the Duke of Mao to govern the realm.
summary_zh: 毛公鼎铭文497字，为现存最长的青铜器铭文，记载宣王对毛公的册命。

title: Battle of Qianmu
summary: Late in his reign King Xuan's army is crushed by the Jiang Rong at Qianmu, and the king tries to count the people to rebuild his forces.
summary_zh: 周宣王晚年，王师在千亩被姜戎打得大败，宣王随后在太原清点人口，以图重建军队。

title: King Xuan takes a census at Taiyuan
summary: After losing southern troops at Qianmu, King Xuan counted the population at Taiyuan to raise new levies, despite Zhong Shanfu's warning against the novelty.
summary_zh: 千亩战败后，宣王丧南国之师，于太原料民以补兵员，仲山父谏阻不从。

title: Earthquake shakes the Three Rivers
summary: A great earthquake strikes the Zhou homeland. The court astrologer Bo Yangfu explains it as an imbalance of yin and yang and predicts the fall of Zhou.
summary_zh: 一场大地震袭击了周人的故土。太史伯阳父用阴阳失调来解释地震，并预言周朝将亡。

title: King You favors Bao Si
summary: King You doted on Bao Si, deposed Queen Shen and Crown Prince Yijiu, and later legend says lit the beacons to amuse her, alienating the lords.
summary_zh: 幽王宠爱褒姒，废申后及太子宜臼，传说烽火戏诸侯，失信于天下，为西周覆灭埋下祸根。

title: Fall of Haojing
summary: The Quanrong and rebel lords kill King You, who had lit the beacon fires to amuse his consort. Western Zhou ends.
summary_zh: 犬戎联合反叛的诸侯杀死周幽王——相传他曾为博宠妃一笑而点燃烽火。西周就此结束。

title: King Ping moves the court east
summary: The Zhou court resettles at Luoyi. From now on the king is a figurehead and the great states go their own way.
summary_zh: 周王室迁居洛邑。从此周王只是名义上的天下共主，各大诸侯国各行其是。

title: Qin becomes a full state
summary: Duke Xiang of Qin escorts King Ping east and is made a lord, with a promise of the old Zhou lands west of Mount Qi if he can take them from the Rong.
summary_zh: 秦襄公护送周平王东迁，被正式封为诸侯，平王还许诺：只要能从戎人手中夺回岐山以西的周人故地，就归秦所有。

title: Qin begins keeping official annals
summary: Duke Wen of Qin appointed historians to keep records for the first time, a sign of Qin's adoption of Zhou court culture.
summary_zh: 秦文公十三年，初有史官记事，秦国逐渐吸收周文化。

title: The Spring and Autumn Annals begin
summary: The court chronicle of Lu starts its year-by-year record in 722 BCE. Later edited by tradition by Confucius, it gives the whole era its name.
summary_zh: 鲁国的官方编年史从公元前722年开始逐年记事。相传后来经孔子修订，这个时代也因此得名“春秋”。

title: Duke Zhuang of Zheng defeats his brother
summary: Duke Zhuang let his ambitious brother Gongshu Duan overreach, then crushed his rebellion at Yan, the opening story of the Zuo Zhuan.
summary_zh: 郑庄公纵容其弟共叔段坐大，待其谋反后于鄢击败之，为《左传》开篇名篇。

title: Zhou and Zheng exchange hostages
summary: The Zhou king and Duke Zhuang of Zheng exchanged sons as hostages, a humiliating sign that the Son of Heaven now dealt with vassals as equals.
summary_zh: 周平王与郑庄公互换王子为人质，天子与诸侯对等交质，王室威信扫地。

title: Zhouxu murders Wey's ruler
summary: Zhouxu killed his half-brother Duke Huan to seize Wey; the old minister Shi Que had him and his own son executed, 'destroying kin for righteousness'.
summary_zh: 州吁弑兄卫桓公自立，老臣石碏设计诛杀州吁及参与其事的儿子石厚，“大义灭亲”。

title: Hua Du assassinates Duke Shang of Song
summary: Coveting the wife of Kong Fujia, the Song minister Hua Du killed him and then Duke Shang, installing Duke Zhuang and bribing the neighboring lords.
summary_zh: 宋太宰华督见孔父嘉之妻而杀孔父，又弑宋殇公，迎立公子冯，并贿赂诸侯。

title: Battle of Xuge: Zheng defeats the king
summary: King Huan of Zhou attacks the state of Zheng and is beaten; an arrow wounds him in the shoulder. Royal prestige never recovers.
summary_zh: 周桓王讨伐郑国，结果大败，肩膀还中了一箭。周王室的威信从此一蹶不振。

title: Xiong Tong of Chu declares himself king
summary: Rebuffed when he asked Zhou for a higher rank, Xiong Tong of Chu proclaimed himself King Wu, the first southern ruler to claim parity with Zhou.
summary_zh: 熊通求周室尊其号被拒，遂自立为楚武王，楚国公开与周王室分庭抗礼。

title: Duke Huan of Lu killed in Qi
summary: Visiting Qi with his wife Wen Jiang, who had an affair with her brother Duke Xiang, Duke Huan of Lu was murdered by Qi's strongman Pengsheng.
summary_zh: 鲁桓公与夫人文姜赴齐，文姜与其兄齐襄公私通，襄公使公子彭生拉杀鲁桓公。

title: King Wen of Chu moves to Ying
summary: Chu moved its capital to Ying near the Yangtze, which remained the political center of the southern power for four centuries.
summary_zh: 楚文王定都于郢（纪南城），此后四百余年郢为楚国政治中心。

title: Qin establishes the first counties
summary: After conquering Rong tribes, Duke Wu of Qin set up Gui and Ji as counties governed directly by appointees, an early step toward centralized administration.
summary_zh: 秦武公伐邽、冀戎，初置邽、冀二县，开郡县制先河。

title: Duke Xiang of Qi assassinated
summary: Disgruntled officers killed Duke Xiang and enthroned Gongsun Wuzhi; his own death soon after triggered the race between princes Xiaobai and Jiu.
summary_zh: 齐襄公被连称、管至父所杀，公孙无知自立，旋被杀，公子小白与公子纠争位。

title: Guan Zhong's reforms in Qi
summary: Guan Zhong becomes chief minister of Qi and reorganises its people, taxes and army, and by tradition puts salt and iron under state control.
summary_zh: 管仲出任齐国国相，整顿户籍、赋税和军制，相传还把盐、铁收归官府经营。

title: Battle of Changshao
summary: Advised by Cao Gui, the small state of Lu waits until the Qi army has drummed three times, then charges and wins.
summary_zh: 在曹刿的谋划下，弱小的鲁国等齐军擂过三通鼓后才发起冲锋，结果大获全胜。

title: Cao Mo seizes Duke Huan at Ke
summary: At a covenant with Lu, the Lu officer Cao Mo held Duke Huan at dagger-point to demand return of land; Huan honored the forced promise, earning trust.
summary_zh: 齐鲁柯之盟，曹沫持匕首劫齐桓公索还侵地，桓公守信归地，诸侯由此信服。

title: Duke Huan of Qi becomes the first hegemon
summary: Advised by Guan Zhong, Qi leads the states in defending the Zhou king, a model later hegemons follow.
summary_zh: 在管仲辅佐下，齐国率领诸侯尊奉周王、抵御外敌，成为后来霸主效仿的榜样。

title: Quwo branch seizes the Jin throne
summary: After 67 years of civil war, the cadet branch of Quwo destroyed the senior Jin line at Yi and bribed the Zhou king to recognize Duke Wu.
summary_zh: 晋国小宗曲沃经六十余年征战，终灭大宗翼，曲沃武公以宝器贿周王，获封晋君。

title: Chen Wan flees to Qi
summary: Prince Wan of Chen fled to Qi and took the surname Tian; his descendants would eventually usurp the Qi state.
summary_zh: 陈国公子完避乱奔齐，改姓田，为田氏代齐之始祖。

title: Duke Huan rescues Yan from the Shanrong
summary: Answering Yan's call, Duke Huan of Qi marched north and broke the Shanrong and Guzhu, embodying the hegemon's slogan 'honor the king, expel the barbarians'.
summary_zh: 山戎病燕，齐桓公北伐山戎，破令支、孤竹而还，践行“尊王攘夷”。

title: The Di overrun Wey
summary: Duke Yi of Wey, who gave his cranes carriages of officials, was killed when the Di stormed the capital; Qi later rebuilt Wey at Chuqiu.
summary_zh: 卫懿公好鹤，狄人来攻，国人不战，懿公被杀卫亡；齐桓公后助卫复国于楚丘。

title: Qi and Chu make peace at Zhaoling
summary: Duke Huan led eight states against Chu, faulting it for unpaid tribute; facing Chu's stout defense, both sides swore a covenant at Zhaoling.
summary_zh: 齐桓公率八国之师伐楚，责其“包茅不入”，楚屈完应对不屈，双方订立召陵之盟。

title: Lady Li drives Prince Shensheng to suicide
summary: Duke Xian's consort Lady Li framed Crown Prince Shensheng with poisoned meat; he hanged himself while princes Chong'er and Yiwu fled abroad.
summary_zh: 骊姬以毒胙诬陷太子申生，申生自缢，公子重耳、夷吾出奔，晋国内乱。

title: Jin borrows a road to conquer Guo
summary: Duke Xian of Jin marches through Yu to destroy Guo, then takes Yu on the way back. The origin of the idiom 唇亡齿寒.
summary_zh: 晋献公向虞国借道灭了虢国，回师途中又顺手灭了虞国。成语“唇亡齿寒”就出自这里。

title: Covenant of Kuiqiu
summary: Duke Huan of Qi holds his greatest assembly of the lords. The Zhou king sends him an honour, and the lords swear to common rules.
summary_zh: 齐桓公召集规模最大的一次诸侯会盟，周王派人赐予他特殊的礼遇，诸侯共同订立盟约。

title: Qin ships grain to famine-hit Jin
summary: Despite Jin's ingratitude, Duke Mu of Qin sent a long convoy of grain boats from Yong to Jiang along the Wei and Fen rivers to relieve Jin's famine.
summary_zh: 晋国饥荒，秦穆公不计前嫌，以船队自雍至绛运粮济晋，史称“泛舟之役”。

title: Qin captures Duke Hui at Hanyuan
summary: When Jin refused grain to famine-stricken Qin, Duke Mu attacked and captured Duke Hui of Jin, releasing him in exchange for the lands west of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 晋惠公背信，秦穆公伐晋，于韩原俘获晋惠公，后释之，晋献河西之地。

title: Duke Huan dies amid succession chaos
summary: After Guan Zhong's death Huan trusted favorites; when he died his five sons fought, and his corpse lay unburied for 67 days until worms crawled out.
summary_zh: 管仲死后桓公任用竖刁、易牙，桓公卒，五公子争立，尸身停放六十七日，虫出于户。

title: Battle of the Hong River
summary: Duke Xiang of Song refuses to attack the Chu army while it is crossing the river and is badly defeated.
summary_zh: 宋襄公不肯趁楚军渡河时进攻，结果大败。

title: Chong'er returns to rule Jin
summary: After nineteen years in exile, Prince Chong'er returns to Jin with Qin's army and becomes Duke Wen.
summary_zh: 流亡十九年后，公子重耳在秦军护送下回到晋国即位，就是晋文公。

title: Battle of Chengpu
summary: Jin defeats the southern state of Chu, and Duke Wen of Jin becomes hegemon.
summary_zh: 晋国打败南方的楚国，晋文公由此成为霸主。

title: Duke Wen of Jin named hegemon at Jiantu
summary: After Chengpu, Duke Wen built a palace for King Xiang at Jiantu and gathered the lords; the king formally named him hegemon (Lord Protector).
summary_zh: 城濮战后晋文公于践土会盟诸侯，周襄王亲临策命其为侯伯，晋文公成为霸主。

title: Zhu Zhiwu talks Qin out of besieging Zheng
summary: With Jin and Qin besieging Zheng, the elderly Zhu Zhiwu slipped out at night and convinced Duke Mu that destroying Zheng would only strengthen Jin.
summary_zh: 秦晋围郑，烛之武夜缒而出，说服秦穆公“亡郑以陪邻”，秦军撤围并留兵戍郑。

title: Battle of Xiao
place_zh: 崤山（今河南三门峡、洛宁一带）
summary: A Qin army returning from a failed raid on Zheng is ambushed and destroyed by Jin in the Xiao mountains.
summary_zh: 偷袭郑国未成的秦军在归途中被晋军伏击于崤山，全军覆没。

title: Prince Shangchen forces King Cheng's suicide
summary: Learning he would be replaced as heir, Shangchen surrounded the palace; denied even a last meal of bear's paws, King Cheng hanged himself.
summary_zh: 楚成王欲废太子商臣，商臣以宫甲围王，成王请食熊掌而死不许，遂自缢；商臣即楚穆王。

title: Duke Mu of Qin dominates the western Rong
summary: Blocked from the east by Jin, Duke Mu of Qin turns west, absorbs a dozen Rong states and becomes master of the western frontier.
summary_zh: 东进之路被晋国阻断后，秦穆公转而向西，兼并了十多个戎人小国，称霸西方。

title: Three nobles buried with Duke Mu
summary: 177 people, including three worthy Ziju brothers, were buried with Duke Mu of Qin; the Odes' 'Yellow Bird' laments them.
summary_zh: 秦穆公卒，从死者一百七十七人，子车氏三良亦在其中，国人作《黄鸟》哀之。

title: Earliest record of Halley's Comet
summary: The Spring and Autumn Annals note 'a broom star entered the Northern Dipper', widely regarded as the earliest reliable record of Halley's Comet.
summary_zh: 《春秋》载鲁文公十四年“有星孛入于北斗”，被认为是世界上最早的哈雷彗星记录。

title: King Zhuang of Chu destroys Yong
summary: Facing famine and revolt, the young King Zhuang rallied Chu with Qin and Ba to destroy Yong, ending his 'three silent years' with a decisive campaign.
summary_zh: 楚国大饥，庸人率群蛮叛楚，楚庄王联合秦、巴灭庸，结束“三年不鸣”。

title: Duke Ling of Jin assassinated; Dong Hu's brush
summary: After the tyrant Duke Ling tried to kill Zhao Dun, Zhao Chuan murdered him; the historian Dong Hu nonetheless recorded that Zhao Dun killed his lord.
summary_zh: 晋灵公欲杀赵盾，赵穿弑灵公，太史董狐书“赵盾弑其君”，孔子称其“古之良史”。

title: King Zhuang of Chu asks about the cauldrons
summary: Parading his army on the Zhou border, King Zhuang of Chu asks the royal envoy how heavy the nine cauldrons, symbols of royal power, are.
summary_zh: 楚庄王在周的边境陈兵示威，向周王派来的使者打听象征王权的九鼎有多大多重。

title: The Classic of Poetry takes shape
summary: Songs from the Zhou court and the states, composed over about five centuries, are gathered into the anthology of 305 poems later called the Classic of Poetry.
summary_zh: 周王室和各诸侯国在约五百年间创作的诗歌，被汇编成305篇的诗集，后世称为《诗经》。

title: Xia Zhengshu kills Duke Ling of Chen
summary: Duke Ling of Chen, mocking Xia Zhengshu over an affair with his mother Xia Ji, was shot by him; King Zhuang of Chu then invaded Chen.
summary_zh: 陈灵公与夏姬私通并辱其子夏征舒，征舒射杀灵公，楚庄王借机伐陈。

title: Battle of Bi
summary: King Zhuang of Chu routs the Jin army by the Yellow River and becomes the leading power of the age.
summary_zh: 楚庄王在黄河边大败晋军，成为当时的霸主。

title: Lu taxes land by area
summary: Lu starts taxing all farmland by its area, a sign that the old shared-field system was breaking down and private landholding was growing.
summary_zh: 鲁国开始按田亩面积对所有耕地征税，这表明旧的井田制正在瓦解，土地私有逐渐发展。

title: Chu's nine-month siege of Song
summary: Song held out so long against Chu that people 'exchanged children to eat'; Hua Yuan crept into the Chu camp and negotiated a mutual withdrawal.
summary_zh: 楚围宋九月，城中“易子而食，析骸以爨”，华元夜入楚营劝说子反，两国议和。

title: Jin crushes Qi at An
summary: Jin's Xi Ke defeated Duke Qing of Qi, who escaped capture only by switching places with his chariot driver, confirming Jin's dominance in the north.
summary_zh: 晋郤克大败齐军于鞌，齐顷公与车右易位才得脱身，晋国霸权得以巩固。

title: Jin expands to six armies
summary: Jin created six armies, each commanded by ministerial clans, strengthening the state but entrenching the great lineages that would later split it.
summary_zh: 晋国扩编为六军，由六卿统率，增强军力，也使卿族坐大，埋下分晋之因。

title: Jin moves its capital to Xintian
summary: Jin moved its capital from Jiang to Xintian, whose large bronze foundries and covenant tablets at Houma reveal a thriving later Jin.
summary_zh: 晋景公迁都新田，侯马晋国遗址的铸铜作坊与盟书见证了晋国的繁盛。

title: Wu Chen teaches Wu chariot warfare
summary: The Chu defector Wu Chen, sent by Jin, taught Wu archery and chariot tactics and set Wu against Chu, launching Wu's rise.
summary_zh: 楚臣巫臣奔晋后出使吴国，教吴人乘车射御，使之叛楚，吴国从此崛起。

title: Zhao clan massacred; the Orphan survives
summary: The Zhao lineage was slaughtered in a court purge, but the infant Zhao Wu survived and was later restored, a story retold as 'The Orphan of Zhao'.
summary_zh: 晋国赵氏遭灭族之祸，唯赵武幸存，后得复立，即“赵氏孤儿”故事原型。

title: Jin's coalition defeats Qin at Masui
summary: After Lü Xiang's famous letter breaking relations, Jin led eight states into Qin and routed it at Masui.
summary_zh: 晋派吕相致书绝秦，随即率诸侯之师伐秦，大败秦军于麻隧。

title: Battle of Yanling
summary: Jin defeats Chu again; King Gong of Chu is hit in the eye by an arrow and his commander takes his own life.
summary_zh: 晋国再次击败楚国，楚共王被箭射中眼睛，楚军主帅事后自杀。

title: Duke Li slain; Duke Dao restores Jin
summary: Ministers Luan Shu and Zhonghang Yan killed the despotic Duke Li; the 14-year-old Duke Dao then reformed government and revived Jin's hegemony.
summary_zh: 栾书、中行偃杀晋厉公，迎立十四岁的悼公，悼公整顿内政，晋国重振霸业。

title: Wei Jiang makes peace with the Rong
summary: Wei Jiang persuaded Duke Dao to buy peace with the Rong and Di through trade rather than war, securing Jin's rear.
summary_zh: 魏绛向晋悼公陈“和戎五利”，以货易土，与戎狄和好，晋国得以专力中原。

title: Qi annexes Lai
summary: Qi conquers its eastern neighbour and gains the whole Shandong peninsula.
summary_zh: 齐国吞并东邻莱国，占有了整个山东半岛。

title: Lu's three clans split the ducal army
summary: The Ji, Meng and Shu lineages, descendants of Duke Huan, divided Lu's army and revenues among themselves, reducing the duke to a figurehead.
summary_zh: 鲁国季孙、孟孙、叔孙三家作三军，三分公室，公室日益衰微。

title: Birth of Confucius
summary: Kong Qiu teaches that order comes from virtue, ritual and proper relationships. His sayings are collected in the Analects.
summary_zh: 孔丘主张靠德行、礼仪和正当的人伦关系来建立秩序。他的言论后来被编成《论语》。

title: Cui Zhu kills Duke Zhuang of Qi
summary: Cui Zhu killed Duke Zhuang over an affair; Qi's historians wrote 'Cui Zhu murdered his lord' even as two brothers were executed for it.
summary_zh: 齐庄公与崔杼之妻私通，崔杼弑庄公，太史兄弟相继书“崔杼弑其君”，前仆后继。

title: Peace conference at Song
place_zh: 宋国都城商丘（今河南商丘）
summary: Fourteen states meet at the Song capital and agree to end the long war between Jin and Chu, which then share leadership of the lords.
summary_zh: 十四个诸侯国在宋都会盟，同意结束晋、楚之间的长期战争，此后由晋、楚共同做诸侯的盟主。

title: Ji Zha appraises Zhou music in Lu
summary: Prince Ji Zha of Wu visited Lu and heard performances of the Odes, judging each state's fortunes from its music—an early piece of literary criticism.
summary_zh: 吴公子季札聘鲁观周乐，逐一评点各国风诗，以乐观政，为早期文艺批评名篇。

title: Zichan takes charge of Zheng
summary: Zichan reorganized fields and households and taxed land, and refused to close the village schools where people criticized his policies.
summary_zh: 子产执政郑国，作封洫、作丘赋，整顿田制与赋税，不毁乡校，郑国大治。

title: King Ling of Chu summons lords to Shen
summary: Taking advantage of the 546 truce, King Ling of Chu gathered the lords at Shen to claim hegemony, then attacked Wu.
summary_zh: 楚灵王会诸侯于申，以盟主自居，旋即伐吴。

title: Zichan casts Zheng's laws in bronze
summary: Zichan, chief minister of Zheng, has the state's penal laws cast on bronze cauldrons so that everyone can know them.
summary_zh: 郑国执政子产把国家的刑法铸在青铜鼎上，让人人都能知道法律的内容。

title: Revolt topples King Ling of Chu
summary: While the extravagant King Ling camped at Qianxi, his brothers seized Ying; deserted by his troops, he hanged himself in the wilds.
summary_zh: 楚灵王驻乾溪，其弟公子比、弃疾等发动政变，灵王众叛亲离，自缢而死。

title: King Jing of Zhou casts heavy coins
summary: Ignoring Shan Mugong's warning that it would harm the people, King Jing of Zhou issued large coins, an early recorded debate on monetary policy.
summary_zh: 周景王铸大钱，单穆公以“废轻作重”害民谏之，为最早关于货币政策的论辩。

title: Wu Zixu flees from Chu to Wu
summary: After King Ping of Chu kills his father and brother, Wu Zixu escapes to Wu and swears revenge.
summary_zh: 楚平王杀了伍子胥的父亲和哥哥，伍子胥逃往吴国，誓言复仇。

title: Prince Zhao's rebellion splits Zhou
summary: After King Jing died, Prince Zhao fought King Jing (Gai) for the throne; when defeated in 516 he fled to Chu carrying the Zhou archives.
summary_zh: 周景王死，王子朝与王子匄争位，内战五年；王子朝败后携周室典籍奔楚。

title: Duke Zhao of Lu exiled by Ji clan
summary: Duke Zhao's attack on the Ji clan failed when the Meng and Shu clans joined against him; he died in exile seven years later.
summary_zh: 鲁昭公攻季氏，孟孙、叔孙二家救之，昭公兵败出奔齐国，客死于外。

title: Zhuan Zhu stabs King Liao
summary: Prince Guang of Wu hid the assassin Zhuan Zhu's dagger in a grilled fish; King Liao died at the banquet and Guang became King Helü.
summary_zh: 吴公子光设宴，专诸藏匕首于鱼腹刺杀吴王僚，公子光即位为吴王阖闾。

title: Wu Zixu builds Helü's great city
summary: Wu Zixu laid out a walled capital for King Helü on the site of modern Suzhou, with water and land gates suited to the canal country.
summary_zh: 伍子胥为吴王阖闾“相土尝水”，营建阖闾大城，即今苏州城前身。

title: Jin casts its laws on an iron cauldron
summary: Two Jin ministers cast the state's penal code on a cauldron made of iron, one of the earliest records of iron in China.
summary_zh: 晋国两位卿大夫把刑法铸在一只铁鼎上，这是中国关于铁的最早记载之一。

title: Wu destroys Xu
summary: King Helü of Wu floods the capital of Xu and turns to attack Chu.
summary_zh: 吴王阖闾引水灌徐国都城，灭徐之后转而进攻楚国。

title: Sun Tzu and the Art of War
summary: By tradition, Sun Wu of Qi presents his thirteen chapters on war to King Helü of Wu and becomes his general.
summary_zh: 相传齐人孙武把他的十三篇兵法献给吴王阖闾，并被任命为将军。

title: Laozi leaves the Daodejing at Hangu
summary: Tradition says the Zhou archivist Laozi, departing west, wrote the 5,000-character Daodejing for the pass keeper Yin Xi, the founding text of Daoism.
summary_zh: 相传周守藏史老子西出函谷关，应关令尹喜之请著书五千言，即《道德经》。

title: Battle of Boju
summary: Wu, with the strategist Sun Tzu by tradition, defeats Chu and takes its capital Ying.
summary_zh: 吴军——相传有兵家孙武参与谋划——大败楚军，攻入楚都郢。

title: Shen Baoxu weeps at the Qin court
summary: After Wu took Ying, the Chu minister Shen Baoxu wept seven days at Qin's court until Qin sent chariots that drove Wu out.
summary_zh: 吴破郢后，申包胥赴秦求救，依庭墙哭七日夜，秦哀公感动出兵，助楚复国。

title: Yang Hu seizes control of Lu
summary: The Ji family steward Yang Hu imprisoned his master and ran Lu for three years—'retainers wielding the state's mandate'—before fleeing in 502.
summary_zh: 季氏家臣阳虎囚禁季桓子，专擅鲁政，“陪臣执国命”，三年后作乱失败出奔。

title: Confucius foils Qi at Jiagu
summary: Assisting Duke Ding at a meeting with Qi, Confucius thwarted a plot to seize the duke and won back Lu territory.
summary_zh: 鲁定公与齐景公会于夹谷，孔子相礼，挫败齐人劫持之谋，并索回汶阳之田。

title: Confucius tries to dismantle clan strongholds
summary: As Lu's minister of justice, Confucius moved to raze the walled bases of the three great clans; resistance at Cheng halted the plan.
summary_zh: 孔子为鲁司寇，主张拆毁三桓私邑城墙以强公室，郈、费已堕，成邑抵抗而功败垂成。

title: Confucius begins his wanderings
summary: Disappointed in Lu, Confucius left with his disciples and spent fourteen years seeking office in Wey, Chen, Cai and other states.
summary_zh: 孔子去鲁，率弟子周游卫、陈、蔡等国十四年，推行其政治主张而不得用。

title: Civil war among Jin's ministerial clans
summary: Zhao Yang's quarrel with the Fan and Zhonghang clans erupted into war; with Han, Wei and Zhi, the Zhao destroyed both, leaving four clans to dominate Jin.
summary_zh: 赵鞅与范氏、中行氏交兵，联合韩、魏、智氏灭二氏，晋国形成四卿专政。

title: Goujian defeats Helü at Zuili
summary: Yue's condemned convicts cut their own throats before the Wu lines; in the confusion Yue attacked, and Helü died of his wound.
summary_zh: 越王勾践令罪人在阵前自刎，吴军惊愕，越军乘机进攻，吴王阖闾负伤而死。

title: Battle of Fujiao: Wu crushes Yue
place_zh: 夫椒（今江苏苏州太湖一带）
summary: King Fuchai of Wu avenges his father by crushing Yue. King Goujian of Yue surrenders and serves Wu.
summary_zh: 吴王夫差为父报仇，大败越国。越王勾践求和投降，臣服于吴。

title: Goujian serves as Fuchai's servant
summary: After defeat, Goujian went to Wu as a servant to Fuchai; released, he 'slept on brushwood and tasted gall' to nurse his revenge.
summary_zh: 勾践战败后入吴为奴三年，归国后卧薪尝胆，十年生聚，十年教训。

title: Wu digs the Han Canal
summary: Fuchai of Wu builds a walled town at Han and digs a canal linking the Yangtze and Huai rivers to move his army north.
summary_zh: 吴王夫差在邗筑城，并开凿运河连通长江和淮河，以便北上用兵。

title: Wu crushes Qi at Ailing
summary: Fuchai of Wu, allied with Lu, annihilated a Qi army at Ailing, bringing Wu to the height of its power in the north.
summary_zh: 吴王夫差联合鲁国在艾陵大败齐军，吴国势力达到顶峰。

title: Wu Zixu ordered to kill himself
summary: Warning that Yue, not Qi, was Wu's true danger, Wu Zixu was slandered by Bo Pi; Fuchai sent him a sword, and he asked that his eyes watch Yue's entry.
summary_zh: 伍子胥力谏先灭越，遭太宰伯嚭谗毁，夫差赐剑令其自尽，子胥请抉其眼悬于东门以观越寇。

title: Meeting at Huangchi
summary: Fuchai of Wu meets the lords at Huangchi to claim leadership, while Yue attacks his undefended capital.
summary_zh: 吴王夫差在黄池会盟诸侯争当霸主，越国却乘虚攻入了吴国都城。

title: The Tian family takes control of Qi
summary: Tian Chang kills Duke Jian of Qi and his rivals. From now on the Tian family rules Qi in all but name.
summary_zh: 田常杀死齐简公和政敌，从此田氏成为齐国实际的统治者。

title: Unicorn captured; the Annals end
summary: A qilin caught on a western hunt saddened Confucius as an omen of the times; the Spring and Autumn Annals end with this entry.
summary_zh: 鲁哀公西狩获麟，孔子叹“吾道穷矣”，《春秋》绝笔于此。

title: Confucius dies in Qufu
summary: Confucius died aged 73; his disciples mourned three years at his grave north of Qufu and compiled his sayings as the Analects.
summary_zh: 孔子卒，年七十三，葬于鲁城北泗水之上，弟子守墓三年，后编成《论语》。

title: Duke Bai's coup in Chu
summary: Sheng, Duke of Bai, seized Ying and killed the chief ministers, but the Duke of She suppressed the coup within a month.
summary_zh: 白公胜作乱，杀令尹子西、司马子期，劫持楚惠王，叶公率兵平乱。

title: Yue routs Wu at the Li Marsh
summary: Goujian's night attacks across the river broke the Wu army, beginning the long siege that ended with Wu's fall.
summary_zh: 越军夜渡笠泽，分兵佯攻、中军偷袭，大败吴军，随后围困吴都。

title: Chu annexes the state of Chen
summary: King Hui of Chu finally extinguished Chen, turning it into a Chu county.
summary_zh: 楚惠王灭陈，以陈为县。

title: Yue destroys Wu
summary: After years of 'sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall', King Goujian of Yue takes revenge and ends Wu.
summary_zh: 越王勾践“卧薪尝胆”，多年后终于报仇雪恨，灭掉吴国。

title: Battle of Jinyang
summary: The Zhao, Han and Wei families destroy the Zhi family and split Jin's lands among themselves.
summary_zh: 赵、韩、魏三家联手消灭智氏，瓜分了晋国的土地。

title: Chu annexes the state of Cai
summary: King Hui of Chu extinguished Cai, a Zhou state long squeezed between Chu and Wu, extending Chu power along the Huai.
summary_zh: 楚惠王灭蔡，楚国势力扩展到淮河流域。

title: Marquess Wen begins Wei's ascendancy
summary: Marquess Wen of Wei gathered talents such as Zixia, Li Kui, Wu Qi and Ximen Bao, making Wei the first great power of the Warring States.
summary_zh: 魏文侯即位，师事子夏，任用李悝、吴起、西门豹等贤才，魏国率先强盛。

title: Mozi stops Chu's attack on Song
summary: Mozi walked ten days to Ying and, in a tabletop war game, beat Lu Ban's siege engines nine times, persuading Chu to abandon its attack on Song.
summary_zh: 墨子闻楚将攻宋，行十日十夜至郢，与公输班模拟攻守，九拒其攻，楚王遂罢兵。

title: Burial of Marquis Yi of Zeng
summary: A small state's ruler is buried with a set of 65 bronze bells that can still play a full musical scale.
summary_zh: 小国曾国的国君下葬，随葬的一套65件编钟至今仍能演奏完整的音阶。

title: Chu destroys the state of Ju
summary: Chu's eastward push reached Shandong when it destroyed Ju, though the city later passed to Qi.
summary_zh: 楚简王灭莒，楚国势力伸入山东半岛南部。

title: Ximen Bao ends river-god sacrifices at Ye
summary: Ximen Bao threw the shamans who 'married' girls to the River Earl into the Zhang River, then dug twelve canals that irrigated Ye's fields.
summary_zh: 西门豹任邺令，投巫婆于漳河，破除“河伯娶妇”陋习，开凿十二渠引漳水灌溉。

title: Wu Qi seizes Qin's Hexi lands
place_zh: 河西（今陕西韩城、大荔一带）
summary: Commanding for Wei, Wu Qi drove Qin back to the Luo River, and Wei set up Xihe commandery that Qin would struggle for decades to regain.
summary_zh: 魏将吴起攻取秦河西之地，魏置西河郡，吴起任郡守，秦被压缩至洛水以西。

title: Qin begins taxing land by grain
summary: Duke Jian of Qin introduced a grain tax on land, recognizing private landholding as Lu had done two centuries earlier.
summary_zh: 秦简公“初租禾”，按田亩征收实物税，承认土地私有。

title: Li Kui's reforms in Wei
summary: Li Kui helps Marquis Wen make Wei the first strong power of the age, with farm policies and a written law code.
summary_zh: 李悝辅佐魏文侯推行重农政策并编订成文法典，使魏国成为战国初年第一个强国。

title: Yue Yang conquers Zhongshan for Wei
summary: After three years of campaigning, Wei's general Yue Yang took Zhongshan; he famously ate soup made from his own son to prove his loyalty.
summary_zh: 魏将乐羊攻中山三年而克之，曾食其子之羹以示忠诚，魏文侯“赏其功而疑其心”。

title: Jin is partitioned into Han, Zhao and Wei
summary: The Zhou king recognises the three families who split Jin. Sima Guang begins his history here.
summary_zh: 周天子正式承认瓜分晋国的韩、赵、魏三家为诸侯。司马光的《资治通鉴》就从这一年写起。

title: Knife money circulates in Qi and Yan
summary: Bronze knife-shaped money spread across Qi and Yan, while spade coins served the Central Plains, reflecting a booming commercial economy.
summary_zh: 齐、燕流通刀币，三晋流行布币，反映战国商品经济繁荣。

title: Nie Zheng assassinates Han's chief minister
summary: Repaying Yan Zhongzi's patronage, Nie Zheng stabbed the Han minister Xia Lei, then disfigured himself to protect his sister; she claimed his body anyway.
summary_zh: 聂政为报严仲子知遇之恩，刺杀韩相侠累，自毁面容而死，其姊聂荣伏尸认弟。

title: 'Virtue, not terrain,' Wu Qi tells his lord
place_zh: 西河（今陕西韩城一带黄河）
summary: Sailing down the Yellow River, Marquess Wu praised its natural defenses; Wu Qi replied that a state's security lies in virtue, not strategic terrain.
summary_zh: 魏武侯浮西河而下，赞叹山河之固，吴起答曰“在德不在险”。

title: Tian He is recognised as ruler of Qi
summary: The Zhou king recognises Tian He as ruler of Qi, ending the old house of Jiang.
summary_zh: 周天子承认田和为齐国国君，姜姓齐国至此终结。

title: Wu Qi's reforms in Chu
summary: The general Wu Qi cuts the privileges of Chu's nobles and strengthens its army, but is killed when his patron dies.
summary_zh: 名将吴起削减楚国贵族的特权、整顿军队，靠山楚悼王一死，他便遭贵族杀害。

title: Qin abolishes burying the living with the dead
summary: Returning from long exile in Wei, Duke Xian of Qin banned human sacrifice at burials, the first of reforms that prepared Qin's rise.
summary_zh: 秦献公即位，下令废止人殉，开启秦国改革。

title: Qin moves its capital to Yueyang
summary: Duke Xian moved the capital east to Yueyang to confront Wei; he also registered households in groups of five and opened markets.
summary_zh: 秦献公迁都栎阳以东向争河西，又推行户籍相伍、初行为市。

title: Wu Qi killed at King Dao's funeral
summary: When his patron King Dao died, nobles stripped of privileges shot Wu Qi; he threw himself on the king's body so his killers were executed for defiling it.
summary_zh: 楚悼王死，宗室大臣射杀吴起，吴起伏王尸，射者因射中王尸被诛灭七十余家。

title: Han, Zhao and Wei abolish Jin
summary: The three successor states deposed Duke Jing of Jin and divided the last of his lands, ending the once-great state.
summary_zh: 韩、赵、魏废晋静公，瓜分晋国残余土地，晋国绝祀。

title: Han annexes Zheng
summary: Han conquers Zheng and moves its capital to Xinzheng.
summary_zh: 韩国吞并郑国，并把都城迁到新郑。

title: Qin defeats Wei at Shimen
summary: Qin killed 60,000 Wei soldiers at Shimen, its first great victory over Wei; the Zhou king congratulated Duke Xian with embroidered robes.
summary_zh: 秦献公大败魏军于石门，斩首六万，周天子以黼黻之服贺秦。

title: Wei moves its capital to Daliang
summary: Pressed by Qin in the west, Wei shifts its centre to the eastern plain.
summary_zh: 魏国西面受秦国压迫，于是把统治中心东移到中原平原。

title: Duke Xiao's edict seeking talent
summary: Ashamed that the eastern states despised Qin, the new Duke Xiao promised office and land to anyone who could strengthen Qin; Shang Yang answered.
summary_zh: 秦孝公即位，下令求贤：“宾客群臣有能出奇计强秦者，吾且尊官，与之分土。”商鞅闻令入秦。

title: Wei digs the Hong Canal
summary: After moving to Daliang, Wei dug the Hong Canal linking the Yellow River with the Huai's tributaries, creating a central-plain waterway network.
summary_zh: 魏惠王迁都大梁后开凿鸿沟，引黄河水连通淮河支流，形成中原水运网。

title: Shang Yang's reforms in Qin
summary: Strict laws, rewards for farming and war, and counties under appointed officials turn Qin into a war machine.
summary_zh: 严刑峻法、奖励耕战、由国君任命官吏治理县邑，这些措施把秦国变成了一台战争机器。

title: Shen Buhai's administrative reforms in Han
summary: Chief minister Shen Buhai taught Marquis Zhao of Han 'techniques' (shu) for controlling officials by checking performance against title, bringing fifteen years of order.
summary_zh: 申不害相韩十五年，以“术”治国，循名责实，韩国国治兵强。

title: Zou Ji urges King Wei to accept criticism
summary: Using flattery about his own looks as a parable, Zou Ji persuaded King Wei of Qi to reward critics; soon 'there was nothing left to criticize'.
summary_zh: 邹忌以比美徐公为喻，劝齐威王广开言路，威王下令赏谏，“期年之后，虽欲言，无可进者”。

title: Battle of Guiling
summary: Sun Bin of Qi 'besieges Wei to save Zhao' (围魏救赵), defeating Wei's army on its way home.
summary_zh: 齐国军师孙膑“围魏救赵”，在魏军回师途中将其击败。

title: Gan De and Shi Shen chart the stars
summary: Gan De of Qi and Shi Shen of Wei compiled star catalogs and observed planetary motions; Gan De may have noted a moon of Jupiter.
summary_zh: 齐人甘德与魏人石申观测星象、行星运行，编成星表，甘德或已观察到木星卫星。

title: Qin moves its capital to Xianyang
summary: In a second round of reforms Shang Yang builds a new capital, groups villages into counties and standardises measures.
summary_zh: 商鞅第二次变法时营建新都咸阳，把乡邑合并为县，并统一度量衡。

title: Bian Que practices pulse diagnosis
summary: Physician Bian Que travelled through Zhao, Qi and Qin; Sima Qian credits him with founding pulse diagnosis.
summary_zh: 名医扁鹊周游诸国行医，司马迁称其为脉诊之祖。

title: Shang Yang standardizes weights and measures
summary: Shang Yang issued standard measures, including a surviving bronze square sheng vessel, to unify taxation and trade across Qin.
summary_zh: 商鞅统一秦国度量衡，现存商鞅方升即为当时标准量器。

title: King Hui of Wei holds court at Fengze
summary: Lord Hui of Wei summoned the lesser lords to Fengze and adopted royal style, provoking the coalition that later humiliated Wei.
summary_zh: 魏惠王召集诸侯会于逢泽，率诸侯朝天子，并僭用王号，引起齐、秦等国反感。

title: Battle of Maling
summary: Sun Bin of Qi lures the Wei army into an ambush. Wei's general Pang Juan dies and Wei's dominance ends.
summary_zh: 齐国孙膑诱魏军进入埋伏，魏将庞涓身死，魏国的霸主地位从此结束。

title: Shang Yang tricks Wei's commander
summary: Shang Yang invited his old friend Prince Ang of Wei to a parley, seized him and routed his army, forcing Wei to cede land west of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 商鞅率军伐魏，以旧友之谊诱公子卬会盟而虏之，大破魏军，魏割河西之地求和。

title: Shang Yang is executed
summary: After Duke Xiao dies, his enemies accuse Shang Yang of rebellion. He is killed, but his laws stay in force.
summary_zh: 秦孝公死后，仇家诬告商鞅谋反，商鞅被处死，但他的新法继续施行。

title: Qin begins issuing coins
summary: King Huiwen of Qin began state casting of round coins, forerunners of the Ban Liang that would later become China's standard currency.
summary_zh: 秦惠文王二年“初行钱”，铸行圆形方孔钱，为后来半两钱的前身。

title: Qi and Wei recognize each other as kings
summary: Wei's Lord Hui and Qi's King Wei met at Xuzhou and acknowledged each other's royal titles, openly discarding Zhou supremacy.
summary_zh: 魏惠王与齐威王会于徐州，互相承认为王，周天子共主地位名存实亡。

title: Chu defeats Yue and seizes Wu lands
summary: King Wei of Chu killed King Wujiang of Yue and took the old Wu territory to the Zhe River; Yue broke into feuding chiefdoms.
summary_zh: 楚威王大败越国，杀越王无疆，尽取故吴地至浙江，越国从此分崩离析。

title: Su Qin forms the Vertical Alliance
summary: The persuader Su Qin is said to have united six states against Qin and carried the seals of six chancellors, though modern scholars redate his career.
summary_zh: 苏秦游说六国合纵抗秦，佩六国相印（据《史记》；其年代学界有争议）。

title: Zhang Yi becomes Qin's chancellor
summary: Zhang Yi became chancellor of Qin and championed the Horizontal strategy, splitting the eastern states into bilateral deals with Qin.
summary_zh: 张仪入秦为相，推行连横之策，离间六国使其分别事秦。

title: Qin's ruler proclaims himself king
summary: Lord Huiwen of Qin assumed the title of king, joining Wei and Qi in rejecting the old Zhou hierarchy.
summary_zh: 秦惠文君称王，改元，与魏、齐并列称王。

title: Mencius debates King Hui of Liang
summary: Asked how he would profit the state, Mencius answered that benevolence and righteousness matter, not profit—the opening exchange of the Mencius.
summary_zh: 梁惠王问“何以利吾国”，孟子答“何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣”，为《孟子》开篇。

title: The Jixia Academy flourishes in Qi
summary: Under King Xuan, Qi pays scholars of every school to live and debate at its capital.
summary_zh: 齐宣王时，齐国供养各家学者在都城讲学辩论。

title: Five states attack Qin at Hangu
summary: Wei, Zhao, Han, Yan and Chu marched on Qin, but the alliance fell apart at Hangu Pass and Qin defeated Han and Zhao at Xiuyu the next year.
summary_zh: 魏、赵、韩、燕、楚五国合纵攻秦，至函谷关不战而溃，次年秦败韩赵联军于修鱼。

title: Qin conquers Ba and Shu
summary: Sima Cuo's army takes the Sichuan basin, giving Qin a rich granary behind the mountains.
summary_zh: 司马错率秦军攻取四川盆地，为秦国在群山之后添了一座富饶的粮仓。

title: King Kuai of Yan abdicates to Zizhi
summary: Swayed by tales of sage-king abdication, King Kuai of Yan handed his throne to the minister Zizhi, provoking civil war.
summary_zh: 燕王哙慕尧舜禅让之名，将王位让给相国子之，燕国大乱。

title: Qi invades Yan during its civil war
summary: Exploiting Yan's chaos, Qi's Kuang Zhang took the capital in fifty days; Zizhi and King Kuai died, but Qi's plunder drove the people to revolt.
summary_zh: 燕国内乱，齐将匡章五十日攻破燕都，子之、燕王哙皆死，齐军暴掠，燕人反抗。

title: Zhang Yi tricks Chu with false land
summary: Zhang Yi promised Chu six hundred li of Shang-Yu land if it broke with Qi; once it did, he offered only six li.
summary_zh: 张仪以商於之地六百里诱楚绝齐，楚怀王绝齐后，张仪改口只给六里。

title: Qin crushes Chu at Danyang
summary: Enraged by Zhang Yi's deceit, Chu attacked; Qin killed 80,000 at Danyang, seized Hanzhong, then repelled a Chu counterattack at Lantian.
summary_zh: 楚怀王怒而伐秦，秦大败楚军于丹阳，斩首八万，取汉中郡，楚军再败于蓝田。

title: King Zhao of Yan builds the Golden Terrace
summary: To rebuild Yan, King Zhao honored Guo Wei and built a terrace to attract talent; Yue Yi, Zou Yan and Ju Xin came to serve him.
summary_zh: 燕昭王即位，以郭隗为师，筑黄金台招贤，乐毅、邹衍、剧辛等纷纷入燕。

title: King Wuling of Zhao adopts nomad dress
summary: Zhao trains mounted archers in steppe clothing and pushes north against the Linhu and Loufan.
summary_zh: 赵国让士兵改穿胡人服装、练习骑射，向北进攻林胡和楼烦。

title: Qin takes Yiyang and opens the road east
summary: Qin's Gan Mao took the Han fortress of Yiyang after a five-month siege, opening the route to Luoyang; King Wu soon died lifting a bronze tripod there.
summary_zh: 秦将甘茂攻韩宜阳五月而拔之，打通东进之路；秦武王入洛阳举鼎，绝膑而死。

title: Qu Yuan composes the Li Sao
summary: Exiled after his advice was rejected, the Chu minister Qu Yuan wrote the Li Sao, the great lyric of the Chu Ci anthology.
summary_zh: 屈原遭谗被疏，忧愤而作《离骚》，开创楚辞文体。

title: Zhuangzi teaches carefree wandering
summary: Zhuangzi, once a lacquer-garden official in Meng, wrote parables like the butterfly dream that made him, after Laozi, Daoism's central thinker.
summary_zh: 庄周曾为蒙漆园吏，著《庄子》，以“庄周梦蝶”等寓言阐发道家思想。

title: Chu casts Ying Yuan gold currency
summary: Chu issued stamped gold plates and small bronze 'ant-nose' coins, the earliest gold currency in China.
summary_zh: 楚国铸行郢爰金版和蚁鼻钱，为中国最早的黄金货币。

title: Guodian bamboo texts buried
summary: A Chu tomb near Ying held the oldest known Laozi manuscript and lost Confucian essays, reshaping understanding of early Chinese thought.
summary_zh: 荆门郭店楚墓出土竹简，含最早的《老子》写本及多篇佚失儒家文献。

title: King Huai of Chu detained by Qin
summary: Invited to a parley at Wu Pass, King Huai was seized and taken to Xianyang to cede land; he refused and died in Qin in 296.
summary_zh: 秦昭王约楚怀王会于武关，扣留怀王要挟割地，怀王不从，三年后客死于秦。

title: Lord Mengchang leads allies through Hangu
summary: Escaping Qin by 'rooster crows and dog thieves', Lord Mengchang led Qi, Han and Wei for three years and finally broke through Hangu Pass.
summary_zh: 孟尝君借“鸡鸣狗盗”之士逃离秦国，率齐、韩、魏联军攻秦三年，攻入函谷关。

title: Zhao annexes Zhongshan
summary: Zhao ends the small Di-founded state of Zhongshan.
summary_zh: 赵国灭掉了狄人建立的小国中山。

title: King Wuling of Zhao starves at Shaqiu
summary: The abdicated King Wuling sheltered his rebel elder son; ministers besieged the palace for three months until the reformer king starved to death.
summary_zh: 赵武灵王长子赵章作乱失败，逃入沙丘宫，公子成、李兑围宫三月，武灵王饿死。

title: Battle of Yique
summary: Bai Qi crushes the combined armies of Han and Wei, the first of his great victories.
summary_zh: 白起大破韩、魏联军，这是他第一场大胜。

title: Yan's Qin Kai drives back the Donghu
summary: The Yan general Qin Kai pushed the Donghu back a thousand li; Yan built a long wall and set up five commanderies including Liaodong.
summary_zh: 燕将秦开袭破东胡，东胡却千余里，燕筑长城，置上谷至辽东五郡。

title: Qin and Qi briefly style themselves emperors
summary: King Zhao of Qin proposed that he be Western Emperor and Min of Qi Eastern Emperor; Su Dai talked Qi out of it, and both dropped the titles.
summary_zh: 秦昭王称西帝，尊齐湣王为东帝，苏代劝齐去帝号，两月后秦亦去帝号。

title: Qi annexes Song
summary: Qi swallows the rich state of Song, alarming every neighbour.
summary_zh: 齐国吞并富庶的宋国，令周边各国惊恐不安。

title: Yue Yi's allied invasion of Qi
summary: Yan's general leads five states into Qi and takes over seventy cities. Tian Dan wins them back in 279 with his fire-oxen.
summary_zh: 燕将乐毅率五国联军攻入齐国，连下七十余城。前279年，田单以“火牛阵”收复失地。

title: King Min of Qi killed at Ju
summary: Fleeing Yue Yi's armies, King Min reached Ju, where the Chu general Nao Chi hung him from a beam and flayed him.
summary_zh: 乐毅破齐后齐湣王逃至莒，被楚将淖齿抽筋悬于庙梁而死。

title: Lin Xiangru brings the jade back to Zhao
summary: Zhao's envoy outwits the King of Qin, who offered fifteen cities for a famous jade disc he never meant to hand over.
summary_zh: 秦王假意用十五座城交换和氏璧，赵国使者蔺相如识破其计，把玉璧完好地送回赵国。

title: Gongsun Long and the white horse paradox
summary: A retainer of Lord Pingyuan, Gongsun Long of the School of Names used paradoxes about names and reality.
summary_zh: 名家公孙龙为平原君门客，提出“白马非马”等命题，探讨名实关系。

title: Tian Dan's fire oxen restore Qi
summary: After Yan replaced Yue Yi, the besieged Tian Dan launched oxen with burning tails at night, routing Yan and recovering more than seventy cities.
summary_zh: 燕惠王以骑劫代乐毅，田单在即墨以火牛阵夜袭燕军，尽复齐七十余城。

title: Lin Xiangru defends Zhao at Mianchi
summary: When the Qin king made Zhao's king play the zither, Lin Xiangru forced him to beat a clay pot; Lian Po later begged his forgiveness.
summary_zh: 秦赵渑池会，蔺相如逼秦王击缶，维护赵国尊严；后廉颇负荆请罪，将相和。

title: Zhuang Qiao founds the Dian kingdom
summary: The Chu general Zhuang Qiao reached Lake Dian; cut off by Qin's conquests, he adopted local customs and ruled as king of Dian.
summary_zh: 楚将庄蹻率军至滇池，归路被秦所断，遂变服从俗，称王于滇。

title: Bai Qi floods the Chu city of Yan
summary: Bai Qi diverted a river into the Chu secondary capital of Yan, drowning hundreds of thousands, then pushed on toward Ying.
summary_zh: 白起引水灌鄢城，楚军民死者数十万，随后进逼郢都。

title: Qu Yuan drowns himself
summary: After Qin takes the Chu capital, the poet of the Chu Ci drowns himself. The Dragon Boat Festival remembers him.
summary_zh: 秦军攻破楚都后，《楚辞》的作者屈原投江自尽。端午节就是为纪念他而来。

title: Bai Qi captures the Chu capital Ying
summary: Qin took Ying, burned the Chu royal tombs at Yiling and made the region Nan commandery; Chu moved its capital to Chen.
summary_zh: 白起攻破郢都，烧夷陵楚先王墓，秦置南郡，楚迁都于陈。

title: Bai Qi routs Wei and Zhao at Huayang
summary: Rushing to rescue Han, Bai Qi beheaded 130,000 Wei troops and drowned 20,000 Zhao soldiers in the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 魏赵攻韩华阳，白起驰援，斩首魏军十三万，沉赵卒二万于河。

title: Qin destroys the Yiqu Rong
summary: Queen Dowager Xuan lured the Yiqu king to Ganquan Palace and killed him; Qin annexed his lands as Longxi, Beidi and Shang commanderies.
summary_zh: 宣太后诱杀义渠王于甘泉宫，秦发兵灭义渠，置陇西、北地、上郡。

title: Zhao She defeats Qin at Yuyu
summary: Zhao She feigned caution, then raced to seize the heights at Yuyu and crushed Qin—'two rats fighting in a hole, the braver wins'.
summary_zh: 赵奢率军救阏与，示弱后急行抢占北山，大破秦军，“狭路相逢勇者胜”。

title: Zou Yan's Five Phases theory
summary: The Jixia scholar Zou Yan explained dynastic change through the cycle of the Five Phases, an idea Qin later used to justify its rule.
summary_zh: 稷下学者邹衍创“五德终始”说，以五行相胜解释王朝更替，后为秦所采用。

title: Fan Ju becomes chancellor of Qin
summary: Fan Ju's strategy of befriending distant states and attacking near ones guides Qin's conquests.
summary_zh: 范雎提出“远交近攻”的策略，成为秦国此后兼并各国的方针。

title: Chu Long persuades Zhao's Queen Dowager
summary: To gain Qi's help, Zhao had to send a royal son as hostage; Chu Long convinced the reluctant Queen Dowager that true love meant giving her son merit.
summary_zh: 秦攻赵，齐要求以长安君为质，触龙以“爱子则为之计深远”说服赵太后。

title: Shangdang defects to Zhao
summary: Cut off by Qin, Han's Shangdang commandery hands itself to Zhao, setting up the clash at Changping.
summary_zh: 被秦军切断的韩国上党郡转投赵国，引发了长平之战。

title: Battle of Changping
summary: Qin's general Bai Qi destroys the army of Zhao. Ancient sources claim the prisoners were killed in the hundreds of thousands.
summary_zh: 秦将白起全歼赵军。据古书记载，被杀的降卒多达数十万。

title: Siege of Handan
summary: Qin besieges the Zhao capital after Changping, but relief armies from Wei and Chu drive it off.
summary_zh: 长平之战后秦军围攻赵都邯郸，魏、楚援军赶到，击退秦军。

title: Lord Xinling steals the tally to save Zhao
summary: Lord Xinling had Lady Ru steal the troop tally, killed General Jin Bi and led Wei's army to lift the siege of Handan.
summary_zh: 信陵君使如姬窃得兵符，椎杀晋鄙，夺军救赵，邯郸之围遂解。

title: Bai Qi ordered to kill himself
summary: Refusing to lead the doomed siege of Handan, Bai Qi was stripped of rank and ordered to die, reflecting that he deserved death for Changping.
summary_zh: 白起拒绝再攻邯郸，被贬为士卒，赐剑自刎于杜邮，自言长平坑卒“固当死”。

title: Qin ends the Zhou dynasty
summary: King Nan of Zhou surrenders his last lands to Qin and dies. Nearly eight centuries of Zhou rule come to an end.
summary_zh: 周赧王向秦国献出最后的土地，不久去世，延续近八百年的周朝就此终结。

title: Li Bing builds Dujiangyan
summary: An irrigation system without a dam splits the Min River and turns the Chengdu Plain into rich farmland. It still works today.
summary_zh: 这项不用大坝的水利工程把岷江一分为二，使成都平原成为沃野，至今仍在使用。

title: Chu extinguishes the state of Lu
summary: King Kaolie of Chu ended the Duke of Zhou's state of Lu after nearly eight centuries, exiling its last ruler.
summary_zh: 楚考烈王灭鲁，迁鲁顷公于下邑，鲁国八百年社稷终结。

title: Xunzi becomes magistrate of Lanling
summary: Leaving Qi, Xunzi was appointed by Lord Chunshen to govern Lanling, where he taught Han Fei and Li Si and wrote that human nature is bad.
summary_zh: 荀子受春申君任为兰陵令，著书主张“性恶”，韩非、李斯皆出其门下。

title: Lian Po defeats Yan at Hao
summary: Thinking Zhao drained after Changping, Yan invaded; Lian Po killed the Yan commander Li Fu and besieged the Yan capital.
summary_zh: 燕以为赵经长平之败可乘，大举攻赵，廉颇大破燕军于鄗，杀燕将栗腹。

title: Lü Buwei becomes Qin's chancellor
summary: The merchant who had 'invested' in the hostage prince Zichu became chancellor when Zichu ascended as King Zhuangxiang.
summary_zh: 秦庄襄王即位，以“奇货可居”扶持其上位的商人吕不韦为相国，封文信侯。

title: Qin annexes the Eastern Zhou duchy
summary: After the last Zhou king's death, the Lord of Eastern Zhou plotted with the lords; Qin annexed his territory, ending the Zhou house entirely.
summary_zh: 东周君与诸侯谋秦，秦相吕不韦率兵灭东周，周祀遂绝。

title: Lord Xinling leads five states against Qin
summary: Recalled to Wei, Lord Xinling led a five-state army that defeated Meng Ao and chased Qin forces to Hangu Pass.
summary_zh: 信陵君归魏，率五国联军败秦将蒙骜于河外，追至函谷关。

title: Ying Zheng becomes King of Qin
summary: The future First Emperor takes the throne at thirteen, with the merchant-turned-chancellor Lü Buwei as regent.
summary_zh: 未来的秦始皇十三岁即位，由商人出身的相国吕不韦主持朝政。

title: Work begins on the Zhengguo Canal
summary: A Han engineer persuades Qin to dig a huge canal to drain its strength. Instead it waters the Guanzhong plain and makes Qin richer.
summary_zh: 韩国水工郑国劝秦国开凿大渠，本想借此消耗秦国国力，结果灌溉了关中平原，反而使秦国更加富强。

title: Last allied offensive against Qin fails
summary: Zhao's Pang Nuan led five states to Zui near Xianyang, but the offensive collapsed—the last joint campaign against Qin.
summary_zh: 赵将庞煖率五国联军攻秦至蕞，无功而返，此为六国最后一次合纵攻秦。

title: Chu moves its capital to Shouchun
summary: Fearing Qin, Chu moved its capital east to Shouchun, again calling it Ying.
summary_zh: 楚考烈王迁都寿春，仍称郢。

title: Lü Buwei's Annals are completed
summary: Lü Buwei's retainers compile a book blending the ideas of many schools.
summary_zh: 吕不韦的门客集体编成一部兼采各家学说的著作。

title: Ying Zheng crushes Lao Ai and takes power
summary: The young king puts down a revolt by his mother's favourite and soon removes Lü Buwei, ruling in his own right.
summary_zh: 年轻的秦王平定太后宠臣嫪毐的叛乱，随后罢免吕不韦，开始亲政。

title: Lord Chunshen ambushed by Li Yuan
summary: When King Kaolie died, Li Yuan's assassins killed Lord Chunshen at the palace gate and exterminated his family.
summary_zh: 楚考烈王卒，李园伏死士于棘门刺杀春申君，尽灭其家。

title: Li Si's memorial against expelling foreigners
summary: When Qin ordered foreign-born officials expelled after the Zheng Guo plot, Li Si argued that Qin's greatness came from foreign talent; the order was rescinded.
summary_zh: 秦因郑国渠事下逐客令，李斯上《谏逐客书》，嬴政废除逐客令。

title: Lü Buwei commits suicide
summary: Ordered into exile in Shu after the Lao Ai scandal, Lü Buwei drank poison rather than await worse punishment.
summary_zh: 嫪毐事发后吕不韦免相就国，又被迁往蜀地，忧惧饮鸩自杀。

title: Han Fei dies in Qin
summary: The great Legalist thinker, sent to Qin as an envoy, is jailed and poisoned. His writings shape the Qin state.
summary_zh: 法家集大成者韩非出使秦国，被下狱毒死，但他的学说深刻影响了秦国的治国之道。

title: Li Mu defeats Qin at Fei
summary: Zhao's frontier general Li Mu routed Huan Yi's Qin army at Fei and was made Lord Wu'an.
summary_zh: 赵将李牧于肥大破秦将桓齮，受封武安君。

title: Qin destroys Han
summary: The first of the six states to fall in Qin's wars of unification.
summary_zh: 秦国统一战争中第一个灭亡的国家。

title: Zhao executes its general Li Mu
summary: Qin bribed King Qian's favorite Guo Kai to slander Li Mu; his execution removed Zhao's last defender months before Handan fell.
summary_zh: 秦以重金收买赵王宠臣郭开，诬李牧谋反，赵王迁杀李牧，次年赵亡。

title: Qin takes Handan
summary: Zhao's king is captured. A prince holds out in Dai until 222.
summary_zh: 赵王被俘，一位赵国公子在代地坚持到前222年。

title: Jing Ke tries to kill the King of Qin
summary: An assassin sent by Yan hides a dagger in a map scroll but fails. Five years later Qin conquers Yan.
summary_zh: 燕国派出的刺客把匕首藏在地图卷轴里，行刺失败。五年后秦灭燕。

title: Qin floods Daliang and ends Wei
summary: Wang Ben diverts the Yellow River canals into the Wei capital.
summary_zh: 王贲引黄河水道之水灌入魏都大梁。

title: Qin conquers Chu
summary: Wang Jian's 600,000 men overwhelm Chu after an earlier Qin defeat.
summary_zh: 秦军先败于楚，随后王翦率六十万大军压垮楚国。

title: Qin conquers Yan and Dai
summary: The Yan court, which had fled to Liaodong after Jing Ke's failed attempt, is captured.
summary_zh: 荆轲行刺失败后逃往辽东的燕国朝廷被秦军俘获。

title: Qin unifies China
summary: King Zheng conquers the last state, takes the new title Huangdi (emperor) and standardises script, coins, weights and axle widths.
summary_zh: 秦王嬴政灭掉最后一个对手，改称“皇帝”，统一文字、货币、度量衡和车轨。

title: The empire is divided into 36 commanderies
summary: Rejecting new fiefs for his sons, the First Emperor rules the whole empire through appointed officials.
summary_zh: 秦始皇拒绝分封子弟，把全国划分为郡县，由朝廷任命的官员治理。

title: Qin's conquest of the Baiyue
summary: Qin armies push into the far south against the Yue peoples and set up three new commanderies.
summary_zh: 秦军南下征讨百越各部，在岭南设立三郡。

title: Ying Zheng adopts the title Huangdi
summary: Combining the titles of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors, Ying Zheng became the First Emperor, abolishing posthumous names in favor of numbered successors.
summary_zh: 嬴政兼采“三皇五帝”之号称“皇帝”，自称始皇帝，废除谥法，后世以数计。

title: Writing unified in small seal script
summary: Li Si led the standardization of characters on the Qin small seal script, discarding regional variants used by the former six states.
summary_zh: 李斯等以秦小篆统一文字，废除六国异体，“书同文”奠定汉字统一基础。

title: Weights, measures and coinage standardized
summary: Qin imposed its standard weights, measures and axle widths empire-wide and made the round Ban Liang coin the single bronze currency.
summary_zh: 秦统一度量衡与车轨，废六国货币，以圆形方孔半两钱为通行铜币。

title: Weapons melted into twelve bronze giants
summary: The emperor confiscated the weapons of the realm, melted them in Xianyang and cast bells and twelve colossal bronze statues.
summary_zh: 收天下兵器聚于咸阳，销以为钟鐻及金人十二，各重千石。

title: Construction of imperial speedways
summary: Qin began a network of tree-lined imperial roads radiating from Xianyang to the east and north, speeding troops and the emperor's tours.
summary_zh: 秦治驰道，以咸阳为中心东穷燕齐、南极吴楚，道广五十步，三丈而树。

title: The First Emperor's sacrifice at Mount Tai
summary: On a tour of the east, the emperor climbs Mount Tai to report his success to Heaven and leaves stone inscriptions.
summary_zh: 秦始皇东巡途中登上泰山祭告天地，并刻石颂扬功德。

title: Xu Fu sails in search of the elixir of life
summary: A magician from Qi persuades the emperor to send him to sea with thousands of young people to find the islands of the immortals.
summary_zh: 齐地方士徐福说服秦始皇，带领数千童男童女出海寻找仙山。

title: Langya stele proclaims Qin's virtue
summary: On his eastern tour the emperor stayed three months at Langya, built a terrace and erected a stele, inscribed by Li Si, extolling unification.
summary_zh: 始皇东巡至琅琊，留三月，作琅琊台，立石刻颂秦德。

title: Zhang Liang's ambush at Bolangsha
summary: A young noble of Han hires a strongman to smash the emperor's carriage with an iron hammer, but hits the wrong one.
summary_zh: 韩国贵族后裔张良雇大力士用铁锤袭击秦始皇的车驾，却误中副车。

title: Shuihudi official buried with Qin law
summary: A local official named Xi was buried with over 1,100 bamboo slips copying Qin statutes and legal procedures, revealing how Qin law worked.
summary_zh: 县吏喜死后随葬竹简一千一百余枚，抄录秦律及法律文书，揭示秦法实况。

title: Commoners ordered to report their land
summary: An edict required all households to declare the land they held, recognizing private ownership and creating a basis for empire-wide taxation.
summary_zh: 秦令“黔首自实田”，令百姓自报占有土地数额，承认土地私有，以便征收赋税。

title: Meng Tian links the northern walls
summary: After driving the Xiongnu from the Ordos, Qin joins older state walls into one long frontier wall.
summary_zh: 秦军把匈奴逐出河套之后，把各国旧有的城墙连接成一道漫长的边墙。

title: Meng Tian drives the Xiongnu from the Ordos
place_zh: 河南地（今内蒙古鄂尔多斯）
summary: With 300,000 men, Meng Tian expelled the Xiongnu from the land within the Yellow River bend and established 44 counties there.
summary_zh: 蒙恬率三十万众北击匈奴，收河南地，置四十四县。

title: The Lingqu Canal is completed
summary: A canal linking the Yangtze and Pearl River systems carries supplies for Qin's conquest of the south.
summary_zh: 一条连通长江与珠江水系的运河，为秦军南征运送补给。

title: Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang commanderies founded
summary: After conquering the Lingnan region, Qin set up Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang commanderies and moved convicts and merchants south to settle.
summary_zh: 秦平岭南，置南海、桂林、象郡，迁徙谪民五十万戍守。

title: Burning of books
summary: On Li Si's advice, histories of other states and private copies of the classics are ordered burned.
summary_zh: 秦始皇采纳李斯的建议，下令焚毁六国史书和民间私藏的经典。

title: Work begins on the Epang Palace
summary: The emperor starts a vast new palace south of the Wei River, adding to the burden of forced labour.
summary_zh: 秦始皇在渭河南岸修建规模空前的新宫殿，百姓的徭役负担更加沉重。

title: Meng Tian builds the Straight Road
summary: A military highway was cut straight north from Yunyang to Jiuyuan, about 700 km, letting troops reach the Xiongnu frontier rapidly.
summary_zh: 命蒙恬修直道，自云阳至九原，堑山堙谷，长一千八百里。

title: Meteorite inscribed with doom prophecy
summary: Someone carved 'The First Emperor will die and his land be divided' on a meteorite; when no culprit was found, everyone nearby was executed.
summary_zh: 东郡陨石上被刻“始皇帝死而地分”，查无主名，尽杀石旁居人，焚其石。

title: Death of the First Emperor and the Shaqiu plot
summary: The emperor dies on tour. Zhao Gao and Li Si forge his will to make Huhai emperor and force the heir Fusu to kill himself.
summary_zh: 秦始皇死于巡游途中。赵高、李斯伪造遗诏，立胡亥为帝，逼迫长子扶苏自杀。

title: The First Emperor is buried with the Terracotta Army
summary: The emperor is laid in his vast tomb, guarded by thousands of life-size clay soldiers that were rediscovered in 1974.
summary_zh: 秦始皇葬入规模宏大的陵墓，守护它的数千个真人大小的陶俑于1974年重见天日。

title: Prince Fusu forced to suicide
summary: A forged decree from Zhao Gao and Li Si ordered Crown Prince Fusu and Meng Tian to die; Fusu obeyed, while Meng Tian was later forced to poison himself.
summary_zh: 赵高、李斯矫诏赐死公子扶苏与蒙恬，扶苏自杀于上郡，蒙恬后服毒死。

title: Dazexiang uprising
summary: Conscripts led by Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, late for duty and facing death, rise in revolt. Rebellion spreads everywhere.
summary_zh: 陈胜、吴广率领误了期限、难逃一死的戍卒揭竿而起，起义烽火迅速燃遍各地。

title: Chen Sheng proclaims Zhang Chu
summary: Taking Chen, Chen Sheng declared himself king of 'Zhang Chu' (Expanded Chu), and sent generals out to rouse the former states.
summary_zh: 陈胜攻占陈县，自立为王，号“张楚”，分遣诸将四出略地。

title: Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu rise at Kuaiji
summary: Xiang Yu beheaded the Kuaiji governor and, with his uncle Xiang Liang, raised 8,000 Jiangdong troops.
summary_zh: 项梁、项羽杀会稽守，举吴中兵，得精兵八千。

title: Liu Bang rises at Pei
summary: A minor local officer becomes leader of a rebel band at his home town and is called the Lord of Pei.
summary_zh: 一个小小的亭长在家乡被拥立为首领，号称“沛公”。

title: Second Emperor slaughters his siblings
summary: On Zhao Gao's advice, Huhai executed twelve princes in Xianyang and ten princesses at Du to secure his throne.
summary_zh: 二世用赵高之计，戮公子十二人于咸阳市，磔公主十人于杜。

title: Zhou Wen's rebels reach Xi near Xianyang
summary: Zhou Wen led hundreds of thousands to within sight of the capital, but Zhang Han armed the Lishan convicts and drove him back.
summary_zh: 张楚将周文率数十万众入关至戏，章邯赦骊山刑徒击退之。

title: Li Si is executed
summary: Zhao Gao has the great chancellor tortured into a false confession and executed with his family.
summary_zh: 赵高对丞相李斯严刑逼供，使其屈打成招，最终连同家族一起被处死。

title: Chen Sheng killed by his charioteer
summary: Defeated by Zhang Han, Chen Sheng retreated and was murdered by his driver Zhuang Jia, six months after his uprising.
summary_zh: 陈胜兵败退至下城父，为车夫庄贾所杀，起义仅六月。

title: Xiang Liang enthrones King Huai of Chu
summary: On Fan Zeng's advice, Xiang Liang found the grandson of King Huai herding sheep and made him king to rally Chu loyalty.
summary_zh: 项梁用范增之策，立楚怀王之孙熊心为楚怀王，都盱眙。

title: Zhang Han kills Xiang Liang at Dingtao
summary: Overconfident after victories, Xiang Liang was surprised by a reinforced Zhang Han at Dingtao and killed.
summary_zh: 项梁屡胜而骄，章邯得增援夜袭定陶，项梁战死。

title: Battle of Julu
summary: Xiang Yu breaks the main Qin army. The Qin empire collapses within the year.
summary_zh: 项羽击溃秦军主力，不到一年秦朝便土崩瓦解。

title: Zhao Gao forces the Second Emperor's suicide
summary: As rebels neared, Zhao Gao's son-in-law Yan Le stormed Wangyi Palace and forced Huhai to kill himself.
summary_zh: 赵高令阎乐率兵入望夷宫，逼秦二世自杀。

title: Zhao Gao calls a deer a horse
summary: Zhao Gao tests the court by presenting a deer as a horse, then forces the Second Emperor to kill himself.
summary_zh: 赵高献鹿称马，借此试探群臣，随后逼迫秦二世自杀。

title: Ziying kills Zhao Gao
summary: Installed as King of Qin, Ziying feigned illness, lured Zhao Gao to his chamber, and had him killed and his clan exterminated.
summary_zh: 子婴立为秦王，称病不出，诱赵高前来，刺杀之并夷其三族。

title: Liu Bang breaks through Wu Pass
summary: While Xiang Yu fought in the north, Liu Bang took the southern route, bribed Qin commanders, and broke through Wu Pass and Yao Pass toward Xianyang.
summary_zh: 刘邦西进，以利诱降秦将，攻破武关、峣关，直逼咸阳。

title: Feast at Hong Gate
summary: Xiang Yu spares his rival Liu Bang at a tense banquet, a mistake that decides the Chu–Han war.
summary_zh: 项羽在一场暗藏杀机的宴会上放过了对手刘邦，这一失误决定了楚汉相争的结局。

title: Liu Bang's three-article covenant
summary: Entering Guanzhong, Liu Bang sealed the Qin treasury and promised the elders just three laws—against murder, injury and theft—winning popular support.
summary_zh: 刘邦入关中，封存秦府库，与父老约法三章：杀人者死，伤人及盗抵罪，深得民心。

title: Xiang Yu divides the Eighteen Kingdoms
summary: Xiang Yu proclaimed himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu and carved the empire into eighteen kingdoms, banishing Liu Bang to Hanzhong as King of Han.
summary_zh: 项羽自立为西楚霸王，分封十八诸侯，将刘邦封为汉王，置于巴蜀汉中。

title: Han Xin secretly crosses at Chencang
summary: Han forces left Hanzhong by the Chencang route, defeating Zhang Han and conquering the Three Qins of Guanzhong.
summary_zh: 汉军明修栈道、暗度陈仓，击败章邯，平定三秦，夺取关中。

title: Battle of Pengcheng
summary: Liu Bang seized Xiang Yu's capital with a huge coalition, but Xiang Yu's 30,000 cavalry routed it, driving Han troops into the Sui River.
summary_zh: 刘邦率诸侯联军攻占彭城，项羽以三万精骑回师大破汉军，睢水为之不流。

title: Battle of Jingxing
summary: Han Xin deployed his army with its back to a river and seized Zhao's camp with a hidden detachment, destroying the kingdom of Zhao.
summary_zh: 韩信背水列阵，奇兵拔赵旗，大破赵军，斩陈馀，擒赵王歇。

title: Siege of Xingyang
summary: Xiang Yu besieged Liu Bang at Xingyang; Ji Xin impersonated the king to let him escape, while Chen Ping's ruse made Xiang Yu doubt his adviser Fan Zeng.
summary_zh: 项羽围刘邦于荥阳，纪信诈降替死，陈平用反间计离间项羽与范增。

title: Battle of Wei River
summary: Han Xin dammed and then released the Wei River, splitting and annihilating the Chu army of Long Ju sent to rescue Qi.
summary_zh: 韩信囊沙壅潍水，半渡决水，斩楚将龙且，平定齐地。

title: Truce along the Hong Canal
summary: Exhausted, Chu and Han agreed to divide the realm at the Hong Canal and Xiang Yu released Liu Bang's family; Liu Bang soon broke the truce.
summary_zh: 楚汉相持于广武，约定中分天下、以鸿沟为界，项羽归还刘邦家眷，刘邦旋即背约追击。

title: Battle of Gaixia
summary: Xiang Yu is surrounded and kills himself. Liu Bang becomes Emperor Gaozu of Han.
summary_zh: 项羽被重重围困，最终自刎。刘邦称帝，成为汉高祖。

title: Liu Bang proclaimed emperor
summary: After Xiang Yu's death, Liu Bang was enthroned north of the Si River at Dingtao, founding the Han dynasty as Emperor Gaozu.
summary_zh: 项羽死后，刘邦在定陶汜水之阳即皇帝位，是为汉高祖。

title: Han Xin seized at Yunmeng ruse
summary: Using a feigned tour to Yunmeng, Gaozu arrested the King of Chu Han Xin on charges of treason and demoted him to Marquis of Huaiyin.
summary_zh: 高祖用陈平计伪游云梦，于陈县擒楚王韩信，贬为淮阴侯。

title: Siege of Baideng
summary: The Xiongnu trap Liu Bang. Han buys peace with princesses and gifts, the heqin policy.
summary_zh: 匈奴把刘邦围困在白登。汉朝只好以公主和亲、赠送财物换取和平，这就是和亲政策。

title: Chang'an becomes the Han capital
summary: Liu Bang moves his court into the newly built Weiyang Palace, and Chang'an becomes the seat of the dynasty.
summary_zh: 刘邦迁入新建成的未央宫，长安成为汉朝的都城。

title: Shusun Tong devises court ritual
summary: At the opening of Changle Palace, Shusun Tong's new court ceremonial brought order to rowdy ministers; Gaozu remarked he now knew the dignity of an emperor.
summary_zh: 长乐宫成，叔孙通所定朝仪施行，群臣肃然，高祖叹：“吾乃今日知为皇帝之贵也。”

title: First heqin marriage alliance
summary: On Liu Jing's advice, Han sent a princess with annual gifts of silk, wine and grain to the Xiongnu chanyu Modu, beginning the heqin policy.
summary_zh: 采纳刘敬建议，汉以宗室女为公主嫁冒顿单于，岁奉絮缯酒食，和亲政策由此开始。

title: Chen Xi's rebellion in Dai
summary: Chen Xi, chancellor of Zhao guarding the north, rebelled as King of Dai; Gaozu campaigned personally, and Chen Xi was killed in 195 BCE.
summary_zh: 赵相国陈豨据代地反，自立为代王，高祖亲征，前195年陈豨被斩。

title: Han Xin is executed
summary: Empress Lü lures Liu Bang's greatest general into the palace and has him killed as a traitor.
summary_zh: 吕后把刘邦麾下最杰出的将领韩信骗进宫中，以谋反罪名将他处死。

title: Execution of Peng Yue
summary: The King of Liang, Peng Yue, accused of plotting rebellion, was executed and his clan exterminated at Empress Lü's urging.
summary_zh: 梁王彭越被告谋反，吕后劝高祖诛之，夷其三族，醢其肉遍赐诸侯。

title: Ying Bu's rebellion
summary: Alarmed by the deaths of Han Xin and Peng Yue, the King of Huainan Ying Bu revolted; Gaozu crushed him but was wounded by an arrow.
summary_zh: 韩信、彭越相继被杀，淮南王英布起兵反，高祖亲征破之于蕲西，自身中流矢。

title: Lu Jia's mission to Nanyue
summary: Lu Jia persuaded Zhao Tuo to accept a Han seal as King of Nanyue and submit as a vassal.
summary_zh: 陆贾出使南越，说服赵佗接受汉朝所封南越王印绶，称臣奉汉约。

title: Empress Lü rules the Han
summary: After Liu Bang's death his widow holds power for fifteen years, the first woman to rule China in all but name.
summary_zh: 刘邦死后，他的遗孀吕后掌权十五年，成为中国第一位实际执政的女性。

title: Death of Emperor Gaozu
summary: Gaozu died of his wound after binding his lords by the White Horse Oath that only Liu clansmen be kings; his son Liu Ying became Emperor Hui.
summary_zh: 高祖与群臣立白马之盟“非刘氏而王者天下共击之”，旋因箭伤驾崩，太子刘盈即位为惠帝。

title: Empress Lü murders Liu Ruyi
summary: Empress Dowager Lü poisoned Gaozu's favourite son Liu Ruyi and mutilated his mother Lady Qi as the 'human swine', horrifying Emperor Hui.
summary_zh: 吕太后鸩杀赵王如意，断戚夫人手足为“人彘”，惠帝见之大病，自此不听政。

title: Cao Shen follows Xiao He's rules
summary: After Xiao He's death, Cao Shen became chancellor and kept his predecessor's laws unchanged, following Huang-Lao non-interference.
summary_zh: 萧何卒，曹参继任相国，一遵萧何约束，清静无为，百姓歌之。

title: Qin ban on private books lifted
summary: Emperor Hui abolished the Qin statute forbidding private possession of books, allowing classical learning to revive.
summary_zh: 惠帝废除秦代挟书律，民间得以收藏书籍，儒学经典逐渐复兴。

title: Statutes of the Second Year
summary: The Han legal code of Empress Lü's second year, later recovered from Zhangjiashan tomb 247, shows how Han law adapted Qin statutes.
summary_zh: 吕后二年颁行的汉律，出土于张家山二四七号汉墓，反映汉初对秦律的继承与改造。

title: Zhao Tuo proclaims himself emperor
summary: Angered by Empress Lü's ban on exporting iron tools to the south, Zhao Tuo declared himself Martial Emperor of Nanyue and raided Changsha.
summary_zh: 吕后禁止向南越输出铁器，赵佗怒而自称南越武帝，发兵攻长沙边邑。

title: The Rule of Wen and Jing
summary: Two frugal emperors cut taxes and punishments, and the country grows rich after decades of war.
summary_zh: 两位节俭的皇帝减轻赋税和刑罚，饱经战乱的国家日渐富庶。

title: Suppression of the Lü clan
summary: After Empress Lü's death, Zhou Bo and Chen Ping seized the Northern Army, slaughtered the Lü clan and enthroned Liu Heng as Emperor Wen.
summary_zh: 吕后死，周勃、陈平夺北军，尽诛诸吕，迎立代王刘恒为汉文帝。

title: Xiongnu drive out the Yuezhi
summary: Modu announced that his Wise King of the Right had crushed the Yuezhi and subjugated Loulan, Wusun and 26 states of the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 冒顿致书汉廷，称右贤王击破月氏，平定楼兰、乌孙等二十六国，尽为匈奴。

title: Jia Yi exiled to Changsha
summary: The brilliant young reformer Jia Yi, author of 'The Faults of Qin', was sent away as tutor to the King of Changsha after senior ministers opposed him.
summary_zh: 《过秦论》作者贾谊遭周勃、灌婴等排挤，出为长沙王太傅，作《吊屈原赋》。

title: Chao Cuo's frontier colonization plan
summary: Chao Cuo urged settling farming colonists with houses and tools along the northern border to defend against the Xiongnu; Emperor Wen adopted it.
summary_zh: 晁错上《守边备塞疏》，主张募民徙居塞下，屯垦守边以御匈奴，文帝采纳。

title: The Mawangdui tombs are sealed
