summary: A noble family of Changsha is buried with silk books, paintings and maps. The well-preserved body of Lady Dai is found in 1972.
summary_zh: 长沙国一个贵族家庭的墓中随葬了帛书、帛画和地图。1972年，保存完好的轪侯夫人遗体出土。

title: Mutilating punishments abolished
summary: Moved by the girl Tiying's plea to serve as a slave in place of her father, Emperor Wen replaced tattooing and amputation with flogging and penal labour.
summary_zh: 少女缇萦上书愿为官婢赎父刑，文帝感动，下诏废除黥、劓、斩趾等肉刑。

title: Xiongnu raid through Xiao Pass
summary: Chanyu Laoshang led 140,000 horsemen through Xiao Pass, burning the Huizhong Palace; their scouts came within sight of Chang'an.
summary_zh: 老上单于率十四万骑入朝那、萧关，烧回中宫，侯骑至雍、甘泉。

title: Zhou Yafu's discipline at Xiliu
summary: During a Xiongnu incursion, Emperor Wen was refused entry to Zhou Yafu's camp until the general's orders allowed it, and praised him as a true general.
summary_zh: 匈奴入边，文帝劳军至细柳营，守卒“军中闻将军令，不闻天子诏”，文帝叹为真将军。

title: Land tax set at one-thirtieth
summary: Emperor Jing fixed the land tax at one-thirtieth of the harvest, a low rate that remained standard for the rest of Han.
summary_zh: 景帝即位，定田租为三十税一，成为两汉长期沿用的轻税制度。

title: Rebellion of the Seven States
summary: Seven Han kings led by the King of Wu revolt against plans to cut their lands. The rebellion is crushed in three months.
summary_zh: 以吴王为首的七个诸侯王反对削藩，起兵叛乱，三个月内即被平定。

title: Liang holds Suiyang against Wu and Chu
summary: Liu Wu, King of Liang, held his capital against the rebel armies of Wu and Chu while Zhou Yafu cut their supply lines, deciding the Seven States war.
summary_zh: 七国之乱中梁王刘武死守睢阳，牵制吴楚主力，周亚夫断其粮道，叛军遂溃。

title: Emperor Wu ascends the throne
summary: Sixteen-year-old Liu Che succeeded Emperor Jing, beginning a 54-year reign of expansion and centralization.
summary_zh: 景帝崩，十六岁的刘彻即位，是为汉武帝，在位五十四年。

title: Wen Weng founds a school in Shu
summary: Wen Weng, governor of Shu, built a stone-chambered public school and sent students to the capital, making Sichuan a centre of learning.
summary_zh: 蜀郡守文翁在成都修石室学宫，选子弟入京受业，开地方官学之先。

title: First reign-era name: Jianyuan
summary: Emperor Wu's first years were later designated Jianyuan, the beginning of China's system of era names used until 1911.
summary_zh: 汉武帝始用“建元”年号纪年，中国年号制度自此开始，沿用两千余年。

title: Liu An presents the Huainanzi
summary: The King of Huainan gives the young Emperor Wu a book of Daoist-leaning thought written by his court scholars.
summary_zh: 淮南王刘安把门客编写的一部以道家为主的著作献给年轻的汉武帝。

title: Zhang Qian travels to the Western Regions
summary: Sent to find allies against the Xiongnu, Zhang Qian is captured twice but returns with knowledge of Central Asia that opens the Silk Road.
summary_zh: 张骞奉命寻找对抗匈奴的盟友，两度被匈奴扣押，最终带回中亚的大量见闻，打开了丝绸之路。

title: Dong'ou rescued and resettled
summary: When Minyue besieged Dong'ou, Emperor Wu sent a fleet from Kuaiji; the Dong'ou people then moved north to settle between the Yangtze and Huai.
summary_zh: 闽越围东瓯，武帝遣严助发会稽兵浮海救之，东瓯举国内迁江淮之间。

title: Confucian classics become state learning
summary: Emperor Wu appoints official scholars for the Five Classics, making Confucian learning the path to government office.
summary_zh: 汉武帝设立五经博士，儒学从此成为入仕做官的正途。

title: Tang Meng opens the road to Yelang
summary: Learning of a route from Shu to Nanyue via Yelang, Tang Meng persuaded Yelang to accept Han officials and set up Jianwei commandery.
summary_zh: 唐蒙在南越食蜀枸酱，知夜郎可通南越，出使夜郎，置犍为郡。

title: Dong Zhongshu's 'Three Responses'
summary: Dong Zhongshu answered Emperor Wu with essays on Heaven and man, urging him to honour Confucianism alone and found a national academy.
summary_zh: 董仲舒对策天人三策，倡“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”，建议兴太学、举贤才。

title: Recommendation of the Filial and Incorrupt
summary: Each commandery was ordered to recommend one filial and one incorrupt man annually, establishing the recommendation system for selecting officials.
summary_zh: 武帝诏郡国每年举孝、廉各一人，察举制度由此确立。

title: The Mayi ambush fails
summary: A Han trap for the Xiongnu chanyu is discovered, ending the peace policy and starting decades of war.
summary_zh: 汉朝设伏诱击匈奴单于的计划败露，和亲政策就此终止，此后汉匈交战数十年。

title: Sima Xiangru pacifies the Southwest
summary: The poet Sima Xiangru, sent as envoy, brought the Qiong and Zuo peoples under Han rule and built roads into the southwest.
summary_zh: 辞赋家司马相如奉使西南夷，邛、筰诸部内附，开通道路，置都尉。

title: Wei Qing's raid on Longcheng
summary: In the first of Emperor Wu's offensives, Wei Qing reached the Xiongnu ritual centre at Longcheng, while three other generals were defeated.
summary_zh: 汉四路出击匈奴，唯卫青直捣龙城，斩首七百，汉军首次主动出击告捷。

title: Ordos recovered; Shuofang founded
place_zh: 朔方（今内蒙古鄂尔多斯）
summary: Wei Qing drove the Xiongnu kings Loufan and Baiyang from the Ordos loop; Han founded Shuofang commandery and resettled 100,000 people there.
summary_zh: 卫青击走楼烦、白羊王，收复河南地，置朔方、五原郡，徙民十万实之。

title: Edict of Grace splits fiefs
summary: On Zhufu Yan's advice, kings were allowed to divide their realms among all sons, steadily fragmenting the princely states without open confrontation.
summary_zh: 采主父偃之策，许诸侯王推恩分封子弟为列侯，王国日益分割削弱。

title: Zhang Qian returns from the west
summary: After thirteen years and two Xiongnu captivities, Zhang Qian returned with knowledge of Dayuan, Bactria, Kangju and Parthia.
summary_zh: 张骞历时十三年，两度被匈奴扣留，归汉报告大宛、大夏、康居、安息诸国情况。

title: Imperial Academy founded
summary: Emperor Wu established the Taixue with fifty students under the Five Classics erudites, the first state academy training officials.
summary_zh: 武帝采公孙弘议，为五经博士置弟子五十人，太学由此创立。

title: Liu An of Huainan conspiracy
summary: Liu An, King of Huainan and patron of the Huainanzi, was accused of plotting rebellion and killed himself; tens of thousands were implicated.
summary_zh: 淮南王刘安、衡山王刘赐谋反事发，刘安自杀，株连数万人。

title: Huo Qubing takes the Hexi Corridor
summary: Two lightning cavalry raids break Xiongnu power west of the Yellow River and open the road to Central Asia.
summary_zh: 两次闪电般的骑兵远征摧毁了匈奴在黄河以西的势力，打通了通往中亚的道路。

title: King Hunye surrenders
summary: The Xiongnu King Hunye killed King Xiuchu and surrendered with 40,000 followers, opening the Hexi Corridor to Han settlement.
summary_zh: 匈奴浑邪王杀休屠王，率四万余众降汉，河西走廊归汉。

title: Battle of Mobei
summary: Wei Qing and Huo Qubing strike deep into Mongolia and drive the Xiongnu north.
summary_zh: 卫青、霍去病深入蒙古高原，把匈奴赶到大漠以北。

title: State monopolies on salt and iron
summary: To pay for war, Emperor Wu puts the production and sale of salt and iron under state control.
summary_zh: 为了筹措军费，汉武帝把盐和铁的生产、销售收归官营。

title: The wuzhu coin is introduced
summary: A new standard bronze coin is issued. It stays in use for about seven hundred years.
summary_zh: 朝廷发行新的标准铜钱五铢钱，此后沿用了约七百年。

title: Zhang Qian's mission to Wusun
summary: Zhang Qian's second embassy sought an alliance with Wusun; he returned in 115 BCE with Wusun envoys, while his deputies reached Parthia and beyond.
summary_zh: 张骞二使西域，赴乌孙谋联盟，前115年偕乌孙使者归，副使分赴大宛、安息等国。

title: Informing on property-tax evasion
summary: Merchants' property was taxed and informers rewarded with half of any concealed wealth, bankrupting most middle-rank merchant families.
summary_zh: 武帝推行算缗，又颁告缗令，告发隐匿资产者得其半，中家以上商贾大抵皆破。

title: Liu Sheng buried in jade suit
summary: Liu Sheng, King of Zhongshan, was buried at Mancheng in a suit of 2,498 jade plates; his wife Dou Wan's tomb held the Changxin Palace lamp.
summary_zh: 中山靖王刘胜卒，葬满城，身着金缕玉衣，其妻窦绾墓出土长信宫灯。

title: Music Bureau expanded
summary: Emperor Wu enlarged the Yuefu under Li Yannian to collect folk songs and compose ritual music, preserving a major body of Han poetry.
summary_zh: 武帝扩充乐府，以李延年为协律都尉，采集各地民歌，形成乐府诗传统。

title: Han conquers Nanyue
summary: Emperor Wu annexes the southern kingdom, bringing Guangdong, Guangxi and northern Vietnam under Han rule.
summary_zh: 汉武帝吞并南越国，把今广东、广西和越南北部纳入汉朝版图。

title: Hexi commanderies established
summary: Wuwei, Jiuquan, Zhangye and Dunhuang commanderies were set up in stages along the Hexi Corridor, securing the road to the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 河西陆续设武威、酒泉、张掖、敦煌四郡，列四郡、据两关，保障西域通道。

title: Southwestern Yi commanderies created
summary: After Nanyue fell, Han troops subdued Qielan and other southwestern peoples, creating Zangke, Yuexi and other commanderies.
summary_zh: 灭南越后汉军平定且兰等西南夷，置牂柯、越巂、沈黎等郡。

title: Equable transport and price stabilization
summary: Sang Hongyang had the state buy goods cheaply and transport them where scarce, and stockpile in the capital to stabilise prices, profiting the treasury.
summary_zh: 桑弘羊全面推行均输、平准法，由官府调剂运销、平抑物价，国库充盈。

title: Emperor Wu's sacrifices at Mount Tai
summary: Emperor Wu performed the Feng and Shan sacrifices at Mount Tai, proclaiming his reign's success to Heaven and Earth; Sima Tan died unable to attend.
summary_zh: 武帝东巡封泰山、禅肃然，告成功于天地，太史令司马谈因未能从行抱憾而终。

title: Conquest of Minyue
summary: Han armies converged on Dong Yue after its king Yushan rebelled; he was killed and the population moved to the Jiang–Huai region.
summary_zh: 东越王余善反，汉军四路进击，余善被杀，徙其民于江淮间，闽越国灭。

title: Han conquers Gojoseon
summary: Han armies take the kingdom in northern Korea and set up four commanderies there.
summary_zh: 汉军攻灭朝鲜半岛北部的卫氏朝鲜，在那里设立四郡。

title: King of Dian receives Han seal
summary: Facing Han troops, the King of Dian surrendered and was granted a gold seal; Yizhou commandery was set up, and the seal was excavated in 1956.
summary_zh: 汉兵临滇，滇王举国降，置益州郡，赐滇王金印，1956年出土于石寨山。

title: Yellow River breach at Huzi sealed
summary: Emperor Wu personally oversaw the closing of the Yellow River breach at Huzi, open for over twenty years, and composed the 'Song of Huzi'.
summary_zh: 武帝亲临瓠子，令将军以下负薪填决口，堵塞决溢二十余年的黄河，作《瓠子歌》。

title: Zhao Ponu captures Loulan
summary: Zhao Ponu with 700 light cavalry captured the King of Loulan and defeated Gushi, extending Han power to the Tarim basin.
summary_zh: 赵破奴率轻骑七百俘楼兰王，破姑师，汉威始振西域。

title: Princess Xijun married to Wusun
summary: Liu Xijun of Jiangdu was married to the Wusun king to secure an alliance against the Xiongnu; her 'Song of Sorrow' laments her exile.
summary_zh: 江都王女刘细君以公主身份嫁乌孙昆莫，联乌孙制匈奴，作《悲愁歌》。

title: The Taichu calendar
summary: A new official calendar starts the year in the first month, as the Chinese New Year still does today.
summary_zh: 新颁行的历法以正月为岁首，今天的农历新年仍沿用这一规定。

title: War of the Heavenly Horses
summary: Emperor Wu sends armies 4,000 kilometres west to win the fine horses of Dayuan in Ferghana.
summary_zh: 汉武帝派大军西行数千公里，攻打费尔干纳盆地的大宛国，夺取良马。

title: Su Wu detained by the Xiongnu
summary: Envoy Su Wu refused to surrender and was exiled to herd rams at Lake Baikal, holding his envoy's staff for nineteen years.
summary_zh: 苏武出使匈奴被扣，坚拒降，徙北海牧羊，持节十九年不屈。

title: Li Ling surrenders at Mount Junji
summary: Li Ling's 5,000 infantry fought eight days against 80,000 Xiongnu before surrendering; Sima Qian's defence of him earned castration.
summary_zh: 李陵率步卒五千与匈奴八万骑激战，矢尽降敌；司马迁为之辩护，下狱受腐刑。

title: Bai Canal dug
summary: Bai Gong's canal led Jing River water across Guanzhong parallel to the Zhengguo Canal, irrigating some 4,500 qing of fields.
summary_zh: 赵中大夫白公奏穿白渠，引泾水注渭，溉田四千五百余顷，与郑国渠并称郑白。

title: Sima Qian completes the Records of the Grand Historian
summary: The first general history of China, from the Yellow Emperor to Emperor Wu, and the model for all later dynastic histories.
summary_zh: 中国第一部通史，从黄帝写到汉武帝，成为后世历代正史的典范。

title: The witchcraft scandal
summary: Accused of using black magic against Emperor Wu, Crown Prince Liu Ju rises in Chang'an, is defeated and kills himself.
summary_zh: 太子刘据被诬用巫术诅咒汉武帝，在长安起兵，兵败自杀。

title: Li Guangli surrenders to the Xiongnu
summary: Learning his family had been arrested in the witchcraft purges, General Li Guangli pushed deep north, lost his army and surrendered.
summary_zh: 李广利出塞时家属因巫蛊案下狱，冒进兵败，降于匈奴，汉军七万覆没。

title: Luntai Edict of repentance
summary: Emperor Wu rejected a plan to garrison Luntai and issued an edict regretting the burdens of war, turning policy toward rest and agriculture.
summary_zh: 武帝驳回桑弘羊屯田轮台之议，下诏深陈既往之悔，政策转向与民休息、重农。

title: Zhao Guo's alternating-furrow farming
summary: Zhao Guo introduced the daitian method of alternating ridges and furrows each year, with improved ox-ploughs and seed drills.
summary_zh: 搜粟都尉赵过推广代田法，垄沟逐年轮换，并推广耦犁、耧车，提高产量。

title: Death of Emperor Wu; Huo Guang regent
summary: Emperor Wu died after naming eight-year-old Liu Fuling heir, with Huo Guang, Jin Midi and Shangguan Jie as regents.
summary_zh: 武帝崩于五柞宫，八岁的刘弗陵即位为昭帝，霍光、金日磾、上官桀受遗诏辅政。

title: The debate on salt and iron
summary: Confucian scholars and the minister Sang Hongyang argue at court over state monopolies and war.
summary_zh: 儒生与大臣桑弘羊在朝廷上围绕盐铁官营和对外战争展开辩论。

title: Su Wu returns after nineteen years
summary: A Han envoy held by the Xiongnu, who herded sheep by Lake Baikal rather than surrender, finally comes home.
summary_zh: 被匈奴扣留、宁可在北海牧羊也不投降的汉朝使者苏武终于回到长安。

title: Shangguan Jie's plot crushed
summary: Shangguan Jie, Sang Hongyang, Princess Eyi and Liu Dan of Yan plotted to kill Huo Guang; the plot was exposed and the conspirators destroyed.
summary_zh: 上官桀、桑弘羊与鄂邑长公主、燕王刘旦合谋除霍光，事泄被诛，霍光独揽朝政。

title: Fu Jiezi assassinates the King of Loulan
summary: Envoy Fu Jiezi killed the pro-Xiongnu king of Loulan at a banquet; the state was renamed Shanshan under a Han-backed ruler.
summary_zh: 傅介子出使楼兰，宴中刺杀亲匈奴的楼兰王，汉立新王，改国名为鄯善。

title: Huo Guang deposes Liu He
summary: The regent removes a new emperor after 27 days and enthrones Liu Bingyi, who grew up as a commoner.
summary_zh: 大将军霍光在新皇帝刘贺即位二十七天后将其废黜，改立在民间长大的刘病已。

title: Han–Wusun campaign against Xiongnu
summary: Five Han armies and Wusun forces under Chang Hui struck the Xiongnu, who lost heavily and never regained their former strength.
summary_zh: 汉遣五将军十五万骑并乌孙兵合击匈奴，常惠率乌孙大获，匈奴自此衰耗。

title: Zheng Ji conquers Jushi
summary: Zheng Ji led agricultural colonists from Quli to capture Jushi, contesting the Turpan oasis with the Xiongnu.
summary_zh: 郑吉率渠犁屯田士卒攻破车师，与匈奴争夺吐鲁番盆地。

title: Huo clan exterminated
summary: Two years after Huo Guang's death, his family plotted to depose Emperor Xuan after poisoning his empress was revealed; the clan was annihilated.
summary_zh: 霍光死后二年，霍氏毒杀许皇后事泄，谋废宣帝，被族诛，霍皇后被废。

title: Feng Fengshi suppresses Yarkand
summary: Envoy Feng Fengshi raised troops from local states to crush a rebellion in Yarkand that had killed a Han envoy, restoring Han prestige.
summary_zh: 冯奉世出使西域，征发诸国兵攻破反汉的莎车，传首长安，威震西域。

title: Zhao Chongguo's Qiang campaign and tuntian
summary: The 76-year-old Zhao Chongguo pacified the Qiang revolt by establishing military farming colonies along the Huang River rather than seeking battle.
summary_zh: 七十六岁的赵充国征西羌，上屯田十二便，屯田湟中，以逸待劳，羌乱平定。

title: Protectorate of the Western Regions
summary: Han sets up a governor over the oasis states of the Tarim Basin.
summary_zh: 汉朝设立都护，统辖塔里木盆地的绿洲诸国。

title: Ever-normal granaries
summary: Geng Shouchang proposed border granaries that bought grain when cheap and sold when dear, the origin of China's ever-normal granary system.
summary_zh: 大司农中丞耿寿昌奏设常平仓，谷贱时增价而籴，谷贵时减价而粜。

title: Huhanye Chanyu comes to the Han court
summary: A Xiongnu ruler visits the emperor in person and accepts Han overlordship, ending a century of war.
summary_zh: 匈奴单于亲自朝见汉朝皇帝，向汉称臣，持续百年的汉匈战争告一段落。

title: Shiqu Pavilion Council
summary: Emperor Xuan convened scholars at the Shiqu Pavilion to resolve differences in interpreting the Five Classics, ruling personally on disputes.
summary_zh: 宣帝召诸儒于石渠阁讲论五经异同，亲自称制临决，增立博士。

title: Eunuch Shi Xian drives Xiao Wangzhi to suicide
summary: Emperor Yuan's tutor Xiao Wangzhi, attacked by the eunuchs Hong Gong and Shi Xian, killed himself; eunuch influence grew at court.
summary_zh: 元帝师傅萧望之遭宦官弘恭、石显构陷，饮鸩自杀，宦官始专权。

title: Zhuya commandery abandoned
summary: After repeated revolts on Hainan, Emperor Yuan accepted Jia Juanzhi's advice and withdrew from Zhuya commandery.
summary_zh: 海南岛屡叛，元帝采贾捐之议，罢弃珠崖郡。

title: Battle of Zhizhi
place_zh: 郅支城（今哈萨克斯坦塔拉兹附近）
summary: Han officers in Central Asia storm the fortress of the rebel chanyu Zhizhi and kill him.
summary_zh: 汉朝驻西域官员攻破郅支单于的城池，将其斩杀。

title: Wang Zhaojun marries the Xiongnu chanyu
summary: A palace lady is sent north as a bride, one of the most retold stories of frontier peace.
summary_zh: 宫女王昭君远嫁匈奴单于，成为流传最广的边塞和平故事之一。

title: Wang Feng dominates the court
summary: Emperor Cheng made his uncle Wang Feng Grand Marshal; five Wang brothers were enfeoffed in one day, beginning the consort clan's grip on power.
summary_zh: 成帝以舅王凤为大司马大将军领尚书事，同日封五侯，王氏外戚专权始此。

title: Wang Yanshi seals the Yellow River
summary: After the river burst its dykes at Dongjun, flooding four commanderies, Wang Yanshi closed the breach in 36 days using bamboo baskets filled with stones.
summary_zh: 黄河决东郡金堤，泛滥四郡，王延世以竹笼盛石塞决口，三十六日堤成。

title: Early sunspot record
summary: The Hanshu records a black vapour 'like a coin' in the sun, among the world's earliest dated sunspot observations.
summary_zh: 《汉书·五行志》载河平元年“日出黄，有黑气大如钱，居日中央”，为世界最早明确的黑子记录之一。

title: Liu Xiang collates the imperial library
summary: Liu Xiang led a team collating and editing the court's books, writing catalogues that formed the 'Bielu', the foundation of Chinese bibliography.
summary_zh: 刘向奉诏领校中秘书，整理群书并撰叙录，成《别录》，开中国目录学之先河。

title: Proposal to limit landholding and slaves
summary: Shi Dan and Kong Guang proposed caps on land and slaves held by nobles and officials; opposition from the powerful left it unenforced.
summary_zh: 哀帝初，师丹、孔光等议限民名田及奴婢数，因外戚权贵反对而搁置。

title: Liu Xin's Seven Epitomes
summary: Liu Xin completed his father's work with the Qilue, classifying the imperial collection into six categories, later the basis of the Hanshu bibliography.
summary_zh: 刘歆继父业，撰《七略》，分群书为六略，班固据以作《汉书·艺文志》。

title: Queen Mother of the West cult frenzy
summary: In a drought, crowds across 26 commanderies passed tokens of the Queen Mother of the West towards the capital, singing and worshipping in the streets.
summary_zh: 关东大旱，民众持稿或棷一枚，传相付与，称“行西王母筹”，经二十六郡国至京师聚会祭祀。

title: Buddhist scripture first transmitted
summary: The Yuezhi envoy Yicun orally taught a Buddhist sutra to the court student Jing Lu, the earliest recorded transmission of Buddhism to China.
summary_zh: 大月氏王使伊存口授博士弟子景卢《浮屠经》，为佛教传入中国的最早记载。

title: Dong Xian falls, Wang Mang returns
summary: On Emperor Ai's death his favourite Dong Xian was stripped of office and killed himself; Grand Empress Dowager Wang recalled Wang Mang as Grand Marshal.
summary_zh: 哀帝崩，宠臣董贤被罢，自杀；太皇太后王政君起用王莽为大司马，立平帝。

title: The oldest surviving census of China
summary: A count of the whole empire records nearly 60 million people in over 12 million households.
summary_zh: 全国户口统计显示，汉朝有一千二百多万户，近六千万人口。

title: Mingtang and Biyong built
summary: Wang Mang built the Mingtang ritual hall and Biyong academy and enlarged the Imperial Academy, winning scholars' support; their foundations survive in Xi'an.
summary_zh: 王莽奏建明堂、辟雍、灵台，扩充太学校舍，网罗儒生，遗址今存西安。

title: Wang Mang becomes acting emperor
summary: After the boy emperor Ping dies, Wang Mang picks an infant heir and rules as 'acting emperor'.
summary_zh: 汉平帝死后，王莽选立一个幼儿为继承人，自己以“摄皇帝”名义执政。

title: Zhai Yi's uprising
summary: Zhai Yi, governor of Dong commandery, raised an army of 100,000 against Wang Mang's regency, but was quickly defeated.
summary_zh: 东郡太守翟义立刘信为天子，起兵讨伐居摄的王莽，众至十余万，旋被击败。

title: Wang Mang founds the Xin dynasty
summary: The regent takes the throne and orders land reform, new coins and state monopolies.
summary_zh: 辅政大臣王莽登上皇位，下令推行土地改革、发行新币并实行国家专卖。

title: King's Fields and private dependants decree
summary: Wang Mang nationalized land as 'king's fields', banned its sale, capped family holdings and forbade trading slaves, renamed 'private dependants'.
summary_zh: 王莽下令更名天下田为“王田”，奴婢为“私属”，皆不得买卖，一家男丁不足八口而田过一井者须分给宗族乡邻。

title: Xiongnu seal downgraded
summary: Wang Mang's envoys replaced the Xiongnu chanyu's 'imperial seal' with a lesser 'Xin Xiongnu chanyu seal', provoking renewed border raids.
summary_zh: 王莽遣使收回匈奴“匈奴单于玺”，改授“新匈奴单于章”，单于怨怒，边患复起。

title: Wang Mang's currency reform
summary: Wang Mang replaces the trusted wuzhu coin with 28 kinds of money made of gold, silver, tortoise shell, cowrie and bronze. Trade falls into chaos.
summary_zh: 王莽废除通行已久的五铢钱，改用金、银、龟甲、贝壳、铜等材料制成的二十八种货币，商品交易陷入混乱。

title: Five Equalizations and Six Controls
summary: Market offices in six cities fixed prices and lent money, while salt, iron, wine, coinage, mountains and marshes, and credit became state controls.
summary_zh: 在长安、洛阳等六大城市设五均官平抑物价、办理赊贷，并对盐、铁、酒、铸钱、山泽、五均赊贷实行官营。

title: The Yellow River changes course
summary: The Yellow River bursts its dikes and shifts to a new course. Wang Mang leaves it unrepaired, and floods ravage the plain for decades.
summary_zh: 黄河决堤改道，王莽没有组织堵口修复，此后几十年间洪水在平原上肆虐。

title: Wang Mang abandons his land reform
summary: Faced with widespread anger, Wang Mang again allows land and slaves to be bought and sold.
summary_zh: 面对普遍的不满，王莽重新允许土地和奴婢买卖。

title: Goguryeo renamed 'Lower Guryeo'
summary: After Goguryeo troops refused to fight the Xiongnu, Xin forces killed their leader and Wang Mang insultingly renamed the state 'Xia Gouli'.
summary_zh: 高句丽兵不肯征匈奴，新军诱杀其侯驺，王莽改其名为“下句丽”，东北诸族怨叛。

title: Protector of Western Regions killed
summary: Yanqi rebelled and killed the Protector General Dan Qin; Xin control of the Western Regions collapsed and the oases fell back to the Xiongnu.
summary_zh: 焉耆叛新，攻杀西域都护但钦，西域与中原交通断绝，诸国复附匈奴。

title: Mother Lü's uprising
summary: A widow, Mother Lü, gathered young men to avenge her son executed by the county magistrate, killing him and taking to the sea.
summary_zh: 海曲吕母为报县宰冤杀其子之仇，散家财聚少年数千人，攻破海曲杀县宰，入海为寇。

title: Huoquan and huobu coins issued
summary: Wang Mang abolished his earlier complex currency and issued the huoquan coin and huobu spade money; frequent changes ruined trust in money.
summary_zh: 王莽罢大小钱，改行货泉、货布，币制屡变，百姓破产，农商失业。

title: Wang Mang orders a human dissection
summary: Wang Mang had court physicians dissect the executed rebel Wang Sunqing, measuring organs and tracing vessels with bamboo probes—an early recorded dissection.
summary_zh: 王莽令太医、尚方与巧屠解剖翟义党羽王孙庆尸体，量度五脏，以竹筳导其脉，知所终始。

title: Lülin uprising
place_zh: 绿林山（今湖北大洪山一带）
summary: Famine refugees form the Green Forest army, one of the revolts that topple Wang Mang.
summary_zh: 饥民聚集在绿林山，组成绿林军，成为推翻王莽的起义力量之一。

title: The Red Eyebrows rise
summary: Starving peasants in Shandong follow Fan Chong in revolt. They paint their eyebrows red to know each other in battle.
summary_zh: 山东饥民跟随樊崇起义，他们把眉毛涂成红色，以便在战斗中辨认自己人。

title: An early attempt at human flight
summary: Recruiting men with special skills against the Xiongnu, Wang Mang tested a man with bird-feather wings who glided several hundred paces before falling.
summary_zh: 王莽募奇技以攻匈奴，有人以大鸟翮为两翼，飞数百步而坠，为早期飞行尝试。

title: Nine Ancestral Temples built
summary: Despite famine, Wang Mang demolished Han palaces to build nine grand ancestral temples south of Chang'an, costing vast sums and many lives.
summary_zh: 王莽拆毁建章等宫，于长安南郊大兴九庙，穷极百工之巧，死者万数，耗费巨万。

title: Liu Yan and Liu Xiu raise troops
summary: Two brothers from a minor branch of the Han imperial family rise in Nanyang and join the Lülin rebels.
summary_zh: 汉室远支的刘縯、刘秀兄弟在南阳起兵，与绿林军联合。

title: Lülin splits after epidemic
summary: An epidemic killed half the Lülin rebels, who split into the Xiajiang and Xinshi armies; they later joined the Liu brothers at Nanyang.
summary_zh: 绿林山大疫，死者近半，义军分为下江兵、新市兵，后与刘縯、刘秀联合。

title: Battle of Chengchang
summary: The Red Eyebrows routed Wang Mang's army and killed his general Lian Dan, breaking Xin power in the east.
summary_zh: 赤眉军于成昌大败新军，斩更始将军廉丹，王莽在东方的统治崩溃。

title: Battle of Kunyang
summary: Liu Xiu routs Wang Mang's huge army. Wang Mang is killed in Chang'an the same year.
summary_zh: 刘秀大破王莽的百万大军。同年，王莽在长安被杀。

title: The Gengshi Emperor is proclaimed
summary: The rebel leaders make Liu Xuan, a member of the Han royal clan, emperor and promise to restore the Han.
summary_zh: 起义军首领拥立汉朝宗室刘玄为帝，号称恢复汉朝。

title: Wang Mang is killed in Chang'an
summary: Rebels break into Chang'an. Wang Mang is cut down on a terrace in the palace lake, and the Xin dynasty ends.
summary_zh: 起义军攻入长安，王莽在未央宫渐台被杀，新朝灭亡。

title: Liu Yan executed by the Gengshi Emperor
summary: Fearing his popularity, the Gengshi Emperor executed Liu Yan; his brother Liu Xiu hid his grief and apologized to avert suspicion.
summary_zh: 更始帝忌刘縯威名，杀之；刘秀不敢服丧，入宛谢罪，饮食言笑如常。

title: Liu Xin's plot against Wang Mang
summary: After Kunyang, the scholar Liu Xin, general Wang She and Dong Zhong plotted to seize Wang Mang; betrayed, they killed themselves.
summary_zh: 昆阳战后，国师刘歆与卫将军王涉、大司马董忠谋劫王莽降汉，事泄，皆自杀。

title: Wei Ao rises in Longxi
summary: Local gentry in Tianshui made Wei Ao their leader; he proclaimed loyalty to Han, killed Wang Mang's governors and took the Longyou region.
summary_zh: 天水豪强拥立隗嚣，称奉汉讨莽，攻杀新朝郡守，据有陇右。

title: Liu Xiu takes Handan from Wang Lang
summary: Sent to pacify the north, Liu Xiu rallied Hebei commanderies, captured Handan and killed the pretender Wang Lang, gaining the base for his empire.
summary_zh: 刘秀持节徇河北，联合上谷、渔阳等郡，攻破邯郸，诛王郎，奠定立国根基。

title: Gongsun Shu proclaims himself King of Shu
summary: Gongsun Shu, governor of Shu, seized Sichuan amid the chaos and declared himself King of Shu, later Emperor of Chengjia.
summary_zh: 导江卒正公孙述据益州，自立为蜀王，次年称帝，国号成家。

title: Liu Xiu restores the Han at Luoyang
summary: As Emperor Guangwu he founds the Eastern Han and moves the capital east.
summary_zh: 刘秀即位为光武帝，建立东汉，把都城东迁到洛阳。

title: Red Eyebrows take Chang'an
summary: The Red Eyebrows enthroned the cowherd Liu Penzi by lot, captured Chang'an and killed the Gengshi Emperor, then plundered the capital.
summary_zh: 赤眉军以抽签立放牛娃刘盆子为帝，攻入长安，更始帝降后被杀，长安遭劫掠。

title: Red Eyebrows surrender at Yiyang
summary: Starving after leaving Chang'an, the Red Eyebrows were trapped by Liu Xiu's armies and surrendered en masse, piling their arms as high as a hill.
summary_zh: 赤眉军粮尽东归，被汉军截于宜阳，刘盆子率众十余万投降，兵甲堆积与熊耳山齐。

title: Tax cut and slave manumission edicts
summary: Guangwu restored the one-thirtieth land tax and issued a series of edicts freeing those enslaved during the wars and forbidding the killing of slaves.
summary_zh: 光武帝恢复三十税一，前后多次下诏释放战乱中沦为奴婢者，禁止虐杀奴婢。

title: Campaign against Wei Ao in Longxi
summary: Guangwu personally led armies against Wei Ao; after Wei Ao's death his son surrendered in 34, prompting the saying 'having got Long, one covets Shu'.
summary_zh: 光武亲征隗嚣，隗嚣病死，其子隗纯于34年投降，光武有“得陇望蜀”之叹。

title: Conquest of Gongsun Shu
summary: Wu Han and Cen Peng's armies advanced up the Yangtze; Gongsun Shu was mortally wounded and Chengdu sacked, reunifying the empire.
summary_zh: 吴汉、岑彭溯江入蜀，公孙述重伤而死，成都破，全国复归统一。

title: Land and household survey
summary: Guangwu ordered a census of land and households to curb powerful clans; officials who falsified returns were executed and local magnates rose in revolt.
summary_zh: 光武下诏检核垦田顷亩与户口年纪，郡守多有舞弊被诛，各地豪强蜂起反抗。

title: Trưng sisters revolt in Jiaozhi
summary: Two sisters lead a rising against Han rule in the Red River delta. The general Ma Yuan crushes it in 43.
summary_zh: 征侧、征贰姐妹在红河三角洲起兵反抗汉朝统治，43年被伏波将军马援镇压。

title: Ma Yuan suppresses the Trưng sisters
summary: General Ma Yuan defeated and beheaded the Trưng sisters, reorganized Jiaozhi's administration and reputedly erected bronze boundary pillars.
summary_zh: 伏波将军马援平定交趾征侧、征贰，整顿郡县，传立铜柱为汉界。

title: Xiongnu split into north and south
summary: Rival claimant Bi proclaimed himself Huhanye Chanyu of the Southern Xiongnu and submitted to Han, which settled them inside the frontier.
summary_zh: 日逐王比自立为南单于，袭用呼韩邪称号附汉，匈奴分为南北两部，南匈奴入居塞内。

title: Ma Yuan dies at Wuxi
summary: The aged Ma Yuan, who had vowed to die 'wrapped in a horse's hide', died of disease campaigning against the Wuxi peoples and was posthumously slandered.
summary_zh: 马援以六十二岁高龄征五溪蛮，病死军中，实践“马革裹尸”之志，死后遭诬陷。

title: Guangwu's sacrifices at Mount Tai
summary: Guangwu performed the Feng and Shan rites and then proclaimed the prophetic chen-wei texts throughout the empire, making apocrypha official doctrine.
summary_zh: 光武帝东封泰山，同年“宣布图谶于天下”，谶纬之学成为官方学说。

title: Emperor Guangwu grants a gold seal to the King of Na
summary: An envoy from the Wa people of Japan reaches Luoyang and receives a gold seal. It is one of the earliest records of Japan in Chinese sources.
summary_zh: 日本倭人的使者来到洛阳，获赐金印。这是中国史书中关于日本最早的记载之一。

title: Portraits of the 28 Yuntai generals
summary: Emperor Ming had portraits of 28 generals who helped found Eastern Han painted in the Yuntai pavilion of the Southern Palace.
summary_zh: 明帝追念功臣，图画邓禹等二十八将于南宫云台。

title: Liu Ying patronizes Buddhism
summary: An edict praised Liu Ying, King of Chu, for honoring the Buddha alongside Huang-Lao—the earliest record of Buddhist practice by a Chinese prince.
summary_zh: 明帝诏书称楚王英“尚浮屠之仁祠”，为中国贵族奉佛的最早记载。

title: White Horse Temple is founded
summary: By tradition the first Buddhist temple in China, built for two Indian monks who arrived with sutras on a white horse.
summary_zh: 相传是中国第一座佛寺，为两位用白马驮经而来的天竺僧人所建。

title: Wang Jing tames the Yellow River
summary: Wang Jing and Wang Wu led several hundred thousand workers to dyke the Yellow River and separate it from the Bian canal; the river stayed stable for centuries.
summary_zh: 王景率卒数十万修筑千余里河堤，河汴分流，此后黄河八百年未有大改道。

title: Ailao submit; Yongchang founded
summary: The Ailao kingdom of western Yunnan submitted with over 500,000 people, and Han created Yongchang commandery.
summary_zh: 哀牢王柳貌率五十余万口内附，东汉置永昌郡，疆域拓至今滇西。

title: Ban Chao takes the Western Regions
summary: With a small force and local allies Ban Chao brings the Tarim oases back under Han control for thirty years.
summary_zh: 班超只带少量人马，联合当地势力，使塔里木盆地诸绿洲国家重归汉朝统辖达三十年。

title: Dou Gu defeats Xiongnu at Pulei Sea
place_zh: 蒲类海（今新疆巴里坤湖）
summary: Dou Gu routed the Northern Xiongnu Huyan King at Lake Barkol and set up a military colony at Yiwu, reopening the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 窦固大破北匈奴呼衍王于天山，追至蒲类海，留吏士屯田伊吾。

title: Geng Gong defends Shule city
summary: Besieged by the Xiongnu, Geng Gong's garrison dug for water and ate boiled leather; only 13 survivors returned to Yumen Pass.
summary_zh: 耿恭被北匈奴围困于疏勒城，拜井得泉，煮铠弩食筋革，坚守近一年，生还玉门者仅十三人。

title: White Tiger Hall debates
summary: Emperor Zhang gathers scholars to settle disputes over the Confucian classics. Ban Gu records the results.
summary_zh: 汉章帝召集儒生讨论经学分歧，由班固整理成书。

title: Wang Chong writes the Lunheng
summary: Wang Chong's Lunheng criticized superstition, omens and the apocrypha, arguing for natural causes—a landmark of Chinese rationalist thought.
summary_zh: 王充著《论衡》，“疾虚妄”，批驳天人感应与谶纬迷信，主张元气自然论。

title: Ban Gu completes the Book of Han
summary: Ban Gu largely completed the Hanshu, the first dynastic history, covering Western Han; his sister Ban Zhao later finished it.
summary_zh: 班固历时二十余年基本完成《汉书》，开创断代史体例，其妹班昭续成八表与天文志。

title: Dou Xian defeats the Northern Xiongnu
summary: A Han army defeats the Northern Xiongnu deep in Mongolia. Ban Gu carves a victory inscription on Mount Yanran.
summary_zh: 汉军深入漠北大败北匈奴，班固在燕然山刻石记功。

title: Kushan army repulsed by Ban Chao
summary: After Ban Chao refused the Kushan king a Han princess, 70,000 Kushan troops attacked; Ban Chao starved them out and they withdrew, paying tribute.
summary_zh: 贵霜求娶汉公主遭拒，遣副王谢率七万兵攻班超，班超坚壁清野，贵霜兵败请和。

title: Battle of the Altai Mountains
summary: Geng Kui routed the Northern Xiongnu chanyu at the Altai Mountains; the Northern Xiongnu fled westward out of Chinese records.
summary_zh: 耿夔大破北单于于金微山，北匈奴被迫西迁，从此远离中原。

title: Emperor He overthrows Dou Xian
summary: With the eunuch Zheng Zhong, Emperor He purged the Dou consort clan; Zheng Zhong's ennoblement began eunuch participation in power.
summary_zh: 和帝与宦官郑众密谋，收窦宪大将军印绶，迫其自杀，宦官自此参政。

title: Ban Chao subdues Yanqi
summary: Ban Chao raised troops from eight states to conquer Yanqi, after which over fifty states sent hostages to Han.
summary_zh: 班超发龟兹、鄯善等八国兵讨焉耆，斩其王，西域五十余国皆纳质内属。

title: Gan Ying is sent toward Rome
summary: Ban Chao sends Gan Ying west to reach Daqin, the Roman Empire. He gets as far as the sea in the Parthian lands and turns back.
summary_zh: 班超派甘英西行，打算出使大秦（罗马帝国）。他抵达安息西境的海边后折返。

title: Xu Shen's Shuowen Jiezi
summary: The first Chinese dictionary to sort characters by their components, explaining over 9,000 characters.
summary_zh: 第一部按部首编排汉字的字典，解说九千多个字。

title: Cai Lun presents paper to the emperor
summary: The court official improves papermaking from bark, hemp and rags, making a cheap writing material.
summary_zh: 宦官蔡伦用树皮、麻头和破布改进造纸法，造出了价廉易得的书写材料。

title: Empress Dowager Deng's regency
summary: Empress Deng Sui ruled as regent for two infant emperors for sixteen years, coping with floods, Qiang war and court frugality.
summary_zh: 和帝崩，邓太后先后立殇帝、安帝，临朝称制十六年，节俭理政，应对水旱与羌乱。

title: Ban Zhao's 'Lessons for Women'
summary: Ban Zhao, historian and tutor to Empress Deng, wrote Lessons for Women, which became a classic text of female conduct.
summary_zh: 班昭为邓太后师，作《女诫》七篇，后世奉为女教经典。

title: Great Qiang rebellion
summary: Qiang conscripts resisting service in the Western Regions rose up across Liangzhou; the decade-long war cost 24 billion cash and devastated the northwest.
summary_zh: 羌人不愿远戍西域，起兵反抗，蔓延凉、并、益诸州，历时十余年，耗费二百四十亿钱。

title: Western Regions Protectorate abolished
summary: With rebellion in the oases and the Qiang war at home, the court recalled the protector and abandoned the Western Regions.
summary_zh: 西域诸国背叛，加之羌乱，朝廷罢西域都护，召还屯田吏士，西域再度断绝。

title: Zhang Heng's water-driven armillary sphere
summary: Zhang Heng built a water-powered armillary sphere that rotated in step with the heavens, and wrote the Lingxian on cosmology.
summary_zh: 张衡制成漏水转浑天仪，以水力驱动与天象同步运转，并著《灵宪》阐述浑天说。

title: Ban Yong restores Han in the west
place_zh: 柳中（今新疆鄯善鲁克沁）
summary: Ban Chao's son Ban Yong was appointed Chief Clerk of the Western Regions, garrisoned Liuzhong and drove out the Northern Xiongnu.
summary_zh: 班超之子班勇任西域长史，屯柳中，击走北匈奴，西域复通。

title: Nineteen eunuchs enthrone Emperor Shun
summary: Sun Cheng and eighteen fellow eunuchs killed the Yan consort clan's men and enthroned Liu Bao as Emperor Shun; all nineteen became marquises.
summary_zh: 宦官孙程等十九人发动宫廷政变，诛阎氏，拥立顺帝，十九人皆封侯。

title: Zhang Heng's seismoscope
summary: The astronomer builds a bronze instrument said to show the direction of a distant earthquake.
summary_zh: 天文学家张衡制成铜质地动仪，据说能测出远方地震发生的方向。

title: Zuo Xiong's recommendation reform
summary: Zuo Xiong had nominees for xiaolian be at least forty and pass examinations in classics or documents, and the Imperial Academy was rebuilt.
summary_zh: 左雄奏定孝廉须年满四十，儒者试经学、文吏试章奏，同年重修太学。

title: Seismoscope detects Longxi earthquake
summary: A ball dropped from Zhang Heng's seismoscope though no tremor was felt in Luoyang; days later a messenger reported an earthquake in Longxi.
summary_zh: 地动仪一龙机发而洛阳无感，数日后驿使至，果报陇西地震，众服其妙。

title: Liang Ji poisons Emperor Zhi
summary: The eight-year-old Emperor Zhi called Liang Ji a 'domineering general' at court; Liang Ji had him poisoned and enthroned Emperor Huan.
summary_zh: 八岁的质帝当众称梁冀为“跋扈将军”，梁冀令人进毒饼杀之，改立桓帝。

title: An Shigao begins translating sutras
summary: The Parthian prince-monk An Shigao arrived in Luoyang and began translating Buddhist texts on meditation and Abhidharma into Chinese.
summary_zh: 安息王子安世高至洛阳，译出《安般守意经》等佛经，开汉译佛经之先。

title: Tanshihuai unites the Xianbei
summary: Tanshihuai united the Xianbei into a vast confederation from Liaodong to Wusun and raided Han's northern frontier for decades.
summary_zh: 檀石槐于弹汗山建庭，统一鲜卑诸部，东西万余里，屡寇汉边。

title: Emperor Huan destroys Liang Ji with eunuch help
summary: The emperor uses five eunuchs to overthrow the all-powerful consort clan of Liang Ji. Power passes from in-laws to eunuchs.
summary_zh: 桓帝依靠五名宦官除掉专权多年的外戚梁冀，朝政从外戚手中转入宦官手中。

title: Emperor Huan sacrifices to Laozi
summary: Emperor Huan sent officials to sacrifice to Laozi at his birthplace, and later worshipped Laozi and the Buddha together in the palace.
summary_zh: 桓帝遣使至苦县祠老子，次年又在宫中并祠黄老与浮屠。

title: Disasters of the Partisan Prohibitions
summary: Scholar-officials who attack the eunuchs are arrested and banned from office. The purge lasts until the Yellow Turban rising.
summary_zh: 抨击宦官的士大夫遭到逮捕并被禁止做官，这场清洗一直持续到黄巾起义爆发。

title: Roman envoy reaches Han
summary: A party claiming to come from the Roman emperor Andun (Marcus Aurelius) arrived via Rinan with ivory and rhinoceros horn—the first recorded Rome–China contact.
summary_zh: 大秦王安敦遣使自日南徼外献象牙、犀角、玳瑁，为中国与罗马交往的最早记载。

title: Duan Jiong crushes the Eastern Qiang
summary: Duan Jiong waged a campaign of annihilation against the Eastern Qiang, fighting over 180 battles and largely ending the Qiang wars.
summary_zh: 段颎主张剿灭，与东羌大小一百八十战，斩首三万八千余级，羌患基本平息。

title: Chen Fan and Dou Wu's failed coup
summary: Regent Dou Wu and Grand Tutor Chen Fan planned to kill the eunuchs; the eunuchs struck first, seized the young emperor and killed both.
summary_zh: 大将军窦武、太傅陈蕃谋诛宦官，事泄，曹节等劫持灵帝发兵，窦武自杀，陈蕃遇害。

title: Second Partisan Prohibition
summary: The eunuchs arrested Li Ying, Du Mi and other reformist literati; over a hundred died in prison and hundreds more were banned from office.
summary_zh: 宦官诬李膺、杜密等为钩党，下狱死者百余人，禁锢者六七百人。

title: Xiping Stone Classics
summary: The standard texts of the Confucian classics are carved on stone tablets outside the Imperial Academy.
summary_zh: 儒家经典的标准文本被刻在石碑上，立于太学门外。

title: Han expedition against the Xianbei fails
summary: Three Han armies of 30,000 cavalry struck at Tanshihuai's Xianbei confederation and were routed, losing nearly 90 percent of their men.
summary_zh: 夏育、田晏、臧旻三路出击檀石槐，大败而还，十丧七八。

title: Emperor Ling sells offices
summary: Emperor Ling openly sold official posts at the Western Garden, with set prices for each rank, accelerating corruption and exploitation.
summary_zh: 灵帝于西园开邸卖官，二千石二千万，四百石四百万，吏治大坏。

title: Hongdu Gate School founded
summary: Emperor Ling founded an academy for calligraphy, painting and rhapsody at the Hongdu Gate, the first arts school, opposed by Confucian officials.
summary_zh: 灵帝设鸿都门学，招收擅长辞赋、书法、绘画者，为世界最早的文艺专科学校。

title: Yellow Turban Rebellion
summary: Zhang Jue's Daoist movement rises across eastern China. The generals who crush it become warlords.
summary_zh: 张角以太平道聚众，在东部各地同时起事。镇压起义的将领后来纷纷成为割据一方的军阀。

title: Battle of Changshe
summary: Besieged by Yellow Turbans under Bo Cai, Huangfu Song launched a night fire attack and routed them, turning the war in Yingchuan.
summary_zh: 皇甫嵩被黄巾波才围于长社，乘风纵火夜袭，大破黄巾，扭转战局。

title: Fall of Guangzong; Zhang Jue dies
summary: Zhang Jue died of illness; Huangfu Song stormed Guangzong, killing Zhang Liang and tens of thousands of Yellow Turbans.
summary_zh: 张角病死，皇甫嵩攻破广宗，斩张梁，黄巾主力覆没。

title: Liangzhou rebellion of Bian Zhang and Han Sui
summary: Qiang and Xiaoyuezhi rebels joined by Han officials Bian Zhang and Han Sui revolted in Liangzhou and threatened the Chang'an region.
summary_zh: 湟中义从胡北宫伯玉等劫持边章、韩遂起兵，凉州大乱，兵锋直逼三辅。

title: Provincial governors (zhoumu) restored
summary: On Liu Yan's advice, powerful governors with military authority replaced inspectors in key provinces, paving the way for warlordism.
summary_zh: 采刘焉之议，改刺史为州牧，以重臣出任，掌一州军政，地方割据由此开端。

title: Eight Colonels of the Western Garden
summary: Emperor Ling created a new army under eight colonels, including Yuan Shao and Cao Cao, commanded by the eunuch Jian Shuo.
summary_zh: 灵帝设西园八校尉，以宦官蹇硕为上军校尉统领，袁绍、曹操等皆在其列。

title: Dong Zhuo seizes the capital
summary: After the eunuchs and the regent He Jin kill each other, the general Dong Zhuo takes Luoyang and puts Emperor Xian on the throne.
summary_zh: 宦官与大将军何进同归于尽后，凉州军阀董卓带兵入洛阳，废少帝，立汉献帝。

title: He Jin killed; eunuchs massacred
summary: The eunuchs assassinated Grand General He Jin; Yuan Shao stormed the palace and killed over 2,000 eunuchs, opening the way for Dong Zhuo.
summary_zh: 大将军何进谋诛宦官，反被张让等杀害，袁绍率兵入宫，尽诛宦官二千余人。

title: Zheng Xuan's commentaries on the classics
summary: Zheng Xuan synthesized New Text and Old Text traditions in commentaries on most classics, becoming the dominant authority on Confucian scholarship.
summary_zh: 郑玄遍注群经，融合今古文经学，形成“郑学”，成为汉代经学集大成者。

title: Coalition against Dong Zhuo; Luoyang burned
title_zh: 关东联军讨董，洛阳被焚
summary: Eastern governors form an alliance against Dong Zhuo. He burns Luoyang and moves the court to Chang'an.
summary_zh: 关东各州郡起兵讨伐董卓，董卓焚毁洛阳，挟持朝廷迁往长安。

title: Zhang Lu's theocracy in Hanzhong
summary: Zhang Lu, leader of the Five Pecks of Rice sect, seized Hanzhong and ruled it as a Daoist state with free hostels for travellers.
summary_zh: 五斗米道首领张鲁据汉中，以“鬼卒”“祭酒”治民，设义舍，政教合一近三十年。

title: Sun Jian defeats Dong Zhuo at Yangren
summary: Sun Jian defeated Dong Zhuo's army, killed Hua Xiong and entered the ruined Luoyang, where he restored the imperial tombs.
summary_zh: 孙坚于阳人大破董卓军，斩华雄，进入洛阳，修复诸陵。

title: Battle of Jieqiao
summary: Yuan Shao's crossbowmen under Qu Yi defeated Gongsun Zan's elite White Horse cavalry, securing Ji province for Yuan Shao.
summary_zh: 袁绍部将麴义以强弩大破公孙瓒“白马义从”，袁绍巩固冀州。

title: Dong Zhuo is killed by Lü Bu
summary: The minister Wang Yun persuades Dong Zhuo's bodyguard Lü Bu to murder him. Dong's officers then retake Chang'an.
summary_zh: 司徒王允说动董卓的亲信吕布刺杀董卓，但董卓部将随即攻回长安。

title: Cao Cao forms the Qingzhou Army
summary: Cao Cao defeated a huge Qingzhou Yellow Turban host and enlisted 300,000 of its men as the Qingzhou Army, the core of his power.
summary_zh: 曹操在寿张击败青州黄巾，受降卒三十余万，选精锐为“青州兵”。

title: Cao Cao's invasion of Xu province
summary: Avenging his father's murder, Cao Cao invaded Tao Qian's Xu province, massacring civilians so that the Si River was blocked with bodies.
summary_zh: 曹操以报父仇为名攻陶谦，屠戮徐州诸县，泗水为之不流。

title: Battle of Puyang
summary: While Cao Cao was in Xu, Zhang Miao and Chen Gong invited Lü Bu into Yan province; Cao Cao struggled for over a year to recover it.
summary_zh: 陈宫、张邈迎吕布入兖州，曹操回师与吕布相持于濮阳百余日，几近覆灭。

title: Sun Ce conquers Jiangdong
summary: Sun Ce crossed the Yangtze with his father's troops and in a few years took Danyang, Wu and Kuaiji, founding the base of the later Wu state.
summary_zh: 孙策渡江，击败刘繇、王朗、严白虎等，据有江东六郡，奠定东吴基业。

title: Emperor Xian's flight from Chang'an
summary: Amid fighting between Li Jue and Guo Si, Emperor Xian escaped east, enduring hunger and pursuit before reaching the ruins of Luoyang.
summary_zh: 李傕、郭汜相攻，献帝东逃，历经曹阳之败、渡河至安邑，次年回到残破的洛阳。

title: Cao Cao brings Emperor Xian to Xu
summary: Cao Cao takes in the homeless emperor and makes Xu the capital. He now issues orders in the emperor's name.
summary_zh: 曹操把流离失所的献帝接到许县并定都于此，从此可以借皇帝的名义发号施令。

title: Cao Cao's military farm colonies
summary: Cao Cao settles refugees and soldiers on abandoned land to grow grain for his armies.
summary_zh: 曹操招募流民和士兵耕种荒地，为军队供应粮食。

title: Yuan Shu proclaims himself emperor
summary: Holding the imperial seal, Yuan Shu declared his Zhong dynasty at Shouchun; condemned by all, his regime soon collapsed.
summary_zh: 袁术据寿春称帝，国号“仲”，众叛亲离，两年后呕血而死。

title: Battle of Wancheng
summary: Zhang Xiu surrendered then launched a surprise attack on Cao Cao, killing his son Cao Ang and bodyguard Dian Wei.
summary_zh: 张绣降而复叛，夜袭曹营，曹昂、典韦战死，曹操负伤逃脱。

title: Battle of Xiapi; Lü Bu executed
summary: Cao Cao flooded Xiapi with river water; Lü Bu's officers mutinied and he was captured and hanged with Chen Gong.
summary_zh: 曹操引沂、泗水灌下邳城，吕布部将叛降，吕布被擒缢杀。

title: Battle of Yijing
summary: Yuan Shao tunnelled under Gongsun Zan's fortress at Yijing; Gongsun Zan burned his family and himself, leaving Yuan Shao master of the north.
summary_zh: 袁绍掘地道攻破易京，公孙瓒自焚，袁绍尽有河北四州。

title: Battle of Guandu
summary: Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao and becomes master of northern China.
summary_zh: 曹操击败袁绍，成为北方的主人。

title: Dong Cheng's 'girdle edict' plot
summary: Dong Cheng claimed a secret edict to kill Cao Cao; the plot was exposed and the conspirators executed, while Liu Bei rebelled in Xu.
summary_zh: 董承称受献帝衣带密诏诛曹操，事泄被杀，刘备亦据徐州叛曹。

title: Battle of Boma
summary: Guan Yu, serving Cao Cao, rode into Yuan Shao's army and beheaded Yan Liang, lifting the siege of Baima before Guandu.
summary_zh: 官渡战前，关羽于万众中斩袁绍大将颜良，解白马之围。

title: Sun Ce assassinated; Sun Quan succeeds
summary: Sun Ce was mortally wounded by retainers of Xu Gong while hunting; his 18-year-old brother Sun Quan inherited Jiangdong.
summary_zh: 孙策出猎遭许贡门客刺杀，临终以江东付十八岁的弟弟孙权。

title: Yuan Shao dies; sons divide
summary: Yuan Shao died after Guandu without fixing an heir; his sons Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang fought each other, inviting Cao Cao's conquest.
summary_zh: 袁绍病死，未定嗣子，袁谭、袁尚兄弟相攻，曹操得以各个击破。

title: Cao Cao captures Ye
summary: Cao Cao flooded Ye, Yuan Shang's capital, and took it after months of siege, making it his own headquarters.
summary_zh: 曹操引漳水灌邺城，围困数月攻克，以邺为根据地，自领冀州牧。

title: Zhang Zhongjing's Treatise on Cold Damage
summary: A physician who lost many relatives to epidemics writes a guide to diagnosing and treating fevers. It is still studied in Chinese medicine.
summary_zh: 医生张仲景在许多族人死于瘟疫后，写成诊治热病的著作，至今仍是中医经典。

title: Battle of White Wolf Mountain
summary: After a secret desert march, Cao Cao's vanguard under Zhang Liao routed the Wuhuan and killed their chief Tadun, ending Yuan resistance.
summary_zh: 曹操出卢龙塞奇袭乌桓，张辽于白狼山斩蹋顿，袁尚、袁熙逃往辽东被杀。

title: Liu Bei visits Zhuge Liang at Longzhong
summary: Liu Bei calls on Zhuge Liang three times. Zhuge proposes taking Jing and Yi provinces and allying with Sun Quan.
summary_zh: 刘备三次登门拜访诸葛亮。诸葛亮提出先取荆州、益州，再联合孙权的战略。

title: Battle of Red Cliffs
summary: Sun Quan and Liu Bei burn Cao Cao's fleet on the Yangtze, fixing the three-way split of China.
summary_zh: 孙权与刘备联军在长江上火烧曹操战船，奠定了三分天下的格局。

title: Battle of Changban
summary: Cao Cao's cavalry caught Liu Bei's fleeing column of refugees; Zhao Yun rescued Liu Bei's son and Zhang Fei held the bridge.
summary_zh: 曹军轻骑追及刘备于当阳长坂，赵云救阿斗，张飞据水断桥。

title: Death of Zhou Yu
summary: Zhou Yu, victor of Red Cliffs, died while preparing to invade Yi province; Lu Su succeeded him and favored alliance with Liu Bei.
summary_zh: 周瑜谋取益州，途中病逝于巴丘，鲁肃继任，主张联刘抗曹。

title: Cao Cao's 'talent only' edict
summary: Cao Cao ordered officials to recommend men of ability regardless of moral reputation—'only talent is to be raised up'.
summary_zh: 曹操下《求贤令》，提出“唯才是举”，打破以德行门第取士的传统。

title: Bronze Sparrow Terrace built
summary: Cao Cao built the Bronze Sparrow Terrace at Ye, a centre of Jian'an literature where he and his sons composed poetry.
summary_zh: 曹操于邺城建铜雀台，曹植作《登台赋》，成为建安文学中心。

title: Battle of Tong Pass
summary: Cao Cao defeated the northwestern warlords Ma Chao and Han Sui, using Jia Xu's ruse to sow discord between them.
summary_zh: 曹操用贾诩离间计，大破马超、韩遂等关西联军，平定关中。

title: Cao Cao made Duke of Wei
summary: Cao Cao was granted ten commanderies as the state of Wei with Ye as capital, and the Nine Bestowments, a step toward usurpation.
summary_zh: 曹操受封魏公，加九锡，以冀州十郡建魏国，都邺，建立宗庙社稷。

title: Battle of Ruxu
summary: Cao Cao attacked Sun Quan's fortified Ruxu but failed to break through, remarking 'a son should be like Sun Zhongmou'.
summary_zh: 曹操攻孙权濡须坞，相持月余不克，叹“生子当如孙仲谋”。

title: Liu Bei takes Yi province
summary: After turning on his host Liu Zhang, Liu Bei besieged Chengdu; Liu Zhang surrendered, giving Liu Bei Sichuan.
summary_zh: 刘备进围成都，刘璋出降，刘备领益州牧，三分格局形成。

title: Battle of Xiaoyao Ford
summary: Zhang Liao's small garrison at Hefei routs Sun Quan's much larger army and nearly captures Sun himself.
summary_zh: 张辽以少量守军在合肥击溃孙权大军，孙权险些被擒。

title: Cao Cao takes Hanzhong
summary: Cao Cao stormed Yangping Pass and Zhang Lu surrendered, ending the Daoist state of Hanzhong.
summary_zh: 曹操攻破阳平关，张鲁投降，汉中归曹。

title: Xiang River boundary dispute
summary: After Lu Su's face-to-face talks with Guan Yu at Yiyang, Liu Bei and Sun Quan divided Jing province along the Xiang River.
summary_zh: 鲁肃与关羽单刀相会于益阳，孙刘以湘水为界平分荆州。

title: Great plague of 217
summary: A pestilence swept the realm, killing four of the Seven Masters of Jian'an; Cao Zhi described families wiped out entirely.
summary_zh: 建安二十二年大疫，“家家有僵尸之痛”，建安七子中徐干、陈琳、应玚、刘桢同年病亡。

title: Battle of Mount Dingjun
summary: Huang Zhong charged downhill and killed Cao Cao's general Xiahou Yuan, leading to Liu Bei's capture of Hanzhong.
summary_zh: 黄忠居高临下猛攻，斩曹操大将夏侯渊，刘备遂取汉中。

title: Guan Yu at Fancheng; Wu takes Jing Province
title_zh: 关羽水淹七军与败走麦城
summary: Guan Yu besieges Fancheng and destroys a relief army in a flood. Wu then seizes his base and he is captured and killed.
summary_zh: 关羽围攻樊城，借洪水全歼援军。东吴趁机偷袭其后方，关羽兵败被杀。

title: Liu Bei becomes King of Hanzhong
summary: After driving Cao Cao from Hanzhong, Liu Bei proclaimed himself King of Hanzhong, rivaling Cao Cao's Wei.
summary_zh: 刘备夺取汉中后自立为汉中王，与魏王曹操抗衡。

title: Cao Pi ends the Han and founds Wei
summary: The last Han emperor abdicates. Within two years Liu Bei and Sun Quan claim thrones of their own.
summary_zh: 汉朝末代皇帝被迫禅位。不到两年，刘备和孙权也先后称帝。

title: Nine-rank system for choosing officials
summary: Cao Pi's minister Chen Qun sets up local assessors who grade candidates for office into nine ranks.
summary_zh: 曹丕采纳陈群的建议，由各地中正官把士人评为九等，作为授官依据。

title: Death of Cao Cao
summary: Cao Cao died at Luoyang in early 220; his son Cao Pi inherited his titles as King of Wei and Imperial Chancellor, setting the stage for the end of Han.
summary_zh: 建安二十五年正月曹操卒于洛阳，子曹丕嗣为魏王、丞相，为代汉铺平道路。

title: Liu Bei founds Shu Han
summary: Claiming to continue the Han, Liu Bei is crowned in Chengdu with Zhuge Liang as chancellor.
summary_zh: 刘备以延续汉室为号召，在成都称帝，任命诸葛亮为丞相。

title: Zhang Fei assassinated by his officers
summary: As Liu Bei prepared to avenge Guan Yu, Zhang Fei was murdered at Langzhong by subordinates Fan Qiang and Zhang Da, who fled to Sun Quan.
summary_zh: 刘备将伐吴，张飞在阆中为部将范强、张达所杀，二人携其首投奔孙权。

title: Sun Quan accepts title King of Wu
summary: Facing Liu Bei's invasion, Sun Quan nominally submitted to Wei and was enfeoffed King of Wu, moving his base to Wuchang.
summary_zh: 为应对刘备东征，孙权向魏称臣，受封吴王，并移镇武昌。

title: Battle of Yiling
summary: Lu Xun of Wu burns Liu Bei's camps. Liu Bei dies the next year.
summary_zh: 东吴陆逊火烧刘备连营，刘备次年病逝。

title: Wei's three-pronged invasion of Wu
summary: Cao Pi attacked Wu at Dongkou, Ruxu and Jiangling after Sun Quan refused to send a hostage; all three thrusts failed by 223.
summary_zh: 孙权拒送质子，曹丕遣军分攻洞口、濡须、江陵，至223年皆无功而还。

title: Liu Bei entrusts his son to Zhuge Liang at Baidi
summary: Dying after Yiling, Liu Bei leaves his heir Liu Shan in Zhuge Liang's care.
summary_zh: 夷陵战败后，病危的刘备在白帝城把太子刘禅托付给诸葛亮。

title: Deng Zhi restores the Shu–Wu alliance
summary: Zhuge Liang sent Deng Zhi to Sun Quan; Wu broke with Wei and renewed the alliance with Shu that endured until Shu's fall.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮遣邓芝使吴，孙权与魏断绝，吴蜀重新结盟，此后维持至蜀亡。

title: Zhuge Liang's southern campaign
summary: Zhuge Liang puts down revolts in the southwest and wins over local chiefs such as Meng Huo.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮平定南中叛乱，收服孟获等当地首领。

title: Cao Pi reviews troops at Guangling
summary: Cao Pi led a huge fleet to the Yangtze at Guangling but, seeing the river and Wu's defenses, sighed that heaven divided north and south and withdrew.
summary_zh: 曹丕率舟师至广陵临江观兵，见江涛汹涌，叹“固天所以限南北也”，引还。

title: Cao Pi dies; Cao Rui succeeds
summary: Cao Pi died aged 39; Cao Rui became emperor with Cao Zhen, Chen Qun, Cao Xiu and Sima Yi as regents.
summary_zh: 魏文帝曹丕病逝，曹叡即位，曹真、陈群、曹休、司马懿受遗诏辅政。

title: Wu ends the Shi clan's rule in Jiaozhi
summary: After the death of Shi Xie, Sun Quan's general Lü Dai crushed his son Shi Hui and brought Jiaozhou under direct Wu control.
summary_zh: 士燮死后，其子士徽拒命，吕岱率军讨平，交州归吴直接统治。

title: Zhuge Liang's memorial on going to war
summary: Before leading his first northern campaign, Zhuge Liang writes a memorial of advice to the young emperor Liu Shan.
summary_zh: 第一次北伐前，诸葛亮上表劝勉后主刘禅，即著名的《出师表》。

title: Battle of Shiting
summary: Lured by Zhou Fang's feigned defection letters, Cao Xiu marched south and was routed by Lu Xun.
summary_zh: 曹休中周鲂诈降之计，深入皖地，被陆逊大败于石亭。

title: Battle of Jieting
summary: Ma Su ignores orders and camps on a hill; Zhang He cuts off his water and routs him, ending the first northern campaign.
summary_zh: 马谡违背调度，舍水上山扎营，被张郃断绝水源击溃，第一次北伐因此失败。

title: Sima Yi crushes Meng Da's defection
summary: Meng Da plotted to return to Shu; Sima Yi marched 1,200 li in eight days, took Xincheng and beheaded him.
summary_zh: 孟达谋叛魏归蜀，司马懿倍道兼行，八日至新城，旬余破城斩孟达。

title: Siege of Chencang
summary: In Zhuge Liang's second northern expedition, Hao Zhao held Chencang with a thousand men for over twenty days until Shu supplies ran out.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮二次北伐围陈仓，郝昭以千余人坚守二十余日，蜀军粮尽退兵。

title: Sun Quan declares himself emperor of Wu
summary: Sun Quan takes the imperial title and soon moves his capital to Jianye, today's Nanjing.
summary_zh: 孙权称帝，不久迁都建业，即今天的南京。

title: Sun Quan moves capital to Jianye
summary: After proclaiming himself emperor, Sun Quan moved from Wuchang to Jianye, making Nanjing a capital for the first time.
summary_zh: 孙权称帝后自武昌迁都建业，南京自此首次成为王朝都城。

title: Shu takes Wudu and Yinping
summary: In his third expedition Zhuge Liang sent Chen Shi to seize Wudu and Yinping, driving back Guo Huai; Zhuge was restored as Chancellor.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮第三次北伐，遣陈式攻取武都、阴平二郡，郭淮退走，亮复丞相职。

title: Wu fleet sails to Yizhou
summary: Sun Quan sent Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi with 10,000 men across the sea to Yizhou, widely identified with Taiwan; they returned with several thousand people.
summary_zh: 孙权遣卫温、诸葛直率甲士万人浮海求夷洲，得数千人而还，一般认为夷洲即台湾。

title: Cao Zhen's rain-ruined invasion of Shu
summary: Cao Zhen led Wei's largest offensive against Shu through the Ziwu and other valleys, but a month of rain washed out the roads and the campaign was called off.
summary_zh: 曹真率军由子午谷等道伐蜀，遇大雨三十余日，栈道断绝，诏令班师。

title: Battle of Mount Qi; Zhang He killed
summary: Zhuge Liang besieged Mount Qi and beat Sima Yi in the field; withdrawing for lack of grain, he ambushed and killed Zhang He at Mumen.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮围祁山，败司马懿，因粮尽退军，于木门道伏杀追将张郃。

title: Zhuge Liang's wooden oxen supply carts
summary: To move grain over the Qinling passes, Zhuge Liang devised the 'wooden ox' and 'gliding horse', probably improved wheelbarrows.
summary_zh: 为解决秦岭运粮难题，诸葛亮创制木牛流马，可能是改良的独轮车。

title: Death of the poet Cao Zhi
summary: Cao Zhi, the most celebrated poet of the Jian'an era and author of the Rhapsody on the Luo River Goddess, died sidelined as Prince of Chen.
summary_zh: 建安文学代表、《洛神赋》作者曹植郁郁而终，时为陈王。

title: Gongsun Yuan beheads Wu's envoys
summary: Sun Quan made Gongsun Yuan King of Yan against his ministers' advice; Gongsun killed the envoys and sent their heads to Wei.
summary_zh: 孙权不听群臣劝阻，遣使封公孙渊为燕王，公孙渊斩吴使，传首于魏。

title: Zhuge Liang dies at Wuzhang Plains
summary: On his last northern campaign against Wei, the Shu chancellor dies in camp.
summary_zh: 蜀汉丞相诸葛亮在最后一次北伐曹魏途中病逝军中。

title: Sun Quan fails at Hefei New City
summary: Coordinating with Zhuge Liang's last expedition, Sun Quan besieged Hefei New City but withdrew when Cao Rui led a relief army.
summary_zh: 孙权配合诸葛亮北伐围攻合肥新城，魏明帝亲征，吴军撤退。

title: Death of the last Han emperor
summary: Liu Xie, the deposed Emperor Xian, died as Duke of Shanyang and was buried with imperial honors.
summary_zh: 退位的汉献帝刘协以山阳公身份去世，魏以天子礼葬之。

title: Wei Yan killed after Zhuge Liang's death
summary: Feuding with Yang Yi over the retreat, Wei Yan burned the plank roads and was killed by Ma Dai.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮死后，魏延与杨仪争权，烧绝栈道，兵败被马岱斩杀。

title: Ma Jun builds the south-pointing chariot
summary: The engineer Ma Jun reconstructed the south-pointing chariot with differential gearing and improved the silk loom and chain pump.
summary_zh: 机械家马钧复原指南车，并改进绫机和翻车，被称为“天下之名巧”。

title: Sima Yi conquers Liaodong
summary: Sima Yi besieges and takes Xiangping, ending the Gongsun family's semi-independent state in the northeast.
summary_zh: 司马懿围攻并攻克襄平，消灭了割据辽东半个世纪的公孙氏。

title: Queen Himiko of Wa sends envoys to Wei
title_zh: 倭女王卑弥呼遣使朝魏
summary: Wei names the Japanese queen "Ruler of Wa, Friend of Wei" and sends her gifts including bronze mirrors.
summary_zh: 魏朝封日本女王卑弥呼为“亲魏倭王”，赐给她铜镜等礼物。

title: Cao Fang enthroned under two regents
summary: Cao Rui died young; the boy Cao Fang succeeded with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as co-regents, a rivalry that ended at Gaopingling.
summary_zh: 魏明帝崩，幼主曹芳即位，曹爽与司马懿共同辅政，埋下争权伏笔。

title: Deng Ai's military farms in the Huai
summary: On Deng Ai's plan, Wei dug canals and set up soldier-farmer colonies along the Huai, storing grain for war against Wu.
summary_zh: 魏用邓艾之策，于淮南淮北广开漕渠，大兴屯田，积谷以备伐吴。

title: Wu's offensive defeated at Quebei
summary: Wu attacked Wei on several fronts; Quan Cong's force was beaten at the Quebei reservoir and the offensive failed.
summary_zh: 吴分兵数路攻魏，全琮于芍陂与魏军激战失利，北伐无功。

title: Wu's succession struggle of the Two Palaces
summary: Factions backing heir Sun He and his brother Sun Ba split Wu's court; in 250 Sun Quan deposed Sun He and forced Sun Ba to suicide.
summary_zh: 太子孙和与鲁王孙霸争位，朝臣分党；250年孙权废和赐霸死，吴政渐衰。

title: Wu expedition to Hainan
summary: Sun Quan sent Nie You and Lu Kai with 30,000 troops to Zhuya and Dan'er on Hainan Island.
summary_zh: 孙权遣聂友、陆凯率兵三万讨珠崖、儋耳，经略海南岛。

title: Wei invades Goguryeo
summary: The Wei general Guanqiu Jian sacks the Goguryeo capital at Hwando and chases its king to the far northeast.
summary_zh: 魏将毌丘俭攻破高句丽都城丸都，一路追击高句丽王。

title: Battle of Xingshi
summary: Cao Shuang invaded Hanzhong to win prestige, but Wang Ping held the Xingshi passes and Fei Yi's relief forced a costly retreat.
summary_zh: 曹爽伐蜀以立威名，王平据守兴势，费祎率援军至，魏军狼狈退还。

title: He Yan and Wang Bi found Xuanxue
summary: During the Zhengshi era He Yan and Wang Bi reinterpreted the Laozi and Yijing around 'nothingness', founding Neo-Daoist Xuanxue and the fashion for Pure Talk.
summary_zh: 正始年间何晏、王弼以“贵无”注《老子》《周易》，开创魏晋玄学与清谈风气。

title: Zhu Ying and Kang Tai visit Funan
place_zh: 扶南（今柬埔寨吴哥波雷）
summary: Wu envoys Zhu Ying and Kang Tai travelled to Funan and beyond; their records are the earliest Chinese accounts of mainland Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 吴遣朱应、康泰出使扶南等国，所著记录为中国关于东南亚最早的详细记载。

title: Eunuch Huang Hao gains power in Shu
summary: After Jiang Wan and Dong Yun died, the eunuch Huang Hao won Liu Shan's trust and gradually dominated Shu's court.
summary_zh: 蒋琬、董允相继去世，宦官黄皓得刘禅宠信，逐渐操弄蜀汉朝政。

title: Kang Senghui founds Jianchu Temple
summary: The Sogdian monk Kang Senghui reached Jianye; Sun Quan built Jianchu Temple for him, the first Buddhist temple in the Yangtze delta.
summary_zh: 康居僧人康僧会至建业传法，孙权为之建建初寺，为江南佛寺之始。

title: Lady Triệu's revolt against Wu
summary: Triệu Thị Trinh led a rising in Jiuzhen against Wu rule; it was suppressed by Lu Yin.
summary_zh: 九真赵氏贞起兵反吴，交州骚动，陆胤率军讨平。

title: Incident at the Gaoping Tombs
summary: While the regent Cao Shuang is away at an imperial tomb, Sima Yi seizes Luoyang. The Sima family now controls Wei.
summary_zh: 趁辅政大臣曹爽随皇帝出城祭扫高平陵，司马懿发动政变控制洛阳，从此司马氏掌握魏国大权。

title: Wang Ling's plot at Shouchun
summary: Wang Ling plotted to replace Cao Fang; Sima Yi struck first, and Wang took poison—the first of three Huainan rebellions.
summary_zh: 王凌谋立楚王曹彪，司马懿率军突至，王凌服毒自尽，为“淮南三叛”之首。

title: Death of Sima Yi
summary: Sima Yi died after crushing Wang Ling; his son Sima Shi took over as regent of Wei.
summary_zh: 司马懿平王凌后病卒，长子司马师继掌魏国大权。

title: Battle of Dongxing
summary: Zhuge Ke routed a Wei army attacking the Dongxing dykes in a snowstorm, Wu's greatest victory over Wei.
summary_zh: 魏军进攻东兴堤，诸葛恪冒雪迎击，大破魏军，为吴对魏最大胜利。

title: Sun Quan dies; Zhuge Ke regent
summary: Sun Quan died after a 50-year rule; nine-year-old Sun Liang succeeded with Zhuge Ke as regent.
summary_zh: 孙权在位多年后病逝，幼子孙亮即位，诸葛恪辅政。

title: Zhuge Ke killed by Sun Jun
summary: After a disastrous siege of Hefei New City, Zhuge Ke was assassinated at a banquet by Sun Jun, who took power.
summary_zh: 诸葛恪围合肥新城大败，回朝后被孙峻于宴席上刺杀，孙峻专权。

title: Fei Yi assassinated by a Wei defector
summary: Shu's chief minister Fei Yi was stabbed at a New Year banquet by Guo Xun, a captured Wei officer; Jiang Wei then gained a free hand.
summary_zh: 蜀汉大将军费祎在岁首宴会上被魏降人郭循刺杀，此后姜维得以频繁北伐。

title: Sima Shi deposes Cao Fang
summary: After a plot by Li Feng and Xiahou Xuan was crushed, Sima Shi deposed Cao Fang and enthroned Cao Mao.
summary_zh: 李丰、夏侯玄谋诛司马师事泄被杀，司马师随即废魏帝曹芳，立曹髦。

title: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rebel
summary: The Huainan commanders rose against Sima Shi; Guanqiu Jian was killed and Wen Qin fled to Wu, and Sima Shi died soon after.
summary_zh: 毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨司马师，兵败，毌丘俭被杀，文钦奔吴，司马师不久病死。

title: Jiang Wei's victory at Taoxi
summary: Jiang Wei crushed Wang Jing west of the Tao River, killing tens of thousands, then besieged Didao.
summary_zh: 姜维于洮水西大破魏雍州刺史王经，魏军死者数万，进围狄道。

title: Jiang Wei defeated at Duangu
summary: Deng Ai routed Jiang Wei at Duangu, inflicting heavy losses that drained Shu's strength.
summary_zh: 姜维在段谷被邓艾击败，士卒星散，死者甚众，蜀国元气大伤。

title: Zhuge Dan's rebellion at Shouchun
summary: Zhuge Dan rebelled with Wu support; Sima Zhao besieged Shouchun for nearly a year and took it, ending Huainan resistance.
summary_zh: 诸葛诞联吴起兵，司马昭围寿春近一年攻破，“淮南三叛”终结。

title: Sun Xiu kills the regent Sun Chen
summary: Sun Chen deposed Sun Liang and enthroned Sun Xiu, who soon had him seized and executed at a winter court assembly.
summary_zh: 权臣孙綝废孙亮立孙休，孙休于腊会上擒杀孙綝，夺回大权。

title: Emperor Cao Mao is killed
summary: The young Wei emperor leads his palace servants against Sima Zhao and is killed in the street.
summary_zh: 魏帝曹髦率宫中侍从讨伐司马昭，在宫外被杀。

title: Ji Kang is executed; the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove
summary: The poet and musician Ji Kang, leader of a circle of free-spirited scholars, is executed by the Sima regime.
summary_zh: 竹林七贤的核心人物、诗人兼音乐家嵇康被司马氏处死。

title: Jiang Wei withdraws to farm at Tazhong
summary: Fearing Huang Hao and failing at Taoyang, Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong to farm, leaving Hanzhong's defenses thin.
summary_zh: 姜维伐魏败于侯和，又惧黄皓谗害，退往沓中屯田避祸，汉中防务空虚。

title: Wei conquers Shu
summary: Deng Ai crosses the mountains by a secret route and Liu Shan surrenders.
summary_zh: 邓艾偷渡阴平小道，直逼成都，后主刘禅出城投降。

title: Liu Hui's commentary on the Nine Chapters
summary: The mathematician explains the classic problem book with proofs and calculates pi to about 3.14.
summary_zh: 数学家刘徽为《九章算术》作注，给出证明，并用割圆术把圆周率算到约3.14。

title: Jiaozhi defects from Wu to Wei
summary: Lü Xing killed Wu's governor in Jiaozhi and submitted to Wei, igniting a long struggle over the far south.
summary_zh: 交趾郡吏吕兴杀吴太守孙谞，举郡附魏，吴、晋长期争夺交州。

title: Zhong Hui's revolt in Chengdu
summary: After the fall of Shu, the Wei general Zhong Hui and the Shu general Jiang Wei plot a revolt. Their own soldiers kill them.
summary_zh: 蜀亡后，魏将钟会与蜀将姜维密谋反叛，结果被乱兵所杀。

title: Liu Shan 'too happy to miss Shu'
summary: Taken to Luoyang as Duke of Anle, Liu Shan told Sima Zhao he was too happy to miss Shu, earning safety and lasting ridicule.
summary_zh: 刘禅迁洛阳封安乐公，司马昭问其是否思蜀，答“此间乐，不思蜀”。

title: Sun Hao becomes emperor of Wu
summary: After Sun Xiu's death, ministers chose Sun Hao, who soon became notorious for cruelty and extravagance.
summary_zh: 孙休死，群臣迎立孙皓，不久即以残暴奢侈著称，吴政日坏。

title: Sima Zhao restores the five noble ranks
summary: Newly King of Jin, Sima Zhao revived the Zhou five ranks of nobility and ordered new codes of rites and law.
summary_zh: 司马昭进爵晋王，奏复五等爵制，命贾充等议定礼仪律令。

title: Sun Hao moves capital to Wuchang
summary: Sun Hao moved the Wu capital upriver to Wuchang; the costly move was resented—'rather drink Jianye water than eat Wuchang fish'.
summary_zh: 孙皓迁都武昌，扬州百姓溯流供给，怨声载道，民谣“宁饮建业水，不食武昌鱼”。

title: Sima Yan founds the Jin
summary: The Sima family, real rulers of Wei, take the throne.
summary_zh: 早已掌握魏国实权的司马氏正式登上皇位。

title: Pei Xiu's grid-based maps
summary: Minister of Works Pei Xiu compiled an 18-sheet historical atlas and set out six principles of cartography, including scale and grids.
summary_zh: 司空裴秀编制《禹贡地域图》十八篇，提出“制图六体”，奠定中国传统地图学。

title: Promulgation of the Taishi Code
summary: Jin issued the Taishi Code drafted by Jia Chong and others, the first comprehensive code to blend Confucian ritual norms into law.
summary_zh: 晋颁行贾充等修订的《泰始律》，首次将儒家礼制系统纳入律令，影响后世。

title: Yang Hu prepares conquest at Xiangyang
summary: Yang Hu governed the Jing frontier with benevolence, built up grain reserves and urged the conquest of Wu, while keeping courteous relations with Lu Kang.
summary_zh: 羊祜坐镇襄阳，屯田积谷，以德怀柔，与吴将陆抗互相敬重，力主伐吴。

title: Tufa Shujineng's Xianbei revolt
summary: The Xianbei chief Tufa Shujineng killed several Jin governors and held Liangzhou for a decade until Ma Long defeated him.
summary_zh: 鲜卑首领秃发树机能起兵，连杀晋数任刺史，据凉州近十年，后为马隆讨平。

title: Lu Kang retakes Xiling
summary: Wu commander Bu Chan defected to Jin; Lu Kang besieged Xiling, repelled Yang Hu's relief and executed Bu Chan.
summary_zh: 吴西陵督步阐降晋，陆抗围西陵，击退羊祜援军，斩步阐。

title: Wang Jun builds a war fleet in Shu
summary: Ordered to prepare for the conquest of Wu, Wang Jun built great towered warships in Shu; wood shavings floating downstream alarmed Wu.
summary_zh: 王濬在蜀大造楼船，木屑蔽江而下，吴建平太守吾彦请增兵防备未果。

title: Discovery of the Bamboo Annals
summary: A tomb robber opened a Wei royal tomb at Ji, revealing bamboo-slip texts including the Bamboo Annals and the Tale of King Mu.
summary_zh: 盗墓者发掘汲郡战国魏王墓，出土大批竹简，包括《竹书纪年》《穆天子传》。

title: Jin conquers Wu and reunifies China
summary: A fleet sails down the Yangtze from Sichuan and Wu surrenders.
summary_zh: 晋军舰队从蜀地顺长江而下，东吴投降。

title: Land allotment and tax system
summary: After reunification Jin set land quotas by household and rank and a household tax in silk and grain, limiting aristocrats' holdings on paper.
summary_zh: 灭吴后西晋颁行占田、课田与户调制，按丁口和品级规定占田限额和赋税。

title: Jin disbands provincial armies
summary: Emperor Wu disbanded provincial and commandery troops after reunification, leaving the realm reliant on princes' armies—later blamed for Jin's collapse.
summary_zh: 晋武帝统一后罢州郡兵备，地方无兵，宗王坐拥重兵，埋下祸乱隐患。

title: Liu Yi denounces the nine-rank system
summary: Liu Yi memorialized that the nine-rank system meant 'no humble families in the upper grades, no great clans in the lower', but nothing changed.
summary_zh: 刘毅上疏陈九品中正八损，指出“上品无寒门，下品无势族”，未被采纳。

title: Shi Chong and Wang Kai's wealth contest
summary: The magnates Shi Chong and Wang Kai competed in extravagance, smashing coral trees and lining roads with silk screens—emblems of Western Jin decadence.
summary_zh: 石崇与王恺竞相斗富，以锦步障、珊瑚树相夸，为西晋奢靡之风的写照。

title: Murong Hui sacks Buyeo
summary: The Xianbei chief Murong Hui sacked the Buyeo capital; its king killed himself, and Jin later helped restore the kingdom.
summary_zh: 鲜卑慕容廆攻破夫余，夫余王依虑自杀，晋后助其复国。

title: Chen Shou writes the Records of the Three Kingdoms
summary: A former Shu official writes the official history of Wei, Shu and Wu, the base of all later Three Kingdoms stories.
summary_zh: 出身蜀汉的史官陈寿撰写魏、蜀、吴三国的历史，后世三国故事都以它为本。

title: Emperor Wu dies; Yang Jun regent
summary: Emperor Wu died; the developmentally disabled Emperor Hui took the throne with the empress dowager's father Yang Jun as sole regent.
summary_zh: 晋武帝崩，惠帝即位，外戚杨骏独揽辅政大权，与贾后矛盾激化。

title: War of the Eight Princes
summary: Princes of the Sima clan fight for control of the court, wrecking the empire.
summary_zh: 司马氏诸王为争夺朝政大权相互攻杀，使国家元气大伤。

title: Qi Wannian's Di-Qiang uprising
summary: Di and Qiang peoples of Guanzhong rose under Qi Wannian, defeating Jin armies until Meng Guan captured him; famine drove refugees into Shu.
summary_zh: 关中氐羌推齐万年为帝起兵，屡败晋军，后为孟观所擒，流民大批入蜀。

title: Jiang Tong urges resettling the Rong
summary: Jiang Tong warned that non-Han peoples settled inside the frontier would rebel and urged their removal; the court ignored him.
summary_zh: 江统作《徙戎论》，主张将内迁的少数民族迁回故地，朝廷未能采纳。

title: Empress Jia frames the crown prince
summary: Empress Jia Nanfeng tricked heir Sima Yu into writing a treasonous text, deposed him and had him murdered in 300.
summary_zh: 贾后诱太子司马遹醉书逆文，废为庶人，次年遣人将其杀害。

title: Sima Lun deposes Empress Jia
summary: The Prince of Zhao kills the scheming Empress Jia Nanfeng and the minister Zhang Hua, and soon seizes the throne.
summary_zh: 赵王司马伦杀死专权的贾南风和大臣张华，不久又篡夺帝位。

title: Li Te leads refugees' rising in Shu
summary: Refugees from Guanzhong, ordered home by the governor of Yizhou, rebelled under the Di chief Li Te; he died in 303 but his son took Chengdu.
summary_zh: 入蜀流民被逼遣返，推氐人李特起兵，李特303年战死，其子李雄继续作战。

title: Zhang Gui takes charge of Liangzhou
summary: Zhang Gui became governor of Liangzhou and kept it orderly and loyal to Jin; his family's rule became the Former Liang.
summary_zh: 张轨出任凉州刺史，保境安民，奉晋正朔，其家族世守凉州，是为前凉。

title: Three princes overthrow usurper Sima Lun
summary: Sima Lun usurped the throne; the princes of Qi, Chengdu and Hejian raised armies, killed him and restored Emperor Hui after 60 days of fighting.
summary_zh: 赵王伦篡位，齐王冏、成都王颖、河间王颙起兵讨伐，战六十余日，诛伦复惠帝位。

title: Zhang Chang's rising in Jing province
summary: Conscripts resisting service in Shu rose under Zhang Chang, overrunning much of Jing, Jiang and Yang provinces before Tao Kan's forces crushed them.
summary_zh: 不愿应征入蜀的民众随张昌起事，席卷荆、江、扬诸州，后被刘弘、陶侃镇压。

title: Poet Lu Ji executed after defeat
summary: Leading Sima Ying's army against Luoyang, the Wu-born poet Lu Ji was defeated and executed, lamenting the cranes' cries of Huating.
summary_zh: 陆机为成都王颖统兵攻洛阳兵败，被谗遇害，临刑叹“华亭鹤唳，岂可复闻乎”。

title: Liu Yuan founds Han Zhao; the Sixteen Kingdoms begin
summary: A Xiongnu noble declares himself king of Han. The same year Li Xiong sets up the Cheng state in Sichuan.
summary_zh: 匈奴贵族刘渊自立为汉王；同年李雄在蜀地建立成国。

title: Li Xiong founds Cheng in Sichuan
summary: Li Xiong declared himself King of Chengdu in 304 and emperor of Cheng in 306, ruling Sichuan with light taxes for three decades.
summary_zh: 李雄据成都称王，306年称帝，国号大成，轻徭薄赋，蜀中安定三十年。

title: Battle of Dangyin; Emperor Hui captured
summary: Sima Yue led Emperor Hui against Sima Ying; the imperial army was routed and the emperor, his face wounded, was taken to Ye.
summary_zh: 东海王越挟惠帝攻成都王颖，于荡阴大败，惠帝面伤，被掳至邺。

title: Sima Rui and Wang Dao move to Jianye
summary: A minor prince and his adviser Wang Dao set up a base south of the Yangtze and win over the local gentry.
summary_zh: 琅琊王司马睿与谋士王导南下建邺，争取江南士族的支持，建立根据地。

title: Fotudeng arrives in Luoyang
summary: The Kuchean monk Fotudeng arrived and later won the trust of Shi Le and Shi Hu, spreading Buddhism widely in the north.
summary_zh: 西域高僧佛图澄至洛阳，后得石勒、石虎崇信，大力推动佛教在北方传播。

title: Disaster of Yongjia
summary: Xiongnu forces of Han Zhao sack Luoyang and capture the emperor. Many northern families flee south.
summary_zh: 匈奴人建立的汉赵军队攻破洛阳，俘虏晋怀帝。大批北方士族百姓南逃。

title: Battle of Ningping
summary: Shi Le's cavalry surrounded the army escorting Sima Yue's coffin and massacred over 100,000; Wang Yan was captured and killed.
summary_zh: 石勒追及护送司马越灵柩的晋军，于宁平城围歼十余万人，俘杀王衍。

title: Zu Ti's northern expedition
summary: With little help from the court, Zu Ti crosses the Yangtze and retakes most land south of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 祖逖几乎没有得到朝廷支持，渡江北伐，收复了黄河以南的大片土地。

title: Sogdian merchants' Ancient Letters
summary: Letters by Sogdian traders, found near Dunhuang, describe the fall of Luoyang and their commercial network across northern China.
summary_zh: 敦煌附近发现的粟特商人书信，记述洛阳陷落及其遍布中国北方的贸易网络。

title: Shi Le seizes Wang Jun at Jicheng
summary: Feigning submission, Shi Le entered Jicheng and seized Wang Jun, the Jin warlord of the northeast.
summary_zh: 石勒伪称归附，进入蓟城擒获割据幽州的王浚，尽并其众。

title: Tuoba Yilu made Prince of Dai
summary: In return for aiding Liu Kun, Jin made the Tuoba chief Yilu Prince of Dai, the origin of the later Northern Wei state.
summary_zh: 拓跋猗卢助刘琨抗汉赵，晋封其为代王，为后来北魏之源。

title: Fall of Chang'an; Western Jin ends
summary: Han Zhao besieges Chang'an until Emperor Min surrenders. He is killed the following year.
summary_zh: 汉赵军围困长安，晋愍帝出城投降，次年遇害。

title: Jin court re-established at Jiankang
summary: Sima Rui rules the south from Jiankang, while the north fragments into the Sixteen Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 司马睿在建康主政南方，北方则分裂为十六国。

title: Ge Hong's Baopuzi
summary: A Daoist scholar writes on alchemy, medicine and long life. His works record early chemistry and herbal cures.
summary_zh: 道教学者葛洪论述炼丹、医药和养生，书中保存了早期化学和草药疗法的记录。

title: Liu Kun killed by Duan Pidi
summary: Driven from Bingzhou, the loyalist Liu Kun took refuge with Duan Pidi, who strangled him on suspicion of plotting.
summary_zh: 刘琨失并州后投奔鲜卑段匹磾，遭猜忌被缢杀，北方晋军抵抗瓦解。

title: Jin Zhun massacres the Liu clan
summary: Jin Zhun killed Han emperor Liu Can and slaughtered the imperial clan; Liu Yao and Shi Le crushed him and split the Han state.
summary_zh: 靳准杀汉主刘粲，屠刘氏宗族，刘曜、石勒合讨平之，汉赵从此分裂。

title: Shi Le founds Later Zhao
summary: Liu Yao renamed his state Zhao at Chang'an, and Shi Le declared himself King of Zhao at Xiangguo, founding Later Zhao.
summary_zh: 刘曜在长安改国号为赵，石勒在襄国自称赵王，建立后赵，二赵对峙。

title: Death of Zu Ti
summary: Zu Ti, who had recovered land south of the Yellow River, died in despair as the court sent Dai Yuan to supervise him; his gains were soon lost.
summary_zh: 祖逖收复黄河以南，因朝廷派戴渊节制且内乱将起，忧愤病卒，失地复陷。

title: Wang Dun's rebellion
summary: The powerful general marches on the capital and takes control. He dies during a second revolt in 324.
summary_zh: 手握重兵的王敦起兵攻入建康，控制朝政；324年再次起兵时病死。

title: Su Jun's rebellion sacks Jiankang
summary: Provoked by Yu Liang, Su Jun and Zu Yue took Jiankang and held the child emperor; Tao Kan and Wen Jiao's coalition crushed them.
summary_zh: 庾亮激变，苏峻、祖约攻入建康，挟持成帝，陶侃、温峤联军讨平。

title: Shi Le defeats Liu Yao at Luoyang
summary: Later Zhao captures the Former Zhao emperor in battle and soon takes all of his lands.
summary_zh: 后赵石勒在洛阳生擒前赵皇帝刘曜，随后吞并前赵全境。

title: Later Zhao destroys Former Zhao
summary: After Liu Yao's capture, Shi Hu took Shanggui and killed the Former Zhao heir, leaving Later Zhao master of the north.
summary_zh: 刘曜被俘后，石虎攻破上邽，杀前赵太子刘熙等，后赵统一北方大部。

title: Shi Hu moves capital to Ye
summary: Shi Hu, who had usurped the throne, moved the Later Zhao capital to Ye and embarked on vast palace and hunting projects.
summary_zh: 石虎篡位后迁都邺城，大兴宫殿园囿，役使无度。

title: Murong Huang founds Former Yan
summary: Murong Huang proclaimed himself King of Yan, founding the Former Yan state of the Murong Xianbei in Liaoxi.
summary_zh: 慕容皝自称燕王，建立前燕，鲜卑慕容部崛起于辽西。

title: Tuoba Shiyijian rebuilds Dai
summary: Returning from hostage at Later Zhao, Tuoba Shiyijian became Prince of Dai, set up offices and laws and built Shengle.
summary_zh: 拓跋什翼犍自后赵归国即代王位，设置百官，制定法令，筑盛乐城。

title: Former Yan sacks the Goguryeo capital
summary: Murong Huang took Hwando, dug up the king's father's tomb and carried off the queen mother, forcing Goguryeo to submit.
summary_zh: 慕容皝攻破高句丽丸都，掘王父墓，掳王母，高句丽被迫称臣。

title: Huan Wen conquers Cheng Han
summary: The Eastern Jin general takes Sichuan, which becomes the base of his power.
summary_zh: 东晋将领桓温攻取蜀地，成为他权势的根基。

title: Ran Min overthrows Later Zhao
summary: A Han Chinese general seizes power in Ye, orders a massacre of the Jie, and founds the short-lived Ran Wei.
summary_zh: 汉人将领冉闵在邺城夺权，下令屠杀羯人，建立短命的冉魏政权。

title: Fu Jiàn founds Former Qin
summary: The Di leader Fu Jiàn occupied Chang'an and proclaimed himself Heavenly King of Great Qin, founding the Former Qin.
summary_zh: 氐人苻健入据长安，自称天王、大单于，国号大秦，史称前秦。

title: Murong Ke captures Ran Min
summary: Former Yan general Murong Ke defeated Ran Min with chained cavalry at Liantai; Ran was executed and Murong Jun declared himself emperor.
summary_zh: 慕容恪以连环马阵大破冉闵于廉台，冉闵被杀，慕容儁称帝。

title: Wang Xizhi writes the Orchid Pavilion Preface
summary: Written at a poetry gathering, it became the most admired work of Chinese calligraphy.
summary_zh: 王羲之在一次修禊雅集上写下此序，成为最受推崇的书法作品。

title: Huan Wen's first northern expedition
summary: Huan Wen advanced to Bashang outside Chang'an, where locals welcomed him and Wang Meng famously chatted while picking lice, but lack of grain forced retreat.
summary_zh: 桓温北伐前秦至灞上，关中父老牵牛持酒迎接，王猛扪虱而谈，终因缺粮而退。

title: Huan Wen recovers Luoyang
summary: Huan Wen defeated Yao Xiang on the Yi River and retook Luoyang, repairing the Jin imperial tombs.
summary_zh: 桓温第二次北伐，于伊水大败姚襄，收复洛阳，修复西晋诸陵。

title: Fu Jian and Wang Meng reform Former Qin
summary: The Di ruler Fu Jian takes power and makes the Han Chinese scholar Wang Meng his chief minister.
summary_zh: 氐族君主苻坚即位，任用汉人谋士王猛主持国政。

title: Gengxu tuduan household registration
summary: Huan Wen enforced the 'Gengxu' registration, enrolling northern émigrés in local registers so they paid tax and served in the army.
summary_zh: 桓温主持庚戌土断，将侨人编入所在郡县户籍，增加国家赋役来源。

title: First caves cut at Mogao
summary: A monk begins the cave temples that grow over a thousand years into a library of Buddhist art.
summary_zh: 一位僧人在此开凿石窟，此后千年间逐渐形成佛教艺术宝库。

title: Battle of Fangtou
summary: Huan Wen's last northern expedition is beaten by Murong Chui of Former Yan, ending his hopes of the throne.
summary_zh: 桓温最后一次北伐被前燕慕容垂击败，他借北伐威望篡位的打算随之落空。

title: Former Qin conquers Former Yan
summary: Wang Meng defeated Murong Ping's huge army at Lushan and took Ye, capturing Emperor Murong Wei.
summary_zh: 王猛于潞川大破慕容评，攻克邺城，俘燕主慕容暐，前燕灭亡。

title: Huan Wen deposes Emperor Fei
summary: To restore prestige after Fangtou, Huan Wen deposed Sima Yi on fabricated charges and enthroned Emperor Jianwen.
summary_zh: 桓温枋头败后为立威，诬废晋帝司马奕为海西公，立简文帝。

title: Former Qin seizes Hanzhong and Shu
summary: Former Qin overran Jin's Liang and Yi provinces, taking Hanzhong and Chengdu.
summary_zh: 前秦攻取东晋梁、益二州，占领汉中、成都。

title: Former Qin unites the north
summary: Fu Jian conquers Former Liang and Dai. Every state in the north is now under Former Qin.
summary_zh: 苻坚灭前凉和代国，北方全部归于前秦。

title: Xie Xuan creates the Beifu Army
summary: Xie Xuan recruited hardy northern refugees into the Beifu Army, the force that would win at Fei River and later carry Liu Yu to power.
summary_zh: 谢玄招募北方流民中的勇健者组成北府兵，后取得淝水大捷，并成为刘裕崛起的基础。

title: Former Qin takes Xiangyang
summary: Fu Pi besieged Xiangyang for a year; despite the defence led by Zhu Xu and his mother, the city fell and Zhu Xu was captured.
summary_zh: 苻丕围攻襄阳近一年，朱序及其母韩夫人筑“夫人城”坚守，终城破被俘。

title: Gu Kaizhi and figure painting
summary: Gu Kaizhi, painter of the Admonitions Scroll and the Nymph of the Luo River, emphasized conveying the spirit of his subjects.
summary_zh: 顾恺之作《女史箴图》《洛神赋图》，主张“以形写神”，为中国人物画奠基者。

title: Lü Guang's expedition to the Western Regions
summary: Fu Jiān sent Lü Guang with 70,000 troops to the Western Regions; he took Kucha and brought Kumarajiva back east.
summary_zh: 苻坚遣吕光率七万兵西征，攻破龟兹，西域诸国归附，并得鸠摩罗什东归。

title: Battle of Fei River
summary: A small Eastern Jin army defeats the Former Qin, keeping the south independent.
summary_zh: 东晋以少量兵力大败前秦，保住了南方的独立。

title: Murong Chui founds Later Yan
summary: After Fei River, Murong Chui broke with Former Qin and restored the Yan state, later making Zhongshan his capital.
summary_zh: 淝水战后慕容垂叛秦复国，建立后燕，后定都中山。

title: Fu Jiān killed by Yao Chang
summary: Fleeing Chang'an, Fu Jiān was captured by the Qiang leader Yao Chang, founder of Later Qin, and strangled in a Buddhist temple.
summary_zh: 苻坚出奔被后秦姚苌所俘，拒绝禅让，被缢杀于新平佛寺。

title: Tuoba Gui founds the Northern Wei
place_zh: 盛乐（今内蒙古和林格尔）
summary: A Xianbei chief restores his people's state of Dai and renames it Wei. It will unite the north in 439.
summary_zh: 鲜卑首领拓跋珪复兴代国，改国号为魏，北魏将在439年统一北方。

title: Lü Guang founds Later Liang
summary: Returning from Kucha, Lü Guang seized Guzang and founded the Later Liang, holding Kumarajiva there for 17 years.
summary_zh: 吕光自西域东归，据姑臧建立后凉，鸠摩罗什被留凉州十七年。

title: Battle of Canhe Slope
summary: Tuoba Gui surprised the retreating Later Yan army at Canhe and buried tens of thousands of prisoners, breaking Later Yan's power.
summary_zh: 拓跋珪于参合陂袭破后燕军，坑杀降卒数万，后燕由此衰落。

title: Northern Liang founded in the Hexi corridor
summary: Juqu Mengxun and his cousin rebelled against Later Liang and installed Duan Ye; Mengxun later killed Duan and ruled Northern Liang.
summary_zh: 沮渠蒙逊兄弟起兵反后凉，推段业为主建北凉，蒙逊后杀段业自立。

title: Wang Gong's revolts
summary: Wang Gong twice raised troops against the court of Sima Daozi; in 398 his general Liu Laozhi defected and Wang was executed.
summary_zh: 王恭两度起兵讨司马道子，398年部将刘牢之倒戈，王恭兵败被杀。

title: Tuoba Gui makes Pingcheng capital
summary: Tuoba Gui moved his capital to Pingcheng, proclaimed himself emperor and began building palaces and settling conquered peoples there.
summary_zh: 拓跋珪迁都平城，即皇帝位，营建宫室，徙民充实京畿。

title: Faxian travels to India
summary: The monk walks across Central Asia to India and returns by sea via Sri Lanka with Buddhist texts.
summary_zh: 僧人法显徒步经中亚到达天竺，又经狮子国（斯里兰卡）走海路带回佛经。

title: Sun En and Lu Xun rebellion
summary: A Daoist sect leader raises peasants along the coast. After his death his brother-in-law Lu Xun fights on.
summary_zh: 五斗米道首领孙恩在沿海发动农民起义，他死后妹夫卢循继续作战。

title: Li Gao founds Western Liang
summary: Li Gao, a Han official, founded Western Liang at Dunhuang, encouraging learning and farming at the western edge of China.
summary_zh: 李暠在敦煌建立西凉，兴学劝农，保存中原文化于河西。

title: Kumarajiva arrives in Chang'an
summary: The Kuchean monk leads a huge translation team. His versions of key sutras are still the ones most read.
