summary_zh: 龟兹高僧鸠摩罗什主持大规模译经，他译出的许多佛经至今仍是最通行的版本。

title: Huiyuan's vow at Mount Lu
summary: Huiyuan and 123 followers vowed rebirth in Amitabha's Pure Land at Donglin Temple, regarded as the origin of Pure Land Buddhism.
summary_zh: 慧远与刘遗民等百余人于庐山东林寺立誓往生西方，被尊为净土宗初祖。

title: Huan Xuan usurps the Jin throne
summary: Huan Wen's son Huan Xuan took Jiankang in 402 and next year deposed Emperor An, proclaiming the state of Chu.
summary_zh: 桓玄402年攻入建康，次年废晋安帝，自立为帝，国号楚。

title: Liu Yu rises against Huan Xuan
summary: Liu Yu and Beifu officers rose at Jingkou, routed Huan Xuan and restored Jin, beginning Liu Yu's ascent.
summary_zh: 刘裕联络北府旧将在京口起兵，击败桓玄，恢复晋室，开始掌握朝政。

title: Tao Yuanming quits office to farm
summary: The poet resigns as magistrate of Pengze after 80 days and goes home to farm and write.
summary_zh: 诗人陶渊明做了八十多天彭泽县令后辞官回乡，躬耕田园，写诗为生。

title: Helian Bobo founds Xia
summary: The Xiongnu chief Helian Bobo broke with Later Qin and founded Xia; in 413 he built the white-walled capital Tongwancheng.
summary_zh: 匈奴赫连勃勃叛后秦，自称大夏天王，413年筑统万城为都。

title: Liu Yu conquers Southern Yan
summary: After a long siege Liu Yu takes Guanggu and brings Shandong back under Jin.
summary_zh: 刘裕围攻广固多时后破城，使山东重归东晋。

title: Faxian returns by sea
summary: After 13 years abroad, Faxian sailed home from Sri Lanka and landed at Laoshan with Sanskrit texts, then wrote his Record of Buddhist Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 法显历十余年自狮子国浮海东归，于牢山登岸，携回梵本，撰《佛国记》。

title: Yixi tuduan registration
summary: Liu Yu carried out another household-registration drive, executing the magnate Yu Hu for concealing households.
summary_zh: 刘裕主持义熙土断，严厉检括隐户，诛隐匿人口的豪强虞亮以立威。

title: Zhu Lingshi conquers Western Shu
summary: Liu Yu's general Zhu Lingshi took Chengdu, ending Qiao Zong's breakaway Western Shu.
summary_zh: 刘裕遣朱龄石伐蜀，攻克成都，谯纵自杀，西蜀灭亡。

title: Gwanggaeto Stele erected
summary: Goguryeo's King Jangsu erected a six-metre stele recording the conquests of his father Gwanggaeto, a key source for Northeast Asian history.
summary_zh: 高句丽长寿王立碑颂其父好太王功业，为研究东北亚古史的重要史料。

title: Liu Yu takes Chang'an
summary: The Eastern Jin general destroys Later Qin and briefly retakes the old capital, the high point of southern power.
summary_zh: 东晋大将刘裕消灭后秦，一度收复故都长安，这是南方军事力量的顶峰。

title: Liu Yu's crescent formation
summary: Advancing up the Yellow River against Later Qin, Liu Yu used a crescent formation of wagons and crossbows to rout Northern Wei cavalry.
summary_zh: 刘裕北伐沿黄河西进，以车阵弩兵布“却月阵”，大破北魏骑兵。

title: Helian Bobo captures Chang'an
summary: After Liu Yu left for the south, Jin's commanders feuded; Helian Bobo crushed them and took Chang'an, undoing the northern conquest.
summary_zh: 刘裕南归后关中晋将内讧，赫连勃勃大败晋军，攻占长安，北伐成果丧失。

title: Liu Yu founds the Song
summary: The general ends the Jin. Four short southern dynasties follow at Jiankang: Song, Qi, Liang and Chen.
summary_zh: 刘裕结束东晋统治。此后建康相继出现宋、齐、梁、陈四个短命的南方王朝。

title: Xie Lingyun founds landscape poetry
summary: Demoted to Yongjia, the aristocrat Xie Lingyun wandered its mountains and wrote the poems that founded the Chinese landscape (shanshui) genre.
summary_zh: 谢灵运出任永嘉太守，遍游山水，所作诗开创中国山水诗派。

title: Northern Wei takes Hulao and Luoyang
summary: After Liu Yu's death, Northern Wei invaded and took Luoyang and, after a 200-day siege, Hulao; Song lost most land south of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 刘裕死后北魏南侵，攻占洛阳，围虎牢二百余日破之，宋失河南大片土地。

title: Regents depose and kill Emperor Shao
summary: Regents Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang and Xie Hui deposed the frivolous Emperor Shao, had him killed and enthroned Liu Yilong as Emperor Wen.
summary_zh: 顾命大臣徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦废杀荒嬉的少帝，迎立宜都王刘义隆，是为宋文帝。

title: Northern Wei captures Tongwancheng
summary: Emperor Taiwu feigned retreat to lure out the Xia army, then stormed its white-walled capital Tongwancheng.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝诱夏军出城决战，大破之，攻克夏都统万城。

title: Emperor Taiwu routs the Rouran
summary: Taiwu struck deep into the steppe, scattering the Rouran and taking hundreds of thousands of captives and livestock.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝亲率大军深入漠北，大破柔然，降附及俘获人畜以数十万计。

title: Shishuo Xinyu compiled
summary: Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, compiled anecdotes of Wei–Jin gentry wit and Pure Talk into the Shishuo Xinyu.
summary_zh: 临川王刘义庆组织文士编撰《世说新语》，记录魏晋名士言行与清谈风尚。

title: Song's failed Yuanjia expedition of 430
summary: Song retook land south of the Yellow River unopposed, but Wei counterattacked; Huatai fell and Tan Daoji's 'counting sand' ruse saved the retreat.
summary_zh: 宋遣到彦之北伐，先收复河南，旋遭魏反击，滑台失守，檀道济“唱筹量沙”全军而还。

title: Xia destroyed by Tuyuhun
summary: Helian Ding, having destroyed Western Qin, was ambushed by the Tuyuhun while crossing the Yellow River and handed to Northern Wei.
summary_zh: 夏主赫连定灭西秦后西渡黄河，被吐谷浑截击生擒，送交北魏，夏亡。

title: Northern Wei destroys Northern Yan
summary: Wei forces took Longcheng; Feng Hong burned his palace and fled to Goguryeo, where he was later killed.
summary_zh: 魏军攻龙城，燕主冯弘焚宫东奔高句丽，后被杀，北燕亡。

title: Tan Daoji executed
summary: Fearing the veteran general, Liu Yikang had Tan Daoji killed; Tan cried that they were destroying their own Great Wall.
summary_zh: 刘义康忌檀道济威名，矫诏杀之，道济怒斥“乃坏汝万里长城”。北魏闻之称快。

title: Song founds four academies
summary: Emperor Wen set up separate schools for Confucianism, Xuanxue, history and literature at Jiankang, recognizing literature and history as distinct fields.
summary_zh: 宋文帝于建康分立儒学、玄学、史学、文学四馆，学术分科自此显明。

title: Northern Wei unifies the north
summary: The Xianbei Tuoba conquer Northern Liang, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 鲜卑拓跋氏灭北凉，十六国时代结束。

title: Taoism becomes Wei's state religion
summary: Backed by Cui Hao, Kou Qianzhi's reformed Celestial Masters Taoism won Emperor Taiwu, who adopted the era name Taiping Zhenjun and received Taoist registers.
summary_zh: 在崔浩支持下，寇谦之改革的新天师道受太武帝尊崇，改元太平真君，帝亲受符箓。

title: Northern Liang remnant seizes Gaochang
summary: Survivors of Northern Liang under Juqu Wuhui and Anzhou took Gaochang, beginning centuries of Han-ruled states in Turpan.
summary_zh: 北凉余部沮渠无讳、安周西走占据高昌，此后吐鲁番长期由汉人政权统治。

title: He Chengtian's Yuanjia calendar
summary: He Chengtian proposed the Yuanjia calendar, adopted in 445, introducing improved lunar month calculations.
summary_zh: 何承天制《元嘉历》，445年颁行，改进朔望月推算方法。

title: Fan Ye's Book of the Later Han
summary: A Liu Song official writes the standard history of the Eastern Han. He is executed for treason in 445.
summary_zh: 刘宋官员范晔撰写东汉一代的正史，445年因谋反罪被处死。

title: Gai Wu's uprising in Guanzhong
summary: The Lushui Hu leader Gai Wu raised over 100,000 against Northern Wei; Taiwu found weapons in a Chang'an monastery, triggering the persecution of Buddhism.
summary_zh: 卢水胡盖吴起义，众至十余万，太武帝平乱时于长安佛寺发现兵器，引发灭佛。

title: Emperor Taiwu persecutes Buddhism
summary: Northern Wei orders monks killed or returned to lay life and temples and images destroyed.
summary_zh: 北魏下令诛杀或勒令僧人还俗，并焚毁寺庙和佛像。

title: Song's northern campaign fails; Wei reaches the Yangtze
summary: Emperor Wen of Song attacks Northern Wei and is routed. Wei cavalry ride all the way to the Yangtze opposite Jiankang.
summary_zh: 宋文帝北伐北魏大败，北魏骑兵一路南下，直抵建康对岸的长江边。

title: Cui Hao is executed over the state history
summary: The leading Han Chinese minister of Northern Wei is killed with his whole clan after his history offends the Xianbei nobles.
summary_zh: 北魏重臣崔浩因修国史触怒鲜卑贵族，被灭族。

title: Defense of Xuyi
summary: After reaching Guabu on the Yangtze, Taiwu's withdrawing army besieged Xuyi for a month; Zang Zhi's stubborn defense inflicted heavy losses.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝饮马长江于瓜步后北撤，围攻盱眙月余，臧质坚守，魏军死伤惨重。

title: Eunuch Zong Ai murders Emperor Taiwu
summary: Fearing punishment, the eunuch Zong Ai killed Emperor Taiwu and then the successor he installed; officials soon killed Zong and enthroned Emperor Wencheng.
summary_zh: 宦官宗爱弑太武帝，又杀所立南安王，群臣诛宗爱，立文成帝。

title: Wencheng restores Buddhism
summary: Emperor Wencheng lifted the ban on Buddhism, rebuilt temples and later made Tanyao head of the sangha.
summary_zh: 文成帝即位后下诏复兴佛法，重建寺塔，后以昙曜为沙门统。

title: Liu Shao murders Emperor Wen
summary: Exposed for witchcraft against his father, crown prince Liu Shao stormed the palace and killed Emperor Wen; his brother Liu Jun overthrew him within months.
summary_zh: 太子刘劭巫蛊事泄，率兵入宫弑杀宋文帝，不久被其弟刘骏起兵诛灭。

title: Liu Yixuan's revolt at Jiangling
summary: Emperor Xiaowu's uncle Liu Yixuan rebelled at Jiangling with Zang Zhi but was defeated at Liangshan; Jing province was then split up.
summary_zh: 荆州刺史刘义宣联合臧质起兵反宋孝武帝，于梁山战败被杀，朝廷遂分割荆州。

title: Sasanian Persia sends envoys to Wei
summary: The first of several Sasanian embassies reached Pingcheng, reflecting Silk Road links that also brought Persian silver to Wei tombs.
summary_zh: 波斯萨珊王朝首次遣使至平城，此后屡有往来，北魏墓葬中多见波斯银器。

title: Yungang Grottoes begun
summary: Northern Wei emperors sponsor giant Buddha figures carved into the cliffs near their capital.
summary_zh: 北魏皇帝出资在都城附近的山崖上开凿巨大佛像。

title: Zu Chongzhi's Daming calendar and pi
summary: The mathematician presents a more accurate calendar. He also calculates pi to between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927.
summary_zh: 祖冲之献上更精确的《大明历》，他还把圆周率推算到3.1415926与3.1415927之间。

title: Empress Dowager Feng's first regency
summary: Empress Dowager Feng killed the regent Yifu Hun and took control of the Wei government, later guiding Xiaowen's reforms.
summary_zh: 冯太后诛权臣乙浑，临朝听政，后主导孝文帝初年改革。

title: Succession war of Taishi
summary: After the tyrant Liu Ziye was murdered, Emperor Ming faced a rival claimant Liu Zixun backed by most provinces; Ming won but killed many princes.
summary_zh: 前废帝被杀后，宋明帝即位，各地拥立晋安王刘子勋于寻阳，明帝平之，大杀宗室。

title: Northern Wei seizes Huaibei and Qingqi
summary: Exploiting Song's civil war, Northern Wei annexed the Huaibei region and Shandong, taking Dongyang in 469; Song was confined south of the Huai.
summary_zh: 北魏乘宋内乱，夺取淮北四州及青齐之地，469年攻克东阳，宋退守淮河。

title: Emperor Xianwen abdicates to his son
summary: At 17, Xianwen yielded the throne to his four-year-old son Xiaowen, becoming retired emperor; he died in 476, reputedly poisoned by Empress Dowager Feng.
summary_zh: 献文帝禅位于年仅五岁的太子拓跋宏，自称太上皇，476年暴卒，传为冯太后所害。

title: Xiao Daocheng has Emperor Houfei killed
summary: Xiao Daocheng arranged the murder of the violent boy-emperor Liu Yu and enthroned Emperor Shun, taking control of the Song court.
summary_zh: 萧道成使人杀暴虐的少主刘昱（苍梧王），立顺帝，独揽宋政。

title: King Bu of Wa petitions Song
summary: King Bu of Wa (Yūryaku) sent a memorial recounting his ancestors' conquests and received the title General Pacifying the East.
summary_zh: 倭王武（雄略天皇）遣使上表，述其祖先征服四方，宋授以安东大将军。

title: Xiao Daocheng founds the Southern Qi
summary: The general Xiao Daocheng forced the last Liu Song emperor to abdicate. The south changed dynasty but kept the same capital and lands.
summary_zh: 将领萧道成逼迫刘宋末帝禅位。南方虽改朝换代，都城和疆域却没有变化。

title: Yongming peace of Southern Qi
summary: Emperor Wu of Qi's Yongming reign brought a decade of stability, frugality and literary flourishing in the south.
summary_zh: 齐武帝永明年间政局安定，崇尚节俭，文学繁荣，史称永明之治。

title: Northern Wei pays official salaries
summary: Northern Wei began paying officials fixed salaries and punished corruption severely, replacing reliance on plunder and extortion.
summary_zh: 北魏颁行俸禄制，官吏按品给禄，贪赃满一匹者处死。

title: Northern Wei's equal-field system
summary: The state hands out farmland to households by the number of adults, to bring land back into use and secure taxes.
summary_zh: 国家按人口授田给农户，使荒地重新耕种，保证赋税来源。

title: Tang Yuzhi's rebellion against registers
summary: Resentment at Southern Qi's harsh household-register audits fuelled Tang Yuzhi's rising in Zhejiang, which briefly took Qiantang.
summary_zh: 南齐检籍苛急，唐寓之聚众起事，一度攻占钱唐，称帝，旋被镇压。

title: Three Elders system
summary: On Li Chong's proposal, Wei organized villages into neighborhood, village and ward heads to register households and enforce the equal-field system.
summary_zh: 采纳李冲建议，北魏设邻、里、党三长，检括户口，配合均田制征收租调。

title: Eight Friends of Jingling
summary: Prince Xiao Ziliang's salon on Jiming Hill gathered Shen Yue, Xie Tiao, Xiao Yan and others, shaping Yongming literature and Buddhist debate.
summary_zh: 竟陵王萧子良开西邸于鸡笼山，聚沈约、谢朓、萧衍等八友，文学与佛学兴盛。

title: Shen Yue's four tones and Yongming style
summary: Shen Yue and Zhou Yong formalized the four tones of Chinese and tonal rules for verse, laying foundations for Tang regulated poetry.
summary_zh: 沈约、周颙等提出四声八病之说，创永明体，为唐代格律诗奠基。

title: Fan Zhen argues the soul perishes
summary: Fan Zhen debated Xiao Ziliang and later Emperor Wu of Liang, arguing that spirit is to body as sharpness is to a blade, denying karma's afterlife.
summary_zh: 范缜与萧子良辩论因果，后著《神灭论》，以“形神相即”批驳佛教神不灭说。

title: Longmen Grottoes begun
summary: As the capital moved to Luoyang, carving began at Longmen with the Guyang Cave; work continued for four centuries.
summary_zh: 北魏迁洛前后开凿龙门古阳洞，此后历朝续凿四百余年。

title: Emperor Xiaowen moves the capital to Luoyang
summary: The Xianbei court adopts Chinese dress, language and surnames. The Longmen Grottoes are begun nearby.
summary_zh: 鲜卑朝廷改穿汉服、说汉语、改汉姓。附近的龙门石窟也开始开凿。

title: Xiao Luan seizes the Qi throne
summary: Xiao Luan murdered two young emperors in succession, took the throne as Emperor Ming of Qi and killed most of Xiao Daocheng's descendants.
summary_zh: 萧鸾连废杀二帝，自立为齐明帝，并大肆诛杀高帝、武帝子孙。

title: Ban on Xianbei dress and language
summary: Xiaowen ordered officials to wear Han-style clothing and banned Xianbei speech at court for those under 30.
summary_zh: 孝文帝诏令禁止胡服，朝廷之上三十岁以下者禁用鲜卑语，改说汉语。

title: Shaolin Temple founded
summary: Emperor Xiaowen built the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song for the Indian monk Batuo.
summary_zh: 孝文帝为天竺僧人跋陀在嵩山少室山下建少林寺。

title: Taihe wuzhu coins minted
summary: Northern Wei minted its first official coinage, the Taihe wuzhu, to replace barter in silk and grain.
summary_zh: 北魏铸行太和五铢钱，改变以绢帛实物交易的状况。

title: Xianbei surnames changed to Han ones
summary: Xiaowen changed the imperial surname Tuoba to Yuan and Xianbei clans' names to Han forms, ranking them with leading Han families.
summary_zh: 孝文帝改拓跋氏为元氏，鲜卑诸姓改为汉姓，并定士族门第，鼓励鲜汉通婚。

title: Xiaowen dies on campaign
summary: Emperor Xiaowen died aged 32 while campaigning against Southern Qi; Emperor Xuanwu succeeded.
summary_zh: 孝文帝南伐齐，病逝于谷塘原军中，年三十三，宣武帝即位。

title: Tao Hongjing's annotated pharmacopoeia
summary: The Daoist recluse Tao Hongjing, 'prime minister in the mountains', doubled the Shennong herbal to 730 drugs and classified them by type.
summary_zh: “山中宰相”陶弘景整理《神农本草经》，著《本草经集注》，收药七百三十种并按自然属性分类。

title: Liu Xie's The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons
summary: The first systematic book of Chinese literary criticism, covering genres, style and the craft of writing.
summary_zh: 中国第一部系统的文学理论著作，论述文体、风格和写作技巧。

title: Xiao Yan founds the Liang
summary: Xiao Yan, Emperor Wu of Liang, ruled for 48 years. His reign was the high point of southern Buddhism and court culture.
summary_zh: 萧衍即梁武帝，在位四十八年，是南朝佛教和宫廷文化的鼎盛时期。

title: Zu Geng's principle and the sphere
summary: Zu Geng, son of Zu Chongzhi, stated that solids with equal cross-sections have equal volumes and derived the sphere's volume.
summary_zh: 祖冲之之子祖暅提出“幂势既同，则积不容异”，求得球体积公式。

title: Xiao Hong's failed northern expedition
summary: Liang massed a huge army under Xiao Hong, but the timid prince fled one stormy night and the force disintegrated.
summary_zh: 梁武帝遣临川王萧宏大举北伐，萧宏怯战，夜遇风雨弃军逃归，大军溃散。

title: Battle of Zhongli
summary: Liang forces destroyed a huge Northern Wei army besieging Zhongli on the Huai, which stopped the northern advance south.
summary_zh: 梁军在淮河边的钟离大败围城的北魏大军，阻止了北方继续南进。

title: Empress Dowager Hu takes power
summary: After Xuanwu's death, Empress Dowager Hu became regent for her young son; lavish Buddhist building and misrule followed.
summary_zh: 宣武帝死，胡太后临朝称制，崇佛奢靡，政治日益腐败。

title: Li Daoyuan's Commentary on the Water Classic
summary: A Northern Wei official describes more than a thousand rivers and the towns, sites and legends along them.
summary_zh: 北魏官员郦道元记述一千多条河流及沿岸城邑、古迹和传说。

title: Monk Faqing's Mahayana rebellion
summary: The monk Faqing led a millenarian rising in Jizhou, burning temples and proclaiming that 'a new Buddha has appeared'.
summary_zh: 沙门法庆在冀州聚众起事，号“大乘”，称“新佛出世，除去旧魔”，焚寺杀僧。

title: Fushan Dam collapses
summary: Liang dammed the Huai to flood Wei-held Shouyang; after two years of labor the dam burst, drowning over 100,000 people downstream.
summary_zh: 梁武帝筑浮山堰欲以淮水灌寿阳，役工二十万，堰成数月即溃，下游溺死十余万人。

title: Yongning Temple pagoda
summary: Empress Dowager Hu built the Yongning Temple and its wooden pagoda, about 136 m tall and seen from 100 li away; it burned in 534.
summary_zh: 胡太后兴建永宁寺，木塔高九层，百里外可见，534年焚毁。

title: Song Yun and Huisheng travel to India
summary: Sent by Empress Dowager Hu, Song Yun and Huisheng crossed the Pamirs to Udyana and Gandhara and brought back 170 Buddhist texts.
summary_zh: 宋云、惠生奉胡太后命西行，越葱岭至乌苌、乾陀罗，取回佛经一百七十部。

title: Bodhidharma brings Chan to China
summary: According to tradition the Indian monk Bodhidharma met Emperor Wu of Liang, then meditated at Shaolin, becoming the first patriarch of Chan.
summary_zh: 相传天竺僧菩提达摩见梁武帝不契，渡江北上，于嵩山面壁，被尊为禅宗初祖。

title: Yuan Cha confines Empress Dowager Hu
summary: Yuan Cha and the eunuch Liu Teng killed Prince Yuan Yi and confined the empress dowager, ruling until 525.
summary_zh: 元叉与宦官刘腾杀清河王元怿，幽禁胡太后，专权五年。

title: Liang casts iron coins
summary: Liang replaced copper with iron coinage; mass minting caused inflation so severe that coins were counted by the cartload.
summary_zh: 梁武帝废铜钱改铸铁钱，私铸泛滥，物价腾贵，交易以车载钱。

title: Revolt of the Six Garrisons
summary: Frontier soldiers on the northern border rose against the Luoyang court. The revolt broke Northern Wei apart within ten years.
summary_zh: 北方边境的戍卒起兵反抗洛阳朝廷，十年之内北魏便因此分崩离析。

title: Emperor Wu of Liang gives himself to Tongtai Temple
summary: The emperor takes vows at a temple he built; ministers pay a huge ransom to buy him back. He does this four times.
summary_zh: 梁武帝到自己修建的同泰寺出家，群臣花巨款把他“赎”回。他先后这样做了四次。

title: Heyin massacre
summary: The warlord Erzhu Rong drowns the Empress Dowager Hu and kills some two thousand court officials.
summary_zh: 军阀尔朱荣把胡太后沉入黄河，屠杀朝臣两千余人。

title: Erzhu Rong crushes Ge Rong
summary: With only 7,000 cavalry Erzhu Rong routed Ge Rong's vast rebel army near Ye and captured him, ending the Hebei rising.
summary_zh: 尔朱荣率精骑七千于滏口大破号称百万的葛荣军，生擒葛荣，河北义军瓦解。

title: Chen Qingzhi marches to Luoyang
summary: A Liang general with 7,000 men in white robes escorts a Wei prince to Luoyang, winning dozens of battles.
summary_zh: 梁将陈庆之率七千白袍军护送北魏宗室北上，连战连捷，攻入洛阳。

title: Xiao Tong compiles the Selections of Refined Literature
summary: The Liang crown prince collects the best poetry and prose of eight centuries. It becomes a standard textbook for later writers.
summary_zh: 梁朝太子萧统选编八百年间的优秀诗文，此书成为后世文人的必读范本。

title: Emperor Xiaozhuang kills Erzhu Rong
summary: Emperor Xiaozhuang lured Erzhu Rong into the palace and killed him; the Erzhu clan retaliated, capturing and killing the emperor.
summary_zh: 孝庄帝诱尔朱荣入宫手刃之，尔朱兆等攻入洛阳，俘杀孝庄帝。

title: Battle of Hanling
summary: Gao Huan, with under 30,000 men, defeated the combined Erzhu forces at Hanling and took control of the Wei court.
summary_zh: 高欢以不足三万之众于韩陵大破尔朱氏联军二十万，掌控北魏朝政。

title: Xie He's Six Principles of Painting
summary: In his Record of Classifying Old Painters, Xie He set out six principles, led by 'spirit resonance', that guided Chinese art criticism.
summary_zh: 谢赫著《古画品录》，提出以“气韵生动”为首的绘画六法。

title: Northern Wei splits in two
summary: Rival generals set up Eastern Wei at Ye and Western Wei at Chang'an.
summary_zh: 两位权臣分别在邺城建立东魏、在长安建立西魏。

title: Yuwen Tai poisons Emperor Xiaowu
summary: Emperor Xiaowu, who fled Gao Huan to Chang'an, quarrelled with Yuwen Tai and was poisoned; Yuwen enthroned Emperor Wen of Western Wei.
summary_zh: 西奔长安的魏孝武帝与宇文泰不和，被鸩杀，宇文泰立文帝，西魏建立。

title: Battle of Shayuan
summary: Yuwen Tai of Western Wei ambushes and routs Gao Huan's much larger Eastern Wei army.
summary_zh: 西魏宇文泰设伏，以少胜多大败高欢率领的东魏大军。

title: Battle of Xiaoguan
summary: Yuwen Tai made a surprise attack on Dou Tai's Eastern Wei column at Xiaoguan; Dou killed himself and Gao Huan withdrew.
summary_zh: 宇文泰奇袭东魏窦泰于小关，窦泰兵败自杀，高欢撤军。

title: Battle of Heqiao and Mangshan
summary: Western Wei and Eastern Wei clashed around Luoyang's Yellow River bridge; both sides suffered heavy losses and Luoyang was left in ruins.
summary_zh: 东西魏于洛阳河桥、邙山一带激战，双方伤亡惨重，洛阳遭严重破坏。

title: Su Chuo's Six Edicts
summary: Su Chuo drafted six edicts for Yuwen Tai on governing the people, appointing the worthy and equalizing taxes, which officials had to memorize.
summary_zh: 苏绰为宇文泰制定六条诏书，倡清心、敷教化、尽地利、擢贤良、恤狱讼、均赋役。

title: First Battle of Mangshan
summary: Western Wei backed the defector Gao Zhongmi; Gao Huan routed Yuwen Tai at Mangshan, after which Western Wei recruited Han local militias.
summary_zh: 西魏接应高仲密，宇文泰于邙山大败于高欢，此后广募关陇豪右乡兵。

title: Gu Yewang compiles the Yupian
summary: Gu Yewang completed the Yupian, a dictionary of over 16,000 characters arranged by radical, the oldest surviving regular-script dictionary.
summary_zh: 顾野王撰成《玉篇》，按部首收字一万六千余，为现存最早的楷书字典。

title: Lý Bí founds Van Xuan
summary: Lý Bí drove out the Liang governor of Jiaozhou and declared the kingdom of Van Xuan, the Early Lý dynasty.
summary_zh: 李贲赶走梁朝的交州刺史，建立万春国，史称前李朝。

title: Jia Sixie's Qimin Yaoshu
summary: A detailed farming manual covering crops, trees, animals and food processing, including early recipes for brewing.
summary_zh: 一部详尽的农书，内容涵盖作物、林木、畜牧和食品加工，包括早期的酿造方法。

title: New Songs from a Jade Terrace
summary: Xu Ling compiled the Yutai Xinyong, an anthology of love poetry that preserved 'Southeast Fly the Peacocks'.
summary_zh: 徐陵编《玉台新咏》，收汉至梁艳情诗，保存了《孔雀东南飞》等名篇。

title: Paramartha arrives in Guangzhou
summary: The Indian monk Paramartha reached Guangzhou and became one of the great translators, rendering Yogacara texts amid the chaos of Hou Jing's revolt.
summary_zh: 天竺高僧真谛抵广州，后历经战乱辗转译经，为四大译经家之一，传瑜伽行派学说。

title: Siege of Yubi
summary: Wei Xiaokuan holds the fortress of Yubi for fifty days against Gao Huan, who falls ill and dies soon after.
summary_zh: 韦孝宽坚守玉璧五十天，高欢久攻不下，忧愤成疾，不久去世。

title: Record of the Buddhist Monasteries of Luoyang
summary: Revisiting the ruined city, Yang Xuanzhi describes the great temples of Northern Wei Luoyang as they once were.
summary_zh: 杨衒之重游残破的洛阳，追记北魏洛阳城中寺院的昔日盛况。

title: Battle of Hanshan
summary: Liang sent Xiao Yuanming to support Hou Jing's defection, damming the Si to flood Pengcheng, but Murong Shaozong routed and captured him.
summary_zh: 梁武帝遣萧渊明接应侯景，于寒山筑堰灌彭城，被慕容绍宗大败，萧渊明被俘。

title: Hou Jing defects to Liang
summary: On Gao Huan's death, Hou Jing, master of thirteen provinces south of the Yellow River, offered them to Liang; Emperor Wu accepted despite warnings.
summary_zh: 高欢死，拥河南十三州的侯景叛东魏，请降于梁，梁武帝不顾劝阻纳之。

title: Hou Jing rebellion
summary: A defecting general besieges and ruins Jiankang, and Emperor Wu of Liang starves to death.
summary_zh: 降将侯景围攻并摧毁建康，梁武帝被困饿死。

title: Gao Yang founds the Northern Qi
summary: The Gao family, who already ran Eastern Wei, took the throne for themselves.
summary_zh: 早已掌控东魏的高氏家族自立为帝。

title: Yuwen Tai's fubing militia system
summary: Western Wei organizes soldier-farmer families into twenty-four armies under eight great generals.
summary_zh: 西魏把兵农合一的军户编为二十四军，由八柱国统领。

title: Wang Sengbian holds Baling
summary: Hou Jing's advance upriver stalled at Baling, where Wang Sengbian held out; the turn of the tide led to Hou Jing's destruction.
summary_zh: 侯景西进被王僧辩阻于巴陵，久攻不下，败退，梁军转入反攻。

title: Bumin founds the Turkic Khaganate
summary: The Turks overthrow their Rouran overlords. Both Northern Qi and Northern Zhou pay them silk to stay friendly.
summary_zh: 突厥推翻柔然的统治。北齐、北周都争相向突厥送去丝绸，以求结好。

title: Western Wei conquers Sichuan
summary: Yuchi Jiong led Western Wei into Sichuan while Liang princes fought each other, taking Chengdu and shifting the balance decisively northwards.
summary_zh: 梁宗室内争，西魏遣尉迟迥入蜀，攻克成都，益州归西魏，南北实力对比大变。

title: Western Wei sacks Jiangling
summary: Western Wei took the Liang capital at Jiangling and carried tens of thousands of people north. Emperor Yuan of Liang burned his library of 140,000 scrolls before he surrendered.
summary_zh: 西魏攻陷梁朝都城江陵，把数万百姓掳往北方。梁元帝投降前焚毁了十四万卷藏书。

title: Wei Shou completes the Book of Wei
summary: Wei Shou completed the official history of Northern Wei; accused of bias, it was nicknamed the 'filthy history'.
summary_zh: 魏收撰成《魏书》，因褒贬不公被讥为“秽史”，仍为研究北魏的基本史料。

title: Western Liang puppet state
summary: After sacking Jiangling, Western Wei installed Xiao Cha as emperor of a small Liang rump state there.
summary_zh: 西魏破江陵后立萧詧为梁帝，据江陵一隅，为附庸政权，史称西梁（后梁）。

title: Chen Baxian kills Wang Sengbian
summary: Wang Sengbian accepted Northern Qi's candidate Xiao Yuanming as Liang emperor; Chen Baxian attacked from Jingkou and killed him.
summary_zh: 王僧辩迎立北齐所送萧渊明，陈霸先自京口袭石头城杀之。

title: Northern Qi builds the Great Wall
summary: Northern Qi conscripted 1.8 million men to build a long wall from Juyong Pass to Datong against Turks and Khitan.
summary_zh: 北齐征发民夫一百八十万筑长城，自幽州夏口至恒州九百余里。

title: Chen Baxian routs Northern Qi at Jiankang
summary: A Northern Qi army crossed the Yangtze to Jiankang; Chen Baxian's starving troops routed it beneath Mount Mufu, securing the south.
summary_zh: 北齐大军渡江逼建康，陈霸先于幕府山南大破之，江南得保。

title: Chen Baxian founds the Chen
summary: The general who had defeated Hou Jing took the throne. Chen was the smallest of the southern dynasties.
summary_zh: 平定侯景之乱的将领陈霸先登上帝位。陈是南朝中疆域最小的王朝。

title: Northern Zhou replaces Western Wei
summary: The Yuwen family, who already ran Western Wei, took the throne. Their state would conquer the north, and its successor Sui would unite China.
summary_zh: 早已掌控西魏的宇文氏称帝。北周后来统一北方，继承它的隋朝则统一了全国。

title: Yuwen Hu kills Emperor Xiaomin
summary: Regent Yuwen Hu deposed and killed Yuwen Jue within a year of the Zhou founding; he later poisoned Emperor Ming too.
summary_zh: 北周建立当年，宇文护废杀孝闵帝宇文觉，560年又毒杀明帝。

title: Gao Yang massacres the Yuan clan
summary: Emperor Wenxuan of Northern Qi had over 700 members of the Northern Wei imperial clan killed and their bodies thrown into the Zhang River.
summary_zh: 北齐文宣帝高洋大杀北魏宗室元氏七百余人，尸投漳水。

title: Zhou and Turks attack Jinyang
summary: Northern Zhou and Göktürk armies attacked Northern Qi's Jinyang in deep winter but were repulsed.
summary_zh: 北周联合突厥冒雪进攻北齐晋阳，被齐军击退。

title: Northern Qi Code promulgated
summary: The Northern Qi Code fixed twelve chapters and the 'ten abominations', providing the model for Sui and Tang law.
summary_zh: 北齐颁布《北齐律》十二篇，首列“重罪十条”，为隋唐律所本。

title: Prince of Lanling at Mangshan
summary: Gao Changgong of Northern Qi breaks through the Northern Zhou siege of Luoyang with 500 cavalry.
summary_zh: 北齐兰陵王高长恭率五百骑兵冲破北周对洛阳的包围。

title: Hua Jiao's revolt against Chen
summary: Hua Jiao, governor of Xiangzhou, rebelled and called in Northern Zhou and Western Liang; Chen forces defeated them on the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 湘州刺史华皎叛陈，引北周、后梁军，陈将吴明彻、淳于量击败之。

title: Turkic princess weds Emperor Wu of Zhou
summary: After years of negotiation, the daughter of Mukan Khagan married Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, sealing a Zhou–Turkic alliance.
summary_zh: 木杆可汗之女阿史那氏嫁北周武帝，周与突厥结盟。

title: Emperor Wu of Zhou kills Yuwen Hu
summary: Emperor Wu struck down the overbearing regent Yuwen Hu with a jade tablet in the palace, taking personal rule.
summary_zh: 周武帝于宫中以玉笏击杀专权十余年的宇文护，开始亲政。

title: Wu Mingche's northern expedition
summary: Chen general Wu Mingche took Northern Qi's lands between the Huai and Yangtze, capturing Shouyang by damming the Fei River.
summary_zh: 陈将吴明彻北伐，堰肥水灌寿阳，尽复淮南之地。

title: Prince of Lanling forced to suicide
summary: Gao Changgong, hero of Mangshan, was sent poisoned wine by the suspicious Gao Wei.
summary_zh: 邙山之战英雄兰陵王高长恭遭后主高纬猜忌，被赐毒酒而死。

title: Emperor Wu of Zhou bans Buddhism and Daoism
summary: Northern Zhou closes monasteries, returns monks and nuns to lay life and takes temple wealth for the state.
summary_zh: 北周关闭寺观，令僧尼道士还俗，没收寺院财产充实国库。

title: Zhiyi enters Mount Tiantai
summary: Zhiyi withdrew to Mount Tiantai to meditate and systematize doctrine, founding the Tiantai school, the first indigenous Chinese Buddhist school.
summary_zh: 智顗入天台山修禅讲学，创立天台宗，为中国最早创立的佛教宗派。

title: Battle of Pingyang
summary: Emperor Wu of Zhou took Pingyang and defeated Gao Wei's relief army, opening the way to Jinyang and Ye.
summary_zh: 周武帝攻克平阳，大败北齐后主援军，进而攻取晋阳、邺城。

title: Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi
summary: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou took Ye and reunited the north for the first time since 534.
summary_zh: 北周武帝攻克邺城，自534年以来北方首次重新统一。

title: Wu Mingche captured at Lüliang
summary: Besieging Pengcheng, Wu Mingche was trapped when Zhou forces blocked the Si River behind him; his army was destroyed.
summary_zh: 吴明彻围彭城，北周王轨断其归路于吕梁，陈军覆没，吴明彻被俘。

title: Yuchi Jiong rises against Yang Jian
summary: When Yang Jian seized the regency, Yuchi Jiong rebelled at Ye; Wei Xiaokuan crushed him in 68 days and Ye was razed.
summary_zh: 杨坚辅政，尉迟迥起兵于邺城，韦孝宽六十八日平之，邺城被焚毁。

title: Yang Jian founds the Sui
summary: The Northern Zhou regent takes the throne as Emperor Wen and builds a new capital, Daxing.
summary_zh: 北周的辅政大臣杨坚登基称帝，是为隋文帝，随后营建新都大兴城。

title: The Kaihuang Code
summary: Emperor Wen issued a new law code that cut the number of capital crimes and banned the cruellest punishments. It became the model for the Tang Code.
summary_zh: 隋文帝颁布新法典，大幅减少死罪，废除了最残酷的刑罚。它后来成为《唐律》的蓝本。

title: Building of the new capital Daxing
summary: The architect Yuwen Kai laid out a huge new capital in a strict grid of walled wards. As Tang Chang'an it became the largest city in the world.
summary_zh: 建筑家宇文恺规划了一座规模空前的新都，城内街坊整齐如棋盘。它就是后来的唐长安城，当时世界上最大的城市。

title: Chen Shubao becomes emperor
summary: Chen Shubao survived a stabbing by his brother to take the throne; his reign of palaces and court poetry became a byword for decadence.
summary_zh: 陈叔宝遭其弟刺伤后即位，大建临春、结绮、望仙三阁，耽于诗酒，荒废政事。

title: The Turkic Khaganate splits in two
summary: Sui armies beat back a Turkic invasion while Sui envoys stirred up rivalry among the khans. The steppe empire broke into Eastern and Western khaganates.
summary_zh: 隋军击退突厥入侵，同时派使者挑拨各位可汗之间的矛盾。突厥汗国从此分裂为东、西两部。

title: Sui abolishes the commanderies
summary: Emperor Wen abolished the commandery tier, simplifying local government to prefectures and counties and cutting redundant officials.
summary_zh: 隋文帝采纳杨尚希建议，罢天下诸郡，实行州县两级制，精简冗官。

title: Sui defeats Ishbara at Baidao
summary: Sui forces under Yang Shuang defeated Ishbara Qaghan at Baidao, contributing to the Turkic split engineered by Zhangsun Sheng.
summary_zh: 隋将杨爽于白道大败沙钵略可汗，配合长孙晟离间之策，突厥由盛转衰。

title: The Guangtong Canal is dug
summary: Yuwen Kai cut a canal of about 300 li beside the Wei River from the capital to Tong Pass, so grain boats could avoid the shallow, winding river.
summary_zh: 宇文恺沿渭河开凿了一条约三百里的运河，从都城直通潼关，运粮船从此不必走浅而弯曲的渭河。

title: Household census and tax registers
summary: Sui checked every household face-to-face against registers and Gao Jiong set standard tax schedules, bringing 1.6 million people onto the rolls.
summary_zh: 隋行大索貌阅，按户核对年貌，高颎制输籍之法，新增户口一百六十余万。

title: Sui abolishes Western Liang
summary: Sui summoned the last Western Liang ruler Xiao Cong to court and annexed Jiangling, ending the Liang line.
summary_zh: 隋召后梁主萧琮入朝，废其国，江陵归隋。

title: Sui conquers Chen and reunifies China
summary: Sui armies cross the Yangtze and take the southern capital Jiankang, ending almost 300 years of division between north and south.
summary_zh: 隋军渡过长江，攻下南朝都城建康，结束了南北近三百年的分裂。

title: Jiangnan revolts against Sui
summary: Southern magnates rose across the former Chen lands, angered by new laws; Yang Su crushed them and Yang Guang was posted to Yangzhou.
summary_zh: 江南豪族因不满隋政纷纷起兵，杨素率军讨平，晋王杨广出镇扬州安抚。

title: Soldiers registered as farmers
summary: An edict placed soldiers' households on ordinary county registers and gave them land, merging military and civilian administration.
summary_zh: 隋文帝诏令军人悉属州县，垦田籍帐与民同，府兵制向兵农合一转变。

title: Renshou Palace built
summary: Yang Su built the lavish Renshou summer palace at the cost of thousands of laborers' lives, later Tang's Jiucheng Palace.
summary_zh: 杨素督建仁寿宫，役夫死者以万计，唐时改为九成宫。

title: Li Chun builds the Zhaozhou Bridge
summary: The craftsman Li Chun built a stone bridge with one long, flat arch and small open arches in its shoulders. It still stands, the oldest bridge of its kind in the world.
summary_zh: 工匠李春主持修建了一座单孔石拱桥，拱圈扁平，两肩还各开了两个小拱。它至今屹立，是世界上现存最古老的敞肩石拱桥。

title: First Sui campaign against Goguryeo
summary: After Goguryeo raided Liaoxi, Emperor Wen sent 300,000 men; floods, disease and storms at sea destroyed the expedition.
summary_zh: 高句丽犯辽西，隋文帝发兵三十万征讨，遇雨涝疾疫和海上风暴，死者十之八九。

title: Yami Qaghan becomes a Sui client
place_zh: 大利城（今内蒙古和林格尔）
summary: Sui installed the Turkic prince Yami (Qimin) as khagan, married him to Princess Yicheng and settled his people in the Ordos.
summary_zh: 隋立突利为启民可汗，筑大利城安置其部，以义成公主妻之。

title: Crown prince Yang Yong deposed
summary: Through intrigue with Yang Su and Empress Dugu, Yang Guang had his brother Yang Yong deposed and became crown prince.
summary_zh: 杨广结纳杨素、独孤皇后，构陷太子杨勇，杨勇被废，杨广立为太子。

title: Lu Fayan's Qieyun rhyme dictionary
summary: Lu Fayan compiled the Qieyun, a rhyme dictionary that became the standard for Middle Chinese pronunciation and examination poetry.
summary_zh: 陆法言编成《切韵》，成为中古汉语音韵标准和后世韵书之祖。

title: Liu Fang ends the Early Lý state
summary: Sui general Liu Fang forced the submission of Lý Phật Tử, restoring Chinese rule over the Red River delta.
summary_zh: 隋将刘方南征，迫使李佛子投降，交州重归中原王朝统治。

title: Emperor Yang comes to the throne
summary: Yang Guang, who had pushed his elder brother aside as heir, succeeded his father. He launched vast projects at once: a new eastern capital, canals and palaces.
summary_zh: 此前已经取代兄长成为太子的杨广继承皇位。他一上台就大兴土木：营建东都、开凿运河、修建宫殿。

title: Yang Liang revolts at Bingzhou
summary: Emperor Yang's brother Yang Liang rebelled at Bingzhou on their father's death; Yang Su defeated him within months.
summary_zh: 炀帝即位，其弟汉王杨谅据并州起兵，杨素讨平之。

title: Building of the Grand Canal begins
summary: Emperor Yang orders the Tongji Canal, linking the Yellow River to the Huai and on to the Yangtze. The canal carried southern grain north for centuries.
summary_zh: 隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，把黄河、淮河与长江连通起来。此后几百年里，南方的粮食都靠这条运河运往北方。

title: Imperial examinations begin
summary: Sui starts recruiting officials by written examination, a system that lasts until 1905.
summary_zh: 隋朝开始用笔试选拔官员。这套科举制度一直延续到1905年。

title: Building the Eastern Capital at Luoyang
summary: Emperor Yang had Yang Su and Yuwen Kai build a new Luoyang, employing two million laborers monthly and moving wealthy households there.
summary_zh: 炀帝命杨素、宇文恺营建东都，每月役丁二百万，徙天下富商大贾充实之。

title: Liu Fang invades Champa
summary: Liu Fang sacked the Cham capital and carried off its golden tablets, but most of his army died of disease on the return.
summary_zh: 刘方攻破林邑国都，掠其金人庙主而还，士卒多死于瘴疫，刘方亦病卒。

title: Japanese envoy Ono no Imoko
summary: Prince Shōtoku's envoy brought a letter from 'the Son of Heaven where the sun rises', annoying Emperor Yang; Pei Shiqing was sent back with him.
summary_zh: 圣德太子遣小野妹子使隋，国书称“日出处天子”，炀帝不悦，仍遣裴世清回访。

title: Pei Ju's Illustrated Record of the Western Regions
summary: Overseeing trade at Zhangye, Pei Ju interviewed merchants and wrote a record of 44 states and three routes to the West, spurring Emperor Yang's ambitions.
summary_zh: 裴矩在张掖主持互市，访问胡商，撰《西域图记》，记四十四国及通西海三道。

title: Yongji Canal dug to Zhuojun
summary: Over a million men and women dug the Yongji Canal from the Yellow River to Zhuojun, the supply line for the Goguryeo wars.
summary_zh: 征发河北民夫百余万开永济渠，引沁水南达黄河、北通涿郡，为征高句丽转运。

title: Sui conquers the Tuyuhun
summary: Emperor Yang's campaign drove Tuyuhun ruler Murong Fuyun away and set up four commanderies around Qinghai and the Tarim fringe.
summary_zh: 炀帝亲征吐谷浑，伏允败逃，隋于其地置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡。

title: Emperor Yang receives envoys at Zhangye
summary: After defeating the Tuyuhun, Emperor Yang crossed the Qilian Mountains to Zhangye. Rulers and envoys from many Western Regions states came to meet him.
summary_zh: 隋炀帝击败吐谷浑后，翻越祁连山来到张掖，西域许多国家的君主和使者前来朝见。

title: Chen Leng's expedition to Liuqiu
summary: Chen Leng and Zhang Zhenzhou sailed from Yi'an with 10,000 men to Liuqiu, probably Taiwan, and returned with thousands of captives.
summary_zh: 陈稜、张镇周率兵万余自义安浮海击流求，掳数千人而还，流求一般认为即台湾。

title: Grand spectacle for foreign envoys
summary: To impress foreign envoys Emperor Yang staged a month of performances in Luoyang, wrapped trees in silk and let foreigners dine free.
summary_zh: 炀帝于东都端门街盛陈百戏一月，以缯帛缠树，令胡商饮食不取值以夸富。

title: Uprisings against the Sui begin
summary: Wang Bo led farmers who refused to be sent to die in Korea. Within a few years rebel armies were active across the empire.
summary_zh: 王薄率领不愿被征去辽东送死的农民起事。短短几年间，各地起义军遍布全国。

title: Failed invasion of Goguryeo, Battle of Salsu
summary: A huge Sui army is destroyed by the Goguryeo general Eulji Mundeok. Repeated failed campaigns drained the empire and fed the revolts that ended it.
summary_zh: 隋朝大军被高句丽名将乙支文德击溃。一次次失败的远征耗尽了国力，引发了最终推翻隋朝的民变。

title: Yang Xuangan's rebellion
summary: During the second Korean campaign, the noble in charge of army supplies rebelled and besieged Luoyang. He was crushed within two months.
summary_zh: 隋军第二次征讨高句丽期间，负责督运粮草的贵族杨玄感起兵反隋，围攻洛阳，两个月内即告失败。

title: Third campaign against Goguryeo
summary: Despite rebellions at home, Emperor Yang launched a third invasion; an exhausted Goguryeo sent the defector Hu Sizheng back to buy peace.
summary_zh: 国内民变蜂起，炀帝仍三征高句丽，高句丽遣使请降并送还叛臣斛斯政，隋军罢兵。

title: Siege of Yanmen
summary: The Eastern Turkic khan trapped Emperor Yang in a frontier town for about a month. The emperor escaped, but his prestige never recovered.
summary_zh: 东突厥可汗把巡视北边的隋炀帝围困在雁门约一个月。炀帝虽然脱险，威望却一落千丈。

title: Emperor Yang retreats to Jiangdu
summary: Ignoring pleas to stay in the north, Emperor Yang left for Jiangdu, abandoning the heartland to rebels; he never returned.
summary_zh: 炀帝不顾谏阻第三次南巡江都，北方局势失控，此后再未北返。

title: Li Mi seizes Luokou Granary
summary: Leading the Wagang army, Li Mi took the vast Luokou granary, opened it to the hungry and issued a manifesto against Emperor Yang.
summary_zh: 李密率瓦岗军攻占洛口仓，开仓赈民，众至数十万，发布讨炀帝檄文。

title: Li Yuan captures Chang'an
summary: Li Yuan's army crossed the Yellow River and took the Sui capital, enthroning Yang You as puppet emperor while Li ruled as regent.
summary_zh: 李渊率军渡河入关，攻克大兴城，立代王杨侑为帝，遥尊炀帝为太上皇。

title: Li Yuan rises at Taiyuan
summary: The Sui commander at Taiyuan raised an army, marched west and took Chang'an before the year was out.
summary_zh: 镇守太原的隋朝大将李渊起兵，向西进军，当年就攻入长安。

title: Dou Jiande proclaims himself king
summary: The Hebei rebel leader Dou Jiande, known for treating captives well, declared himself King of Changle at Leshou.
summary_zh: 河北义军领袖窦建德在乐寿自称长乐王，礼遇降人，势力大增。

title: Li Yuan founds the Tang dynasty
summary: After Emperor Yang is killed at Jiangdu, the Sui general Li Yuan proclaims himself Emperor Gaozu of Tang at Chang'an.
summary_zh: 隋炀帝在江都被杀后，隋朝大将李渊在长安称帝，是为唐高祖。

title: Li Shimin defeats Xue Rengao at Qianshuiyuan
summary: Li Shimin crushed the Qin regime of Xue Rengao, securing the northwest flank of the new Tang state.
summary_zh: 李世民在浅水原大破薛仁杲，平定陇右西秦政权，稳固唐朝西北后方。

title: Battle of Hulao crushes Dou Jiande
summary: Li Shimin defeated Dou Jiande's relief army at Hulao, then forced Wang Shichong to surrender, winning the Central Plains in one stroke.
summary_zh: 李世民于虎牢关大破窦建德援军，王世充随即投降，一举平定中原。

title: Kaiyuan Tongbao coin introduced
summary: The Tang abolished Sui wuzhu coins and issued the Kaiyuan Tongbao, a standard coin imitated across East Asia for centuries.
summary_zh: 唐废五铢钱，铸行开元通宝，成为此后千余年钱币的范式。

title: Li Xiaogong conquers Xiao Xian's Liang
summary: Li Xiaogong and Li Jing sailed down the Yangtze and took Jiangling; Xiao Xian surrendered, bringing the middle Yangtze under Tang rule.
summary_zh: 李孝恭、李靖顺江东下攻克江陵，萧铣出降，荆湘之地归唐。

title: Liu Heita's Hebei revolt crushed
summary: Dou Jiande's old general Liu Heita twice raised Hebei against Tang; Crown Prince Li Jiancheng finally destroyed him in early 623.
summary_zh: 窦建德旧将刘黑闼两度起兵河北，终为太子李建成所平，被擒处死。

title: Equal-field and zuyongdiao laws promulgated
summary: The Wude laws fixed land allotments per adult male and the grain, cloth and labour dues of the zuyongdiao tax system.
summary_zh: 武德七年颁布均田令和租庸调法，按丁授田，征收租、调与力役。

title: Fu Gongshi's Song state destroyed
summary: Fu Gongshi rebelled and declared the state of Song; Li Xiaogong and Li Jing crushed it, completing Tang control of the lower Yangtze.
summary_zh: 辅公祏据丹阳称帝，国号宋，被李孝恭、李靖讨平，江南悉定。

title: Xuanwu Gate Incident
summary: Li Shimin kills his brothers at the palace gate and is soon made emperor. As Taizong he presides over the Zhenguan era, remembered as a model of good government.
summary_zh: 李世民在宫门前杀死两个兄弟，不久登上皇位。他就是唐太宗，他统治的贞观年间被后世视为政治清明的典范。

title: Reign of Zhenguan begins
summary: Taizong's Zhenguan reign, with ministers like Wei Zheng and Fang Xuanling, became the model of frugal, remonstrance-friendly government.
summary_zh: 太宗改元贞观，任用房玄龄、杜如晦、魏征等，虚心纳谏，史称贞观之治。

title: Liang Shidu falls, unification completed
summary: The last Sui-era warlord, Turkic-backed Liang Shidu, was killed by his cousin as Tang troops besieged Shuofang.
summary_zh: 唐军围朔方，梁师都为其从弟所杀，隋末群雄至此全部平定。

title: Xuanzang sets out for India
summary: The monk Xuanzang leaves Chang'an on a 16-year journey through Central Asia to India, returning with hundreds of Buddhist texts. His travel record later inspired Journey to the West.
summary_zh: 玄奘从长安出发，经中亚前往印度，历时十六年，带回数百部佛经。他的西行经历后来成为《西游记》的灵感来源。

title: Tang defeats the Eastern Turks
summary: Li Jing's campaign captures the Illig Qaghan. Steppe chiefs hail Taizong as the Heavenly Qaghan, and Tang power opens toward the west.
summary_zh: 李靖出兵俘获颉利可汗。草原各部尊唐太宗为“天可汗”，唐朝的势力由此向西扩展。

title: Li Jing's campaign against Tuyuhun
summary: Li Jing led armies deep into the Qinghai highlands, routing Tuyuhun and turning it into a Tang client.
summary_zh: 李靖率军深入青海高原大破吐谷浑，伏允可汗败死，吐谷浑归附。

title: Christian monk Alopen arrives in Chang'an
summary: The Church of the East missionary Alopen reached Chang'an, and Taizong allowed a monastery to be built three years later.
summary_zh: 景教僧阿罗本抵长安，三年后太宗诏准建寺传教。

title: Tang repels Tibet at Songzhou
summary: Songtsen Gampo attacked Songzhou after being refused a princess; a Tang night raid drove him off, opening the way to marriage alliance.
summary_zh: 松赞干布求婚未遂进攻松州，唐军夜袭败之，吐蕃遣使谢罪请婚。

title: Tang conquers Gaochang and sets up the Anxi Protectorate
title_zh: 唐灭高昌 · 设安西都护府
summary: Taizong annexes the oasis kingdom of Gaochang. The Anxi Protectorate later moves to Kucha and oversees the Four Garrisons of the Tarim Basin.
summary_zh: 唐太宗吞并绿洲王国高昌。安西都护府后来移驻龟兹，统辖塔里木盆地的安西四镇。

title: Princess Wencheng goes to Tibet
summary: A Tang princess marries the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo, a marriage alliance later credited with bringing Chinese Buddhism and crafts to Tibet.
summary_zh: 唐朝公主嫁给吐蕃赞普松赞干布。后人认为这次和亲把汉地佛教和各种工艺带到了吐蕃。

title: Li Ji defeats Xueyantuo at Nuozhen River
summary: Xueyantuo invaded the Ordos to strike the resettled Turks; Li Ji defeated its cavalry at the Nuozhen River.
summary_zh: 薛延陀南侵突厥降部，李勣在诺真水大破其军。

title: Death of remonstrator Wei Zheng
summary: Taizong mourned that with Wei Zheng gone he had lost a mirror by which to see his own faults.
summary_zh: 魏征病逝，太宗叹“以人为镜，可以明得失”，今亡一镜矣。

title: Taizong fails at Siege of Ansi
summary: Taizong's Goguryeo campaign took many Liaodong forts but stalled before Ansi; with winter coming he withdrew.
summary_zh: 太宗亲征高句丽，连下辽东诸城，然久攻安市不克，天寒班师。

title: Tang destroys Xueyantuo Khaganate
summary: Tang forces destroyed Xueyantuo; the Tiele tribes submitted and Tang set up the Yanran Protectorate over the steppe.
summary_zh: 唐军灭薛延陀，铁勒诸部归附，唐于漠北设燕然都护府。

title: Wang Xuance raises an army in India
summary: Attacked by a usurper in northern India, envoy Wang Xuance gathered Tibetan and Nepali troops, defeated him and brought him captive to Chang'an.
summary_zh: 使臣王玄策在天竺遇劫，借吐蕃、泥婆罗兵击败阿罗那顺并俘归长安。

title: Tang conquers Kucha
summary: Ashina She'er captured Kucha; the Anxi Protectorate was later moved there, anchoring the Four Garrisons.
summary_zh: 阿史那社尔攻破龟兹，安西都护府后移治于此，形成安西四镇。

title: The Tang Code and its commentary
summary: Emperor Gaozong issued the Tang law code together with an official commentary. It is the oldest Chinese code that survives complete.
summary_zh: 唐高宗颁行唐律及其官方注释。这是现存最早的完整中国法典。

title: Wu Zhao becomes empress
summary: Emperor Gaozong deposed Empress Wang and raised his consort Wu to empress, overriding his senior ministers.
summary_zh: 唐高宗不顾元老重臣反对，废黜王皇后，立武昭仪为皇后。

title: Su Dingfang destroys the Western Turks
summary: Su Dingfang routed Ashina Helu; the Western Turkic Khaganate collapsed and Tang protectorates extended toward Central Asia.
summary_zh: 苏定方大破阿史那贺鲁，西突厥灭亡，唐势力远及中亚。

title: Newly Revised Materia Medica completed
summary: Su Jing's team compiled the illustrated Xinxiu Bencao, regarded as the world's first state-issued pharmacopoeia.
summary_zh: 苏敬等奉敕编成《新修本草》，被视为世界上第一部官修药典。

title: Zhangsun Wuji forced to suicide
summary: Accused of treason by Xu Jingzong at Empress Wu's urging, the senior statesman was exiled and driven to suicide.
summary_zh: 武后授意许敬宗诬告长孙无忌谋反，流放黔州后被逼自缢。

title: Tang and Silla conquer Baekje
summary: Su Dingfang crossed the Yellow Sea and, with Silla, captured King Uija, ending Baekje.
summary_zh: 苏定方渡海与新罗夹攻，俘百济义慈王，百济灭亡。

title: Xue Rengui's three arrows at Tianshan
summary: Xue Rengui reportedly shot three Tiele champions dead, demoralising their army and subduing the tribes.
summary_zh: 薛仁贵连发三箭射杀铁勒骁将，敌军丧气降服，军中歌之。

title: Battle of Baekgang
place_zh: 白江口（今韩国锦江入海口）
summary: Tang and Silla fleets destroy a Japanese and Baekje force. Japan withdraws from the peninsula, and Goguryeo falls five years later in 668.
summary_zh: 唐朝和新罗的水军大败倭国与百济联军。日本从此退出朝鲜半岛，五年后的668年高句丽也被灭亡。

title: Shangguan Yi executed after deposition plot
summary: Shangguan Yi drafted an edict to depose Empress Wu; she discovered it and had him executed.
summary_zh: 上官仪为高宗草废后诏，事泄，被武后诬陷下狱处死。

title: Death of Xuanzang
summary: Xuanzang died after translating 75 works, including the vast Mahaprajnaparamita Sutra.
summary_zh: 玄奘于玉华寺圆寂，一生译经七十五部一千三百余卷。

title: Tang and Silla destroy Goguryeo
summary: After decades of war, Tang and Silla armies took the Goguryeo capital and captured its king. Tang set up a protectorate at Pyongyang.
summary_zh: 经过几十年战争，唐朝与新罗联军攻下高句丽都城，俘虏其国王。唐朝在平壤设立安东都护府。

title: Tibet routs Xue Rengui at Dafeichuan
summary: Gar Qinling's Tibetans annihilated a Tang army; Tuyuhun was lost and Tang briefly abandoned the Four Garrisons.
summary_zh: 吐蕃论钦陵大败薛仁贵，唐军覆没，吐谷浑亡于吐蕃。

title: Silla–Tang War
summary: Silla turned on its ally and drove Tang from the peninsula; the Andong Protectorate retreated to Liaodong.
summary_zh: 新罗反唐争夺百济、高句丽故地，唐军退出朝鲜半岛，安东都护府内迁。

title: The great Vairocana Buddha at Longmen
summary: A 17-metre Buddha was carved into the cliff at Longmen under imperial patronage. Empress Wu gave money from her own allowance.
summary_zh: 龙门山崖上雕成一尊高约17米的大佛，由皇家出资修建，武后还捐出了自己的脂粉钱。

title: Huineng ordained, Southern Chan rises
summary: Huineng, Sixth Patriarch of Chan, was ordained at Guangzhou and began teaching sudden enlightenment.
summary_zh: 六祖慧能于广州法性寺剃度，此后在曹溪弘扬顿悟禅法。

title: Pei Xingjian captures Ashina Duzhi
place_zh: 碎叶（今吉尔吉斯托克马克）
summary: Escorting a Persian prince, Pei Xingjian seized the rebel Turk Ashina Duzhi by ruse and built Suyab as a Tang garrison.
summary_zh: 裴行俭以护送波斯王子为名，计擒阿史那都支，设碎叶镇。

title: Eastern Turks revive under Ilterish
summary: Ashina Qutlugh (Ilterish Qaghan) rebelled against Tang, re-founding the Turkic khaganate that raided north China for decades.
summary_zh: 阿史那骨咄禄起兵反唐，重建突厥汗国，长期侵扰北边。

title: Li Jingye rises against Wu at Yangzhou
summary: Li Jingye raised troops to restore Zhongzong, with Luo Binwang's famous manifesto, but was crushed within three months.
summary_zh: 李敬业据扬州起兵讨武，骆宾王作檄文，三月而败。

title: Bronze petition boxes and cruel officials
summary: Wu Zetian invited denunciations through bronze boxes, empowering cruel officials such as Lai Junchen and Zhou Xing.
summary_zh: 武后置铜匦受密告，任用来俊臣、周兴等酷吏罗织大狱。

title: Tang princes' revolt against Wu
summary: Li Zhen and his son rose to restore the Li house but were defeated within weeks; Wu then purged many Tang princes.
summary_zh: 越王李贞父子起兵反武，旋即失败，李唐宗室遭大规模诛杀。

title: Wu Zetian proclaims her own Zhou dynasty
summary: The only woman to rule China in her own name moves the court to Luoyang and reigns until 705, when the Tang name is restored.
summary_zh: 中国历史上唯一以自己名义称帝的女性，把朝廷迁到洛阳，一直统治到705年唐朝国号恢复。

title: Khitan revolt of Li Jinzhong
summary: Khitan chiefs Li Jinzhong and Sun Wanrong revolted, crushing Zhou armies before Turkic intervention ended the rising.
summary_zh: 契丹李尽忠、孙万荣起兵攻陷营州，屡败周军，后为突厥袭破。

title: Dae Joyeong founds Bohai (Balhae)
summary: After the Khitan revolt, Dae Joyeong led Mohe and Goguryeo people to found a state later invested by Tang as Bohai.
summary_zh: 大祚荣率靺鞨及高句丽遗民于东牟山建国，后受唐册封为渤海郡王。

title: Beiting Protectorate is founded
summary: A second protectorate governs Dzungaria and the steppe north of the Tianshan.
summary_zh: 唐朝设立第二个都护府，管辖准噶尔盆地和天山以北的草原。

title: Shenlong Coup restores Tang
summary: Zhang Jianzhi and other ministers killed the Zhang brothers and forced Wu Zetian to abdicate; Zhongzong restored the Tang name.
summary_zh: 张柬之等发动政变诛二张，逼武则天退位，中宗复位，恢复唐国号。

title: Zhang Renyuan builds Shouxiang forts
place_zh: 三受降城（今内蒙古河套）
summary: Zhang Renyuan built three fortresses north of the Yellow River loop, pushing the frontier against the Turks.
summary_zh: 张仁愿于黄河以北筑东、中、西三受降城，拓地三百余里。

title: Li Longji kills Empress Wei
summary: After Zhongzong's sudden death, Li Longji and Princess Taiping slaughtered Empress Wei's faction and enthroned Ruizong.
summary_zh: 中宗暴崩，李隆基与太平公主起兵诛韦后、安乐公主，拥立睿宗。

title: Princess Jincheng married to Tibet
summary: Princess Jincheng was sent to marry the Tibetan ruler, renewing marriage ties after Wencheng.
summary_zh: 金城公主远嫁吐蕃赞普，延续唐蕃和亲。

title: First jiedushi appointed in Hexi
summary: He Ba Yansi became Hexi military governor, the first formal jiedushi command that later grew into regional warlordism.
summary_zh: 贺拔延嗣任河西节度使，节度使从此正式成为常设官职。

title: Xuanzong's Kaiyuan era begins
summary: The high point of Tang prosperity: the age of the poets Li Bai and Du Fu, and of Chang'an as the largest city in the world.
summary_zh: 唐朝繁荣的顶峰：这是李白、杜甫的时代，长安也是当时世界上最大的城市。

title: Xuanzong eliminates Princess Taiping
summary: Xuanzong struck first against his aunt's faction; Princess Taiping was ordered to commit suicide, leaving him sole ruler.
summary_zh: 玄宗先发制人诛太平公主党羽，公主赐死，玄宗独掌大权。

title: Yao Chong's anti-locust campaign
summary: Against objections that locusts were heaven's punishment, Yao Chong had them burned and buried, saving the harvest.
summary_zh: 山东蝗灾，姚崇力排“天灾不可除”之议，令焚瘗灭蝗。

title: Abe no Nakamaro arrives with Japanese mission
summary: Abe no Nakamaro came with the embassy to study, passed the examinations and served the Tang court for life.
summary_zh: 日本留学生阿倍仲麻吕随遣唐使入唐，后中进士，终身仕唐。

title: Recruited guards replace fubing levies
summary: On Zhang Yue's proposal, paid volunteers replaced the decaying fubing rotation for palace guards, marking the shift to a professional army.
summary_zh: 张说建议募兵宿卫，后称彍骑，府兵制逐渐被募兵制取代。

title: Yixing's survey of the meridian
summary: The monk Yixing had the noon shadow measured at stations from Vietnam to Mongolia, and worked out the length of a degree of latitude.
summary_zh: 僧人一行组织人员在从越南到蒙古的多个地点测量正午日影，推算出子午线上一度的长度。

title: Yuwen Rong registers vagrant households
summary: Yuwen Rong's campaign re-registered some 800,000 runaway households, boosting state revenue.
summary_zh: 宇文融主持检括逃户，得户八十余万，增收赋税。

title: Dayan calendar adopted
summary: Yixing's Dayan calendar, based on new observations, was promulgated and influenced calendars in China and Japan.
summary_zh: 僧一行所编《大衍历》颁行，体例为后世历法所沿用。

title: Zhang Jiuling dismissed; Li Linfu dominates
summary: Xuanzong dismissed the upright Zhang Jiuling; Li Linfu held power for 16 years, often seen as the turn toward decline.
summary_zh: 张九龄罢相，李林甫专权十六年，开元政治由盛转衰。

title: Piluoge unifies Nanzhao
summary: With Tang backing, Piluoge united the six zhao of Erhai and was invested Prince of Yunnan.
summary_zh: 皮逻阁在唐支持下统一洱海六诏，受封云南王。

title: Ten frontier commands under jiedushi
summary: By 742 almost half a million professional soldiers served in ten frontier commands, far more than guarded the capital. Their generals held vast power.
summary_zh: 到742年，近五十万职业兵驻守在十个边防军镇，远远超过京城的兵力，统兵的节度使手握重权。

title: Li Bai and Du Fu meet
summary: The two greatest Tang poets met after Li Bai left the court, and travelled together for a time. Du Fu wrote about his friend for the rest of his life.
summary_zh: 李白离开朝廷后，与杜甫在洛阳相遇，两人结伴同游了一段时间。此后杜甫一生都在写诗怀念这位朋友。

title: Uyghur Khaganate founded
summary: Uyghurs destroyed the Second Turkic Khaganate and founded their own empire; Tang invested Kutlug Bilge as khagan.
summary_zh: 回纥灭后突厥，建立汗国，唐册封骨力裴罗为怀仁可汗。

title: Gao Xianzhi crosses the Pamirs
place_zh: 小勃律（今巴基斯坦吉尔吉特）
summary: Gao Xianzhi led 10,000 men over the Pamirs and Darkot Pass to subdue Little Balur and cut Tibet's link to the west.
summary_zh: 高仙芝率万人翻越葱岭，攻破小勃律，切断吐蕃与大食联系。

title: Geshu Han storms Shibao Fortress
summary: Geshu Han took the Tibetan stronghold at a cost of tens of thousands of lives, a costly victory criticised by poets.
summary_zh: 哥舒翰攻克吐蕃石堡城，士卒死者数万。

title: Battle of Talas
place_zh: 怛罗斯河（今哈萨克斯坦与吉尔吉斯斯坦交界）
summary: Gao Xianzhi's army is defeated by the Abbasid Caliphate. Tang expansion into Central Asia stops here.
summary_zh: 高仙芝率领的唐军被阿拔斯王朝击败，唐朝在中亚的扩张就此止步。

title: Tianbao War: Tang defeated by Nanzhao
summary: Two Tang expeditions against Nanzhao were annihilated, costing some 200,000 men and pushing Nanzhao into alliance with Tibet.
summary_zh: 唐两次征南诏全军覆没，丧师近二十万，南诏转附吐蕃。

title: Jianzhen sails for Japan
summary: On his sixth attempt, the blind monk Jianzhen reached Japan, where he ordained the retired emperor and founded Tōshōdai-ji in Nara.
summary_zh: 第六次东渡时，已经双目失明的鉴真终于抵达日本。他为太上天皇授戒，并在奈良创建了唐招提寺。

title: An Lushan rebellion breaks out
summary: The frontier general An Lushan marches south from Fanyang and takes both capitals. Eight years of war follow, and the dynasty never fully recovers.
summary_zh: 边将安禄山从范阳起兵南下，攻占东西两京。此后八年战乱不断，唐朝再也没有完全恢复元气。

title: An Lushan takes Luoyang
summary: About a month after the revolt began, rebel cavalry crossed the Yellow River and took the eastern capital. An Lushan soon proclaimed himself emperor of Yan.
summary_zh: 叛乱爆发约一个月后，叛军骑兵渡过黄河，攻陷东都洛阳。不久，安禄山在此称帝，国号大燕。

title: Mawei Incident: death of Yang Guifei
summary: Fleeing Chang'an, Xuanzong's guards demand the death of his consort Yang Guifei. Bai Juyi later retold the story in the Song of Everlasting Regret.
summary_zh: 唐玄宗逃离长安途中，护驾的禁军要求处死杨贵妃。后来白居易在《长恨歌》中重述了这段故事。

title: Tong Pass falls
summary: Ordered out of his strong position, Geshu Han's army was ambushed and destroyed. The road to Chang'an lay open.
summary_zh: 哥舒翰被迫放弃坚守、出关迎战，结果中伏全军覆没，通往长安的门户就此洞开。

title: Suzong takes the throne at Lingwu
summary: The crown prince split from his fleeing father, went north to Lingwu and declared himself emperor, rallying the loyal armies.
summary_zh: 太子与出逃的父亲分道扬镳，北上灵武自行即位，号召各路忠于唐室的军队。

title: Yan Gaoqing resists at Changshan
summary: Yan Gaoqing rallied Hebei against An Lushan but was captured and killed cursing the rebel.
summary_zh: 颜杲卿起兵常山抗安禄山，城破被俘，骂贼而死。

title: Zhang Xun defends Yongqiu
summary: Zhang Xun held Yongqiu against rebel attacks for months with tricks such as straw-man arrows before moving to Suiyang.
summary_zh: 张巡坚守雍丘，以草人借箭等计屡挫叛军。

title: Siege of Suiyang
summary: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang for most of a year against a much larger rebel army, keeping the rebels out of the rich Huai and Yangtze lands.
summary_zh: 张巡、许远以少量兵力死守睢阳近一年，抵挡了数倍于己的叛军，使江淮富庶之地免遭蹂躏。

title: Tang recaptures Chang'an
summary: Guo Ziyi's army, with Uyghur cavalry, beat the rebels south of the city and retook Chang'an, then Luoyang weeks later.
summary_zh: 郭子仪率军在回纥骑兵协助下，于长安城南击败叛军，收复长安，几周后又收复洛阳。

title: Prince Yong's revolt in the Yangtze
summary: Li Lin led his fleet down the Yangtze against Suzong's orders and was destroyed; Li Bai, on his staff, was exiled.
summary_zh: 永王李璘擅引舟师东下，被肃宗讨灭，李白受牵连流放夜郎。

title: Diwu Qi introduces salt monopoly
summary: To fund the war, Diwu Qi made salt a state monopoly, which soon provided half of Tang revenue.
summary_zh: 第五琦推行榷盐法，盐利后来占唐财政收入一半。

title: Nine armies routed at Yecheng
summary: Nine Tang armies without a supreme commander besieged An Qingxu but were scattered by Shi Siming's relief force and a sandstorm.
summary_zh: 九节度使围邺城，不设统帅，史思明援军至，又遇大风，唐军溃散。

title: Du Fu writes the 'Three Officials'
summary: After Yecheng, Du Fu recorded conscription and suffering in poems such as 'The Officer at Shihao'.
summary_zh: 邺城战败后，杜甫写下《石壕吏》等“三吏三别”，记录战乱苦难。

title: Lu Yu writes the Classic of Tea
summary: Lu Yu wrote the first book devoted to tea, on growing, processing and brewing it. Tea drinking spread across China and became a major trade.
summary_zh: 陆羽写成第一部茶学专著，讲述茶的种植、制作和煎煮。饮茶之风随之遍及全国，茶叶也成为重要的商品。

title: Shi Siming killed by his son
summary: After a setback at Shanzhou, Shi Siming threatened his son Shi Chaoyi, who had him strangled.
summary_zh: 史思明攻陕州受挫，欲杀其子史朝义，反被缢杀。

title: Tibetan army occupies Chang'an
summary: With Tang troops pulled east against the rebels, Tibet seizes the capital for about two weeks and then takes the Hexi Corridor in the following decades.
summary_zh: 唐军被调往东方平叛，吐蕃趁虚攻占都城约两周，此后几十年间又夺取了河西走廊。

title: Shi Chaoyi dies; rebellion ends
summary: Abandoned by his generals, Shi Chaoyi hanged himself, ending eight years of rebellion.
summary_zh: 史朝义众叛亲离，自缢于林中，安史之乱结束。

title: Three Hebei garrisons left semi-autonomous
summary: To end the war quickly, Tang left surrendered rebel generals ruling Weibo, Chengde and Lulong, which became hereditary fiefs.
summary_zh: 唐为速平叛乱，以降将统领魏博、成德、卢龙，河朔三镇长期割据。

title: Liu Yan reforms canal grain transport
summary: Liu Yan reorganised Grand Canal shipping in stages, restoring grain supply to Chang'an after the war.
summary_zh: 刘晏整顿漕运，分段转运，江淮粮米重新源源运至关中。

title: Pugu Huai'en rebels
summary: The loyal Tiele general, alienated by eunuch slander, revolted and led Tibetans and Uyghurs toward Chang'an before dying in 765.
summary_zh: 仆固怀恩遭宦官诬陷而叛，引吐蕃、回纥入寇，次年病死。

title: Guo Ziyi rides alone to the Uyghurs
summary: Guo Ziyi went unarmed into the Uyghur camp, won them back to alliance and turned them against Tibet.
summary_zh: 郭子仪单骑入回纥营，说服回纥与唐联合，共破吐蕃。

title: Eunuch Yu Chao'en executed
summary: Daizong and Yuan Zai had the overbearing commander of the Shence Army strangled in the palace.
summary_zh: 代宗与元载密谋，缢杀专横的神策军统帅宦官鱼朝恩。

title: Two-tax system introduced
summary: Yang Yan replaces the equal-field taxes with levies on property, paid twice a year. The reform shapes Chinese taxation for centuries.
summary_zh: 杨炎废除与均田制配套的旧税，改为按财产征税，一年分两次缴纳。这次改革影响了此后数百年的中国税制。

title: The Nestorian Stele is set up
summary: Christians of the Church of the East erected a stone in Chang'an recording their mission's history in China since 635.
summary_zh: 景教（东方教会）信徒在长安立碑，记述了自635年以来景教在中国的传播历程。

title: Hebei and Henan governors revolt
summary: Dezong's attempt to curb hereditary succession set off a war in which four governors declared themselves kings.
summary_zh: 德宗欲削藩，引发成德、魏博、淄青等镇叛乱，四镇称王。

title: Jingyuan mutiny; Dezong flees
summary: Ill-provisioned Jingyuan troops mutinied in Chang'an and enthroned Zhu Ci; Dezong fled to Fengtian.
summary_zh: 泾原军过长安因犒赏菲薄哗变，拥朱泚称帝，德宗出奔奉天。

title: Tang–Tibet treaty of Qingshui
summary: Tang and Tibet fixed a border along the Longshan, effectively recognising Tibetan control of Hexi and Longyou.
summary_zh: 唐蕃清水会盟划定边界，实际承认吐蕃占有河陇。

title: Dezong's edict of self-reproach
summary: Lu Zhi drafted an edict taking the blame on the emperor and pardoning rebels, splitting the rebel coalition.
summary_zh: 陆贽为德宗起草罪己诏，赦免诸叛镇，分化瓦解叛军。

title: Yan Zhenqing killed by Li Xilie
summary: The calligrapher-statesman, sent to persuade Li Xilie, refused to serve him and was strangled.
summary_zh: 颜真卿奉命宣慰李希烈，被扣押不屈，遭缢杀。

title: Dunhuang surrenders to Tibet
summary: After a long siege the oasis city falls to the Tibetan Empire, which holds it for about sixty years.
summary_zh: 经过长期围困，这座绿洲城市落入吐蕃之手，此后被吐蕃统治约六十年。

title: Tibet ambushes treaty at Pingliang
summary: Tibetan troops seized the Tang delegation at a treaty ceremony; Hun Jian barely escaped.
summary_zh: 吐蕃于平凉会盟时伏兵劫持唐使，浑瑊仅以身免。

title: Tang introduces tea tax
summary: Zhang Pang's proposal imposed a one-tenth tax on tea, a sign of tea's spread as a mass commodity.
summary_zh: 采张滂之议，始税茶，十取其一。

title: Nanzhao rejoins Tang at Cangshan
summary: Yimouxun swore allegiance to Tang, attacked Tibet and was re-invested as King of Nanzhao.
summary_zh: 异牟寻与唐使盟于点苍山，归唐攻吐蕃，受封南诏王。

title: Eunuchs formally command Shence Army
summary: Dezong created the posts of Shence commanders for eunuchs, giving them control of the palace army and the throne.
summary_zh: 德宗设护军中尉由宦官充任，宦官掌握禁军，权倾朝廷。

title: Du You completes the Tongdian
summary: Du You's encyclopedic history of institutions from antiquity to the Tang created the genre of zhengshu.
summary_zh: 杜佑撰《通典》二百卷，开创典章制度通史体例。

title: Wei Gao defeats Tibet in Sichuan
summary: Wei Gao's Sichuan army won a string of victories over Tibet, capturing a Tibetan grand minister.
summary_zh: 剑南节度使韦皋大破吐蕃，生擒论莽热。

title: Kūkai and Saichō sail to Tang
summary: Monks Kūkai and Saichō came with the Japanese embassy, taking home esoteric and Tiantai Buddhism.
summary_zh: 空海、最澄随遣唐使入唐求法，归国后分创真言宗、天台宗。

title: Yongzhen Reform of Wang Shuwen
summary: Wang Shuwen and Liu Zongyuan tried to curb eunuchs and abuses; within months eunuchs forced Shunzong to abdicate.
summary_zh: 王叔文等推行改革，抑宦官、罢宫市，半年即失败，“二王八司马”被贬。

title: Han Yu leads Classical Prose Movement
summary: Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan championed plain classical prose over ornate parallelism, reviving Confucian thought.
summary_zh: 韩愈、柳宗元倡导古文，反对骈文，提倡文以载道。

title: Merchants use 'flying cash' drafts
summary: Merchants deposited coin in the capital and drew it in the provinces with certificates, a forerunner of paper money.
summary_zh: 商人在京城交钱领券，到地方凭券取钱，称为“飞钱”。

title: Bai Juyi writes the Song of Everlasting Regret
summary: A young county official, Bai Juyi wrote a long ballad about Xuanzong and Yang Guifei. It became one of the best-loved poems in Chinese.
summary_zh: 年轻的县尉白居易写下长篇叙事诗，讲述唐玄宗和杨贵妃的故事，成为最受喜爱的中国诗歌之一。

title: Xianzong crushes Liu Pi in Sichuan
summary: Gao Chongwen took Chengdu and captured Liu Pi, signalling Xianzong's resolve to tame the provinces.
summary_zh: 高崇文攻克成都擒刘辟，宪宗削藩初见成效。

title: Niu–Li factional strife
summary: Rivalry between Niu Sengru's and Li Deyu's factions paralysed court politics for four decades.
summary_zh: 以牛僧孺、李宗闵与李德裕为首的两派官僚相互倾轧四十年。

title: Li Jifu's Yuanhe geographic gazetteer
summary: Chancellor Li Jifu completed a comprehensive atlas and gazetteer of all Tang prefectures.
summary_zh: 李吉甫撰成《元和郡县图志》，为现存最早的全国性地理总志。

title: Chancellor Wu Yuanheng assassinated
summary: Assassins sent by provincial rebels murdered the chancellor in the street; Bai Juyi was exiled for demanding action.
summary_zh: 藩镇刺客于街头刺杀宰相武元衡，白居易上疏急请缉凶被贬江州。

title: Bai Juyi writes 'Song of the Pipa'
summary: In exile at Jiangzhou, Bai Juyi wrote his famous ballad of a former courtesan pipa player.
summary_zh: 白居易贬江州司马，作《琵琶行》。

title: Li Su takes Caizhou in snowstorm
summary: Li Su marched through a snowy night to seize Caizhou and capture Wu Yuanji, ending Huaixi's 30-year defiance.
summary_zh: 李愬雪夜奇袭蔡州，擒吴元济，平定淮西。

title: Han Yu's memorial on the Buddha's bone
summary: When Emperor Xianzong brought a relic of the Buddha into the palace, Han Yu protested in writing and was exiled to the far south.
summary_zh: 唐宪宗把佛骨舍利迎入宫中供奉，韩愈上表劝谏，结果被贬到遥远的潮州。

title: Pinglu pacified; Li Shidao killed
summary: Li Shidao was killed by his own officer; his circuit was split, completing the Yuanhe restoration.
summary_zh: 淄青李师道为部将所杀，其地一分为三，元和中兴达于顶点。

title: Xianzong murdered by eunuchs
summary: Xianzong, erratic from elixirs, was killed by eunuch Chen Hongzhi; eunuchs thereafter chose most emperors.
summary_zh: 宪宗服丹药暴躁，被宦官陈弘志所杀，此后皇帝多由宦官拥立。

title: Peace treaty between Tang and Tibet
summary: After long wars, Tang and Tibet swore a peace that fixed their border. Its text was carved on a stone pillar that still stands in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 长期交战之后，唐朝与吐蕃会盟立约，划定边界。盟文刻在石碑上，这块碑至今仍立在拉萨。

title: Lulong and Chengde revolt again
summary: Mutinies in Lulong, Chengde and Weibo overturned the Yuanhe settlement; Tian Hongzheng was killed.
summary_zh: 卢龙、成德相继兵变，田弘正遇害，河朔再度失控。

title: The Sweet Dew Incident
summary: Emperor Wenzong's plot to kill the palace eunuchs failed. The eunuchs' troops massacred officials, and the eunuchs controlled the court for decades.
summary_zh: 唐文宗谋诛宦官失败，宦官指挥禁军屠杀朝臣，此后几十年朝政都被宦官把持。

title: Ennin's pilgrimage diary in Tang
summary: The Japanese monk Ennin travelled through Tang China and witnessed the Huichang persecution, recording it in his diary.
summary_zh: 日本僧圆仁入唐求法，亲历会昌毁佛，撰《入唐求法巡礼行记》。

title: Fall of the Uyghur Khaganate
place_zh: 斡耳朵八里（今蒙古国境内）
summary: The Kyrgyz sacked the Uyghur capital on the Orkhon River. The Uyghurs scattered to Gansu, Turpan and the Tang frontier.
summary_zh: 黠戛斯人攻破回鹘位于鄂尔浑河畔的都城，回鹘人四散迁往河西、吐鲁番和唐朝边境。

title: Li Deyu crushes Zhaoyi's Liu Zhen
summary: Li Deyu refused hereditary succession in Zhaoyi and the circuit was retaken, the last major Tang victory over a rebel province.
summary_zh: 李德裕力主讨伐昭义刘稹，平定泽潞。

title: Great Anti-Buddhist Persecution
summary: Emperor Wuzong closes thousands of monasteries and returns hundreds of thousands of monks and nuns to lay life and taxation.
summary_zh: 唐武宗下令拆毁数以千计的寺院，让几十万僧尼还俗、重新纳税。

title: Zhang Yichao retakes Dunhuang
summary: A local leader drives out the Tibetan garrison and pledges loyalty to Tang, founding the semi-independent Guiyi Circuit.
summary_zh: 当地豪强张议潮赶走吐蕃守军，归附唐朝，建立了半独立的归义军。

title: Early gunpowder formula recorded
summary: A Taoist alchemical text warned that mixing saltpetre, sulphur and charcoal caused fires, the earliest gunpowder record.
summary_zh: 道教炼丹书记载硝石、硫黄与木炭混合易燃，是火药的最早记录。

title: Guiyi Army established at Shazhou
summary: After Zhang Yichao presented maps of eleven prefectures, Tang made him military governor of the new Guiyi circuit.
summary_zh: 张议潮献河西十一州图籍，唐设归义军，以其为节度使。

title: Qiu Fu's rising in Zhejiang
summary: Qiu Fu's peasant army seized towns in eastern Zhejiang before Wang Shi suppressed it.
summary_zh: 裘甫在浙东起义，攻占数县，被王式镇压。

title: Nanzhao captures Annam
summary: Nanzhao seized the Protectorate of Annam; Gao Pian retook it in 866.
summary_zh: 南诏攻陷安南都护府治所交趾，866年高骈收复。

title: The Diamond Sutra is printed
summary: The oldest dated printed book that survives, a woodblock scroll later found sealed in the Mogao Caves library cave.
summary_zh: 现存最古老的、带有确切日期的印刷书籍，是一卷雕版印刷的经卷，后来在莫高窟藏经洞中被发现。

title: Pang Xun's Guilin mutiny
summary: Overdue garrison troops at Guilin mutinied and marched home to seize Xuzhou, foreshadowing the Huang Chao rebellion.
summary_zh: 戍守桂林的徐泗士兵逾期不得归，拥庞勋起事，攻占徐州。

title: Yizong welcomes Famen Buddha relic
summary: Yizong lavishly welcomed the Buddha's finger relic; the treasures returned with it were found in the crypt in 1987.
summary_zh: 懿宗盛礼迎法门寺佛骨，所供奉宝物于1987年地宫中出土。

title: Huang Chao rebellion begins
summary: A failed examination candidate and salt smuggler joins a peasant uprising that sweeps across the empire for nearly a decade.
summary_zh: 一个屡试不第的私盐贩子加入农民起义，起义军转战全国近十年。

title: Huang Chao sacks Guangzhou
summary: The rebels storm the great southern port. Arab sources report the killing of many foreign merchants.
summary_zh: 起义军攻破这座南方大港。据阿拉伯文献记载，许多外国商人遇害。

title: Huang Chao takes Chang'an
summary: Emperor Xizong flees to Chengdu and Huang Chao declares his own Qi dynasty. Imperial authority never recovers.
summary_zh: 唐僖宗逃往成都，黄巢称帝，国号大齐。唐朝的权威从此一蹶不振。

title: Wei Zhuang's 'Lament of the Lady of Qin'
summary: Wei Zhuang's long ballad depicted the horrors of Huang Chao's occupation of Chang'an; it survived only in Dunhuang manuscripts.
summary_zh: 韦庄作长诗《秦妇吟》描写黄巢占长安惨状，后赖敦煌写本得以重见。

title: Li Keyong's Shatuo retake Chang'an
summary: Li Keyong's black-clad Shatuo cavalry beat Huang Chao at Liangtianpo and drove him from Chang'an.
summary_zh: 李克用率沙陀“鸦儿军”在梁田陂大败黄巢，收复长安。

title: Huang Chao dies at Langhu Valley
summary: Pursued by Li Keyong and Zhu Wen, Huang Chao died at Langhu Valley, ending the rebellion.
summary_zh: 黄巢在狼虎谷被围自杀（一说为其甥所杀），起义失败。

title: Zhu Wen tries to kill Li Keyong
summary: Zhu Wen attacked his drunken guest Li Keyong at Shangyuan Inn, starting their lifelong feud.
summary_zh: 朱温于上源驿夜袭醉酒的李克用，两人结下世仇。

title: Wang Jian seizes Chengdu
summary: Wang Jian captured Chengdu from Chen Jingxuan, laying the base for his Former Shu.
summary_zh: 王建攻占成都，取得西川，奠定前蜀基业。

title: Yang Xingmi takes Yangzhou
summary: After years of war in the ruined city, Yang Xingmi became Huainan governor, founding what became the state of Wu.
summary_zh: 杨行密夺取扬州，任淮南节度使，为吴国奠基。

title: Wang Chao captures Fuzhou
summary: Wang Chao and Wang Shenzhi took Fuzhou and controlled all of Fujian, the foundation of Min.
summary_zh: 王潮、王审知兄弟攻克福州，据有福建全境。

title: Zhu Wen moves the court and tears down Chang'an
summary: The warlord Zhu Wen forced Emperor Zhaozong to move to Luoyang and had Chang'an's palaces taken apart. The emperor was murdered later that year.
summary_zh: 军阀朱温胁迫唐昭宗迁都洛阳，拆毁长安的宫殿官署。同年稍后，昭宗被杀。

title: Baima Station massacre of officials
summary: Zhu Wen had some thirty senior officials killed and thrown into the Yellow River, eliminating the Tang aristocracy.
summary_zh: 朱温杀裴枢等朝臣三十余人，投尸黄河，曰“使之为浊流”。

title: Zhu Wen ends the Tang
summary: The warlord Zhu Wen forces the last Tang emperor to abdicate and founds the Later Liang, opening the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.
summary_zh: 军阀朱温逼迫唐朝末代皇帝退位，建立后梁，五代十国时期由此开始。

title: Qian Liu becomes King of Wuyue
summary: Later Liang made Qian Liu King of Wuyue; his house ruled the prosperous Hangzhou region by deferring to northern dynasties.
summary_zh: 后梁封钱镠为吴越王，钱氏以“善事中国”保境安民，杭州日益繁盛。

title: Wang Jian founds the Former Shu
summary: The governor of Sichuan refused to accept the Later Liang and made himself emperor of Shu. Many Tang officials and scholars took refuge with him.
summary_zh: 四川节度使王建拒不承认后梁，自立为帝，国号蜀。许多唐朝官员和文人前来投奔。

title: Ma Yin founds the state of Chu
summary: Ma Yin, master of Hunan, was enfeoffed as King of Chu and promoted the tea trade with the north.
summary_zh: 马殷据湖南，受后梁封为楚王，鼓励茶叶贸易。

title: Li Cunxu breaks the siege of Luzhou
summary: Weeks after his father's death, the young Prince of Jin attacked the Liang siege lines in a morning fog and won a crushing victory.
summary_zh: 父亲去世几周后，年轻的晋王李存勖趁晨雾突袭后梁围城的营寨，大获全胜。

title: Wu ruler Yang Wo murdered by generals
summary: Yang Xingmi's heir was killed by his generals Zhang Hao and Xu Wen; Xu Wen soon became the real power in Wu.
summary_zh: 吴王杨渥被张颢、徐温所杀，徐温随后诛张颢独揽吴国大权。

title: Wang Shenzhi made Prince of Min
summary: Wang Shenzhi ruled Fujian peacefully, developing Fuzhou and Quanzhou ports and welcoming northern scholars.
summary_zh: 后梁封王审知为闽王，他保境息民，发展福州、泉州海外贸易。

title: Qian Liu builds the Hangzhou seawall
summary: The king of Wuyue walled off the Qiantang River's tidal bore with bamboo cages of stone and timber piles, protecting Hangzhou's farmland.
summary_zh: 吴越王钱镠用装满石块的竹笼和木桩筑起海塘，挡住钱塘江大潮，保护了杭州一带的农田。

title: Jin crushes Liang at Boxiang
summary: Li Cunxu and Zhou Dewei routed a Later Liang army at Boxiang, tipping the balance in Hebei toward Jin.
summary_zh: 李存勖、周德威在柏乡大败梁军，河北局势转向晋方。

title: Zhu Wen murdered by his son
summary: Zhu Wen was stabbed by his son Zhu Yougui; months later another son, Zhu Youzhen, killed Yougui and took the throne.
summary_zh: 朱温被其子朱友珪弑杀，次年朱友贞诛友珪即位。

title: Jin destroys Liu Shouguang's Yan
summary: Zhou Dewei captured Youzhou and Liu Shouguang, who had proclaimed himself emperor of Yan, bringing Lulong under Jin.
summary_zh: 周德威攻克幽州，擒自立为燕帝的刘守光，晋得卢龙。

title: Weibo mutinies and joins Jin
summary: Liang's attempt to split Weibo provoked a mutiny that handed the province to Li Cunxu, opening the road south.
summary_zh: 后梁欲分魏博，激起兵变，魏博归附李存勖，晋得河北大部。

title: Abaoji founds the Khitan state
place_zh: 上京临潢府（今内蒙古巴林左旗）
summary: The Khitan leader takes the title of emperor. His dynasty is later called Liao.
summary_zh: 契丹首领阿保机称帝，他建立的王朝后来称为辽。

title: Liu Yan founds the Southern Han
summary: The governor of Guangzhou made himself emperor. His state grew rich from sea trade and lasted until Song conquered it in 971.
summary_zh: 广州的割据者刘䶮称帝建国。南汉靠海上贸易致富，一直存在到971年被宋朝灭亡。

title: Pyrrhic Jin victory at Huliupo
summary: Jin defeated Liang near the Yellow River but lost veteran general Zhou Dewei and many troops.
summary_zh: 晋梁大战于胡柳陂，晋军虽胜，名将周德威战死。

title: Xu Zhigao takes control of Wu court
summary: Xu Wen's arrogant son Xu Zhixun was assassinated; adopted son Xu Zhigao (later Li Bian) took over the Wu government.
summary_zh: 徐温长子徐知训被朱瑾所杀，养子徐知诰入主吴国朝政。

title: Wuyue–Wu naval battle of Langshan River
summary: A Wuyue fleet under Qian Chuanguan defeated Wu's navy at the Yangtze mouth; peace followed for two decades.
summary_zh: 吴越钱传瓘于狼山江大败吴国水军，此后两国休战二十余年。

title: The Khitan large script is created
place_zh: 上京临潢府（今内蒙古巴林左旗）
summary: Abaoji's scholars devised a writing system for the Khitan language based on Chinese characters. A second, 'small' script followed a few years later.
summary_zh: 阿保机命人参照汉字创制契丹文字，即契丹大字。几年后又出现了契丹小字。

title: Li Cunxu repels Abaoji at Wangdu
summary: Abaoji invaded Hebei to aid Zhang Wenli's revolt but was defeated by Li Cunxu at Wangdu.
summary_zh: 阿保机南下援助镇州，被李存勖败于望都，契丹北退。

title: Li Cunxu destroys the Later Liang
summary: The Shatuo Turk ruler of Jin proclaimed the Later Tang and took Kaifeng within months. The last Liang emperor killed himself.
summary_zh: 沙陀人出身的晋王李存勖称帝，建立后唐，几个月内就攻下开封，后梁末帝自杀。

title: Gao Jixing made Prince of Nanping
summary: Gao Jixing's tiny Jingnan state survived by submitting to all neighbours; Later Tang recognised him as Prince of Nanping.
summary_zh: 后唐封高季兴为南平王，荆南以向四方称臣而得存。

title: Later Tang conquers Former Shu
summary: A Later Tang army took Sichuan in about seventy days.
summary_zh: 后唐大军只用了约七十天就平定了四川。

title: Jing Hao's landscape treatise
summary: Living as a hermit in the Taihang, Jing Hao painted monumental landscapes and wrote 'Notes on Brushwork'.
summary_zh: 荆浩隐居太行洪谷，开创北方山水画派，撰《笔法记》。

title: The Khitan destroy Balhae
place_zh: 上京龙泉府（今黑龙江宁安）
summary: Abaoji took the Balhae capital and turned the kingdom into the vassal state of Dongdan.
summary_zh: 阿保机攻下渤海国都城，把渤海改为附属的东丹国。

title: Emperor Zhuangzong is killed in a mutiny
title_zh: 后唐庄宗死于兴教门之变
summary: Three years after his great victory, Li Cunxu was killed in a mutiny in his own capital, and his adoptive brother Li Siyuan took the throne.
summary_zh: 大胜后梁仅三年，李存勖就在都城的兵变中被杀，他的义兄李嗣源登上皇位。

title: Li Siyuan enthroned as Emperor Mingzong
summary: After Zhuangzong's death, Li Siyuan took the throne; his relatively moderate reign gave the north a brief respite.
summary_zh: 李嗣源入洛阳即位，是为明宗，在位期间政治较为清明。

title: Abaoji dies; Empress Shulü takes charge
summary: Returning from conquering Bohai, Abaoji died; Empress Shulü cut off her hand rather than follow him to the grave.
summary_zh: 阿保机灭渤海后卒于扶余府，述律后断腕殉葬，摄理国政。

title: Conqueror of Shu Guo Chongtao killed
summary: After conquering Former Shu, chancellor-general Guo Chongtao was murdered on Empress Liu's secret order, sparking army mutinies.
summary_zh: 郭崇韬灭蜀后遭刘皇后矫令杀害，诸军疑惧，叛乱四起。

title: The government prints the Nine Classics
summary: At Feng Dao's urging the court began printing the Confucian classics from woodblocks. The set was finished in 953 after four changes of dynasty.
summary_zh: 在冯道的倡议下，朝廷开始用雕版印刷儒家经典。历经四个朝代，这套书在953年全部完成。

title: Wuyue founder Qian Liu dies
summary: Qian Liu died after decades of building seawalls, irrigation and Hangzhou's prosperity; his son Qian Yuanguan succeeded.
summary_zh: 吴越王钱镠卒，其子钱元瓘继位。

title: Meng Zhixiang founds the Later Shu
summary: The Later Tang governor of Sichuan made himself emperor. Later Shu was rich and stable until Song conquered it in 965.
summary_zh: 后唐的四川节度使孟知祥自立为帝。后蜀富庶安定，直到965年被宋朝灭亡。

title: Li Congke seizes the Later Tang throne
summary: Threatened with transfer, Li Congke rebelled at Fengxiang; the court armies defected and he became emperor.
summary_zh: 潞王李从珂在凤翔起兵，朝廷军队倒戈，入洛阳称帝。

title: Sixteen Prefectures given to the Khitan
summary: Shi Jingtang buys Khitan help to found the Later Jin. The northern frontier stays in foreign hands for four centuries.
summary_zh: 石敬瑭借契丹之力建立后晋，代价是割让燕云十六州。此后四百多年，北方边地一直落在异族手中。

title: Later Tang falls to Shi Jingtang
summary: With Khitan help, Shi Jingtang broke the siege of Taiyuan and marched on Luoyang; Li Congke burned himself to death.
summary_zh: 石敬瑭借契丹兵解太原之围，南下洛阳，李从珂自焚，后唐亡。

title: Li Bian founds the Southern Tang
summary: The regent of Wu took the throne and claimed descent from the Tang. Southern Tang became the largest and most cultured of the southern kingdoms.
summary_zh: 吴国的执政大臣登基称帝，自称唐朝后裔。南唐成为南方诸国中疆域最大、文化最盛的一个。

title: Battle of Bạch Đằng
place_zh: 白藤江（今越南海防附近）
summary: Ngô Quyền trapped a Southern Han fleet on stakes in the river. Vietnam stayed independent from then on.
summary_zh: 吴权在江中暗插木桩，困住南汉水军。从此越南走上了独立的道路。

title: Later Jin makes Kaifeng the Eastern Capital
summary: Shi Jingtang moved the capital to Kaifeng for its canal links, beginning its role as capital of the next dynasties.
summary_zh: 石敬瑭迁都汴州，建东京开封府，开封自此长期为都城。

title: Khitan make Youzhou their Southern Capital
summary: After acquiring the Sixteen Prefectures, the Khitan raised Youzhou to Southern Capital, the start of Beijing's role as a capital.
summary_zh: 契丹得燕云十六州后，升幽州为南京，北京由此成为陪都。

title: The Huajian Ji anthology is compiled
summary: An official of Later Shu gathered 500 song lyrics by eighteen poets. It is the oldest surviving anthology of ci poetry.
summary_zh: 后蜀官员赵崇祚收集了十八位词人的五百首词。这是现存最早的词集。

title: Zhang Yuxian's rebellion in Southern Han
summary: Zhang Yuxian led a peasant rising in eastern Guangdong against Southern Han's heavy taxes, before being crushed by Southern Tang.
summary_zh: 张遇贤在循州起义反抗南汉苛政，后被南唐所擒。

title: Li Jing succeeds Southern Tang founder
summary: Li Bian died of elixir poisoning and his son Li Jing began an expansionist reign.
summary_zh: 南唐烈祖李昪服丹药而卒，李璟即位。

title: Min splits as Wang Yanzheng founds Yin
summary: Wang Yanzheng broke with his brother Wang Yanxi and proclaimed the state of Yin, plunging Min into civil war.
summary_zh: 王延政与兄王延羲交恶，在建州称帝，国号殷，闽国陷入内战。

title: Southern Tang and Wuyue divide Min
summary: After years of civil war in Min, Southern Tang took the west and Wuyue took Fuzhou in 947.
summary_zh: 闽国经过多年内战后，西部被南唐占领，福州则在947年归于吴越。

title: Old Book of Tang completed
summary: Liu Xu presented the official history of the Tang, compiled from Tang court records under Later Jin.
summary_zh: 后晋刘昫等撰成《唐书》（后称《旧唐书》）二百卷。

title: Later Jin defeats Khitan at Yangcheng
summary: Thirsty Jin troops broke out in a sandstorm and routed Yelü Deguang, who fled on a camel.
summary_zh: 晋军乘大风奋击，大败契丹，耶律德光乘骆驼北逃。

title: Du Chongwei surrenders Jin army to Khitan
summary: Jin's main army under Du Chongwei surrendered at Zhongdu bridge, leaving Kaifeng defenceless.
summary_zh: 后晋主帅杜重威在中渡桥率大军投降契丹，开封门户洞开。

title: The Khitan take Kaifeng and found the Liao
summary: The Khitan emperor ended the Later Jin and named his dynasty Liao, but withdrew north within months.
summary_zh: 契丹皇帝灭后晋，改国号为辽，但几个月内就撤回了北方。

title: Liu Zhiyuan founds the Later Han
summary: The Shatuo governor of Taiyuan filled the gap left by the Khitan withdrawal. His dynasty lasted four years.
summary_zh: 沙陀人出身的河东节度使刘知远趁契丹北撤称帝，他建立的后汉只存在了四年。

title: Liao Taizong dies retreating north
summary: Facing revolts, Yelü Deguang withdrew from Kaifeng and died of fever at Shahulin.
summary_zh: 耶律德光因中原反抗北撤，病死于栾城杀胡林。

title: Wuyue defeats Southern Tang at Fuzhou
summary: Wuyue relieved Li Renda at Fuzhou and routed Southern Tang's besieging army, keeping northern Fujian.
summary_zh: 吴越救援福州，大败南唐军，据有福州。

title: Revolt of the three western garrisons
summary: Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, with Yongxing and Fengxiang, rebelled; Guo Wei besieged and took Hezhong.
summary_zh: 河中李守贞联合永兴、凤翔叛汉，郭威围攻一年而平。

title: Ma brothers' civil war wrecks Chu
summary: Ma Xi'e overthrew his brother Ma Xiguang, leaving Chu so weakened that Southern Tang annexed it.
summary_zh: 马希萼攻杀其弟马希广，楚国内乱，南唐乘机灭楚。
