title: Liu Chengyou's purge drives Guo Wei to revolt
summary: The young emperor killed his regents Yang Bin and Shi Hongzhao and Guo Wei's family; Guo Wei marched on Kaifeng.
summary_zh: 后汉隐帝诛杀杨邠、史弘肇及郭威家属，郭威起兵南下。

title: Gu Hongzhong paints Han Xizai's Night Revels
summary: The Southern Tang court painter recorded minister Han Xizai's banquets, a masterpiece of figure painting.
summary_zh: 南唐画家顾闳中绘《韩熙载夜宴图》，为人物画杰作。

title: Guo Wei founds the Later Zhou
summary: The Han general Guo Wei took the throne. The Liu family kept Taiyuan as the Northern Han, allied with the Liao.
summary_zh: 后汉大将郭威登基称帝。刘氏家族退守太原，建立北汉，与辽结盟。

title: Southern Tang destroys Chu
summary: Southern Tang took Hunan during a war between the Ma princes, but local generals drove it out a year later.
summary_zh: 马氏兄弟争位期间，南唐乘机夺取湖南，但一年后就被当地将领赶走。

title: Liu Chong founds Northern Han
summary: Liu Zhiyuan's brother refused to accept Guo Wei and founded Northern Han at Taiyuan as a Liao client.
summary_zh: 刘崇在太原称帝，建立北汉，依附契丹。

title: Liao Shizong murdered at Xiangshan
summary: On campaign to aid Northern Han, Liao Shizong was killed in a coup; Emperor Muzong succeeded.
summary_zh: 辽世宗出兵援北汉，途中遇弑，辽穆宗即位。

title: Battle of Gaoping
summary: Guo Rong of Later Zhou beats Northern Han and the Khitan, starting the reunification that Song completes.
summary_zh: 后周柴荣击败北汉和契丹联军，开启了由宋朝最终完成的统一大业。

title: Chai Rong becomes Emperor Shizong
summary: Guo Wei's adopted son Chai Rong took the throne and began reforms aimed at reunifying China.
summary_zh: 郭威病逝，养子柴荣即位，是为周世宗，锐意统一。

title: Death of perennial chancellor Feng Dao
summary: Feng Dao, who served ten emperors of five dynasties, died; later historians condemned his lack of loyalty.
summary_zh: 历仕五朝十帝的冯道去世，后世对其气节多有非议。

title: Emperor Shizong closes monasteries and melts statues
summary: Chai Rong closed some 30,000 unregistered monasteries and had bronze Buddhist images melted down to mint coins.
summary_zh: 柴荣下令废除三万余所未经朝廷批准的寺院，并把铜佛像熔化铸钱。

title: Shizong expands Kaifeng's outer city
summary: Shizong ordered a new outer wall, wider streets and fire lanes for crowded Kaifeng, laying out the Song capital.
summary_zh: 周世宗下诏扩建开封外城，拓宽街道，奠定北宋东京格局。

title: Wang Pu presents unification strategy
summary: Wang Pu proposed taking the south first, easiest targets first, then Liao and Northern Han, a plan the Song largely followed.
summary_zh: 王朴献《平边策》，主张先南后北、先易后难。

title: Later Zhou takes four prefectures from Shu
summary: Wang Jingchao seized Qin, Feng, Cheng and Jie from Later Shu, securing the western flank.
summary_zh: 王景率周军攻取后蜀秦、凤、成、阶四州。

title: Later Zhou conquers the land north of the Yangtze
summary: Over three campaigns Chai Rong took every Southern Tang prefecture north of the Yangtze. By 958 Southern Tang had become a vassal.
summary_zh: 柴荣三次亲征，夺取南唐在长江以北的全部州县。到958年，南唐已向后周称臣。

title: Shouzhou falls after long siege
summary: After a siege of over a year, Southern Tang's Shouzhou surrendered on its defender Liu Renshan's death.
summary_zh: 周军围寿州一年余，守将刘仁赡病危，寿州降周。

title: Southern Tang cedes lands north of Yangtze
summary: Li Jing surrendered all fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze, dropped the imperial title and paid tribute to Later Zhou.
summary_zh: 南唐李璟献江北十四州，去帝号，向后周称臣。

title: Shizong orders equalized land tax
summary: Inspired by Yuan Zhen's 'Equal Field Map', Shizong sent officials to survey land and equalise taxes in sixty prefectures.
summary_zh: 周世宗读元稹《均田图》，遣使均定河南六十州田赋。

title: Chai Rong's campaign against the Liao
summary: In about six weeks Later Zhou retook three passes and three prefectures south of modern Beijing. Then the emperor fell ill and died.
summary_zh: 后周大军在四十多天里收复了今北京以南的三关三州。随后周世宗患病，不久去世。

title: Emperor Shizong dies; child heir succeeds
summary: Shizong fell ill on his northern campaign and died; his seven-year-old son succeeded, opening the way for Zhao Kuangyin.
summary_zh: 周世宗北伐途中患病，回京后卒，七岁的柴宗训继位。

title: Chenqiao Mutiny: Zhao Kuangyin founds Song
place_zh: 陈桥驿（今河南封丘东南）
summary: Troops drape a yellow robe on their general. As Emperor Taizu he founds the Song and sidelines the military.
summary_zh: 士兵们把黄袍披在主帅身上。赵匡胤由此称帝，是为宋太祖，他建立宋朝后削夺了武将的兵权。

title: Li Yun rebels at Zezhou
summary: Li Yun, a Later Zhou military governor, rose against the new Song dynasty; Zhao Kuangyin personally led the campaign and crushed him within months.
summary_zh: 后周旧将李筠在泽州起兵反宋，宋太祖亲征，数月即平定。

title: Li Chongjin rebels at Yangzhou
summary: Li Chongjin, a Later Zhou imperial relative, revolted at Yangzhou; Taizu besieged the city and Li burned himself to death, consolidating Song rule south of the Huai.
summary_zh: 后周宗室李重进据扬州叛，太祖亲征，李重进自焚，宋巩固淮南。

title: Taizu takes back his generals' armies over wine
summary: At a banquet Emperor Taizu persuaded his leading generals to give up their commands in return for wealth and honours.
summary_zh: 宋太祖在宴席上劝说手握重兵的将领们交出兵权，换取富贵荣华。

title: Song annexes Jingnan and Hunan
summary: Using a 'borrowed passage' ruse, Song troops seized Jingnan and then Wuping (Hunan), the first step of the southern unification campaigns.
summary_zh: 宋以假道之计取荆南，继平湖南周氏，开统一南方之先。

title: Song conquers Later Shu
summary: Song armies advanced from the north and along the Yangtze, forcing Meng Chang of Later Shu to surrender within 66 days and bringing rich Sichuan under Song rule.
summary_zh: 宋军两路入蜀，六十六日而孟昶降，后蜀亡，富庶四川归宋。

title: Song conquers Southern Han
summary: Pan Mei's army defeated Southern Han's elephant corps and took Guangzhou; Liu Chang surrendered, giving Song the Lingnan region.
summary_zh: 潘美率军破南汉象阵，攻下广州，刘鋹投降，岭南归宋。

title: Maritime Trade Office at Guangzhou
summary: Right after taking Guangzhou, Song set up a Maritime Trade Superintendency to tax and manage foreign shipping, the core institution of Song overseas commerce.
summary_zh: 宋取广州后即设市舶司，管理征税海外商舶，为宋代海外贸易之基本制度。

title: Palace examination becomes regular
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: After a cheating scandal, Taizu re-examined candidates himself; the palace examination, with the emperor as final examiner, became a permanent stage of the civil service exams.
summary_zh: 因科场舞弊案，太祖亲自复试进士，此后殿试成为定制，进士皆为天子门生。

title: Song conquers the Southern Tang
summary: Song troops crossed the Yangtze on a pontoon bridge and took Jinling after a long siege. The poet-ruler Li Yu was taken to Kaifeng.
summary_zh: 宋军在长江上架起浮桥渡江，经过长期围困攻下金陵，南唐后主李煜被押往开封。

title: Death of Taizu; Taizong succeeds
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Emperor Taizu died suddenly and his brother Zhao Guangyi took the throne as Taizong; the mysterious 'candle shadow and axe sound' story fueled suspicion of fratricide.
summary_zh: 宋太祖暴卒，其弟赵光义继位为太宗，“烛影斧声”遂成千古之谜。

title: Yuelu Academy founded
summary: Prefect Zhu Dong founded the Yuelu Academy at the foot of Mount Yuelu; it became one of the Four Great Academies and has taught continuously to the present.
summary_zh: 潭州知州朱洞创建岳麓书院，后为四大书院之一，弦歌不绝至今。

title: Wuyue peacefully submits to Song
summary: Qian Chu, king of Wuyue, surrendered his thirteen prefectures to Song without a fight, sparing the prosperous Zhejiang region from war.
summary_zh: 吴越王钱俶献十三州之地归宋，两浙免于兵燹。

title: Battle of Gaoliang River
summary: Fresh from conquering Northern Han, Song tries to take the Sixteen Prefectures and is routed by the Liao.
summary_zh: 宋军刚灭北汉，便乘胜进攻燕云十六州，结果在高梁河被辽军击溃。

title: Song conquers Northern Han
summary: Taizong besieged Taiyuan, beat off a Liao relief army and forced Liu Jiyuan to surrender, completing the reunification of China proper except the Sixteen Prefectures.
summary_zh: 宋太宗围太原，击退辽援军，刘继元降，北汉亡，五代十国分裂局面结束。

title: Empress Dowager Xiao Chuo rules Liao
place_zh: 辽上京（今内蒙古巴林左旗）
summary: After Emperor Jingzong died, his widow Xiao Chuo ruled for the young Shengzong, strengthening Liao through reforms and leading its armies against Song.
summary_zh: 辽景宗卒，萧绰以太后身份辅佐幼主圣宗，整顿内政，亲征宋朝，辽国大盛。

title: Li Jiqian rebels against Song
place_zh: 地斤泽（今内蒙古鄂尔多斯）
summary: When his clan head ceded Xia lands to Song, Li Jiqian fled to the steppe and led Tangut resistance, laying the foundation of the later Western Xia state.
summary_zh: 李继捧献地入朝，族弟李继迁出奔地斤泽，聚众抗宋，奠定西夏立国基础。

title: Taiping Yulan encyclopedia completed
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Li Fang's team completed the thousand-scroll Taiping Yulan, one of the Four Great Books of Song, preserving quotations from many lost works.
summary_zh: 李昉等编成千卷类书《太平御览》，为“宋四大书”之一，保存大量佚书。

title: Yongxi expedition defeated at Qigou Pass
summary: Taizong's three-pronged attempt to recover the Sixteen Prefectures collapsed when Cao Bin's main army was routed by Liao at Qigou Pass, ending Song offensives against Liao.
summary_zh: 宋太宗三路北伐燕云，曹彬主力在岐沟关大败，宋此后转攻为守。

title: General Yang Ye dies at Chenjiagu
summary: Covering the retreat of the western column, Yang Ye was left without support at Chenjiagu, captured by Liao and starved himself to death, inspiring the Yang family generals legends.
summary_zh: 杨业掩护西路撤退，陈家谷口援兵不至，被俘绝食而死，后世演为杨家将故事。

title: Wang Xiaobo and Li Shun uprising
summary: Tea farmers in Sichuan rose under the slogan of equalizing rich and poor; Li Shun later captured Chengdu and proclaimed the Great Shu state before Song armies retook it.
summary_zh: 四川茶农王小波以“均贫富”号召起事，李顺继之攻占成都，建大蜀，后被宋军镇压。

title: Fan Kuan paints Travelers among Mountains
summary: Fan Kuan's monumental landscape, with its towering central peak, defined the northern landscape style of early Song.
summary_zh: 范宽作《溪山行旅图》，巨峰耸立，为北宋山水画典范。

title: Li Jiqian captures Lingzhou
summary: Tangut forces took the strategic frontier city of Lingzhou, which Li Jiqian made his base, cutting Song off from the horse-rich northwest.
summary_zh: 李继迁攻占灵州，改为西平府，宋失西北要地与马源。

title: Liao general Xiao Talin shot dead
summary: During the Liao invasion that reached the Yellow River, a Song crossbow bolt killed Liao commander Xiao Talin, demoralizing Liao and paving the way for the Chanyuan peace.
summary_zh: 辽军南下至澶州，主将萧挞凛被宋军床子弩射杀，辽军气沮，促成议和。

title: Jingdezhen named for the reign era
summary: The pottery town of Changnan was renamed after the Jingde reign, as its porcelain was supplied to the court; it later became China's porcelain capital.
summary_zh: 昌南镇瓷器进御，以景德年号命名为景德镇，后成为瓷都。

title: Treaty of Chanyuan
summary: Song agrees to pay Liao silver and silk each year. Peace lasts more than a century.
summary_zh: 宋朝同意每年给辽朝送去银两和绢帛，换来了一百多年的和平。

title: Zhenzong's Heavenly Text and Taishan rites
summary: To restore prestige after Chanyuan, Zhenzong staged the 'descent of heavenly texts' and performed the Fengshan sacrifice at Mount Tai, spending lavishly on rituals and temples.
summary_zh: 澶渊之盟后真宗伪造天书，东封泰山，大兴宫观，耗费巨大。

title: Champa rice is spread through the south
summary: During a drought Emperor Zhenzong had seed of a fast-ripening, drought-resistant rice from Champa sent to the Yangtze and Huai regions.
summary_zh: 旱灾期间，宋真宗下令把来自占城、早熟耐旱的稻种分发到长江、淮河流域推广种植。

title: First government paper money
summary: After private merchants' notes failed, the state took over and issued the jiaozi in Sichuan, the world's first government-issued paper money.
summary_zh: 私商发行的交子出现兑付危机后，官府在四川接手发行交子，这是世界上最早由政府发行的纸币。

title: Fan Zhongyan builds the sea dike
summary: Fan Zhongyan led the rebuilding of a long seawall along the Jiangsu coast, protecting farmland and salt works; locals called it the Fan Gong Dike.
summary_zh: 范仲淹主持修筑泰州捍海堰，保护农田盐场，人称“范公堤”。

title: Wang Weiyi's bronze acupuncture figures
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Physician Wang Weiyi cast two life-size bronze figures marked with acupuncture points for teaching and examining doctors, along with an illustrated manual.
summary_zh: 王惟一铸造针灸铜人两具，标注穴位，并著《铜人腧穴针灸图经》，用于教学考试。

title: Li Yuanhao becomes Tangut ruler
summary: Li Yuanhao succeeded his father, abolished Tang and Song surnames, decreed new hairstyles and dress, and prepared to proclaim an independent empire.
summary_zh: 李元昊嗣位，弃唐宋赐姓，下秃发令，定官制服饰，为称帝做准备。

title: Tangut script created
summary: Yeli Renrong devised the Tangut script at Li Yuanhao's command; it was used for official documents and translated Buddhist sutras.
summary_zh: 野利仁荣奉命创制西夏文字，用于官方文书并翻译佛经。

title: Western Xia is founded
summary: The Tangut leader Li Yuanhao declares an empire with its own script.
summary_zh: 党项首领李元昊称帝，还创制了自己的文字。

title: Battle of Sanchuankou
summary: Li Yuanhao ambushed and destroyed a Song relief army near Yanzhou, the first of three major Xia victories that exposed Song military weakness.
summary_zh: 元昊围延州，于三川口全歼宋援军，为宋夏三大战之首。

title: Fan Zhongyan defends the northwest
summary: Fan Zhongyan and Han Qi took charge of Shaanxi defenses, building forts and training local troops; the frontier stabilized and Xia called him a general with armies in his belly.
summary_zh: 范仲淹与韩琦经略陕西，筑城练兵，边防稳固，西夏称其“胸中自有数万甲兵”。

title: Bi Sheng invents movable type
summary: Recorded by Shen Kuo: a commoner prints with clay characters set in an iron frame.
summary_zh: 据沈括记载，平民毕昇用胶泥制成活字，排在铁板上印书。

title: Battle of Haoshuichuan
summary: Li Yuanhao lured a Song army into a valley ambush and destroyed it. The Song commander Ren Fu was killed.
summary_zh: 李元昊把宋军诱入山谷伏击圈，将其全歼，宋将任福战死。

title: Battle of Dingchuan Fort
summary: Xia forces encircled and annihilated a Song army under Ge Huaimin, the third great Xia victory, after which both exhausted sides sought peace.
summary_zh: 西夏围歼葛怀敏所部于定川寨，宋军大败，此后宋夏均趋议和。

title: Liao extracts higher Song payments
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Exploiting Song's war with Xia, Liao massed troops and demanded land; envoy Fu Bi negotiated instead an increase of 100,000 in annual silk and silver payments.
summary_zh: 辽乘宋夏交战，陈兵索地，富弼出使交涉，宋增岁币银绢各十万。

title: The Qingli Reforms
summary: Fan Zhongyan and his allies tried to make government leaner and promotions depend on merit. Opposition ended the reforms within about two years.
summary_zh: 范仲淹等人试图精简机构，让官员升迁以政绩为准。改革遭到强烈反对，大约两年后便告终止。

title: The Wujing Zongyao records gunpowder formulas
summary: A military encyclopedia compiled for the court gave the first known written recipes for gunpowder and described a magnetised 'south-pointing fish'.
summary_zh: 朝廷组织编成的这部军事百科全书，记载了已知最早的火药配方，还描述了用磁化铁片制成的“指南鱼”。

title: Song–Xia peace of 1044
summary: Li Yuanhao agreed to call himself a Song vassal in return for yearly gifts of silver, silk and tea.
summary_zh: 李元昊同意向宋称臣，宋朝每年“赐”给西夏银、绢、茶。

title: Fan Zhongyan's Record of Yueyang Tower
summary: Written for the restored Yueyang Tower, Fan Zhongyan's essay proclaimed the scholar-official ideal: 'be first to worry for the world, last to enjoy its pleasures.'
summary_zh: 范仲淹为重修岳阳楼作记，提出“先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐”。

title: Ouyang Xiu's Old Drunkard's Pavilion
summary: Demoted to Chuzhou after the Qingli reforms failed, Ouyang Xiu wrote his celebrated essay on the Old Drunkard's Pavilion, a model of Song prose.
summary_zh: 庆历新政失败后欧阳修贬知滁州，作《醉翁亭记》，为宋代散文名篇。

title: Li Yuanhao killed by his son
summary: Western Xia's founder was stabbed by his son Ning Linge after taking the prince's bride; the infant Yizong succeeded under the Mozang clan's regency.
summary_zh: 元昊夺太子之妃，被太子宁令哥刺杀，幼子谅祚继位，没藏氏专权。

title: Yellow River breaches at Shanghu
summary: The Yellow River broke its dikes at Shanghu and shifted north to the sea near Tianjin, causing massive flooding and decades of debate over returning it to its old course.
summary_zh: 黄河于商胡决口，北流入海，河北大水，此后朝廷围绕回河之议争论数十年。

title: Nong Zhigao's rebellion
summary: The Zhuang chieftain Nong Zhigao proclaimed the Great Southern Kingdom, took Yongzhou and besieged Guangzhou before being defeated by Di Qing.
summary_zh: 壮族首领侬智高建大南国，攻陷邕州，围广州，后为狄青所败。

title: Di Qing's night raid at Kunlun Pass
summary: During the Lantern Festival, Di Qing feigned feasting then crossed Kunlun Pass by night, defeating Nong Zhigao's army and ending the rebellion.
summary_zh: 狄青上元节佯宴，夜度昆仑关，大破侬智高于归仁铺。

title: Song astronomers record the 1054 supernova
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Song court astronomers recorded a 'guest star' near Tianguan visible in daylight for 23 days; it is the supernova that produced the Crab Nebula.
summary_zh: 宋司天监记录天关客星，昼见二十三日，即今蟹状星云之超新星。

title: Liao builds the Yingxian Wooden Pagoda
summary: The 67-metre Sakyamuni Pagoda of Fogong Temple was built under Liao; it is the oldest and tallest fully wooden pagoda in the world.
summary_zh: 辽建佛宫寺释迦塔，高六十七米，为世界现存最古老最高的木塔。

title: Su Shi and Su Zhe pass jinshi exam
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Under chief examiner Ouyang Xiu, who championed plain classical prose, Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong and others passed in one celebrated examination class.
summary_zh: 欧阳修知贡举，倡平实古文，苏轼、苏辙、曾巩等同榜登第。

title: Wang Anshi's Ten-Thousand-Word Memorial
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Wang Anshi submitted a long memorial to Renzong urging fundamental reform of personnel and institutions, foreshadowing his later New Policies.
summary_zh: 王安石上《言事书》，力主变革法度、培养人才，为日后变法张本。

title: New Book of Tang completed
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Ouyang Xiu and Song Qi completed a new official history of the Tang in a terse classical style, later counted among the Twenty-Four Histories.
summary_zh: 欧阳修、宋祁修成《新唐书》，文辞简洁，列入二十四史。

title: Death of Judge Bao Zheng
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Bao Zheng, famed for incorruptibility as prefect of Kaifeng, died; he later became the legendary Judge Bao of drama and fiction.
summary_zh: 以清廉刚正著称的开封知府包拯去世，后世演为“包青天”。

title: Wang Anshi's New Policies
summary: State loans to farmers, new taxes and a militia system split the court into reformers and conservatives for decades.
summary_zh: 国家向农民放贷、开征新税、推行保甲制度，朝廷因此分裂为变法派和保守派，争斗持续了几十年。

title: Baojia mutual-security system
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Part of Wang Anshi's New Policies, Baojia grouped rural households into units for mutual surveillance and militia training, aiming to cut the cost of professional armies.
summary_zh: 王安石推行保甲法，编户为保，农闲习武，以民兵代募兵。

title: Zhou Dunyi's Taiji diagram
summary: Zhou Dunyi's Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate offered a Confucian cosmology later regarded as the starting point of Neo-Confucianism.
summary_zh: 周敦颐著《太极图说》《通书》，被尊为理学开山。

title: State trade and land survey laws
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: New Policies created a State Trade Bureau to buy, sell and lend to merchants, and launched land surveys to equalize taxes, provoking opposition from great merchants and landlords.
summary_zh: 设市易务平抑物价、贷款商人，并行方田均税法清丈土地，遭大商人与地主反对。

title: Wang Shao's Xihe campaign
summary: Wang Shao drove Tibetan tribes from the Tao River region and set up Xihe Circuit, the largest Song territorial gain, outflanking Western Xia.
summary_zh: 王韶收复熙、河等州，设熙河路，拓地二千余里，对西夏形成侧翼包围。

title: Guo Xi paints Early Spring
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Court painter Guo Xi completed Early Spring, a masterpiece of shifting perspectives that matched his theory of landscape painting.
summary_zh: 宫廷画家郭熙作《早春图》，体现其“三远”山水理论。

title: Lý–Song war
summary: Đại Việt's Lý Thường Kiệt raided Yongzhou; the Song counter-invasion stalled at the Như Nguyệt River, where the poem 'Mountains and Rivers of the Southern Country' was recited.
summary_zh: 交趾李常杰攻陷邕州，宋军反攻受阻于如月江，双方议和。

title: Song–Liao border negotiation
summary: Liao demanded border adjustments in Hedong; Shen Kuo argued Song's case with archives, but Song ultimately ceded land along the watershed of the Fenshui range.
summary_zh: 辽索河东地界，沈括据档案力争，宋终以分水岭划界，让地数百里。

title: Death of Zhang Zai, founder of Guanxue
summary: Zhang Zai, whose qi-based cosmology and Western Inscription shaped Neo-Confucianism, died; his Guanzhong school ranked with those of the Cheng brothers.
summary_zh: 张载卒。其气本论与《西铭》影响深远，所创关学为理学重要一派。

title: The Crow Terrace Poetry Case
summary: Su Shi was arrested for poems that mocked the New Policies, held for months and then exiled to Huangzhou.
summary_zh: 苏轼因诗文讥讽新法被捕入狱，关押数月后被贬到黄州。

title: Cheng brothers teach Luoxue
summary: Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi taught in Luoyang that 'principle' (li) underlies all things, founding the school that Zhu Xi would later synthesize into orthodox Neo-Confucianism.
summary_zh: 程颢、程颐在洛阳讲学，以“天理”为核心，开创洛学，为朱熹理学之源。

title: Yuanfeng reform of the bureaucracy
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Shenzong restored the Tang Three Departments structure, aligning official titles with actual duties and abolishing many sinecure posts.
summary_zh: 神宗依《唐六典》改革官制，恢复三省六部实职，使官名与职事相符。

title: Five-route campaign against Western Xia
summary: Shenzong sent five armies into Western Xia; they besieged Lingzhou but Xia breached the Yellow River dikes and cut supplies, forcing a disastrous retreat.
summary_zh: 神宗发五路大军伐夏，围灵州，夏人决黄河灌营、断粮道，宋军溃退。

title: Su Shi writes the Red Cliff Odes
summary: In exile at Huangzhou after the Crow Terrace trial, Su Shi wrote the two Red Cliff rhapsodies and the ci 'The Great River Flows East', peaks of Song literature.
summary_zh: 乌台诗案后贬居黄州，苏轼作前后《赤壁赋》及《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》。

title: Fall of Yongle fortress
summary: Xu Xi's newly built fortress of Yongle was overwhelmed by Xia forces after its water supply was cut, with heavy Song casualties that shocked Shenzong.
summary_zh: 徐禧所筑永乐城被西夏围困断水，城陷，宋军死伤惨重。

title: Sima Guang completes the Comprehensive Mirror
summary: A year-by-year history from 403 BCE to 959, written as a guide for rulers.
summary_zh: 一部按年记事的通史，从公元前403年写到959年，意在为君主治国提供借鉴。

title: Sima Guang reverses the New Policies
summary: With the boy emperor Zhezong under a regent, Sima Guang became chief minister and abolished most of Wang Anshi's reforms.
summary_zh: 宋哲宗年幼，由太皇太后听政，司马光出任宰相，废除了王安石的大部分新法。

title: Deaths of Wang Anshi and Sima Guang
summary: Within months of each other the two great rivals died: Wang Anshi in retirement at Jiangning as his laws were repealed, and Sima Guang in office at Kaifeng.
summary_zh: 新法尽废之际王安石卒于江宁，数月后司马光亦卒于相位。

title: Maritime Trade Office at Quanzhou
summary: Song established a Maritime Trade Superintendency at Quanzhou, which grew into one of the world's busiest ports, home to Arab, Persian and Southeast Asian merchants.
summary_zh: 宋于泉州设市舶司，泉州逐渐成为世界大港，蕃商云集。

title: Shen Kuo writes the Dream Pool Essays
summary: In retirement the scholar-official Shen Kuo wrote notes on everything from the magnetic compass and fossils to movable type.
summary_zh: 退居的学者型官员沈括写下大量笔记，内容从磁针指南、化石到活字印刷无所不包。

title: Su Song's astronomical clock tower
summary: Su Song and Han Gonglian built a water-driven tower about 12 metres high that turned an armillary sphere and a star globe and struck the hours.
summary_zh: 苏颂与韩公廉建成一座高约12米的水力天文钟楼，能带动浑仪和浑象运转，并自动报时。

title: Zhezong restores the New Policies
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: After taking personal rule, Zhezong declared he would 'continue' his father's policies; Zhang Dun restored the reforms and exiled Yuanyou officials to the far south.
summary_zh: 哲宗亲政，改元绍圣，起用章惇恢复新法，元祐党人遭贬岭南。

title: Song captures Qingtang
summary: Song armies took the Tibetan Gusiluo kingdom's capital Qingtang, renaming it Shanzhou, though control proved costly and was soon abandoned and retaken.
summary_zh: 宋军攻取唃厮啰政权都城青唐，改为鄯州，后几经得失。

title: Death of Su Shi
summary: Pardoned from exile on Hainan, Su Shi died at Changzhou on his way north; he remains the most celebrated poet, essayist, calligrapher and painter of Song.
summary_zh: 苏轼自海南遇赦北归，卒于常州。其诗词文书画皆为宋代之冠。

title: Yuanyou Partisans Stele
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Under Cai Jing, Huizong had the names of over 300 'Yuanyou partisans' including Sima Guang and Su Shi carved on steles and banned their descendants from office.
summary_zh: 蔡京当政，徽宗刻司马光、苏轼等三百余人为“元祐奸党”，立碑天下，禁锢子孙。

title: Yingzao Fashi building manual printed
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Li Jie's Treatise on Architectural Methods standardized building modules, materials and labour, the most complete premodern Chinese architectural manual.
summary_zh: 李诫编成《营造法式》并刊行，规定建筑模数、用料与工限，是古代最完整的建筑典籍。

title: Huizong founds the Painting Academy
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Huizong, himself a master painter and calligrapher, created an imperial painting school with examinations, fostering the refined academic style of late Northern Song.
summary_zh: 宋徽宗设画学，以诗句命题考试，推动院体画发展。

title: Flower and Rock Network begins
summary: Zhu Mian ran an agency in Suzhou that seized rare rocks and plants for Huizong's gardens, shipping them in convoys to Kaifeng and fueling resentment in the southeast.
summary_zh: 朱勔在苏州设应奉局，搜刮奇石异木运往开封，号“花石纲”，东南民怨沸腾。

title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
summary: Zhang Zeduan painted a long scroll of daily life along the river at Kaifeng, crowded with boats, shops and people.
summary_zh: 张择端画下一幅长卷，描绘开封汴河两岸的日常生活，船只、店铺和行人熙熙攘攘。

title: Aguda's victory at Ningjiang
summary: Wanyan Aguda led some 2,500 Jurchen warriors to rout the Liao garrison at Ningjiang, beginning the Jurchen uprising against Liao.
summary_zh: 完颜阿骨打率二千五百人起兵，攻克宁江州，揭开女真反辽序幕。

title: Aguda founds the Jurchen Jin
summary: The Jurchen rise against Liao and destroy it within ten years.
summary_zh: 女真人起兵反辽，不到十年就灭亡了辽朝。

title: Battle of Hubudagang
place_zh: 护步达冈（今黑龙江五常）
summary: Some 20,000 Jurchens crushed Emperor Tianzuo's huge Liao army, a decisive blow after which Liao never regained the initiative.
summary_zh: 阿骨打以两万之众大破辽天祚帝亲征大军，辽从此一蹶不振。

title: Earliest record of nautical compass
summary: Zhu Yu's Pingzhou Table Talks describes Guangzhou sailors using a compass in overcast weather, the earliest known record of magnetic navigation at sea.
summary_zh: 朱彧《萍洲可谈》记载广州海船阴晦时观指南针，为指南针航海最早记录。

title: Fang La's rebellion
summary: Angered by the court's demands for rare plants and rocks, Fang La led a rising that took Hangzhou before it was crushed.
summary_zh: 朝廷搜刮奇花异石，激起民怨，方腊率众起义，一度攻下杭州，最终被镇压。

title: The Alliance Conducted at Sea
summary: Song envoys sailed across the Bohai Sea to the Jurchen and agreed to attack the Liao together, hoping to regain the Sixteen Prefectures.
summary_zh: 宋朝使者渡过渤海与女真结盟，约定共同攻辽，希望借此收复燕云十六州。

title: Jin captures the Liao Supreme Capital
place_zh: 辽上京（今内蒙古巴林左旗）
summary: Aguda took the Liao Supreme Capital in a single day, then went on to capture the Central and Western capitals over the following two years.
summary_zh: 阿骨打一日攻破辽上京，此后两年间连下中京、西京。

title: Song Jiang's band surrenders
summary: Song Jiang's band of 36 roamed Shandong and the Huai region before being defeated at Haizhou by Zhang Shuye; their story inspired the novel Water Margin.
summary_zh: 宋江等三十六人转战河朔、京东，在海州被张叔夜击败投降，后演为《水浒传》。

title: Song attacks on Yanjing fail
summary: Tong Guan's two attempts to take Yanjing from the weakened Liao ended in humiliating defeat; Jin troops then took the city, exposing Song weakness to the Jurchens.
summary_zh: 童贯两次进攻燕京皆为残辽所败，燕京终为金军攻取，宋之虚弱暴露。

title: Song ransoms an emptied Yanjing
summary: Jin handed Yanjing and six prefectures to Song for a large annual payment, after stripping the city of its people and wealth.
summary_zh: 金将燕京及六州交宋，索取大量代税钱，城中人口财富已被掳掠一空。

title: Yelü Dashi leads Khitans west
summary: Breaking with Tianzuo, Yelü Dashi led followers to the Liao garrison at Kedun, regrouped the steppe tribes and later founded the Western Liao (Qara Khitai) in Central Asia.
summary_zh: 耶律大石率部北走可敦城，召集诸部，后西迁建立西辽。

title: Western Xia becomes Jin vassal
summary: Western Xia recognized the rising Jin as overlord in exchange for land, abandoning its former ally Liao.
summary_zh: 西夏向金奉表称臣，换取土地，弃辽附金。

title: Huizong abdicates to Qinzong
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: As Jin armies invaded, a panicked Huizong abdicated in favour of his son Zhao Huan and fled south toward Bozhou.
summary_zh: 金兵南下，徽宗惊惶禅位于太子赵桓，是为钦宗，自己南逃。

title: The Jin capture the last Liao emperor
summary: After years on the run, Emperor Tianzuo was captured by Jin troops, ending the Liao dynasty in China.
summary_zh: 辽天祚帝流亡多年后被金兵俘获，辽朝在中国境内的统治宣告结束。

title: First Jin siege of Kaifeng
summary: Huizong abdicated as Jin armies approached. Li Gang held the walls, and the Jin withdrew after Song promised a huge ransom and three frontier towns.
summary_zh: 金兵南下，宋徽宗仓促让位。李纲组织守城，宋朝答应支付巨额赔款并割让三镇，金军才撤退。

title: Students led by Chen Dong petition
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Imperial University students led by Chen Dong, joined by tens of thousands of citizens, demanded the reinstatement of Li Gang and punishment of the 'Six Traitors'.
summary_zh: 太学生陈东率众伏阙上书，请诛“六贼”、复用李纲，军民数万响应。

title: Jingkang Incident
summary: Jin armies take Kaifeng and carry off two emperors. A Song prince restores the dynasty in the south.
summary_zh: 金军攻破开封，掳走徽、钦二帝。宋朝宗室赵构在南方重建宋廷。

title: Zhao Gou enthroned at Yingtianfu
summary: After the Jin carried off Huizong and Qinzong, Prince Kang Zhao Gou took the throne at Yingtianfu as Emperor Gaozong, founding the Southern Song.
summary_zh: 靖康之变后，康王赵构在应天府即位，是为宋高宗，南宋开始。

title: Zong Ze dies defending Kaifeng
place_zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）
summary: Zong Ze organized loyalist militias to hold Kaifeng and repeatedly begged Gaozong to return; he died crying 'Cross the river!', and the defence soon collapsed.
summary_zh: 东京留守宗泽联结义军守开封，屡请高宗还都，临终三呼“过河”而卒。

title: Miao–Liu mutiny
summary: Guards commanders Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan forced Gaozong to abdicate to his infant son; Han Shizhong and Zhang Jun restored him within a month.
summary_zh: 苗傅、刘正彦发动兵变逼高宗退位，韩世忠、张浚等勤王，月余复辟。

title: Wuzhu pursues Gaozong to the sea
summary: Jin general Wuzhu crossed the Yangtze, took Hangzhou and Mingzhou, and chased Gaozong, who fled by ship along the Zhejiang coast before the Jin withdrew.
summary_zh: 金兀术渡江南侵，连陷临安、明州，高宗航海避敌于温台沿海。

title: Zhong Xiang and Yang Yao uprising
summary: Zhong Xiang called for 'equal noble and base, rich and poor'; after his death Yang Yao held Dongting Lake with paddle-wheel ships until Yue Fei crushed the movement.
summary_zh: 钟相倡“等贵贱，均贫富”起事，杨幺继据洞庭湖，以车船抗宋，终为岳飞所平。

title: Battle of Huangtiandang
summary: Han Shizhong's fleet traps the Jin general Wuzhu on the Yangtze for 48 days after his raid into the south.
summary_zh: 韩世忠率水军把南侵的金将兀术困在长江黄天荡达四十八天。

title: Jin installs puppet Qi under Liu Yu
summary: Jin made the surrendered Song official Liu Yu emperor of a buffer state of Qi in Henan and Shandong, which later moved its capital to Kaifeng.
summary_zh: 金立宋降臣刘豫为大齐皇帝，统辖河南山东，作为宋金缓冲。

title: Battle of Fuping
summary: Zhang Jun's large Song army in Shaanxi was routed by Jin forces at Fuping, losing most of the northwest; Song then held only the Sichuan passes.
summary_zh: 张浚集五路大军与金战于富平，宋军大溃，陕西大部失陷。

title: Qin Hui returns from Jin captivity
summary: Qin Hui, captured with the emperors, returned south claiming to have escaped; promoting peace with Jin, he soon became chief councillor.
summary_zh: 被掳至金的秦桧自称杀监逃归，倡言南北议和，旋任宰相。

title: Battle of Heshangyuan
summary: Wu Jie and Wu Lin defeated Wuzhu at Heshangyuan, wounding him and blocking the Jin route into Sichuan.
summary_zh: 吴玠、吴璘大败金兀术于和尚原，保住入蜀门户。

title: Yue Fei recovers Xiangyang
summary: Yue Fei's first northern expedition drove Qi forces out of Xiangyang and five other prefectures, securing the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 岳飞首次北伐，击败伪齐，收复襄阳等六郡。

title: Battle of Xianren Pass
summary: The Wu brothers again repelled a massive Jin offensive at Xianren Pass, securing Sichuan for the Southern Song.
summary_zh: 吴玠、吴璘于仙人关再败金军，确保四川安全。

title: Li Qingzhao's afterword to Jinshi lu
summary: Fleeing war, Li Qingzhao wrote the afterword to her late husband's epigraphy catalogue, a moving memoir; her ci poetry makes her China's foremost woman poet.
summary_zh: 李清照避乱江南，作《金石录后序》追忆往事，其词为婉约派之宗。

title: Huaixi mutiny of Li Qiong
summary: Resentful at being placed under a civil official, general Li Qiong killed him and defected to Qi with 40,000 troops, hardening the court's distrust of generals.
summary_zh: 郦琼不满文臣统兵，杀吕祉，率四万人降伪齐，朝廷更忌武将。

title: Lin'an becomes the Song capital
summary: Hangzhou grows into perhaps the largest city in the world.
summary_zh: 杭州由此发展成当时世界上可能最大的城市。

title: Liu Qi's victory at Shunchang
summary: Outnumbered, Liu Qi held Shunchang and defeated Wuzhu's armoured cavalry in the summer heat, one of the great Song victories of 1140.
summary_zh: 刘锜以少胜多，坚守顺昌，大败金兀术铁骑。

title: Yue Fei wins at Yancheng
summary: Yue Fei's army beats Wuzhu's cavalry in Henan, but the court soon orders him to pull back.
summary_zh: 岳飞在河南郾城击败兀术的骑兵，但朝廷随即命他班师。

title: Treaty of Shaoxing
summary: Song accepted vassal status, a Huai River–Dasan Pass border and annual tribute of 250,000 taels of silver and bolts of silk, fixing the Song–Jin division for decades.
summary_zh: 宋向金称臣，以淮水至大散关为界，岁贡银绢各二十五万，南北对峙格局形成。

title: Three great generals stripped of command
summary: Qin Hui promoted Han Shizhong, Zhang Jun and Yue Fei to privy councillors, removing them from their armies, which were placed under direct court control.
summary_zh: 秦桧以升官为名罢韩世忠、张俊、岳飞兵权，诸军直隶朝廷。

title: Yue Fei is executed
summary: The general who wanted to retake the north is killed as Qin Hui makes peace with Jin along the Huai River.
summary_zh: 力主收复北方的名将岳飞被杀，秦桧主持与金议和，双方以淮河为界。

title: Wanyan Liang murders Emperor Xizong
place_zh: 上京会宁府（今黑龙江哈尔滨阿城）
summary: Wanyan Liang assassinated the Jin emperor Xizong and seized the throne, then centralized power and moved the capital south to Yanjing.
summary_zh: 完颜亮弑金熙宗自立，集权并迁都燕京。

title: Jin moves its capital to Zhongdu
summary: Emperor Hailing moves the Jin court south to Zhongdu, the first time Beijing becomes a dynastic capital.
summary_zh: 金海陵王把都城南迁到中都，北京第一次成为一个王朝的正式都城。

title: Death of Qin Hui
summary: Qin Hui, who dominated the court for nearly two decades and arranged Yue Fei's death, died; Gaozong kept the peace policy but purged some of his clique.
summary_zh: 专权近二十年、构陷岳飞的秦桧病卒，高宗仍守和议。

title: Song issues huizi paper money
summary: The government takes over Hangzhou's private paper notes and issues the huizi, which becomes the main currency of the south.
summary_zh: 朝廷接管临安民间的纸币，发行官方会子，会子逐渐成为南宋的主要货币。

title: Battle of Caishi
summary: Song paddle-wheel ships and gunpowder weapons stop a Jin crossing of the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 宋军凭借车船和火药武器，挡住了金军渡江。

title: Naval battle of Tangdao
summary: Li Bao's small Song fleet used fire arrows to destroy a much larger Jin fleet off Shandong, one of the earliest naval battles using gunpowder weapons.
summary_zh: 李宝率舟师在唐岛以火箭焚毁金水军，为早期火药海战之一。

title: Emperor Shizong of Jin enthroned
place_zh: 东京辽阳府（今辽宁辽阳）
summary: While Wanyan Liang campaigned south, Wanyan Yong was proclaimed emperor at Liaoyang; his peaceful reign was remembered as Jin's golden age.
summary_zh: 完颜雍在辽阳即位，是为金世宗，在位期间号称“小尧舜”。

title: Xiaozong enthroned, Yue Fei rehabilitated
summary: Gaozong abdicated to his adopted heir Xiaozong, who restored Yue Fei's titles, reburied him with honour and prepared to recover the north.
summary_zh: 高宗禅位孝宗，孝宗为岳飞昭雪，锐意恢复。

title: Defeat at Fuli
summary: Emperor Xiaozong's northern campaign collapses at Fuli, and the Longxing peace of 1164 follows.
summary_zh: 宋孝宗发动的北伐在符离溃败，次年双方订立隆兴和议。

title: Longxing peace with Jin
summary: After the Fuli defeat, Song and Jin made peace: Song became 'nephew' rather than vassal and reduced its tribute, inaugurating forty years of stable coexistence.
summary_zh: 符离之败后宋金议和，宋改称侄国、减岁币，此后四十年相对和平。

title: Wang Chongyang founds Quanzhen Daoism
summary: Wang Chongyang preached in Shandong, gathering the Seven Masters of Quanzhen; the school combined Daoism, Buddhism and Confucianism and spread widely under Jin and Yuan.
summary_zh: 王重阳在山东传教，收全真七子，三教合一的全真道风行北方。

title: Fan Chengda's embassy to Jin
summary: Fan Chengda risked his life to request return of the imperial tombs and changes in protocol; his travel diary and poems record life in the occupied north.
summary_zh: 范成大使金，求陵寝地并争受书礼，几被扣留，作日记与诗记录北方见闻。

title: Lu You's journey into Sichuan
summary: Lu You travelled up the Yangtze to his post at Kuizhou, recording the journey in his Diary of a Journey into Shu; he became the most prolific patriotic poet of Song.
summary_zh: 陆游赴任夔州，沿江而上作《入蜀记》，其诗以爱国为主旋律。

title: Zhu Xi establishes community granaries
summary: Zhu Xi set up a community granary lending grain at low interest in famine years, a model later promoted empire-wide.
summary_zh: 朱熹于崇安五夫里创立社仓，荒年低息贷粮，后推广全国。

title: Goose Lake debate
summary: Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debate how a person should learn the moral order of the world.
summary_zh: 朱熹与陆九渊兄弟在鹅湖寺当面辩论治学之道。

title: Zhu Xi revives White Deer Grotto Academy
place_zh: 庐山白鹿洞（今江西九江）
summary: As prefect of Nankang, Zhu Xi rebuilt the White Deer Grotto Academy and wrote its rules, a model for academies across East Asia.
summary_zh: 朱熹知南康军，重建白鹿洞书院，订《白鹿洞书院揭示》，影响东亚书院。

title: Li Tao completes the Changbian
summary: After forty years' work, Li Tao presented his massive annalistic history of Northern Song, the chief source for the period.
summary_zh: 李焘历四十年撰成《续资治通鉴长编》，为北宋史最重要史籍。

title: Zhu Xi prints his Four Books commentary
title_zh: 朱熹刻印《四书章句集注》
summary: Zhu Xi's commentary on the Four Books later becomes the official basis of the imperial examinations.
summary_zh: 朱熹为四书作的注释后来成为科举考试的官方标准。

title: Yellow River seizes the Huai
summary: The Yellow River broke its banks at Yangwu and flowed southeast into the Huai, a shift that lasted until 1855 and devastated the Huai basin's drainage.
summary_zh: 黄河在阳武决口，南流夺淮入海，至1855年方改道，淮河水患加剧。

title: Shaoxi abdication crisis
summary: When the mentally unstable Guangzong refused to mourn his father, Zhao Ruyu and Han Tuozhou engineered his replacement by Ningzong.
summary_zh: 光宗不执父丧，赵汝愚、韩侂胄拥立宁宗，迫光宗内禅。

title: Ban on "false learning"
summary: Chief minister Han Tuozhou bans Zhu Xi's school as "false learning" and purges its followers.
summary_zh: 权臣韩侂胄把朱熹的学说定为"伪学"，打击其门人和支持者。

title: Death of Zhu Xi
summary: Zhu Xi died under the ban on 'false learning'; within decades his commentaries became orthodox and later the basis of the civil service examinations.
summary_zh: 朱熹卒于“伪学”禁锢之中，其学后被尊为官学，为科举标准。

title: Ma Yuan and Xia Gui's 'one-corner' style
summary: Court painters Ma Yuan and Xia Gui developed asymmetric compositions with vast empty space, nicknamed 'Ma One-Corner' and 'Xia Half-Edge'.
summary_zh: 画院画家马远、夏圭构图多取一角半边，人称“马一角”“夏半边”。

title: Xin Qiji's Beigu Pavilion lyric
title_zh: 辛弃疾作京口北固亭词
summary: As prefect of Zhenjiang, the veteran Xin Qiji wrote 'Recalling the Past at Beigu Pavilion', warning against reckless war while longing to recover the north.
summary_zh: 辛弃疾知镇江，作《永遇乐·京口北固亭怀古》，抒恢复之志又警轻敌。

title: Temüjin becomes Genghis Khan
place_zh: 斡难河（今蒙古国鄂嫩河）
summary: A great assembly makes him ruler of all the Mongols. His conquests begin in Western Xia and Jin.
summary_zh: 蒙古各部在大会上推举铁木真为全蒙古的大汗，此后他开始进攻西夏和金。

title: Kaixi Northern Expedition
summary: Han Tuozhou launches a war to retake the north. It fails within a year.
summary_zh: 韩侂胄发动北伐，想收复中原，不到一年便告失败。

title: Han Tuozhou killed; Shi Miyuan rises
summary: After the failed Kaixi war, Shi Miyuan and the empress had Han Tuozhou murdered and his head sent to Jin; Shi then dominated the court for 26 years.
summary_zh: 开禧北伐失败，史弥远与杨皇后谋杀韩侂胄，函首送金，此后史弥远专权二十六年。

title: Peace of Jiading
summary: Song sends Han Tuozhou's head to the Jin and pays more tribute to end the war.
summary_zh: 南宋把韩侂胄的首级送给金朝，并增加岁币，以结束战争。

title: Battle of Yehuling
summary: Genghis Khan's army annihilated the main Jin field army at Badger Mouth Pass, opening northern China to Mongol invasion.
summary_zh: 成吉思汗在野狐岭大败金军主力，金国精锐尽丧，华北门户洞开。

title: Jin moves capital to Kaifeng
summary: Under Mongol pressure Emperor Xuanzong abandoned Zhongdu for Kaifeng, a move that led the Mongols to resume their attack and seize Zhongdu.
summary_zh: 金宣宗迫于蒙古压力迁都汴京，蒙古借口再攻，次年中都陷落。

title: Red Coat Army rises in Shandong
summary: Peasant bands wearing red jackets under Yang An'er, Li Quan and others rose against Jin in Shandong, later bargaining between Song, Jin and the Mongols.
summary_zh: 山东杨安儿、李全等以红袄为号起兵抗金，后周旋于宋金蒙之间。

title: Mongols take Zhongdu
summary: After the Jin court flees to Kaifeng, Genghis Khan's army captures and burns Zhongdu.
summary_zh: 金朝迁都开封后，成吉思汗的军队攻陷并焚掠了中都。

title: Mongol invasion of Khwarazm
summary: After the Otrar massacre of his envoys, Genghis Khan destroyed the Khwarazmian Empire, sacking Bukhara, Samarkand and Urgench.
summary_zh: 因讹答剌杀使事件，成吉思汗西征，摧毁花剌子模，布哈拉、撒马尔罕相继陷落。

title: Qiu Chuji meets Genghis Khan
place_zh: 八鲁湾（今阿富汗兴都库什山）
summary: The Quanzhen master travelled to the Hindu Kush and counselled Genghis Khan to limit killing; he won tax exemption for Daoist clergy.
summary_zh: 全真道长丘处机西行至大雪山觐见成吉思汗，劝以止杀，获免赋役特权。

title: Shi Miyuan installs Emperor Lizong
summary: On Ningzong's death Shi Miyuan bypassed the heir Zhao Hong and enthroned his own candidate as Lizong, later forcing Zhao Hong to death.
summary_zh: 宁宗卒，史弥远矫诏废皇子赵竑，立赵昀为理宗。

title: Zhao Rugua describes foreign lands
summary: The trade official at Quanzhou records the countries and goods of the maritime trade, from Java to East Africa.
summary_zh: 泉州市舶官员赵汝适记录了海外各国的风土和物产，范围从爪哇一直到东非。

title: Mongols destroy Western Xia
summary: Genghis Khan dies during the campaign, and the Tangut state is wiped out.
summary_zh: 成吉思汗在征战途中去世，西夏随即被灭。

title: Death of Genghis Khan
summary: Genghis Khan died during the final campaign against Western Xia; his body was secretly carried back to Mongolia.
summary_zh: 成吉思汗在征西夏途中病逝于六盘山一带，遗体秘葬漠北。

title: Ögedei elected Great Khan
summary: A kurultai confirmed Genghis Khan's third son Ögedei as Great Khan; with Yelü Chucai's advice he set up taxation of northern China.
summary_zh: 忽里勒台大会推举窝阔台为大汗，用耶律楚材建立赋税制度。

title: First Mongol invasion of Korea
summary: Mongol armies invaded Goryeo, which moved its court to Ganghwa Island the next year and resisted for nearly three decades.
summary_zh: 蒙古军入侵高丽，高丽迁都江华岛，抗蒙近三十年。

title: Battle of Sanfengshan
summary: Tolui's Mongols, having marched through Song territory, destroyed Jin's last main army in a snowstorm, sealing Jin's fate.
summary_zh: 拖雷借道宋境北上，在三峰山风雪中歼灭金军主力，金亡已成定局。

title: Siege of Kaifeng and gunpowder bombs
summary: Defending Kaifeng against the Mongols, Jin used iron-cased 'thunder crash' bombs and fire lances; the city surrendered the next year after a plague.
summary_zh: 金守汴京，使用震天雷、飞火枪抗蒙，次年城中疫起，崔立以城降。

title: Song allies with Mongols against Jin
summary: Song agreed to join the Mongols against the dying Jin, sending Meng Gong with troops and grain to the siege of Caizhou.
summary_zh: 宋与蒙古约定夹攻金朝，派孟珙率军运粮会攻蔡州。

title: Mongols and Song destroy the Jin
summary: The last Jin emperor dies in the siege. Mongols and Song soon turn on each other.
summary_zh: 金朝末代皇帝死于围城之中。灭金之后，蒙古与南宋很快反目成仇。

title: Song tries to retake Luoyang and Kaifeng
summary: Right after the fall of Jin, Song troops march into the empty old capitals but are driven out by the Mongols.
summary_zh: 金亡后不久，宋军进入空虚的开封、洛阳，却被蒙古军击退。

title: Karakorum built as Mongol capital
place_zh: 哈拉和林（今蒙古国哈尔和林）
summary: Ögedei walled Karakorum and built a palace there, making it the political centre of the Mongol Empire.
summary_zh: 窝阔台修筑和林城及万安宫，为蒙古帝国政治中心。

title: Mongols sack Chengdu
summary: Opening the long Song–Mongol war, Köten's army broke into Sichuan and sacked Chengdu, slaughtering much of its population.
summary_zh: 宋蒙战争爆发，阔端攻入四川，成都陷落遭屠。

title: Meng Gong recovers Xiangyang
summary: Meng Gong retook Xiangyang and Fancheng from the Mongols and organized defences along the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 孟珙收复襄、樊，经营京湖防线。

title: Yu Jie's mountain-fortress defence
summary: Yu Jie built a network of fortified mountain cities in Sichuan, including Diaoyucheng, which held off the Mongols for decades.
summary_zh: 余玠在四川依山筑城，建钓鱼城等山城防御体系，长期阻滞蒙古。

title: Liangzhou meeting: Tibet submits to the Mongols
summary: The Sakya lama Sakya Pandita meets the Mongol prince Köden and agrees to Mongol overlordship of Tibet.
summary_zh: 萨迦派高僧萨迦班智达与蒙古王子阔端会面，同意吐蕃归附蒙古。

title: Qin Jiushao's Mathematical Treatise in Nine Sections
summary: The book solves systems of remainders and high-degree equations with methods far ahead of Europe.
summary_zh: 这部书讲解了同余方程组和高次方程的解法，比欧洲早了几百年。

title: Song Ci's handbook of forensic medicine
summary: A judge writes the world's first systematic book on examining bodies to find the cause of death.
summary_zh: 宋慈写成世界上第一部系统的法医学著作，教官员如何验尸断案。

title: Li Ye's Sea Mirror of Circle Measurements
summary: Li Ye systematized the 'tian yuan' method of setting up polynomial equations with one unknown, a milestone of Chinese algebra.
summary_zh: 李冶著《测圆海镜》，系统阐述天元术，为中国代数学里程碑。

title: Kublai conquers the Dali Kingdom
summary: Kublai crossed the Jinsha River on inflated hides and took Dali, outflanking the Song from the southwest; Yunnan came under Mongol rule.
summary_zh: 忽必烈“革囊渡江”攻灭大理国，从西南包抄南宋，云南归入版图。

title: Kaiping (Shangdu) founded
summary: Liu Bingzhong designed the city of Kaiping for Kublai; it became the Yuan summer capital Shangdu, the Xanadu of Western legend.
summary_zh: 刘秉忠为忽必烈营建开平城，后为元上都。

title: First Mongol invasion of Đại Việt
summary: Uriyangkhadai invaded from Yunnan and briefly took Thăng Long, but the Trần forced the Mongols out within weeks.
summary_zh: 兀良合台自云南攻入陈朝，一度攻占升龙，旋即撤兵。

title: Siege of Diaoyu Fortress
summary: A Song mountain fortress holds out, and the Great Khan Möngke dies during the siege.
summary_zh: 南宋的钓鱼城坚守不降，蒙古大汗蒙哥死于围城期间。

title: Kublai besieges Ezhou
summary: Kublai besieged Ezhou until news of Möngke's death sent him north; Jia Sidao secretly offered terms but claimed a great victory.
summary_zh: 忽必烈围鄂州，闻蒙哥死讯北还，贾似道私下议和却诈称大捷。

title: Bamboo 'fire-spurting lance' invented
summary: Song forces at Shouchun made a bamboo-tube weapon firing a projectile with gunpowder, considered an early ancestor of the gun.
summary_zh: 寿春府造突火枪，以巨竹为筒，内装子窠，为管形射击火器之先声。

title: Kublai becomes Great Khan
summary: Kublai claims the throne at Kaiping and fights his brother Ariq Böke for it for four years.
summary_zh: 忽必烈在开平即大汗位，此后与弟弟阿里不哥争位四年。

title: Kublai–Ariq Böke succession war
title_zh: 忽必烈与阿里不哥争位
place_zh: 哈拉和林（今蒙古国哈尔和林）
summary: Ariq Böke was proclaimed khan at Karakorum against Kublai; cut off from Chinese grain, he surrendered in 1264, but the empire fragmented.
summary_zh: 阿里不哥在和林称汗，与忽必烈争位，粮道被断，1264年投降，蒙古帝国分裂。

title: Envoy Hao Jing detained by Song
summary: Kublai's envoy Hao Jing came to confirm the Ezhou terms; Jia Sidao held him for 16 years to hide the deal, later a pretext for war.
summary_zh: 忽必烈遣郝经使宋，贾似道恐私和事泄，拘之真州十六年。

title: Li Tan's rebellion
summary: The Shandong warlord Li Tan defected to Song and rose against Kublai; his defeat at Jinan led Kublai to curb the power of Han hereditary lords.
summary_zh: 山东世侯李璮叛蒙降宋，兵败济南被杀，忽必烈遂削汉人世侯兵权。

title: Jia Sidao's Public Fields Law
summary: To feed the army and curb inflation, Jia Sidao forced landowners in the lower Yangtze to sell excess land to the state, alienating the gentry.
summary_zh: 贾似道在浙西等地强买官户逾限之田为公田，以供军饷，大失士大夫之心。

title: Kublai sets up a bureau to govern Tibet
summary: The office later called the Xuanzheng Yuan runs Tibetan affairs and Buddhism, with the lama Phagpa as Imperial Preceptor.
summary_zh: 忽必烈设立管理吐蕃事务和佛教的机构，即后来的宣政院，由帝师八思巴主持。

title: Construction of Dadu begins
summary: Kublai ordered a new capital built northeast of the old Jin Zhongdu, planned by Liu Bingzhong on classical principles; it became today's Beijing.
summary_zh: 忽必烈命刘秉忠在金中都东北营建新城，即大都，奠定北京城格局。

title: Mongols begin the siege of Xiangyang
summary: On the advice of Song defector Liu Zheng, Aju began encircling Xiangyang and Fancheng with forts and a new navy.
summary_zh: 蒙古采纳降将刘整之策，阿术筑堡围困襄樊，并编练水军。

title: 'Phags-pa script promulgated
summary: Kublai decreed the 'Phags-pa script, devised by the Tibetan lama 'Phags-pa, as the official alphabet for writing all languages of the empire.
summary_zh: 忽必烈颁行帝师八思巴所创新蒙古字，用以译写帝国各种语言。

title: Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan
summary: Kublai takes a Chinese dynastic name and builds a new capital at Dadu.
summary_zh: 忽必烈采用中原王朝的国号，并在大都营建新都城。

title: Zhongdu renamed Dadu as capital
summary: Kublai renamed his new capital Dadu (Khanbaliq), making it the main seat of Yuan government while Shangdu served as the summer capital.
summary_zh: 忽必烈改中都为大都，定为首都，上都为夏都，实行两都巡幸。

title: Fall of Xiangyang
summary: After a six-year siege broken with counterweight trebuchets, the key Song fortress surrenders.
summary_zh: 元军围城六年，最后用配重式投石机（回回炮）打开局面，这座南宋要塞终于投降。

title: First invasion of Japan
summary: A Yuan and Korean fleet lands at Hakata Bay, fights for a day, then withdraws and is hit by a storm.
summary_zh: 元朝与高丽联军在博多湾登陆，激战一天后撤退，途中遭遇风暴。

title: Marco Polo reaches Kublai's court
summary: The Venetian's account of Yuan China shapes European ideas of Asia for centuries.
summary_zh: 这位威尼斯人对元代中国的描述，影响了此后几百年欧洲人对亚洲的想象。

title: Battle of Dingjiazhou
summary: Bayan's Yuan army routed the main Song fleet and army led by Jia Sidao on the Yangtze, after which Song resistance collapsed along the river.
summary_zh: 伯颜在丁家洲大败贾似道所率宋军主力，沿江州郡纷纷降元。

title: Jia Sidao dismissed and killed
place_zh: 漳州木绵庵（今福建漳州）
summary: Disgraced after Dingjiazhou, Jia Sidao was banished south and murdered on the road by his escort Zheng Huchen.
summary_zh: 丁家洲败后贾似道被贬，途中为押送官郑虎臣所杀于木绵庵。

title: Battle of Jiaoshan
summary: Song commanders chained their warships together at Jiaoshan; Yuan forces attacked with fire arrows and destroyed the last major Song fleet on the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 宋将张世杰等以铁索连舟于焦山，元军火攻，宋水军覆灭。

title: Yuan armies take Lin'an
summary: The Song court surrenders its capital to Bayan, and the boy emperor is taken north.
summary_zh: 南宋朝廷向元军统帅伯颜献城投降，年幼的宋恭帝被押往北方。

title: Song loyalists crown Zhao Shi at Fuzhou
summary: After Lin'an surrendered, Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu enthroned the young prince Zhao Shi at Fuzhou to continue resistance.
summary_zh: 临安降元后，陈宜中、张世杰、陆秀夫等在福州拥立赵昰为帝，继续抗元。

title: Pu Shougeng surrenders Quanzhou
summary: The powerful Arab-descended trade commissioner Pu Shougeng refused the Song court refuge, massacred Song clansmen and handed Quanzhou's fleet to the Yuan.
summary_zh: 泉州提举市舶蒲寿庚拒纳宋帝，屠宋宗室，以泉州降元。

title: Yuan maritime trade offices
summary: Yuan set up maritime trade offices at Quanzhou, Qingyuan, Shanghai and Ganpu; Quanzhou (Zaitun) became one of the world's largest ports.
summary_zh: 元于泉州、庆元、上海、澉浦设市舶司，泉州“刺桐港”跻身世界大港。

title: Battle of Yamen
summary: The last Song fleet is destroyed and the boy emperor drowns. Mongol rule covers all of China.
summary_zh: 南宋最后的船队覆没，幼帝投海而死，蒙古统治了整个中国。

title: Survey of the Four Seas and Gaocheng observatory
summary: Guo Shoujing organized astronomical measurements at 27 stations from the South China Sea to Siberia and built the gnomon tower at Gaocheng.
summary_zh: 郭守敬主持四海测验，设二十七处观测点，建登封观星台。

title: Guo Shoujing's Shoushi calendar
summary: New instruments and observations across the empire produce a calendar with a year of 365.2425 days.
summary_zh: 郭守敬等人用新仪器在全国各地观测，编成以365.2425日为一年的新历法。

title: Golden age of Yuan drama
summary: Playwrights such as Guan Hanqing make zaju, a sung drama in four acts, the great art form of the age.
summary_zh: 关汉卿等剧作家使杂剧成为元代最有代表性的艺术形式。

title: Second invasion of Japan
summary: A typhoon, later called kamikaze, wrecks the Yuan fleet.
summary_zh: 一场台风摧毁了元军船队，日本人后来称之为"神风"。

title: Sea transport of tax grain begins
summary: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan first shipped southern tax grain by sea around Shandong to Zhigu near Dadu; sea transport became the lifeline of the capital.
summary_zh: 朱清、张瑄始由海道运江南漕粮至直沽，海运成为大都命脉。

title: Finance minister Ahmad assassinated
summary: Officers Wang Zhu and Gao He killed the extortionate Central Asian finance minister Ahmad Fanākatī; Kublai later posthumously condemned him.
summary_zh: 王著等刺杀专权敛财的回回大臣阿合马，忽必烈后追治其罪。

title: Wen Tianxiang is executed
summary: The captured Song chief minister refuses to serve the Yuan and is put to death in Dadu.
summary_zh: 被俘的南宋丞相文天祥拒绝投降元朝，在大都被处死。

title: Yuan invasion of Champa
summary: Sogetu's seaborne expedition took the Cham capital, but the king fled to the hills and guerrilla resistance forced the Yuan to withdraw.
summary_zh: 唆都率舟师攻占城，国王退入山中抗击，元军无功而还。

title: Second Yuan invasion of Đại Việt
summary: Prince Toghan took Thăng Long, but Trần Hưng Đạo's scorched-earth tactics and counterattacks drove the Yuan out, killing Sogetu.
summary_zh: 脱欢攻占升龙，陈兴道坚壁清野后反击，元军败退，唆都战死。

title: Branch Secretariats become provinces
summary: Yuan branch secretariats (xingsheng), first military-administrative offices, became permanent regional governments, the origin of China's provinces.
summary_zh: 元设行中书省分治各地，行省成为常设地方机构，为后世省制之源。

title: Nayan's rebellion
place_zh: 辽河流域（今内蒙古通辽）
summary: The Genghisid prince Nayan rebelled in Manchuria in league with Qaidu; the aged Kublai led the campaign himself and had Nayan executed.
summary_zh: 东道诸王乃颜联合海都反叛，忽必烈亲征平定。

title: Zhiyuan paper currency issued
summary: To combat inflation of the earlier Zhongtong notes, Sangha issued the Zhiyuan banknote at five times their value, one of history's first fiat-currency systems.
summary_zh: 为应对中统钞贬值，桑哥发行至元宝钞，一贯当中统钞五贯。

title: Battle of Bạch Đằng (1288)
summary: Trần Hưng Đạo planted iron-tipped stakes in the river bed and trapped the retreating Yuan fleet at low tide, ending the third Yuan invasion.
summary_zh: 陈兴道在白藤江底植木桩，乘退潮围歼元军水师，第三次征安南失败。

title: Huitong Canal links the Grand Canal north
summary: The Huitong Canal cut through western Shandong allowed boats to travel directly from Hangzhou to Dadu, creating the north-south Grand Canal used ever since.
summary_zh: 开凿会通河，使大运河由杭州直通大都，奠定京杭运河格局。

title: Guan Hanqing's Injustice to Dou E
summary: Guan Hanqing, the greatest Yuan playwright, wrote 'The Injustice to Dou E', a tragedy of a wrongly executed widow condemning corrupt officials.
summary_zh: 元曲大家关汉卿作《窦娥冤》，控诉官府黑暗，为中国古典悲剧名作。

title: Finance minister Sangha executed
summary: Sangha, the Tibetan-Uighur minister who had raised taxes and looted Song tombs through his ally, was executed for corruption.
summary_zh: 敛财专权、纵容杨琏真加盗掘宋陵的桑哥以贪腐被诛。

title: Grand Canal reaches Dadu
summary: Guo Shoujing's new canal lets grain ships from the south sail right into the capital.
summary_zh: 郭守敬主持开凿的通惠河完工，南方的漕船可以直接驶入大都城内。

title: Death of Kublai Khan
summary: Kublai died aged 79; his grandson Temür (Chengzong) succeeded and ended further overseas wars against Japan and Annam.
summary_zh: 元世祖忽必烈病逝，孙铁穆耳即位为成宗，停止对日本、安南用兵。

title: Huang Daopo brings new cotton skills
summary: A woman returns from Hainan and teaches better ways to gin, spin and weave cotton, making Songjiang a textile center.
summary_zh: 黄道婆从海南回到家乡，传授先进的轧棉、纺纱、织布技术，松江由此成为棉纺织中心。

title: Zhao Mengfu's Autumn Colors
summary: Back in his hometown, Zhao Mengfu painted the Jinan landscape for Zhou Mi in a deliberately archaic style that renewed Chinese literati painting.
summary_zh: 赵孟頫归湖州，为周密作《鹊华秋色图》，倡古意，开元代文人画风。

title: Wang Shifu's Romance of the West Chamber
summary: Wang Shifu's five-part zaju about the lovers Zhang Sheng and Cui Yingying became the most popular love drama in Chinese theatre.
summary_zh: 王实甫作杂剧《西厢记》，歌颂自由爱情，传唱不衰。

title: Ma Zhiyuan's 'Autumn Thoughts' sanqu
summary: Ma Zhiyuan, author of 'Autumn in the Han Palace', wrote the short lyric 'Autumn Thoughts', hailed as the finest of all Yuan sanqu.
summary_zh: 马致远作《汉宫秋》及小令《天净沙·秋思》，被誉为“秋思之祖”。

title: Zhu Shijie's Jade Mirror of Four Unknowns
summary: Zhu Shijie extended the tian yuan method to systems of equations in up to four unknowns and summed higher-order series, the peak of Chinese algebra.
summary_zh: 朱世杰著《四元玉鉴》，创四元术解多元高次方程组，达古代代数巅峰。

title: Ma Duanlin's Wenxian Tongkao
summary: Ma Duanlin completed a 348-scroll encyclopedic history of institutions from antiquity to Song, one of the 'Three Comprehensive' works.
summary_zh: 马端临撰成三百四十八卷《文献通考》，为“三通”之一。

title: First Catholic archbishop of Khanbaliq
summary: Pope Clement V named the Franciscan John of Montecorvino archbishop of Khanbaliq, where he had built churches and baptized thousands.
summary_zh: 教皇任命方济各会士孟高维诺为汗八里大主教，他在大都建堂传教。

title: Yuan restores the civil service exams
summary: Emperor Renzong revives the exams with Zhu Xi's commentaries as the standard; the first are held in 1315.
summary_zh: 元仁宗下诏恢复科举，以朱熹的注释为标准，1315年举行第一次考试。

title: Wang Zhen's Treatise on Agriculture
summary: Wang Zhen's Nongshu illustrated hundreds of farm tools and described his invention of rotating wooden movable type.
summary_zh: 王祯《农书》图绘农具数百种，并记其木活字与转轮排字法。

title: Nanpo coup kills Emperor Gegeen
summary: Conservative Mongol nobles led by Tegshi murdered the reforming emperor Shidebala and his minister Baiju near Shangdu.
summary_zh: 铁失等守旧贵族在上都附近南坡刺杀推行改革的英宗及丞相拜住。

title: Da Yuan Tongzhi law code issued
summary: Under Emperor Yingzong, Yuan compiled its laws and precedents into the Da Yuan Tongzhi, its first comprehensive legal code.
summary_zh: 英宗时编成《大元通制》颁行，为元代较完整的法典。

title: War of the Two Capitals
summary: Rival courts at Dadu and Shangdu fight over the throne. Dadu wins, and strongmen dominate the court afterwards.
summary_zh: 大都和上都两个朝廷为争夺皇位开战，大都一方获胜，此后权臣把持朝政。

title: Bayan abolishes the civil examinations
summary: Chancellor Bayan of the Merkid, hostile to Han Chinese, suspended the civil service exams and imposed discriminatory measures.
summary_zh: 权相伯颜排斥汉人，罢废科举。

title: Toghto's reforms
summary: Toghto ousted his uncle Bayan, restored the examinations, eased penalties and sponsored the official histories, a brief revival of Yuan government.
summary_zh: 脱脱逐伯颜，恢复科举，宽刑减赋，主持修史，史称“脱脱更化”。

title: Yellow River breaches at Baimao
summary: The Yellow River burst its dikes at Baimao, flooding much of Shandong and Henan for years and damaging the Grand Canal and salt works.
summary_zh: 黄河在白茅堤决口，山东、河南大片泛滥数年，运河盐场受损。

title: Histories of Liao, Jin and Song completed
summary: Under chief minister Toghto, official histories of all three earlier dynasties are finished in two years.
summary_zh: 在丞相脱脱主持下，辽、金、宋三朝正史用两年多时间全部修成。

title: Ibn Battuta visits Zaitun
summary: The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta landed at Zaitun (Quanzhou), describing it as one of the greatest ports in the world, before travelling north.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰抵泉州，称其为世界最大港口之一。

title: Fang Guozhen's revolt at sea
summary: The salt trader Fang Guozhen took to the sea with a fleet, raiding the coast and disrupting the grain shipments vital to Dadu.
summary_zh: 盐贩方国珍聚众入海起事，劫掠海运漕粮，威胁大都供给。

title: Wang Dayuan's Daoyi Zhilüe
summary: After two voyages across the Indian Ocean, Wang Dayuan described about 100 foreign lands, a key source on Asian maritime trade.
summary_zh: 汪大渊两次远航后著《岛夷志略》，记海外近百国地理风物。

title: Huang Gongwang paints Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains
place_zh: 富春江（今浙江杭州富阳）
summary: The old painter finishes a long handscroll of the river landscape, one of the most admired works of Chinese art.
summary_zh: 年迈的黄公望画成描绘富春江山水的长卷，这是中国最受推崇的画作之一。

title: Zhizheng paper money reform
summary: Toghto's issue of new Zhizheng notes caused runaway inflation; paper money soon became nearly worthless and markets reverted to barter.
summary_zh: 脱脱发行至正交钞，滥发致物价飞涨，钞法崩溃。

title: Red Turban Rebellion
summary: Forced labour on the Yellow River dikes sparks a millenarian revolt across the north.
summary_zh: 朝廷征发民夫修治黄河堤防，引发了席卷北方的宗教性起义。

title: Jia Lu's Yellow River works
summary: Jia Lu mobilized 170,000 labourers to close the Baimao breach and restore the river; the discontented workforce helped spark the Red Turban uprising.
summary_zh: 贾鲁征发民夫十七万治河，堵塞决口；民夫聚集，成为红巾起义导火索。

title: Xu Shouhui founds Tianwan
summary: Southern Red Turbans led by Xu Shouhui and Peng Yingyu proclaimed the Tianwan state, spreading across the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 南方红巾军徐寿辉、彭莹玉起兵，建天完国，势及长江中游。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang joins the rebels
summary: A poor former monk joins Guo Zixing's Red Turban force and soon marries his adopted daughter, the future Empress Ma.
summary_zh: 出身贫苦的游方僧朱元璋投奔郭子兴的红巾军，不久娶了郭的养女，也就是后来的马皇后。

title: Zhang Shicheng's salt workers' revolt
summary: The salt boatman Zhang Shicheng led salt workers in revolt, took Gaoyou and proclaimed the state of Great Zhou.
summary_zh: 盐贩张士诚率盐丁起事，占高邮，建大周。

title: Siege of Gaoyou
summary: Toghto's huge army was on the verge of taking Gaoyou when court intrigue had him dismissed; the army dissolved, and Yuan never recovered the initiative.
summary_zh: 脱脱率大军围高邮，垂克之际被罢，大军溃散，元朝从此无力平乱。

title: Han Lin'er proclaimed Song emperor
summary: Liu Futong enthroned Han Lin'er as 'Little Prince of Radiance' of a restored Song dynasty, rallying the northern Red Turbans.
summary_zh: 刘福通拥立韩林儿为帝，号小明王，国号宋，北方红巾军奉其正朔。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang takes Nanjing
summary: Zhu captures the city, renames it Yingtian and makes it his base.
summary_zh: 朱元璋攻下集庆，改名应天府，以此为根据地。

title: Red Turbans burn Shangdu
summary: A column of the Red Turban northern expedition captured and burned the summer capital Shangdu, then raided into Liaodong and Korea.
summary_zh: 红巾军北伐中路攻克上都，焚毁宫阙，转战辽东、高丽。

title: Battle of Longwan
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang lured Chen Youliang's fleet into an ambush at Longwan outside Nanjing, defeating the newly proclaimed emperor of Han.
summary_zh: 朱元璋诱陈友谅至龙湾设伏，大败之。

title: Gao Ming's The Lute
summary: Gao Ming's southern drama The Lute, about the loyal wife Zhao Wuniang, was later called the ancestor of chuanqi drama.
summary_zh: 高明作南戏《琵琶记》，被誉为“南戏之祖”“传奇之祖”。

title: Yuan general Chaghan Temür assassinated
summary: The ablest Yuan commander was murdered by surrendered rebels while besieging Yidu, removing the main threat to Zhu Yuanzhang.
summary_zh: 元军统帅察罕帖木儿围益都时被降将刺杀，元廷失柱石。

title: Battle of Lake Poyang
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang defeats Chen Youliang in one of the largest naval battles in history.
summary_zh: 朱元璋在鄱阳湖击败陈友谅，这是历史上规模最大的水战之一。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims himself Prince of Wu
summary: After destroying Chen Youliang, Zhu Yuanzhang took the title Prince of Wu at Yingtian, setting up a full administration.
summary_zh: 朱元璋灭陈友谅后于应天称吴王，建百官。

title: Han Lin'er drowns at Guabu
summary: Being escorted to Yingtian, the Red Turban emperor Han Lin'er drowned when his boat capsized, almost certainly on Zhu Yuanzhang's orders.
summary_zh: 小明王韩林儿被迎往应天，途中于瓜步沉舟溺死。

title: Xu Da's northern expedition
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang sent Xu Da and Chang Yuchun north with the call to 'expel the barbarians and restore China'; they took Dadu the following year.
summary_zh: 朱元璋命徐达、常遇春北伐，檄文号召“驱逐胡虏，恢复中华”，次年攻克大都。

title: Fall of Zhang Shicheng at Suzhou
summary: After a ten-month siege Zhu's army takes Suzhou and captures his last major rival in the south.
summary_zh: 经过十个月围城，朱元璋的军队攻下平江，俘获了南方最后一个强敌张士诚。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang founds the Ming
summary: The former monk becomes the Hongwu Emperor. His army takes Dadu and the Yuan court flees north.
summary_zh: 出身僧人的朱元璋登基称帝，年号洪武。明军攻占大都，元朝宫廷北逃。

title: Xu Da captures Yuan capital Dadu
summary: Ming general Xu Da took Dadu as the Yuan emperor Toghon Temür fled north, ending Mongol rule over China proper.
summary_zh: 明将徐达北伐攻入大都，元顺帝北逃，元朝在中原的统治结束。

title: Imperial kilns at Jingdezhen
summary: The early Ming set up an imperial porcelain factory at Jingdezhen, making blue-and-white ware for the court and export.
summary_zh: 明初于景德镇设御器厂，烧造宫廷与外销青花瓷。

title: Ming victory at Yingchang
place_zh: 应昌（今内蒙古克什克腾旗）
summary: Li Wenzhong raided Yingchang, capturing the Yuan heir's son and many nobles shortly after Toghon Temür's death.
summary_zh: 李文忠奇袭应昌，俘获元嗣君之子买的里八剌及大批宗室官员。

title: Hongwu enfeoffs his sons as princes
summary: Hongwu made his sons princes with troops in strategic cities, a system meant to guard the dynasty that later fuelled the Jingnan war.
summary_zh: 朱元璋分封诸子为王，镇守要地、掌握兵权，为日后靖难之役埋下伏笔。

title: Hongwu imposes the maritime ban
summary: The Hongwu Emperor forbade private overseas trade, restricting foreign commerce to official tribute missions; the ban shaped coastal society for two centuries.
summary_zh: 洪武帝下令片板不许入海，禁止私人出海贸易，对外交往限于朝贡，影响沿海二百年。

title: Ming conquers the Xia regime in Sichuan
summary: Tang He and Fu Youde advanced up the Yangtze and from Shaanxi, forcing Ming Sheng of the Xia regime to surrender and bringing Sichuan under Ming rule.
summary_zh: 汤和、傅友德两路入川，大夏明昇出降，四川归入明朝版图。

title: Xu Da defeated in the steppe at Lingbei
place_zh: 岭北（今蒙古国哈拉和林一带）
summary: Xu Da's deep thrust into Mongolia was routed by Köke Temür, persuading Hongwu to adopt a defensive frontier policy.
summary_zh: 徐达深入漠北，被扩廓帖木儿击败，明朝此后对北元转取守势。

title: Ryukyu begins tribute to the Ming
summary: After a Ming envoy's visit, King Satto of Chūzan sent tribute, beginning a tributary tie that lasted five centuries.
summary_zh: 明使杨载出使琉球，中山王察度遣使入贡，开启延续五百年的宗藩关系。

title: Hu Weiyong purge; chancellor abolished
summary: The Hongwu Emperor executes his chancellor for treason and abolishes the post, ruling the ministries directly.
summary_zh: 明太祖以谋反罪处死丞相胡惟庸，随后废除丞相制度，由皇帝直接统领六部。

title: Ming conquest of Yunnan
summary: Fu Youde, Lan Yu and Mu Ying destroyed the Yuan prince of Liang's forces; the Mu family then governed Yunnan hereditarily.
summary_zh: 傅友德、蓝玉、沐英击灭元梁王，云南归附，沐氏世镇云南。

title: Yellow Registers compiled
summary: A nationwide household census organized households into lijia units and recorded labour and tax duties, renewed every ten years.
summary_zh: 全国编造赋役黄册，推行里甲制，十年一造，登记户口与赋役。

title: Embroidered Uniform Guard established
summary: Hongwu created the Jinyiwei, an imperial guard with powers to investigate, arrest and torture officials outside normal courts.
summary_zh: 朱元璋设立锦衣卫，掌侍卫、缉捕、刑狱，可直接奉旨办案。

title: Guo Huan embezzlement case
summary: A vice minister of revenue was accused of embezzling grain; tens of thousands of officials and landlords were killed in the fallout.
summary_zh: 户部侍郎郭桓被控贪污官粮，牵连处死者数万人。

title: Lan Yu's victory at Buir Lake
summary: Lan Yu surprised the Northern Yuan camp, capturing tens of thousands and breaking the power of Tögüs Temür.
summary_zh: 蓝玉率军奔袭捕鱼儿海，大破北元脱古思帖木儿，俘获数万人。

title: Lan Yu purge
summary: General Lan Yu was executed for alleged treason; some 15,000 people died, eliminating most surviving founding generals.
summary_zh: 大将蓝玉以谋反罪被杀，株连一万五千余人，开国功臣几被诛尽。

title: Great Ming Code promulgated
summary: After thirty years of revision, the final Great Ming Code was issued, becoming the model for Qing law.
summary_zh: 历经三十年修订，《大明律》正式颁行，后为清律所本。

title: Northern and Southern examination lists case
summary: When all successful candidates were southerners, Hongwu executed examiners and passed only northerners, leading to regional quotas.
summary_zh: 会试录取者全为南人，朱元璋杀考官、另录北士，后形成南北分卷取士。

title: Jianwen Emperor curtails the princes
summary: Advised by Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng, the new emperor stripped several uncles of their fiefs, provoking Zhu Di's revolt.
summary_zh: 建文帝用齐泰、黄子澄之策削夺诸王，激起燕王朱棣起兵。

title: Battle of Dongchang
summary: Imperial general Sheng Yong inflicted the heaviest defeat on Zhu Di's army during the Jingnan campaign.
summary_zh: 盛庸在东昌大败燕军，燕将张玉战死，为靖难中燕军最大挫败。

title: Prince of Yan takes Nanjing
summary: After a three-year civil war Zhu Di overthrows his nephew and becomes the Yongle Emperor.
summary_zh: 经过三年内战，燕王朱棣推翻侄子建文帝，登基为永乐帝。

title: Grand Secretariat formed
summary: Yongle had Hanlin scholars such as Xie Jin and Yang Shiqi assist in drafting decisions, the origin of the Ming Grand Secretariat.
summary_zh: 永乐帝命解缙、杨士奇等入直文渊阁参预机务，内阁制度由此形成。

title: Execution of Fang Xiaoru
summary: The Confucian scholar refused to draft Yongle's accession edict and was executed with his kin and followers.
summary_zh: 方孝孺拒为朱棣草拟即位诏书，被杀，亲族门生遭株连。

title: Tally trade with Ashikaga Japan
summary: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu accepted investiture as 'King of Japan', opening licensed tribute trade through Ningbo.
summary_zh: 足利义满受封日本国王，中日以勘合符为凭开展朝贡贸易，经宁波入贡。

title: Zheng He's first voyage
summary: The first of seven treasure fleet voyages that reach India, Arabia and East Africa.
summary_zh: 郑和率宝船队第一次出海，此后七下西洋，到达印度、阿拉伯和东非。

title: Construction of the Forbidden City
summary: Yongle ordered the building of a new palace complex in Beijing; finished in 1420, it housed 24 Ming and Qing emperors.
summary_zh: 永乐帝下令营建北京宫殿，1420年建成，此后为明清两代皇宫。

title: Ming conquest of Đại Ngu (Vietnam)
summary: Ming armies under Zhang Fu overthrew the Hồ dynasty and annexed Vietnam as Jiaozhi province.
summary_zh: 张辅等率军攻灭胡朝，在安南设交趾布政使司。

title: Yongle Encyclopedia completed
summary: More than 2,000 scholars compile a huge encyclopedia of over 11,000 volumes, the largest in the world for 600 years.
summary_zh: 两千多名学者编成一万一千多册的大型类书，此后六百年间一直是世界上规模最大的百科全书。

title: Nurgan Regional Commission set up
summary: Ming established a regional military commission near the Amur estuary; the eunuch Yishiha later erected the Yongning Temple steles there.
summary_zh: 明在黑龙江下游设奴儿干都司，亦失哈多次巡视并立永宁寺碑。

title: Yongle's first Mongolian campaign
summary: Yongle personally led a huge army into Mongolia, defeating Bunyashiri on the Onon and Arughtai soon after.
summary_zh: 永乐帝亲征漠北，于斡难河击败本雅失里，继破阿鲁台。

title: Huitong Canal reopened
summary: Song Li restored the Huitong section of the Grand Canal, after which grain went to Beijing by canal and sea transport ended.
summary_zh: 工部尚书宋礼重浚会通河，漕运全由运河北上，海运罢废。

title: Guizhou made a province
summary: After suppressing the Sizhou chieftains, Ming created Guizhou province, extending direct rule into the southwest.
summary_zh: 废思州、思南宣慰司，设贵州布政使司，贵州正式建省。

title: Eastern Depot founded
summary: Yongle creates a secret police office run by eunuchs to spy on officials.
summary_zh: 永乐帝设立由宦官掌管的东厂，专门侦察臣民。

title: Tang Sai'er uprising
summary: A woman leader of the White Lotus rose in Shandong against heavy corvée; the revolt was crushed but she was never caught.
summary_zh: 山东女子唐赛儿以白莲教聚众起事，被镇压后不知所终。

title: Beijing becomes the capital
summary: Yongle moves the court north to his new Forbidden City.
summary_zh: 永乐帝把朝廷迁到北方，入居新建的紫禁城。

title: Yongle dies returning from campaign
summary: The emperor died on the way back from his fifth campaign against the Mongols, ending Ming offensives on the steppe.
summary_zh: 永乐帝第五次北征回师途中病逝榆木川，明朝对漠北的大规模出击告终。

title: Ming abandons Vietnam
summary: After Liu Sheng was killed in ambush by Lê Lợi's forces, Xuande withdrew Ming troops and recognized Vietnamese independence.
summary_zh: 柳升援军在支棱关中伏败死，宣德帝撤军，安南复国。

title: Zheng He dies on final voyage
summary: Zheng He died during the seventh expedition; the treasure fleet returned and Ming ocean voyages ceased.
summary_zh: 郑和第七次下西洋途中卒于古里，此后明朝不再远航。

title: Luchuan campaigns
summary: Wang Ji led repeated expeditions against the Shan state of Luchuan-Pingmian, at great cost to the treasury.
summary_zh: 王骥三征麓川思任发父子，耗费巨大。

title: Eunuch Wang Zhen dominates court
summary: After Grand Empress Dowager Zhang died, the eunuch Wang Zhen took control of Yingzong's court, beginning eunuch dominance.
summary_zh: 太皇太后张氏死后，宦官王振专擅朝政，开明代宦官专权之端。

title: Deng Maoqi tenant uprising
summary: Tenant farmers and miners in Fujian rose against rent burdens and corrupt officials; the revolt spread widely before suppression.
summary_zh: 福建佃农邓茂七抗租起事，矿工叶宗留等响应，声势浩大。

title: Tumu Crisis
summary: The Oirat Mongols capture the Zhengtong Emperor. Yu Qian defends Beijing.
summary_zh: 瓦剌蒙古俘虏了明英宗，于谦率军民保卫北京。

title: Yu Qian defends Beijing
summary: After Tumu, Yu Qian enthroned the Jingtai Emperor and repelled Esen's Oirat army at the gates of Beijing.
summary_zh: 土木之变后，于谦拥立景泰帝，击退也先瓦剌军，保住京师。

title: Captive Yingzong released by Oirats
summary: Esen freed the captured emperor, who returned to be confined in the Southern Palace by his brother Jingtai.
summary_zh: 瓦剌放还英宗，景泰帝尊其为太上皇，幽居南宫。

title: Yingzong retakes the throne
summary: Generals and officials free the former captive emperor from house arrest and restore him; Yu Qian is executed.
summary_zh: 一批将领和官员把被软禁的明英宗拥上皇位，于谦随后被冤杀。

title: Battle of Big Rattan Gorge
summary: Han Yong led a large army against Yao and Zhuang rebels in Guangxi's Big Rattan Gorge, killing thousands.
summary_zh: 韩雍率军进剿大藤峡瑶、壮起义，斩杀数千。

title: Western Depot established
summary: Chenghua created a second secret-police agency under eunuch Wang Zhi, abolished in 1482 after protests.
summary_zh: 成化帝设西厂，由太监汪直掌管，侦缉横行，1482年撤销。

title: Eight-legged essay standardised
summary: By the Chenghua reign the rigid eight-part essay format became mandatory in civil examinations.
summary_zh: 成化年间八股文格式定型，成为科举考试固定文体。

title: Hongzhi Restoration
summary: The Hongzhi Emperor curbed eunuchs and trusted able ministers such as Liu Jian and Li Dongyang, a period remembered as good government.
summary_zh: 弘治帝勤政节俭，任用刘健、李东阳等贤臣，史称弘治中兴。

title: Wu School of painting flourishes
summary: Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, Tang Yin and Qiu Ying made Suzhou the centre of literati painting.
summary_zh: 沈周、文徵明、唐寅、仇英等名家辈出，吴门画派兴盛。

title: Wang Yangming's enlightenment at Longchang
summary: In exile in Guizhou, Wang Yangming realizes that moral principle is found in one's own mind.
summary_zh: 被贬到贵州龙场的王阳明领悟到：道理不必向外求，就在自己心中。

title: Eunuch Liu Jin executed
summary: The powerful eunuch Liu Jin, leader of the 'Eight Tigers', was convicted of treason and executed by slicing.
summary_zh: 八虎之首刘瑾专权数年，以谋反罪被凌迟处死。

title: Portuguese embassy of Tomé Pires
summary: The first Portuguese embassy reached Guangzhou and travelled to Beijing but was rejected after Zhengde's death.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙使节皮莱资抵广州并北上，正德帝死后遭驱逐。

title: Prince of Ning rebellion
summary: Zhu Chenhao rebelled in Jiangxi; Wang Yangming defeated him at Poyang Lake within about forty days.
summary_zh: 宁王朱宸濠在南昌起兵，王守仁四十余日即平定。

title: Great Rites Controversy
summary: The new Jiajing Emperor fights his officials over how to honor his own father, and has protesters flogged.
summary_zh: 嘉靖帝即位后，为如何尊奉生父与群臣激烈争执，最后下令廷杖抗议的官员。

title: Ming expels the Portuguese at Tunmen
summary: Ming naval forces drove off Portuguese ships at Tunmen, the first armed clash between China and a European power.
summary_zh: 明水师在屯门击退葡萄牙船队，为中欧首次武装冲突。

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms printed
summary: The earliest surviving edition of Luo Guanzhong's novel, the Jiajing edition, appeared with a 1522 preface.
summary_zh: 现存最早的嘉靖本《三国志通俗演义》刊行，序署嘉靖壬午。

title: Ningbo tribute dispute
summary: Rival Japanese tribute missions fought in Ningbo, leading Ming to close the maritime trade office and fuelling piracy.
summary_zh: 日本两派贡使在宁波相互仇杀，明廷罢市舶司，倭患渐起。

title: Water Margin circulates in print
summary: Printed editions of the outlaw saga attributed to Shi Nai'an circulated widely in the mid-sixteenth century.
summary_zh: 题为施耐庵所著的《水浒传》在嘉靖年间刊印流行。

title: Zhu Wan destroys Shuangyu smuggling port
summary: Zhu Wan razed the smuggling base at Shuangyu used by Portuguese and Chinese traders, intensifying wokou raids.
summary_zh: 朱纨攻毁中葡走私据点双屿港，倭寇活动随之加剧。

title: Altan Khan raids the outskirts of Beijing
summary: Mongol horsemen break through the Great Wall and loot the Beijing suburbs for days while Ming troops stay inside.
summary_zh: 蒙古骑兵突破长城，在北京郊外劫掠多日，明军却闭城不战。

title: Shaanxi earthquake
place_zh: 华州（今陕西渭南华州区）
summary: The deadliest earthquake in recorded history kills about 830,000 people.
summary_zh: 有记载以来死亡人数最多的地震，约八十三万人遇难。

title: Portuguese settle at Macau
summary: Ming lets Portuguese traders stay, opening a door for European trade and missionaries.
summary_zh: 明朝允许葡萄牙商人在澳门居留，为欧洲贸易和传教士打开了一扇门。

title: Pirate leader Wang Zhi executed
summary: Lured by Hu Zongxian's promises, the merchant-pirate Wang Zhi surrendered and was executed.
summary_zh: 胡宗宪诱降海商首领汪直，后汪直被处斩。

title: Qi Jiguang defeats the pirates at Taizhou
summary: Qi Jiguang's newly trained army wins a string of battles against the wokou pirates raiding the coast.
summary_zh: 戚继光率领新练成的戚家军连战连捷，大败侵扰沿海的倭寇。

title: Fall of Grand Secretary Yan Song
summary: After two decades dominating Jiajing's court, Yan Song was dismissed and his son Yan Shifan later executed.
summary_zh: 专权二十年的首辅严嵩被罢，其子严世蕃后被处斩。

title: Hai Rui's memorial rebukes Jiajing
summary: Hai Rui bought a coffin and submitted a memorial denouncing the emperor's neglect, and was jailed until Jiajing's death.
summary_zh: 海瑞备棺上疏直斥嘉靖帝，被下狱，嘉靖死后获释。

title: Ming lifts the ban on private sea trade
summary: Private merchants may now sail abroad from Yuegang, and silver from the Americas begins to pour in.
summary_zh: 朝廷允许私人商船从月港出海贸易，美洲白银随之大量流入。

title: Qi Jiguang rebuilds the Great Wall near Beijing
summary: Qi Jiguang takes command north of Beijing and builds over a thousand brick watchtowers on the wall.
summary_zh: 戚继光镇守蓟州，在北京以北的长城上修建了一千多座砖砌空心敌台。

title: Peace and trade with Altan Khan
summary: The Ming names Altan Khan a prince and opens border markets, ending decades of raids.
summary_zh: 明朝封俺答汗为顺义王，开放边境互市，结束了数十年的战乱。

title: Zhang Juzheng's reforms
summary: As senior grand secretary for the young Wanli Emperor, Zhang Juzheng enforced official accountability, restored finances and strengthened frontiers.
summary_zh: 张居正辅佐幼年万历帝，推行考成法、整顿财政、巩固边防。

title: Manila galleons bring American silver
summary: Spanish galleons began shipping Mexican silver to Manila to buy Chinese silk and porcelain, making China the sink of world silver.
summary_zh: 西班牙大帆船将美洲白银运至马尼拉换取中国丝瓷，白银大量流入中国。

title: Li Shizhen completes the Compendium of Materia Medica
summary: After 27 years of work, a doctor finishes a book describing about 1,900 medicines.
summary_zh: 医生李时珍历时二十七年，写成记载约一千九百种药物的巨著。

title: Pan Jixun controls the Yellow River
summary: Pan Jixun applied 'confining the river to scour the silt', rebuilding dikes at the Yellow-Huai confluence.
summary_zh: 潘季驯以束水攻沙之法治理黄淮，修筑大堤。

title: Nationwide land survey
summary: Zhang Juzheng ordered a re-measurement of all taxable land, uncovering large hidden holdings.
summary_zh: 张居正下令全国清丈田亩，查出大量隐匿田地。

title: Single Whip tax reform
summary: Zhang Juzheng extends a reform that merges land tax and labor service into one payment in silver.
summary_zh: 张居正在全国推行一条鞭法，把田赋和徭役合并，折成白银征收。

title: Zhang Juzheng dies; reforms reversed
summary: After his death Zhang was posthumously disgraced and his family property confiscated, and many reforms lapsed.
summary_zh: 张居正死后被抄家夺谥，新政多被废止。

title: Zhu Zaiyu defines equal temperament
summary: The Ming prince Zhu Zaiyu calculated twelve-tone equal temperament with high precision.
summary_zh: 明宗室朱载堉精确计算出十二平均律。

title: Dispute over the heir
summary: Officials fought Wanli for fifteen years over naming his eldest son heir; the emperor retreated from court business.
summary_zh: 群臣与万历帝围绕立太子争执十五年，万历帝怠政不朝。

title: Journey to the West published
summary: A Nanjing printer publishes the novel about the monk Xuanzang and the Monkey King.
summary_zh: 南京书坊刊行了讲述唐僧和孙悟空取经故事的小说《西游记》。

title: Ningxia campaign against Bobai
summary: Li Rusong and others besieged and flooded Ningxia to crush the mutiny of Bobai, first of Wanli's three great campaigns.
summary_zh: 李如松等水灌宁夏城，平定哱拜叛乱，为万历三大征之一。

title: Ming relieves Pyongyang
summary: Ming armies join Korea against Hideyoshi's invasion of Joseon.
summary_zh: 明军入朝，与朝鲜一道抗击丰臣秀吉的侵略。

title: Wanli's mining and commercial tax eunuchs
summary: Wanli sent eunuchs to collect mining and commercial taxes across the provinces, provoking urban riots.
summary_zh: 万历帝派宦官四出征收矿税商税，激起各地民变。

title: Battle of Noryang
summary: The Ming-Korean fleet destroyed withdrawing Japanese ships; Yi Sun-sin and Ming commander Deng Zilong were both killed.
summary_zh: 中朝水师在露梁海截击撤退日军，李舜臣、邓子龙战死。

title: Tang Xianzu's The Peony Pavilion
summary: A playwright finishes a romantic drama about a girl who dies of love and comes back to life.
summary_zh: 汤显祖写成《牡丹亭》，讲述少女杜丽娘因情而死、又为情复生的故事。

title: Bozhou campaign against Yang Yinglong
summary: Li Hualong led 240,000 men to destroy the hereditary chieftain Yang Yinglong, ending 700 years of Yang rule.
summary_zh: 李化龙统兵二十余万平定播州杨应龙，结束杨氏七百年统治。

title: Matteo Ricci reaches Beijing
summary: The Jesuit brings clocks, maps and mathematics to the Wanli court.
summary_zh: 这位耶稣会士把自鸣钟、世界地图和数学知识带到了万历朝廷。

title: Ricci's world map printed
summary: Matteo Ricci and Li Zhizao printed a large world map introducing China to the Americas and modern geography.
summary_zh: 利玛窦与李之藻刊印《坤舆万国全图》，介绍五大洲知识。

title: Li Zhi dies in prison
summary: The iconoclastic thinker Li Zhi, accused of heresy, took his own life in jail.
summary_zh: 异端思想家李贽被以惑世诬民下狱，自刎而死。

title: Donglin Academy revived
summary: Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong reopened the Donglin Academy, whose members criticised court politics and formed the Donglin faction.
summary_zh: 顾宪成、高攀龙重修东林书院讲学议政，形成东林党。

title: Euclid translated into Chinese
summary: Xu Guangqi and Matteo Ricci translate the first six books of Euclid's Elements.
summary_zh: 徐光启与利玛窦合译欧几里得《几何原本》前六卷。

title: Satsuma invades Ryukyu
summary: Japan's Satsuma domain subjugated Ryukyu, which thereafter paid tribute to both Ming and Japan.
summary_zh: 日本萨摩藩攻占琉球，此后琉球两属于中日。

title: Case of the Attack with the Club
summary: A man armed with a club broke into the heir apparent's palace, first of the three great cases of the late Ming.
summary_zh: 男子张差持梃闯入太子宫，为明末三大案之一。

title: Nurhaci founds the Later Jin
