summary: The Jurchen leader unites his people under the Eight Banners.
summary_zh: 女真首领努尔哈赤以八旗制度统一部众，建立后金。

title: Nurhaci's Seven Grievances; Fushun falls
summary: Nurhaci declared war on the Ming with his Seven Grievances and captured Fushun, opening the Ming-Jurchen war.
summary_zh: 努尔哈赤以七大恨告天，攻陷抚顺，明金战争开始。

title: Jin Ping Mei printed
summary: The realist novel by 'Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng' appeared in print, its frank portrayal of merchant life causing scandal.
summary_zh: 兰陵笑笑生所著《金瓶梅词话》刊行，描写市井生活。

title: Battle of Sarhu
summary: Nurhaci destroys a much larger Ming army.
summary_zh: 努尔哈赤击溃了兵力远胜于己的明军。

title: Feng Menglong's Three Words collections
summary: Feng Menglong published three collections of vernacular short stories, landmarks of Ming popular fiction.
summary_zh: 冯梦龙编成《喻世明言》《警世通言》《醒世恒言》。

title: Red Pill case
summary: The Taichang Emperor died a month after accession after taking red pills, fuelling factional accusations.
summary_zh: 泰昌帝服红丸后暴毙，在位仅一月，引发党争。

title: Palace Removal case
summary: Officials forced Consort Li out of the Palace of Heavenly Purity so the young Tianqi Emperor could take the throne.
summary_zh: 东林官员迫使李选侍移出乾清宫，天启帝即位。

title: Shenyang and Liaoyang fall to Later Jin
summary: Nurhaci captured Shenyang and Liaoyang, seizing the Ming heartland east of the Liao River.
summary_zh: 后金攻陷沈阳、辽阳，辽河以东尽失。

title: She-An Rebellion
summary: Yi chieftains She Chongming and An Bangyan revolted in Sichuan and Guizhou, besieging Chengdu and Guiyang.
summary_zh: 彝族土司奢崇明、安邦彦起兵，围攻成都、贵阳，历时九年。

title: Battle of Guangning
summary: Feuding commanders Wang Huazhen and Xiong Tingbi lost Guangning, and Ming fell back behind Shanhai Pass.
summary_zh: 王化贞、熊廷弼不和，广宁失守，明军退守山海关。

title: Sino-Dutch conflict in Penghu
summary: The Dutch East India Company occupied Penghu; Ming forces besieged them until they withdrew to Taiwan.
summary_zh: 荷兰东印度公司占据澎湖，明军围攻，荷人退往台湾。

title: Dutch establish Fort Zeelandia in Taiwan
summary: After leaving Penghu, the Dutch built Fort Zeelandia and began colonial rule over southwestern Taiwan.
summary_zh: 荷兰人退出澎湖后在大员筑热兰遮城，殖民台湾南部。

title: Wei Zhongxian purges the Donglin faction
summary: The eunuch dictator has leading critics tortured to death in prison.
summary_zh: 权宦魏忠贤将东林党的主要人物下狱，酷刑致死。

title: Battle of Ningyuan
summary: Yuan Chonghuan's European-style cannon beat off Nurhaci, his first major defeat.
summary_zh: 袁崇焕用西洋大炮击退努尔哈赤，这是努尔哈赤第一次遭到重大失败。

title: Wanggongchang explosion
summary: A massive blast at a gunpowder factory in Beijing destroyed thousands of houses and killed some 20,000 people.
summary_zh: 北京王恭厂火药局发生大爆炸，毁屋万间，死伤约两万。

title: Chongzhen purges Wei Zhongxian
summary: The new Chongzhen Emperor banished the eunuch dictator, who hanged himself en route; his faction was purged.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝即位后贬斥魏忠贤，魏在阜城自缢，阉党被清算。

title: Battle of Ning-Jin
summary: Yuan Chonghuan's defences at Ningyuan and Jinzhou repulsed Hong Taiji's attack.
summary_zh: 袁崇焕守宁远、锦州，击退皇太极进攻。

title: Peasant revolts break out in Shaanxi
summary: Famine and unpaid soldiers spark uprisings that grow into the armies of Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong.
summary_zh: 饥荒和欠饷引发民变，后来发展成李自成、张献忠的大军。

title: Courier stations cut back
summary: To save money Chongzhen slashed the postal relay system, throwing many men, including Li Zicheng, out of work.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝为节省开支裁撤驿站，李自成等驿卒失业。

title: Hong Taiji raids to Beijing
summary: Later Jin troops bypassed Shanhai Pass via Inner Mongolia and reached Beijing's walls.
summary_zh: 皇太极绕道蒙古破关入塞，兵临北京城下。

title: Yuan Chonghuan is executed
summary: The Chongzhen Emperor executes his best frontier general on charges of treason.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝以通敌罪名处死了最得力的边关将领袁崇焕。

title: Battle of Liaoluo Bay
summary: Zheng Zhilong's fleet defeated the Dutch East India Company, securing dominance over the Taiwan Strait.
summary_zh: 郑芝龙率明水师在料罗湾击败荷兰舰队。

title: Chongzhen calendar completed
summary: Xu Guangqi, Adam Schall and others completed a calendar compendium based on Western astronomy.
summary_zh: 徐光启、汤若望等依西法编成《崇祯历书》。

title: Rebels burn imperial tombs at Fengyang
summary: Peasant rebel armies took Fengyang and burned the Ming founder's ancestral tombs.
summary_zh: 农民军攻破凤阳，焚毁明皇陵。

title: Hong Taiji proclaims the Qing
summary: Hong Taiji declared himself emperor and renamed the Later Jin state as the Great Qing.
summary_zh: 皇太极称帝，改国号为大清。

title: Qing invasion of Joseon
summary: Qing forces besieged King Injo at Namhansanseong, forcing Joseon to break with the Ming.
summary_zh: 清军围困朝鲜仁祖于南汉山城，朝鲜被迫断绝与明朝关系。

title: Song Yingxing's Tiangong Kaiwu
summary: An illustrated encyclopedia describes Chinese farming and crafts, from rice and silk to iron and paper.
summary_zh: 这部图文并茂的百科全书记录了中国的农业和手工业技术，从稻米、丝绸到冶铁、造纸。

title: Complete Treatise on Agriculture
summary: Xu Guangqi's agricultural encyclopedia was edited by Chen Zilong and printed after his death.
summary_zh: 徐光启遗著《农政全书》经陈子龙整理刊行。

title: Battle of Song-Jin
summary: Qing forces destroyed Hong Chengchou's relief army of 130,000; Hong surrendered and Ming lost its last field army in Liaodong.
summary_zh: 清军大败洪承畴十三万援军，洪承畴降清，明关外精锐尽失。

title: Li Zicheng takes Luoyang
summary: Rebels kill the rich Prince of Fu and hand out his grain, winning huge popular support.
summary_zh: 起义军杀死富甲一方的福王朱常洵，开仓散粮，民心大附。

title: Yellow River breached at Kaifeng
summary: During Li Zicheng's siege the Yellow River dikes were breached, drowning most of Kaifeng's population.
summary_zh: 李自成围开封期间黄河决口，城中军民大多溺死。

title: Sun Chuanting killed; Li takes Xi'an
summary: Li Zicheng crushed Sun Chuanting's last Ming field army, captured Xi'an and prepared to found the Shun dynasty.
summary_zh: 李自成破潼关，孙传庭战死，旋占西安。

title: Zhang Xianzhong takes Wuchang
summary: Zhang Xianzhong captured Wuchang, killed the Prince of Chu and styled himself King of the Great West.
summary_zh: 张献忠攻占武昌，杀楚王，自称大西王。

title: Battle of Shanhai Pass
summary: Li Zicheng has taken Beijing and the last Ming emperor has hanged himself. Wu Sangui opens the pass and the Qing take Beijing.
summary_zh: 李自成已攻占北京，崇祯帝自缢身亡。吴三桂打开山海关，清军随即进入北京。

title: Qing moves its capital to Beijing
summary: After Li Zicheng fled, Dorgon brought the young Shunzhi Emperor to Beijing, proclaiming Qing rule over all China.
summary_zh: 李自成撤离北京后，多尔衮迎顺治帝入关，定都北京。

title: Southern Ming Hongguang court in Nanjing
summary: Ming loyalists enthroned the Prince of Fu in Nanjing; factional strife left it unable to resist the Qing.
summary_zh: 明遗臣在南京拥立福王朱由崧，党争不断，次年覆灭。

title: Banner land enclosures
summary: The Qing seized farmland around Beijing for bannermen, dispossessing many Han farmers until enclosure was halted under Kangxi.
summary_zh: 清廷在京畿圈占民田分给旗人，至康熙时停止。

title: Fall of Yangzhou
summary: Qing troops storm the city defended by Shi Kefa and kill a great part of its people over ten days.
summary_zh: 清军攻破史可法据守的扬州，屠城十日，城中大批百姓遇害。

title: Queue Order
summary: All Han men must shave the front of the head and wear a Manchu braid, or die. Many towns resist.
summary_zh: 清廷下令汉族男子一律剃发留辫，违者处死，江南多地奋起反抗。

title: Li Zicheng dies at Jiugong Mountain
summary: Pursued by Qing armies, the Shun ruler Li Zicheng was killed by local militia in Hubei.
summary_zh: 李自成兵败南撤，在通山九宫山遇害。

title: Jiading massacres
summary: Resistance to the queue order in Jiading was crushed three times by Li Chengdong's troops, with heavy civilian deaths.
summary_zh: 嘉定民众抗拒剃发，清将李成栋三次屠城。

title: Li Dingguo's victories at Guilin and Hengzhou
summary: Li Dingguo took Guilin, driving Kong Youde to suicide, then killed the Qing prince Nikan at Hengzhou.
summary_zh: 李定国攻克桂林，孔有德自焚，又于衡州斩杀尼堪。

title: Fifth Dalai Lama visits Beijing
summary: The Fifth Dalai Lama was received by Shunzhi and granted a title, establishing Qing patronage of the Gelug school.
summary_zh: 五世达赖入京觐见顺治帝，受册封，清与格鲁派关系确立。

title: Koxinga's assault on Nanjing
summary: Zheng Chenggong sailed up the Yangtze and besieged Nanjing but was routed, ending his northern offensive.
summary_zh: 郑成功率军溯江围攻南京，兵败退回厦门。

title: Coastal evacuation order
summary: To starve the Zheng regime, the Qing forced coastal residents inland from Shandong to Guangdong, devastating the coast.
summary_zh: 为困郑氏，清廷令沿海居民内迁数十里，沿海残破。

title: Lamentation at the Temple case
summary: Suzhou scholars protesting a corrupt magistrate were executed, among them critic Jin Shengtan, amid the Jiangnan tax arrears purge.
summary_zh: 苏州士子哭庙控告县令，金圣叹等被斩，同年江南奏销案株连甚众。

title: Koxinga takes Taiwan from the Dutch
summary: The Ming loyalist builds a base on Taiwan.
summary_zh: 这位忠于明朝的将领在台湾建立了抗清基地。

title: Yongli Emperor executed; Southern Ming ends
summary: Handed over by Burma, the last Southern Ming emperor was strangled in Kunming on Wu Sangui's orders.
summary_zh: 缅甸交出永历帝，吴三桂将其绞杀于昆明，南明灭亡。

title: Huang Zongxi writes Waiting for the Dawn
summary: Huang Zongxi's treatise attacked autocracy, arguing that rulers exist to serve the people rather than the reverse.
summary_zh: 黄宗羲著《明夷待访录》，批判君主专制，主张天下为主、君为客。

title: Calendar case against Adam Schall
summary: Yang Guangxian's accusations led to the imprisonment of Jesuit astronomer Schall; Kangxi later reinstated Western methods under Verbiest.
summary_zh: 杨光先控告汤若望，西洋历法被废，康熙亲政后由南怀仁恢复。

title: Kangxi arrests the regent Oboi
summary: The teenage emperor has young wrestlers seize his overbearing regent and takes power himself.
summary_zh: 少年康熙帝命一群习武少年擒拿专横的辅政大臣鳌拜，从此亲掌大权。

title: Revolt of the Three Feudatories
summary: Wu Sangui and two other southern lords rebel and the Kangxi Emperor crushes them.
summary_zh: 吴三桂等三位南方藩王起兵反清，被康熙帝平定。

title: Fall of Kunming ends the Three Feudatories
summary: Qing armies took Kunming; Wu Shifan killed himself, ending the eight-year revolt.
summary_zh: 清军攻克昆明，吴世璠自杀，三藩之乱平定。

title: Qing takes Taiwan
summary: Admiral Shi Lang defeats the Zheng fleet and Taiwan becomes part of the Qing.
summary_zh: 水师提督施琅击败郑氏水军，台湾归入清朝版图。

title: Taiwan Prefecture established
summary: After the Zheng surrender, the Qing kept Taiwan, creating a prefecture under Fujian province.
summary_zh: 郑氏降清后，清廷设台湾府，隶属福建省。

title: Sea ban lifted; four customs houses
summary: Kangxi lifted the maritime ban and set up customs at Guangzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo and Shanghai.
summary_zh: 康熙开放海禁，设粤、闽、浙、江四海关。

title: Kangxi's first southern tour
summary: Kangxi inspected Yellow River works and visited the Ming founder's tomb, the first of six southern tours.
summary_zh: 康熙帝首次南巡，视察河工并祭明孝陵。

title: Sieges of Albazin
summary: Qing troops twice besiege a Russian fort on the Amur, leading to peace talks.
summary_zh: 清军两次围攻俄国人在黑龙江边修建的雅克萨城，促成了中俄谈判。

title: Treaty of Nerchinsk
place_zh: 尼布楚（今俄罗斯涅尔琴斯克）
summary: China's first treaty with a European power fixes the border with Russia.
summary_zh: 中国与欧洲国家签订的第一个条约，划定了中俄东段边界。

title: Battle of Ulan Butung
place_zh: 乌兰布通（今内蒙古克什克腾旗）
summary: Qing forces under Prince Fuquan defeated Galdan's Dzungar army at Ulan Butung, only about 350 km north of Beijing.
summary_zh: 裕亲王福全率清军在乌兰布通击败噶尔丹准噶尔军。

title: Dolon Nor assembly
summary: Khalkha Mongol princes submitted to Kangxi, bringing Outer Mongolia into the Qing empire.
summary_zh: 喀尔喀蒙古王公在多伦会盟归附清朝。

title: Battle of Jao Modo
place_zh: 昭莫多（今蒙古国土拉河畔）
summary: Kangxi's armies crush the Dzungar leader Galdan in Mongolia.
summary_zh: 康熙帝亲征漠北，清军在昭莫多大败准噶尔首领噶尔丹。

title: Kong Shangren's Peach Blossom Fan
summary: Kong Shangren's drama on the fall of the Southern Ming became a classic of kunqu.
summary_zh: 孔尚任完成《桃花扇》，借离合之情写兴亡之感。

title: Chengde Mountain Resort built
summary: Kangxi began a summer palace at Rehe used to host Mongol and Tibetan elites.
summary_zh: 康熙始建热河行宫，后成为接见蒙藏首领之地。

title: Crown Prince Yinreng deposed
summary: Kangxi deposed his heir twice, setting off a bitter struggle among his sons.
summary_zh: 康熙两废太子胤礽，诸皇子夺嫡愈烈。

title: Poll tax quota frozen forever
summary: Kangxi fixed the poll tax at 1711 levels, paving the way for merging it into the land tax.
summary_zh: 康熙宣布以康熙五十年丁数为准，滋生人丁永不加赋。

title: Kangxi Dictionary completed
summary: A dictionary of about 47,000 characters, arranged by 214 radicals, becomes the standard for two centuries.
summary_zh: 收字约四万七千个、按214个部首编排的字典问世，此后二百年一直是标准字典。

title: Kangxi atlas completed
summary: Jesuits and Qing surveyors completed a triangulated map of the empire.
summary_zh: 传教士与清朝官员实地测绘，完成《皇舆全览图》。

title: Qing expedition to Tibet
summary: Qing armies drive the Dzungars out of Lhasa and install the Seventh Dalai Lama. From 1727 Qing residents (ambans) are stationed in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 清军把准噶尔军赶出拉萨，护送七世达赖喇嘛入藏坐床。1727年起，清朝在拉萨派驻驻藏大臣。

title: Kangxi bans Christian missions
summary: Angered by the papal ban on Chinese rites, Kangxi forbade missionary work.
summary_zh: 因罗马教廷禁止中国礼仪，康熙下令禁教。

title: Head tax merged into land tax
summary: Yongzheng folds the poll tax into the land tax, so taxes fall on land instead of people.
summary_zh: 雍正帝把丁银并入田赋征收，赋税从按人头改为按土地。

title: Nian Gengyao crushes Lobzang Danjin
summary: Nian Gengyao and Yue Zhongqi suppressed the Khoshut revolt, bringing Qinghai under direct control.
summary_zh: 年羹尧、岳钟琪平定罗卜藏丹津叛乱，青海直属清廷。

title: Meltage fees returned to public funds
summary: Yongzheng converted informal surcharges into regular revenue paying 'nourish-integrity' salaries.
summary_zh: 雍正将火耗归公，设养廉银。

title: Replacing native chieftains
summary: Ortai replaced hereditary tusi chiefs in Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi with regular officials.
summary_zh: 鄂尔泰在滇黔桂推行改土归流。

title: Treaty of Kyakhta
summary: Qing and Russia fixed the Mongolian border and regulated caravan trade.
summary_zh: 中俄签订条约，划定中段边界并规定贸易。

title: Ambans posted in Lhasa
summary: After civil war in Tibet, Yongzheng stationed imperial residents in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 雍正设驻藏大臣，监督西藏地方。

title: Grand Council created
summary: A small war office next to the emperor's quarters becomes the real center of government.
summary_zh: 雍正帝在宫中设立处理军务的小机构，后来成为实际上的最高决策中枢。

title: First edict against opium
summary: Yongzheng issued the first imperial edict banning the sale of opium and the running of opium dens, with harsh penalties.
summary_zh: 雍正帝颁布中国第一道禁烟令，严禁贩卖鸦片、开设烟馆。

title: Wu Jingzi's The Scholars
summary: Living in Nanjing, Wu Jingzi wrote a satirical novel exposing the hypocrisy of examination candidates and officials.
summary_zh: 吴敬梓寓居南京，著《儒林外史》，讽刺科举制度下的士林百态。

title: Qing conquers the Dzungars
summary: Qianlong's campaigns destroy the Dzungar Khanate and bring Xinjiang under Qing rule.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝发兵消灭准噶尔汗国，把新疆纳入清朝统治。

title: Canton System
summary: Qianlong limits Western trade to Guangzhou, through licensed Chinese merchants.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝下令西洋商船只许在广州一口通商，并由特许的行商经营。

title: Qing defeats the Altishahr Khojas
summary: Zhaohui's armies took Kashgar and Yarkand, bringing the Tarim Basin under Qing rule; the region was named Xinjiang.
summary_zh: 兆惠等平定大小和卓叛乱，天山南路归入清朝，称新疆。

title: Sino-Burmese War
summary: Four Qing invasions of Konbaung Burma failed with heavy losses; the war ended in an uneasy truce.
summary_zh: 清军四次征缅，损失惨重，最终议和。

title: Torghut Mongols return from the Volga
summary: Led by Ubashi Khan, the Torghuts left Russia and trekked to Ili, losing many people on the way, and were settled by Qianlong.
summary_zh: 渥巴锡率土尔扈特部摆脱沙俄，万里东归伊犁，受清廷安置。

title: Second Jinchuan campaign
summary: Agui subdued the Gyalrong chiefdoms after five years of mountain warfare costing over 60 million taels.
summary_zh: 阿桂历时五年平定大小金川，耗银六千余万两。

title: Siku Quanshu compiled
summary: Qianlong's scholars copy about 3,500 works into a giant library, while also banning and destroying thousands of books.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝组织学者把约三千五百种书籍抄成一部巨型丛书，同时禁毁了数千种书。

title: Wang Lun uprising
summary: Wang Lun's White Lotus offshoot sect rose in Shandong and besieged Linqing on the Grand Canal.
summary_zh: 清水教首王伦在山东起事，攻打运河重镇临清。

title: Yizhulou poetry case
summary: Xu Shukui's poems were deemed anti-Manchu; his corpse was mutilated and relatives punished, typifying Qianlong's literary inquisition.
summary_zh: 徐述夔诗集被指悖逆，剖棺戮尸，为乾隆文字狱典型。

title: Lin Shuangwen rebellion
summary: The Heaven and Earth Society uprising overran much of Taiwan until Fuk'anggan's expedition ended it.
summary_zh: 天地会林爽文在台起事，福康安率军渡海平定。

title: Anhui opera troupes come to Beijing
summary: The Sanqing troupe performed for Qianlong's 80th birthday; Anhui troupes later blended with Hubei tunes into Peking opera.
summary_zh: 三庆班进京为乾隆祝寿，徽汉合流，孕育京剧。

title: Dream of the Red Chamber printed
summary: Cao Xueqin's novel of a great family's decline is published in 120 chapters.
summary_zh: 曹雪芹描写一个大家族盛衰的小说以一百二十回本刊行。

title: Qing war with Gorkha Nepal
summary: After Gorkha raids on Tibet, Fuk'anggan drove them back to near Kathmandu and forced Nepal into tribute.
summary_zh: 廓尔喀侵藏，福康安率军反击直逼加德满都，廓尔喀请降。

title: Macartney Embassy
summary: Britain asks for trade and an embassy. Qianlong refuses.
summary_zh: 英国要求通商并互派使节，被乾隆帝拒绝。

title: Golden Urn regulations for Tibet
summary: The 29-article ordinance placed Tibetan affairs under the ambans and introduced a golden urn lottery to choose reincarnations.
summary_zh: 颁布《钦定藏内善后章程》，确立金瓶掣签制度。

title: White Lotus Rebellion
summary: A religious revolt in the mountains of Hubei, Sichuan and Shaanxi takes nine years and a fortune to put down.
summary_zh: 湖北、四川、陕西山区爆发白莲教起义，清廷花了九年时间和巨额军费才将其镇压。

title: Fall of Heshen
summary: Days after Qianlong's death, Jiaqing arrested Heshen, ordered his suicide and confiscated a vast fortune.
summary_zh: 乾隆死后，嘉庆赐和珅自尽，抄没巨额家产。

title: Eight Trigrams rebels attack the Forbidden City
summary: A sect helped by palace eunuchs breaks into the palace; a prince drives them off with a musket.
summary_zh: 天理教徒在太监接应下攻入紫禁城，皇子旻宁用鸟枪将其击退。

title: Jahangir Khoja's revolt
summary: Jahangir invaded from Kokand and seized Kashgar before Qing troops captured him.
summary_zh: 张格尔从浩罕入侵，占领喀什等城，后被擒。

title: Lin Zexu destroys opium at Humen
summary: The commissioner destroys over 1,000 tonnes of British opium, triggering the First Opium War.
summary_zh: 钦差大臣林则徐销毁英国商人一千多吨鸦片，第一次鸦片战争随之爆发。

title: Sanyuanli resistance
summary: Villagers north of Guangzhou attacked British troops, an episode later celebrated as popular resistance.
summary_zh: 广州三元里民众围攻英军。

title: Battle of the Bogue
summary: British warships stormed the Humen forts; Admiral Guan Tianpei was killed.
summary_zh: 英军攻陷虎门炮台，关天培战死。

title: Treaty of Nanking
summary: The first of the unequal treaties: Hong Kong is ceded and five ports opened.
summary_zh: 第一个不平等条约：清朝割让香港岛，开放五个通商口岸。

title: Wei Yuan's Illustrated Treatise on Maritime Kingdoms
summary: Wei Yuan's survey of world geography urged 'learning foreign skills to control foreigners'.
summary_zh: 魏源编《海国图志》，提出师夷长技以制夷。

title: Battle of Zhenjiang
summary: Manchu garrison troops fought to the end; the British then cut the Grand Canal and forced peace.
summary_zh: 镇江八旗守军死战，英军切断漕运，清廷求和。

title: Shanghai opens as a treaty port
summary: Shanghai opened under the Treaty of Nanjing; the British settlement founded in 1845 grew into the International Settlement.
summary_zh: 上海开埠，1845年设英租界，渐成通商中心。

title: Taiping Rebellion
summary: Hong Xiuquan, who believed he was Jesus's brother, leads a revolt that takes Nanjing and costs tens of millions of lives.
summary_zh: 自称耶稣之弟的洪秀全发动起义，攻占南京，战乱造成数千万人死亡。

title: Taipings take Nanjing as Tianjing
summary: Taiping armies took Nanjing, renamed it Tianjing and issued the Heavenly Land System.
summary_zh: 太平军攻克南京，定都天京，颁布《天朝田亩制度》。

title: Zeng Guofan forms the Xiang Army
summary: Zeng Guofan organised a personal militia army in Hunan that became the main force against the Taipings.
summary_zh: 曾国藩在湖南编练湘军，成为镇压太平天国主力。

title: Nian Rebellion
summary: Bandit groups in the Huaibei plain united under Zhang Lexing and raided north China for 15 years.
summary_zh: 张乐行在雉河集会盟，捻军纵横华北十余年。

title: Taiping Northern Expedition
summary: A Taiping force reached near Tianjin but was annihilated by Senggerinchin.
summary_zh: 太平军北伐逼近天津，被僧格林沁全歼。

title: Tianjing Incident
summary: Infighting killed Yang Xiuqing, Wei Changhui and thousands, crippling the Taipings.
summary_zh: 杨秀清、韦昌辉相继被杀，太平天国由盛转衰。

title: Panthay Rebellion
summary: Du Wenxiu led Hui and other peoples in Yunnan, ruling Dali for sixteen years.
summary_zh: 杜文秀在大理建政，抗清十六年。

title: Treaties of Tianjin
summary: After the Western powers take the Dagu forts, the Qing opens more ports and the Yangtze and accepts envoys in Beijing.
summary_zh: 英法联军攻占大沽炮台后，清朝被迫增开口岸、开放长江，并允许外国公使驻京。

title: Treaty of Aigun
summary: Russia takes the land north of the Amur River.
summary_zh: 沙俄割占黑龙江以北的大片土地。

title: Battle of Sanhe
summary: Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng wiped out Li Xubin's elite Xiang Army brigade.
summary_zh: 陈玉成、李秀成歼灭湘军李续宾部。

title: Hong Rengan's New Treatise
summary: Hong Rengan proposed railways, banks and Western-style reforms for the Taiping state.
summary_zh: 洪仁玕提出《资政新篇》，主张学习西方。

title: Burning of the Old Summer Palace
summary: British and French troops loot and burn the imperial gardens at the end of the Second Opium War.
summary_zh: 第二次鸦片战争末期，英法联军洗劫并焚毁了这座皇家园林。

title: Convention of Peking
summary: Britain, France and Russia extracted Kowloon, Tianjin's opening and the Ussuri territory.
summary_zh: 割九龙、开天津，沙俄割取乌苏里江以东。

title: Self-Strengthening Movement
summary: Officials like Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang build arsenals, shipyards and schools on Western models.
summary_zh: 曾国藩、李鸿章等官员仿照西方，兴办兵工厂、造船厂和新式学堂。

title: Xinyou Coup: Cixi takes power
summary: Two empress dowagers and Prince Gong overthrow the regents, and Cixi begins to rule from behind the curtain.
summary_zh: 两宫太后联合恭亲王推翻顾命大臣，慈禧从此垂帘听政。

title: Zongli Yamen created
summary: Prince Gong set up the Zongli Yamen to handle relations with Western powers, China's first foreign-affairs office.
summary_zh: 奕䜣奏设总理各国事务衙门，为中国第一个专门外交机构。

title: Tongwen Guan school opens
summary: The government's first school of foreign languages, later adding science.
summary_zh: 清朝第一所官办外语学校成立，后来又增设算学和科学课程。

title: Shaanxi-Gansu Hui uprising
summary: Hui-Han violence in Shaanxi grew into a revolt across the northwest, finally suppressed by Zuo Zongtang.
summary_zh: 陕西回汉冲突引发大规模回民起义，蔓延西北，后被左宗棠镇压。

title: Shi Dakai trapped at the Dadu River
summary: Shi Dakai's army was trapped by floods and Qing troops at the Dadu River; he surrendered and was executed in Chengdu.
summary_zh: 石达开部受阻大渡河，全军覆没，石达开在成都被杀。

title: Fall of Tianjing
summary: Zeng Guoquan's Xiang Army stormed Nanjing weeks after Hong Xiuquan's death, effectively ending the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
summary_zh: 洪秀全病逝后，曾国荃率湘军攻破天京，太平天国失败。

title: Jiangnan Arsenal founded
summary: Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang founded the largest Self-Strengthening arsenal, which also translated Western science books.
summary_zh: 曾国藩、李鸿章创办江南制造总局，兼设翻译馆译介西书。

title: Tianjin Massacre
summary: Rumours about a French orphanage led a crowd to kill nuns, priests and the French consul; Zeng Guofan's settlement was widely condemned.
summary_zh: 民众因育婴堂传闻焚毁教堂、杀死法国领事等，曾国藩处理遭非议。

title: Chinese Educational Mission
summary: The first of 120 Chinese boys sail to study in New England.
summary_zh: 首批留美幼童从上海出发，前后共一百二十人赴美国新英格兰求学。

title: China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company
summary: Li Hongzhang founded a government-supervised, merchant-managed shipping company to compete with foreign lines.
summary_zh: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局，官督商办，与外商争利。

title: Japanese expedition to Taiwan
summary: Japan attacked Paiwan villages over the killing of Ryukyuan sailors; the Qing paid an indemnity, weakening its claim to Ryukyu.
summary_zh: 日本借琉球船民被杀出兵台湾，清廷赔款了事。

title: Great North China Famine
summary: Drought brings one of the worst famines in history; around 9 to 13 million people die.
summary_zh: 华北大旱引发历史上最严重的饥荒之一，约九百万至一千三百万人死亡。

title: Zuo Zongtang recovers Xinjiang
summary: Zuo Zongtang's army destroyed Yaqub Beg's regime and retook all of Xinjiang except Ili.
summary_zh: 左宗棠率军消灭阿古柏政权，收复除伊犁外的新疆。

title: Battle of Fuzhou
summary: A French squadron destroys the Fujian Fleet in under an hour at the start of the Sino-French War.
summary_zh: 中法战争中，法国舰队在不到一小时内摧毁了福建水师。

title: Xinjiang becomes a province
summary: The Qing made Xinjiang a regular province with Liu Jintang as first governor.
summary_zh: 清廷设新疆省，刘锦棠任首任巡抚。

title: Victory at Zhennan Pass
summary: Veteran general Feng Zicai routed the French, leading to the fall of the Ferry ministry in Paris.
summary_zh: 冯子材在镇南关大败法军，法国茹费理内阁倒台。

title: Beiyang Fleet formally established
summary: Li Hongzhang's northern fleet, built around German battleships, became Asia's largest navy on paper.
summary_zh: 北洋水师正式成军，以定远、镇远为主力。

title: First Sino-Japanese War
summary: Japan sinks the Beiyang Fleet. China gives up Taiwan in the Treaty of Shimonoseki.
summary_zh: 日本击溃北洋舰队，清朝在《马关条约》中割让台湾。

title: Battle of the Yellow Sea
summary: The Beiyang Fleet lost five ships to Japan's fleet; Deng Shichang went down with the Zhiyuan.
summary_zh: 北洋水师与日舰激战，致远舰沉没，邓世昌殉国。

title: Treaty of Shimonoseki
summary: Li Hongzhang ceded Taiwan and Penghu, recognised Korean independence, paid 200 million taels and opened ports to Japanese factories.
summary_zh: 李鸿章签约割台湾、澎湖，赔款二亿两，允日本设厂。

title: Petition of the examination candidates
summary: Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao led provincial candidates in petitioning against the treaty and for reform.
summary_zh: 康有为、梁启超联合举人上书，反对议和、要求变法。

title: Weihaiwei falls; Beiyang Fleet surrenders
summary: Japanese forces took Weihaiwei; Ding Ruchang killed himself and the Beiyang Fleet was lost.
summary_zh: 日军攻陷威海卫，丁汝昌自杀，北洋水师覆灭。

title: Triple Intervention
summary: Russia, Germany and France forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula for extra indemnity.
summary_zh: 俄德法干涉，日本归还辽东半岛，清加赎银三千万两。

title: Republic of Formosa resists Japan
summary: Taiwanese officials declared a republic; Liu Yongfu's Black Flags resisted Japanese occupation for months.
summary_zh: 台湾士绅成立台湾民主国，刘永福等抗日数月。

title: Germany seizes Jiaozhou Bay
summary: Using the killing of two missionaries, Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay, triggering a scramble for concessions.
summary_zh: 德国借巨野教案强占胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。

title: Hundred Days' Reform
summary: The Guangxu Emperor backs Kang Youwei's reforms until Empress Dowager Cixi stops them.
summary_zh: 光绪帝支持康有为推行变法，被慈禧太后发动政变中止。

title: Imperial University of Peking founded
summary: Founded during the Hundred Days' Reform, it survived the coup and became Peking University.
summary_zh: 戊戌变法中创办京师大学堂，即北京大学前身。

title: Yan Fu's translation of Evolution and Ethics
summary: Yan Fu's adaptation of Huxley popularised social Darwinism: 'survival of the fittest'.
summary_zh: 严复译述《天演论》，传播物竞天择思想。

title: Six Gentlemen executed
summary: After Cixi's coup, Tan Sitong and five other reformers were executed without trial.
summary_zh: 慈禧政变后，谭嗣同等六人被斩于菜市口。

title: Oracle bone script identified
summary: Wang Yirong recognised inscriptions on 'dragon bones' as Shang writing.
summary_zh: 王懿荣辨识龙骨上刻辞为商代文字。

title: Boxer Rebellion
summary: Boxers besiege the foreign legations and an eight-nation army occupies Beijing.
summary_zh: 义和团围攻各国使馆，八国联军攻占北京。

title: Dunhuang Library Cave discovered
summary: Wang Yuanlu found a sealed cave of tens of thousands of manuscripts, many later taken abroad.
summary_zh: 王圆箓发现藏经洞，大量文书后流散海外。

title: Mutual Protection of Southeast China
summary: Southern governors-general ignored the war edict and agreed with the powers to keep order.
summary_zh: 东南督抚拒奉宣战诏书，与列强约定互保。

title: New Policies proclaimed
summary: From exile in Xi'an, Cixi announced sweeping reforms in education, army and administration.
summary_zh: 慈禧在西安下诏变法，推行新政。

title: Boxer Protocol
summary: China must pay 450 million taels and let foreign troops guard the legations and the road to the sea.
summary_zh: 清朝须赔款四亿五千万两，并允许外国军队驻守使馆区及北京至海口的要地。

title: Subao case
summary: Zhang Binglin and Zou Rong were tried in the International Settlement for revolutionary writings.
summary_zh: 章炳麟、邹容因鼓吹革命被租界会审公廨审判。

title: British expedition to Tibet
summary: Younghusband's force fought its way to Lhasa; Tibetans defended Gyantse fortress.
summary_zh: 荣赫鹏率英军侵藏，江孜军民抗英。

title: Imperial examinations abolished
summary: After 1,300 years the examination system ends.
summary_zh: 延续一千三百年的科举制度宣告结束。

title: Tongmenghui founded
summary: Sun Yat-sen unites revolutionary groups in Tokyo with a program to overthrow the Qing and found a republic.
summary_zh: 孙中山在东京联合各革命团体，提出推翻清朝、建立共和的纲领。

title: Preparation for constitutional government
summary: After five ministers studied abroad, the court announced preparation for constitutional government.
summary_zh: 五大臣出洋考察后，清廷宣布预备仿行立宪。

title: Qiu Jin executed
summary: After Xu Xilin's failed rising, revolutionary Qiu Jin was executed.
summary_zh: 徐锡麟起义失败后，秋瑾在绍兴就义。

title: Guangxu and Cixi die
summary: The Guangxu Emperor died, followed a day later by Empress Dowager Cixi; the toddler Puyi was enthroned with Prince Chun as regent.
summary_zh: 光绪帝与慈禧太后相继去世，三岁的溥仪即位，载沣摄政。

title: Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway opens
summary: Zhan Tianyou built the first railway designed by Chinese engineers, crossing Badaling with a switchback.
summary_zh: 詹天佑主持修建京张铁路，为首条中国自主设计铁路。

title: Manchurian plague
summary: Wu Lien-teh contained a pneumonic plague that killed about 60,000.
summary_zh: 伍连德主持防疫，扑灭东北鼠疫。

title: Wuchang Uprising
summary: Army units revolt and province after province declares independence from the Qing.
summary_zh: 新军起义，各省纷纷宣布脱离清朝独立。

title: Huanghuagang uprising
summary: Huang Xing's Tongmenghui assault failed; 72 martyrs were buried at Huanghuagang.
summary_zh: 黄兴率同盟会起义失败，七十二烈士葬黄花岗。

title: Railway Protection Movement
summary: Anger at the nationalization of railways leads to protests and a massacre in Chengdu, months before the revolution.
summary_zh: 清廷将铁路收归国有，激起各地抗议，成都发生血案，几个月后革命爆发。

title: Outer Mongolia declares independence
summary: Amid the revolution, Khalkha princes declared independence and enthroned the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu as Bogd Khan in Urga.
summary_zh: 辛亥革命爆发后，喀尔喀王公宣布独立，拥立哲布尊丹巴为博克多汗。

title: The last emperor abdicates
summary: Puyi abdicates on 12 February 1912, ending more than two thousand years of imperial rule.
summary_zh: 1912年2月12日溥仪退位，延续两千多年的帝制宣告终结。

title: Republic of China proclaimed
summary: Sun Yat-sen was inaugurated in Nanjing as provisional president of the Republic of China on 1 January 1912, weeks before the Qing abdication.
summary_zh: 1912年1月1日孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，中华民国成立。
